```text
Si3N4 RI (n at 632.8nm)┤████████████████               │
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Physical Units |

| **Gate Oxide Reference Layer Sensitivity Range** | $3.5\text{ to }4.0$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ (EOT) |
| **Particle Size Distribution Monodispersity ($CV$)** | $< 3.0$ | Max $\le 3.0$ | $\%$ |

### Literature Context & Citations

- **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**:  
  Used to establish the optical refractive index benchmark ($n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$) and material density expectations for calibration nitride particles.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:  
  Defines bitline and wordline pitch specifications ($360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$) and physical equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) requirements ($3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$, with gate dielectric dry oxidation thickness of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$) driving metrology calibration limits.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:  
  Sets physical gate oxide thickness baseline targets ($3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$) grown at $900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ to evaluate surface roughness and particle contamination thresholds.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title:** Aerosol Deposition and Surface Seeding of Controlled Test Particles on Monitor Wafers
- **Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2 / µm)
- **Module:** Wet Chemistry / Metrology Surface Qualification
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
Establish a reproducible, cleanroom-compliant procedure for seeding controlled inorganic test particles ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{SiO}_2$) onto monitor silicon wafers. This baseline preparation is required to calibrate metrology systems and qualify the Particle Removal Efficiency (PRE) of downstream clean processes (such as RCA-1 / SC-1) prior to critical 180nm gate oxidation.

```text
+-----------------------+     +-------------------------+     +-----------------------+
|  Bare / Monitor Si    | --> | Pre-Deposition Surface  | --> | Controlled Aerosol    |
|  Wafer Inspection     |     | Prep (Dehydration/Clean)|     | Particle Seeding      |
+-----------------------+     +-------------------------+     +-----------------------+
                                                                          |
                                                                          v
+-----------------------+     +-------------------------+     +-----------------------+
| PRE / Clean Benchmark | <-- | Metrology Baseline      | <-- | N2 Purge & Soft Bake  |
| Ready                 |     | Surface Defect Mapping  |     | Fixation              |
+-----------------------+     +-------------------------+     +-----------------------+
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Cleaning & Dehydration:**
   - Prepare bare monitor wafers by executing an intermediate dump rinse using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for 3 minutes.
   - Strip any non-uniform native oxide layers using a $1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ dip for 15–30 seconds until the surface transitions to hydrophobic.
   - Perform wafer dehydration in a clean convection oven or hotplate at $150^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }200^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes to desorb physisorbed water molecules prior to particle loading.

2. **Aerosol Particle Suspension & Generation:**
   - Prepare a certified liquid suspension of uniform test particles ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ / $\text{SiO}_2$ spheres calibrated for Gen 2 sub-micron qualification) diluted in ultra-pure deionized water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
   - Load the colloidal suspension into a calibrated aerosol atomizer connected to high-purity carrier gas ($\text{N}_2$).

3. **Chamber Seeding & Deposition Cycle:**
   - Load the prepared monitor wafer onto the deposition chuck inside the sealed aerosol deposition chamber.
   - Introduce the atomized aerosol stream at a regulated gas flow rate, ensuring a uniform laminar flow showerhead distribution across the wafer surface.
   - Maintain the deposition cycle to target controlled particle count distribution across the wafer area.

4. **Drying and Particle Fixation:**
   - Purge the deposition chamber using high-purity $\text{N}_2$ to clear residual aerosol mist and prevent uncontrolled agglomeration.
   - Perform a low-temperature fixation bake at $150^\circ\text{C}$ to evaporate any residual moisture droplets, leaving dry, seeded surface particles adhered via van der Waals forces.

5. **Post-Seeding Metrology Handoff:**
   - Transfer the seeded wafer to an automated optical surface defect mapper (particle counter) to establish the pre-clean baseline count and coordinate map.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Tolerance / Limit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Rinse Water Resistivity** | $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Minimum threshold | In-line resistivity sensor |
| **Native Oxide Strip Time** | $15\text{ to }30\text{ s}$ | In $1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ solution | Immersion timer / Contact angle inspection |
| **Wafer Dehydration Bake Temperature** | $150^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }200^\circ\text{C}$ | Maintained for 30 minutes | Calibrated thermal thermocouple |
| **Test Particle Film Refractive Index ($\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$)** | $n = 2.00$ | $\pm 0.02$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Rinse specification: Dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for 3 minutes.
  - HF strip parameters: $1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ dip for 15–30 seconds for surface oxide removal and transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.
  - Final dry specification: High-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.

- **Source: Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming**
  - Substrate dehydration parameters: Bake at $150^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }200^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes to desorb physisorbed water molecules.

- **Source: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**
  - $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ physical metrics: Refractive index $n = 2.00 \pm 0.02$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$, high etch resistance against HF/BOE ($< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$).
citations: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming (Madou - Fundamentals of Microfabrication)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-LSS-001`
**Title:** Pre-Clean Baseline Laser Surface Scanning and Defect Coordinate Metrology Mapping  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm DRAM Integration)  
**Process Step Classification:** Metrology / Make  
**Parent Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > RCA-1 (SC-1) Organic & Particle Removal Bath Formulation and Bench Qualification > Post-RCA-1 Particle Removal Efficiency (PRE) and Surface Roughness Metrology Qualification > Si3N4/SiO2 Test Particle Deposition and Pre-Clean Baseline Defect Mapping > Pre-Clean Baseline Laser Surface Scanning and Defect Coordinate Metrology Mapping

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Wafer Load & Chuck   │
│  Vacuum Verification  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Notch Alignment &   │
│   Coordinate Origin   │
│         Setup         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Full-Wafer Laser    │
│  Surface Dark-Field   │
│       Scanning        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Defect Coordinate   │
│  Binning & KLARF Map  │
│        Export         │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Chuck Loading:**
   - Transfer the post-deposition test wafer (deposited with $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4/\text{SiO}_2$ calibration/challenge particles) onto the automated laser surface scanner end-effector.
   - Load wafer face-up onto the vacuum chuck. Engage vacuum retention ($\ge 80\text{ kPa}$) to eliminate wafer slip or vibration during high-speed rotation/translation.
2. **Pre-Alignment & Coordinate Origin Indexing:**
   - Optical pre-aligner detects the wafer notch/flat and center coordinates.
   - Establish the polar-to-Cartesian global reference coordinate system $(X=0.000\text{ mm}, Y=0.000\text{ mm})$ referenced directly to the wafer center with notch orientation defined at $0^\circ / 180^\circ$.
3. **Laser Optics & Dark-Field Scanning Setup:**
   - Select dark-field oblique/normal incidence solid-state laser channel calibrated for unpatterned bare silicon and ultra-thin dielectric surfaces.
   - Set scan recipe with a 3 mm edge exclusion zone across the wafer surface.
4. **Helical / Raster Surface Scan Execution:**
   - Initiate laser surface inspection via coordinated chuck rotation (r-$\theta$) or high-speed X-Y stage translation.
   - Collect scattered light signal through low-angle and high-angle PMT/photodiode collectors to capture Rayleigh-scattered signatures from particulate matter down to sub-micron baseline thresholds.
5. **Coordinate Extraction, Binning & Map Generation:**
   - Extract raw defect scatter events: compile physical coordinate pairs $(X_i, Y_i)$, scattering cross-section, and equivalent polystyrene latex (PSL) sphere diameter bin.
   - Export standard baseline defect coordinate map (`.klarf` / Klarf file format) into the metrology server for subsequent Post-RCA-1 Particle Removal Efficiency (PRE) coordinate-by-coordinate matching.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Edge Exclusion Zone** | $3.0 \pm 0.5$ | $\text{mm}$ | Automated recipe perimeter mask |
| **Coordinate Location Repeatability ($3\sigma$)** | $\le 10$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Repeat-pass defect re-detection registration |
| **Scan Surface Vacuum Chuck Pressure** | $\ge 80$ | $\text{kPa}$ | In-situ vacuum transducer interlock |
| **Substrate Center Offset ($\Delta X, \Delta Y$)** | $\le 15$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical notch/center pre-aligner sensor |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml)**:
   - Identifies the critical active area and feature dimensions for the 180nm DRAM node (access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$). Baseline particle coordinate fidelity prior to wet cleaning is critical to prevent bridging across cell contact geometries and stacked capacitor structures.
2. **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology](docs/context.yaml)**:
   - Establishes the non-destructive optical characterization framework and tight process limits required for thin dielectrics (e.g. 3.5 nm dry gate oxide with sub-Ångström precision $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ and multi-point automated mapping). Ensures zero chemical or optical contamination from prior metrology passes before thermal oxidation.
3. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering](docs/context.yaml)**:
   - Details critical dimensions including the 360 nm to 400 nm bitline/wordline pitches and the $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical gate oxide thickness grown at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation. Undetected pre-clean particulate defects propagate directly into fatal dielectric gate punch-through and retention degradation ($< 64\text{ ms}$ at 85°C).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

```text
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Post-RCA-1 Scan &    │
│     Defect Mapping     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Differential PRE    │
│  Calculation by Size   │
│          Bin           │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Acceptance Gate &    │
│    Tool Disposition    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Stage Positioning**:
   - Transfer bare or post-process 180nm test wafers to the commercial laser surface particle scanner chuck using an automated end-effector or vacuum wand.
   - Align wafer notch/flat and verify stage motion repeatability and alignment tolerance within **±5 µm** (Gen 2 standard alignment constraint).

2. **Optical System Setup & Surface Calibration**:
   - Set laser source to darkfield scattering detection mode to detect particulate light scattering across the substrate plane.
   - For dielectric verification monitoring (underlying oxide/photoresist thickness), configure 9-point or 49-point automated wafer mapping tracking radial film non-uniformity across the substrate.

3. **Pre-Clean Baseline Inspection (Pre-Scan)**:
   - Perform full-surface laser scan on the wafer prior to RCA-1 immersion.
   - Classify scattered defect counts into standard particle diameter bins:
     - Sub-micron fine particles: $\le 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$
     - Standard defect particles: $0.5\ \mu\text{m} - 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$
     - Gross particulate contaminants: $> 1.3\ \mu\text{m}$
   - Store baseline spatial coordinates $(X_i, Y_i)$ and count $N_{\text{pre}, \text{bin}}$.

4. **Post-RCA-1 Wet Clean Inspection (Post-Scan)**:
   - Following SC-1 bath processing and DI water spin-drying, reload the wafer into the laser scanner under identical coordinate alignment (within **±5 µm**).
   - Execute darkfield laser raster scan and log post-clean defect count $N_{\text{post}, \text{bin}}$ and newly added particles ($N_{\text{added}}$).

5. **Particle Removal Efficiency (PRE) Quantification**:
   - Compute PRE across each discrete particle size bin using:
     $$\text{PRE}_{\text{bin}} (\%) = \frac{N_{\text{pre}, \text{bin}} - N_{\text{post}, \text{bin}}}{N_{\text{pre}, \text{bin}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Verify that residual particle density does not violate the active area budget for 180nm access transistor layouts ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

6. **Defect Map Disposition & Archival**:
   - Export 49-point spatial particle density heatmaps to the fab manufacturing execution database.
   - Flag wafers exceeding critical defect thresholds for wet-bench reclean or bath reclamation.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Metric / Target | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Laser interferometer & optical edge sensor |
| **Film Thickness Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry validation |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Density** | $9\text{ or }49$ | $\text{points / wafer}$ | Automated radial raster mapping |
| **Critical Defect Size Inspection Floor** | $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Darkfield Rayleigh scatter threshold |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**:
  - Validates automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping for tracking radial non-uniformity across runs.
  - Specifies gate dielectric measurement precision benchmark at $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0.5\text{ \AA}$) and photoresist metrology ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ measured within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$).
- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**:
  - Establishes the Gen 2 macroscopic mechanical stage alignment tolerance specification of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ (improved from Gen 1 $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$).
  - Defines particulate and layer scaling baseline referenced against $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ thin films.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Establishes critical defect sensitivity constraints based on the unit cell layout geometry: access transistor gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-AFM-001`
**Title:** AFM Post-SC-1 Surface Microroughness ($R_q$/$R_a$) and Etch Pitting Topography Qualification  
**Process Step Hierarchy:**  
`180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip` $\rightarrow$ `180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm)` $\rightarrow$ `Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean & In-Situ HF Dip` $\rightarrow$ `RCA-1 (SC-1) Organic & Particle Removal Bath` $\rightarrow$ `Post-RCA-1 PRE & Surface Roughness Metrology` $\rightarrow$ `AFM Post-SC-1 Surface Microroughness Qualification`  
**Classification:** Gen 1 (mm) Baseline / Metrology Qualification  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) inspection protocol used to verify silicon surface topography, root-mean-square microroughness ($R_q$), arithmetic average roughness ($R_a$), and etch pit formation following the RCA-1 (SC-1) alkaline clean. 

Prior to thermal dry oxidation of a ultra-thin 3.5 nm gate oxide (for 180nm / Gen 1 DRAM pass gates), excessive microroughness or local crystal-originated pit (COP) etching induced by SC-1 ($5:1:1\ \text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{NH}_4\text{OH}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ base etching) can cause gate oxide dielectric breakdown, degraded electron channel mobility, and premature breakdown voltage ($V_{BD}$) failure.

```
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       |   Post-SC-1 Cleaned & Dump-Rinsed Wafer (18.2 MOhm-cm)|
       +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       |  Tapping-Mode AFM Stage Load & Laser Alignment        |
       |  (Drive Freq ~300 kHz, Scan Area: 1 um x 1 um / 5 um)  |
       +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       |  Topography Mapping & 2nd-Order Flattening            |
       |  Extraction of Rq (RMS), Ra, and Peak-to-Valley (Z)   |
       +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       |  Acceptance Criteria Check:                           |
       |  - Rq <= 0.15 nm                                      |
       |  - Max Etch Pit Depth <= 0.50 nm                      |
       |  - Surface Roughness Ra <= 0.12 nm                    |
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 2. Equipment & Tooling Setup
- **Metrology System:** Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) equipped with acoustic isolation hood and active vibration isolation table.
- **Probe Tip:** High-resolution non-contact / tapping-mode silicon cantilever probe (nominal tip radius $\le 10\text{ nm}$, force constant $k \approx 40\text{ N/m}$, resonant frequency $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$).
- **Environment:** Class 100 / ISO 5 cleanroom airflow bay; temperature: $22.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$; relative humidity: $45\% \pm 5\%$.
- **Sample:** Prime p-type Si (100) test coupon/wafer, sampled immediately following the 10-minute SC-1 clean ($70^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }75^\circ\text{C}$, 5-cycle cascade dump rinse to $>16\text{ M}\Omega\text{-cm}$) and $\text{N}_2$ dry.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Inspection Tool Verification & Tip Integrity
1. Verify AFM vibration isolation stage pressure and acoustic hood lock.
2. Load a fresh silicon tapping-mode probe into the cantilever holder.
3. Align the four-quadrant photodiode detector laser until sum signal is maximized ($> 6.0\text{ V}$) and vertical/horizontal deflection voltages are balanced to $0.00\text{ V} \pm 0.05\text{ V}$.
4. Run tune sweep to locate probe resonance; lock the operating drive frequency at $-5\%$ below peak resonance ($\sim 290\text{--}300\text{ kHz}$) with a free-air oscillation amplitude setpoint of $2.0\text{ V}$.

#### Step 2: Sample Loading & Coordinate Alignment
1. Transfer post-SC-1 dried Si coupon to the AFM sample vacuum chuck.
2. Engage vacuum hold-down ($> 70\text{ kPa}$).
3. Position the optical objective over the wafer active device region:
   - Sample at least 5 standard site locations (Center, North, South, East, West with edge exclusion $\ge 5\text{ mm}$).
   - Set scan window resolution grid:
     - **Survey Scan:** $5.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 5.0\ \mu\text{m}$ (512 lines $\times$ 512 samples) to inspect for localized etch pits and pinholes.
     - **Fine Roughness Scan:** $1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ (512 lines $\times$ 512 samples) for precise $R_q$ and $R_a$ calculation.

#### Step 3: Topographic Scanning Protocol
1. Initiate automated approach until amplitude setpoint damping reaches $75\%\text{--}80\%$ of free air amplitude.
2. Configure scan parameters:
   - **Scan Rate:** $0.50\text{ Hz}$ to $0.75\text{ Hz}$ (trace/retrace).
   - **Integral Gain:** Optimized until trace and retrace profile curves overlay without ringing.
   - **Proportional Gain:** Set to $1.5\times$ Integral Gain.
3. Acquire raw height retrace channels for both the $5.0\ \mu\text{m}$ survey and $1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ fine scans at each location.

#### Step 4: Flattening & Metrology Extraction
1. Apply a standard 2nd-order polynomial plane fit (`Flattening - Order 2`) across the raw height image to eliminate thermal drift and sample tilt artifacts.
2. Extract the surface microroughness statistics across the $1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ field:
   $$R_q = \sqrt{\frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N (Z_i - \bar{Z})^2}, \quad R_a = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N |Z_i - \bar{Z}|$$
3. Perform a depth threshold analysis on the $5.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 5.0\ \mu\text{m}$ survey image to calculate:
   - Maximum Peak-to-Valley height ($Z_{max} - Z_{min}$).
   - Pit depth count for depressions exceeding baseline roughness.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter ID | Parameter Name | Metric Specification | Unit | Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-AFM-01** | Post-SC-1 RMS Microroughness ($R_q$) | **$\le 0.15$** ($1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ scan) | $\text{nm}$ | Automated AFM Software Metric |
| **AC-AFM-02** | Arithmetic Average Roughness ($R_a$) | **$\le 0.12$** ($1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ scan) | $\text{nm}$ | Automated AFM Software Metric |
| **AC-AFM-03** | Max Etch Pit Depth / Peak-to-Valley Delta | **$\le 0.50$** (relative to nominal background Si etch) | $\text{nm}$ | AFM Section Profile Analysis |
| **AC-AFM-04** | Cascade Rinse Deionized Water Resistivity | **$> 16.0$** (prior to wafer unload) | $\text{M}\Omega\text{-cm}$ | In-line Resistivity Sensor |

*Disposition Rule:* If $R_q > 0.15\text{ nm}$ or etch pit depth $> 0.50\text{ nm}$, the SC-1 bath ammonium hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$) ratio or bath temperature ($70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}75^\circ\text{C}$) exceeds acceptable micro-etch limits; quarantine the lot, dump SC-1 chemistry, and reformulate.

---

### 5. Context Citations
1. **RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering:**
   - Chemistry formulation ($5\ \text{UPW} : 1\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : 1\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$), bath temperature ($70^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }75^\circ\text{C}$, 10 min immersion), micro-etching baseline ($\sim 0.5\text{ nm}$ silicon base etch), and cascade dump rinse resistivity target ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\text{-cm}$ DI water, rinse endpoint $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\text{-cm}$).
2. **Architecture & Integration Context (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip):**
   - 3.5 nm dry gate oxide thickness constraints dictating sub-angstrom/angstrom-level surface roughness thresholds ($R_q \le 0.15\text{ nm}$).
3. **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid:**
   - 180nm critical dimension and baseline physical grid resolution ($5\text{ nm}$) constraints.
citations: SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid (SkyWater Technology / Google Open Source Silicon)
RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-AFM-021`
**Title:** AFM Instrument Cantilever Calibration and Reference Substrate Baseline Setup  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Process Step:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > RCA-1 (SC-1) Organic & Particle Removal Bath Formulation and Bench Qualification > Post-RCA-1 Particle Removal Efficiency (PRE) and Surface Roughness Metrology Qualification > AFM Post-SC-1 Surface Microroughness ($R_q/R_a$) and Etch Pitting Topography Qualification > **AFM Instrument Cantilever Calibration and Reference Substrate Baseline Setup**  
**Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Calibration Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Mount Reference    │
│     Sample & Tip      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Laser Alignment &   │
│  Photodiode Zeroing   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Cantilever Thermal   │
│   Tune & Deflection   │
│      Sensitivity      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Reference Standard   │
│    Scan & Baseline    │
│        Zeroing        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Acceptance Criteria  │
│     Verification      │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Vibration Isolation & Environment Setup**:
   - Verify acoustic enclosure seal and active pneumatic isolation table pressure. Ensure the acoustic and mechanical vibration damping is stabilized.
2. **Cantilever Loading & Laser Alignment**:
   - Securely load an AFM cantilever probe (tapping/non-contact mode silicon tip) into the cantilever holder assembly.
   - Adjust the optical tracking laser optics to center the beam spot onto the reflective backside of the cantilever apex.
   - Center the reflected beam onto the 4-quadrant position-sensitive photodetector (PSPD) to zero the vertical ($A-B$) and horizontal ($C-D$) differential photodiode signals ($\text{Differential Voltage} \approx 0.00\text{ V}$).
3. **Thermal Tune & Optical Deflection Sensitivity ($InvOLS$)**:
   - Disengage probe $> 1\text{ mm}$ above the substrate; execute a cantilever thermal power spectrum capture in ambient air to determine fundamental resonance frequency ($f_0$) and quality factor ($Q$).
   - Perform a ramp cycle on a rigid sapphire/silicon calibration reference substrate to establish optical deflection sensitivity ($\text{nm/V}$).
4. **Spring Constant ($k$) Calibration & Baseline Noise Floor Verification**:
   - Calculate effective spring constant via thermal noise power integration (Sader/Equipartition method).
   - Park tip at scanning setpoint height above a reference standard; capture a zero-scan amplitude profile for 60 seconds to quantify baseline $Z$-sensor RMS noise floor.
5. **Reference Baseline Lateral & Vertical Calibration**:
   - Engage on the Gen 2 reference standard step grid. Calibrate lateral scanner piezo non-linearity and verify stage positioning accuracy across orthogonal axes within the Gen 2 calibration envelope.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
       AFM Baseline Metrology Acceptance Thresholds
 ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
 │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■ 5.0        │ Stage Alignment Tolerance (± µm)
 │░░░ 0.35                                                │ Optical Z-Noise Floor / Gate Oxide Budget (nm)
 │▒ 0.05                                                  │ Metrology Precision Resolution (± nm)
 └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
  0                       2                      4        
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gen 2 Stage Positioning / Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Lateral reference grid step-pitch displacement measurement (per Gen 2 mechanical alignment limits) |
| **Optical Metrology Precision Resolution** | $\le \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Sub-Angstrom calibrated $Z$-sensor height repeatability on step standard |
| **Z-Sensor Background Noise Floor (RMS)** | $\le 0.35$ (within $10\%$ budget of $3.5\text{ nm}$ oxide) | $\text{nm}$ | Static zero-scan baseline RMS displacement ($R_q$) measurement |
| **Dry Gate Oxide Target Layer Reference Baseline** | $3.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Vertical step standard baseline offset corresponding to the gate oxide target thickness |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Source: Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - *Context Rule / Metric*: Macroscopic stage alignment tolerance requirements evolve from Gen 1 ($\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$) down to **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ in Gen 2**, defining the calibration boundaries for stage travel and alignment.
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - *Context Rule / Metric*: Metrology resolution baseline requirements establish sub-Angstrom precision (**$\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$**) when monitoring the **$3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide** target layer.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Context Rule / Metric*: Access transistor channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) and unit cell layout constraints set the nanoscale planar sensitivity criteria for critical dielectric interface preparation and gate oxide growth.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Post-SC-1 Silicon Wafer AFM Topographical Scanning and Microroughness ($R_q$/$R_a$) Mapping

- **Module**: Metrology / Pre-Oxidation Surface Qualification
- **Process Step Node**: 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (~3.5 nm physical target)
- **Action Type**: Buy (Automated AFM Metrology Tool Benchmarking & Wafer Acceptance)
- **Target Cell Architecture**: 180nm 1T1C DRAM Cell ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $8F^2 / 6F^2$ Folded Bitline Topology)

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Load & Chuck   │
│         Vacuum         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Tip Approach &     │
│    Resonance Tuning    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Multi-Point AFM     │
│        Scanning        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Topography &      │
│  Roughness Extraction  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Acceptance Decision:  │
│       Ra/Rq Spec       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Vacuum Chucking**:
   - Transfer the post-SC-1 (RCA-1) and post-rinse/dry silicon wafer via automated cleanroom end-effector into the Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) enclosure (Class 1 / ISO Class 3 environment).
   - Seat the wafer onto the vacuum chuck and verify vacuum seal ($\ge 80\text{ kPa}$ differential pressure). Ensure environmental isolation active (anti-vibration table floated, acoustic enclosure sealed).

2. **Probe Inspection & Resonance Tuning (Tapping / Non-Contact Mode)**:
   - Mount a high-aspect-ratio, ultra-sharp single-crystal silicon cantilever (tip nominal radius $\le 7\text{ nm}$, resonant frequency $f_0 \approx 300\text{ kHz}$).
   - Perform automated laser alignment to quadrant photodiode to maximize sum signal.
   - Sweep acoustic excitation frequency around $f_0$ to tune drive amplitude and lock operating tapping amplitude at 80% free amplitude ($A/A_0 = 0.80$).

3. **Coordinate Navigation & Recipe Execution**:
   - Align wafer notch/flat and register coordinate system.
   - Program automated multi-site scanning across the standard wafer layout matching dielectric thickness validation sites (e.g., 9-point or 49-point grid layout spanning center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zone).
   - Set scan dimensions to $1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ (with optional $5.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 5.0\ \mu\text{m}$ wide-field scans to detect microroughness and etch pitting clusters) at a scan rate of $0.5\text{ Hz}$ to $1.0\text{ Hz}$ with $512 \times 512$ pixel resolution.

4. **Surface Topography Acquisition & Profile Flattening**:
   - Engage tip with soft-landing algorithm; verify stable phase contrast and feedback lock (integral and proportional gains optimized).
   - Capture height trace/retrace, amplitude, and phase channels.
   - Apply real-time 1st-order/2nd-order plane fit and line-by-line flattening to remove tilt, bowing, and scanner bow artifacts without clipping nanoscale features.

5. **Microroughness Extraction & Defect/Pit Tagging**:
   - Extract arithmetic average roughness ($R_a$), root-mean-square roughness ($R_q$), and maximum peak-to-valley height ($R_{\max}$).
   - Evaluate height distribution histograms for asymmetric negative tailing indicating post-SC-1 chemical etch pits or alkaline-induced micro-voiding.
   - Export 9-point/49-point wafer topographical map to the fab yield and SPC system.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon Microroughness ($R_q$ / RMS)** | $\le 0.15$ | $\text{nm}$ (RMS) | AFM scan ($1\ \mu\text{m} \times 1\ \mu\text{m}$, 9-point / 49-point wafer map) |
| **Arithmetic Mean Roughness ($R_a$)** | $\le 0.12$ | $\text{nm}$ | AFM trace ($512 \times 512$ points, post-flattening) |
| **Max Peak-to-Valley Height ($R_{\max}$ / Etch Pit Depth)** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | AFM bearing analysis & height histogram thresholding |
| **Surface Scanned Gate Area Feature Scale** | Matches $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Metrology scan window resolution ($512 \times 512$ grid) |
| **Oxide Pre-Clean Uniformity Baseline** | Surface compatible with $3.5\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) dry gate oxide | $\text{nm}$ | Correlated via downstream Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Context References

- **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness**: Target gate dielectric is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness, requiring sub-Angstrom precision surface smoothness before furnace insertion (*Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
- **Sub-Angstrom Metrology Precision Reference**: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) requires ellipsometric monitoring with sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$), dictating that pre-oxidation SC-1 cleaning does not roughen the silicon substrate or create atomic steps that induce localized oxide thinning (*Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*).
- **Wafer Mapping Grid Standard**: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial non-uniformity across process benches and furnaces (*Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*).
- **Access Transistor Channel Geometry**: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ with bitline and wordline pitch of approximately $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, requiring AFM scan fields ($1\ \mu\text{m} \times 1\ \mu\text{m}$) capable of resolving sub-channel pitch surface morphology (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench; Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-GTOX-007`  
**Title:** Etch Pitting Statistical Analysis and Surface Quality Qualification for Gate Oxidation  
**Process Step Hierarchy:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation [Wet Chemistry] > RCA-1 (SC-1) Organic & Particle Removal Bath Formulation and Bench Qualification [Wet Chemistry] > Post-RCA-1 Particle Removal Efficiency (PRE) and Surface Roughness Metrology Qualification [Metrology] > AFM Post-SC-1 Surface Microroughness (Rq/Ra) and Etch Pitting Topography Qualification [Metrology] > Etch Pitting Statistical Analysis and Surface Quality Qualification for Gate Oxidation [Metrology]  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm class)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Execution & Disposition  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the statistical sampling, AFM etch pit density quantification, surface microroughness extraction, and final wafer surface quality qualification protocol prior to loading bare silicon wafers into the dry thermal oxidation quartz tube furnace for 3.5 nm gate dielectric growth ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                       AFM & Surface Metrology Flow                       |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1] 9-Point Radial Wafer Sampling (Center, Mid-radius, Edge)       |
|                                    |                                     |
|                                    v                                     |
|  [Step 2] AFM Scan Acquisition (1 um x 1 um & 5 um x 5 um Tapping Mode)  |
|                                    |                                     |
|                                    v                                     |
|  [Step 3] Flattening & Statistical Extraction (Rq, Ra, Pit Count/Depth)  |
|                                    |                                     |
|                                    v                                     |
|  [Step 4] Lot Disposition & Transfer to 850°C-900°C Quartz Tube Furnace  |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Wafer Inspection & Automated Sampling Setup**:
   - Transfer post-SC-1/pre-gate oxidation monitor wafers to the automated Atomic Force Microscope (AFM) cassette station under Class 1 laminar flow hood.
   - Program a standard 9-point radial sampling map across the 200 mm wafer (Center, 4 points at mid-radius $r = R/2$, and 4 points at edge exclusion boundary $5\text{ mm}$ from bevel).

2. **High-Resolution Topography & Etch Pit Scanning**:
   - Engage non-contact / tapping mode AFM probe (tip radius $< 5\text{ nm}$).
   - Perform dual-field scanning at each site:
     - Area A: $1\ \mu\text{m} \times 1\ \mu\text{m}$ scan ($512 \times 512$ pixels, scan rate $0.5\text{ Hz}$) for high-frequency microroughness ($R_a$, $R_q$).
     - Area B: $5\ \mu\text{m} \times 5\ \mu\text{m}$ scan ($512 \times 512$ pixels, scan rate $0.5\text{ Hz}$) for crystallographic SC-1 induced etch pit / micro-void detection.

3. **Statistical Topography Flattening & Defect Extraction**:
   - Apply 2nd-order polynomial plane flattening to remove macro-bowing/tilt.
   - Identify etch pits using depth-threshold segmentation: flag any depressions with depth $> 0.5\text{ nm}$ and aspect ratio indicative of SC-1 chemical etching along (111) planes.
   - Calculate total pit count per scan area, compute Etch Pit Density (EPD in $\text{pits/cm}^2$), and extract root-mean-square roughness ($R_q$).

4. **Statistical Lot Disposition & Furnace Release**:
   - Perform ANOVA and $3\sigma$ control limit analysis across the 9 sampling sites.
   - Verify all sites meet roughness and pit density criteria to prevent local oxide thinning and premature breakdown of the 3.5 nm physical gate oxide.
   - If qualified, generate electronic run-card sign-off and immediately dispatch the lot to the quartz oxidation tube furnace (within $< 2\text{ hours}$ Q-time to prevent native oxide regrowth).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Metric | Target / Specification | Tool / Metrology Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Surface Microroughness ($R_q$ / RMS)** | $\le 0.15\text{ nm}$ across all 9 scan points ($1\ \mu\text{m} \times 1\ \mu\text{m}$ scan) | High-Resolution Tapping-Mode AFM |
| **Etch Pit Density (EPD)** | $\le 5 \times 10^3\text{ pits/cm}^2$ (Zero pits detected in $5\ \mu\text{m} \times 5\ \mu\text{m}$ area) | Automated AFM Topographical Particle/Void Filter |
| **Etch Pit Maximum Depth ($d_{max}$)** | $< 0.5\text{ nm}$ (to prevent local electric-field distortion under 3.5 nm gate oxide) | AFM Cross-Sectional Profilometry |
| **Pre-Oxidation Clean-to-Furnace Q-Time** | $\le 120\text{ minutes}$ ($< 2.0\text{ hours}$) | Cleanroom MES Automated Lot Tracker |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - *Context applied*: Thermal oxidation kinetics governing the thin gate oxide regime; specifies dry oxidation at 900°C–1000°C in pure dry $\text{O}_2$ producing high-dielectric breakdown gate oxide ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) with minimal interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$) at a target thickness of 3.5 nm to 4.0 nm. Surface pitting and roughness must be strictly controlled at this stage because any step or pit approaching ~0.5 nm introduces critical localized thinning in a 3.5 nm film.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Context applied*: 180nm DRAM 1T1C transistor integration baseline with thermally grown gate dielectric ($\text{SiO}_2$) at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness and bitline/wordline pitch of 360 nm to 400 nm.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-WET-180NM-004`  
**Title:** Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution  
**Integration Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Wet Chemistry  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Sequence Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Post SC-1 Wafer     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Dilute HF Dip 1:50   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Intermediate QDR /   │
│     Overflow Rinse     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  RCA-2 SC-2 Bath 75C   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Final Dump Rinse    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Marangoni / IPA / N2  │
│          Dry           │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Etch Inspection & Chemistry Formulation
1. Verify wafer lot has completed SC-1 clean and intermediate dump rinse.
2. Prepare the **Dilute HF (DHF)** bath in a PVDF/PTFE tank:
   - Mix **1 part 49% HF : 50 parts UPW** (alternatively 1:100; yielding **0.5% to 1.0% HF**).
   - Stabilize bath temperature at **22°C**.
3. Prepare the **RCA-2 / SC-2** solution in a high-purity quartz immersion tank:
   - Mix **6 parts UPW : 1 part 37% HCl : 1 part 30% H₂O₂**.
   - Heat and stabilize bath at **75°C ± 2°C** (process window: **70°C to 80°C**).

#### Step 2: Dilute HF Native Oxide Strip
1. Immense the wafer carrier into the dilute HF bath (0.5%–1.0% HF) at **22°C**.
2. Process for **15 to 30 seconds**.
3. Verify visual endpoint transition: surface changes from hydrophilic to **hydrophobic dewetting** (water cleanly sheets off bare silicon without clinging/wetting).
4. Perform rapid transfer (< 5 seconds) to prevent uncontrolled air exposure.

#### Step 3: Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)
1. Immerse carrier in overflow/dump rinse tank using **18.2 MΩ·cm Ultra-Pure Water (UPW)**.
2. Cycle dump rinse for **3 minutes** (or minimum 5 purge cycles) until bath effluent resistivity exceeds **> 16 MΩ·cm**.

#### Step 4: RCA-2 (SC-2) Acid Desorption / Metallic Decontamination
1. Transfer wafer carrier directly into the preheated SC-2 quartz tank at **75°C ± 2°C**.
2. Maintain immersion for **10 minutes** (10–15 min window) to desorb alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and transition heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$, $\text{Au}$) through soluble metal-chloride coordination complexes.

#### Step 5: Final Dump Rinse & Wafer Drying
1. Cascade dump rinse using **18.2 MΩ·cm UPW** until bath effluent resistivity stabilizes at **18.2 MΩ·cm**.
2. Immediately transfer to drying chamber: execute filtered high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry, Marangoni dry, or isopropyl alcohol (IPA) vapor drying.
3. Queue dry wafers directly for thermal dry gate oxidation furnace loading.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Exact Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DHF Immersion Time** | `22.5` | `15 to 30` | $\text{s}$ (seconds) | Wet bench automated timer |
| **DHF Bath Temperature** | `22` | `± 1` | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-line PTFE thermocouple |
| **SC-2 Bath Temperature**| `75` | `± 2` (Range: `70 to 80`) | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Quartz bath calibrated RTD |
| **SC-2 Immersion Time** | `10` | `10 to 15` | $\text{min}$ (minutes) | Wet bench automated timer |
| **Rinse Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | `> 16.0` (final: `18.2`) | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line conductivity/resistivity probe |
| **Surface Dewetting State**| Hydrophobic | Zero wetting/sheeting off bare Si | Boolean / Qualitative | In-situ optical dewetting sensor / camera |

---

### 3. Literature Citations

- **Source 1:** *RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering*  
  - Dilute HF ratio (1:50 to 1:100 HF:UPW, 0.5%–1.0%), 15–30 s immersion at 22°C, and hydrophobic dewetting endpoint transition.  
  - RCA-2 composition (6 parts UPW : 1 part 37% HCl : 1 part 30% H₂O₂), 75°C ± 2°C temperature, 10 min immersion, metal-chloride complexation mechanism, 18.2 MΩ·cm final rinse, and IPA vapor / Marangoni / filtered N₂ drying.
- **Source 2:** *Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*  
  - 1:50 HF:H₂O oxide strip timing (15–30 s), intermediate 18.2 MΩ·cm dump rinse (3 min), and SC-2 operating temperature band (70°C–80°C) targeting alkali and heavy metal elimination.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification

**Branch Path:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Node)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Flowchart

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Post RCA-1 DI Dump   │
│         Rinse          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   1:50 DHF Immersion   │
│        (15-30s)        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    DI Water Cascade    │
│  Overflow Rinse (18.2  │
│        MOhm-cm)        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Hydrophobic Surface   │
│   Dewet Verification   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Transfer to RCA-2 /   │
│     SC-2 Wet Bench     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety Protocol & PPE Verification:**
   - Confirm chemical wet bench laminar exhaust flow is within specification.
   - Don acid-resistant apron, face shield, and heavy-duty nitrile over-gloves.
   - Verify unexpired **calcium gluconate gel** is present and within arm's reach at the wet bench before opening chemical baths.

2. **DHF Bath Preparation & Temperature Stabilization:**
   - Ensure the PVDF/PFA bath is charged with high-purity **1:50 HF:H₂O** (1 part 49% HF to 50 parts ultra-pure deionized water).
   - Maintain and verify ambient bath operating temperature at **25°C**.

3. **Substrate Immersion & Native Oxide Etch:**
   - Transfer the wafer cassette directly from the post-RCA-1 deionized water dump rinse into the 1:50 DHF tank.
   - Immerse the batch for **15 to 30 seconds** with gentle vertical agitation to strip the chemical/native oxide film without over-etching substrate isolation structures.

4. **Deionized Water Cascade Rinse:**
   - Immediately transfer the carrier into the adjacent quick-dump/overflow cascade rinse tank.
   - Rinse continuously with ultra-pure deionized water having a resistivity of **18.2 MΩ·cm** for **3 minutes** to halt chemical reactions and wash away ionic fluorides.

5. **Hydrophobic Dewet Verification & Transfer:**
   - Withdraw the wafer slowly from the DI water stream under laminar flow.
   - Inspect the silicon wafer surface: verify complete dewetting (water sheeting breaks completely into rolling beads or sheets off immediately, indicating silicon-hydride Si-H termination / hydrophobic state).
   - Promptly transfer the cassette to the **RCA-2 (SC-2)** cleaning bath (heated to 70°C–80°C) for metallic ionic decontamination without allowing the bare silicon surface to sit dry in ambient air.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Exact Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DHF Volumetric Concentration** | 1:50 | 1:50 ($\pm 2\%$) | HF:H₂O volume ratio | Automated inline titration / chemical dosing |
| **Bath Etch Duration** | 22.5 | 15 – 30 | seconds ($s$) | Automated wet bench recipe timer |
| **DHF Bath Temperature** | 25 | $\pm 1.0$ | degrees Celsius (°C) | Inline RTD temperature sensor |
| **Cascade Rinse Water Resistivity**| 18.2 | $\ge 18.0$ | Megaohm-centimeters (MΩ·cm) | Inline resistivity conductivity probe |
| **Surface Hydrophobic Transition** | Complete Dewet | $100\%$ dewet | Binary pass/fail (hydrophobic sheet break) | Optical dewet / in-situ surface tension sensor |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - *Dilute HF concentration & immersion time:* "Hydrofluoric Dip: 1:50 HF:H2O dip for 15-30 seconds to strip native oxide; surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic."
  - *DI water quality & intermediate rinse duration:* "Dump rinse with 18.2 MOhm-cm deionized water for 3 minutes."
  - *Subsequent processing stage:* "RCA-2 (SC-2): 6 parts Deionized H2O, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% HCl), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% H2O2). Temperature: 70°C-80°C for 10 minutes."
  - *Safety protocol:* "Caution: Hydrofluoric acid penetrates skin and binds calcium; calcium gluconate gel must be present at all times." (via *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Precision Tooling & Fixturing for Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification  
**Task Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification > Precision Tooling & Fixturing  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Safety Classification:** High Hazard (Hydrofluoric Acid Protocol Required)

---

## 1. Safety & PPE Protocols

```text
       ┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
       │               SAFETY & PPE PROTOCOLS                   │
       ├────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤
       │ 1. Mandatory PPE: Heavy-duty Neoprene/Viton outer      │
       │    gloves over Nitrile, chemical splash face shield,   │
       │    acid-resistant apron.                               │
       │ 2. Safety Equipment: Calcium gluconate gel (2.5%)      │
       │    inspected, unexpired, and immediately accessible.   │
       │ 3. Cleanroom Exhaust: Dedicated laminar acid exhaust   │
       │    fume hood operational.                              │
       └────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

> [!CAUTION]
> **Hydrofluoric Acid Hazard:** HF penetrates skin deeply, dissociated fluoride ions scavenge and bind systemic calcium and magnesium. Calcium gluconate gel must be on-site and present at all times.

---

## 2. Precision Tooling & Fixture Preparation

1. **Carrier Fixture Inspection & Material Compatibility:**
   - Verify wafer cassette and dipping handle are manufactured from virgin **PTFE (Teflon)** or **PVDF**. *Never use quartz, glass, or metallic tooling in HF baths.*
   - Inspect wafer cassette teeth for mechanical tolerances (pitch clearance: $4.76\text{ mm} \pm 0.1\text{ mm}$) to ensure minimal surface-contact area and zero pinching.
2. **Dilute HF Bath Makeup:**
   - Prepare a **1:50 HF:H₂O** dilute bath in a clean PTFE tank:
     - 50 parts ultra-pure Deionized (DI) Water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
     - 1 part Hydrofluoric Acid ($49\%\text{ HF}$, semiconductor grade).
   - Equilibrate chemical bath temperature to $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$.

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```text
 ┌───────────────────────┐
 │ 1. Load Wafers        │ ---> PTFE Cassette (minimize edge contact)
 └──────────┬────────────┘
            │
            ▼
 ┌───────────────────────┐
 │ 2. Immersion Dip      │ ---> 1:50 HF:H2O at 25°C for 15–30 seconds
 └──────────┬────────────┘
            │
            ▼
 ┌───────────────────────┐
 │ 3. Quick Dump Rinse   │ ---> 18.2 MOhm-cm DI Water for 3 minutes
 └──────────┬────────────┘
            │
            ▼
 ┌───────────────────────┐
 │ 4. Nitrogen Blow-Dry  │ ---> High-purity N2 gun (filtered 0.02 µm)
 └──────────┬────────────┘
            │
            ▼
 ┌───────────────────────┐
 │ 5. Verification       │ ---> Complete water de-wetting / bead roll-off
 └───────────────────────┘
```

1. **Cassette Loading:**
   - Load processed wafers into the dedicated PTFE carrier fixture handling exclusively from the edge exclusion zone ($< 3\text{ mm}$).
2. **Native Oxide Etch Immersion:**
   - Lower fixture vertically into the 1:50 HF tank.
   - Submerge wafers completely for **$15\text{ to }30\text{ seconds}$** at $25^\circ\text{C}$ to strip native oxide ($10\text{ to }15\text{ seconds}$ minimum reaction threshold).
   - Apply gentle vertical oscillation ($\pm 5\text{ mm}$, $1\text{ Hz}$) using the PTFE handle to prevent bubble entrapment and boundary layer stagnation.
3. **Immediate Dump Rinse:**
   - Swiftly transfer fixture into the Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) tank within $5\text{ seconds}$ to prevent native re-oxidation and airborne halogen dry-stain formation.
   - Cascade rinse with high-purity DI water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) for **$3\text{ minutes}$**.
4. **Nitrogen Blow-Dry & Surface Verification:**
   - Lift wafer carrier from QDR tank and blow-dry immediately using a high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$ nozzle.
   - Verify transition to a fully hydrophobic surface state: pure deionized water must sheet off cleanly with no pinhole water retention on active silicon.

---

## 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Target Metric | Nominal Specification | Engineering Tolerance / Window | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dilute HF Dip Duration** | `22.5` | `15.0 – 30.0` | seconds ($\text{s}$) | Automated wet bench process timer |
| **Rinse Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\ge 18.0$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line resistivity probe |
| **Bath Process Temperature** | `25.0` | `24.0 – 26.0` | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Immersion thermocouple / RTD sensor |
| **DI Dump Rinse Time** | `180` | $\ge 180$ ($3\text{ min}$) | seconds ($\text{s}$) | Programmable QDR controller |
| **Surface Hydrophobic State** | Hydrophobic | Rapid de-wetting / sheeting (no pinhole puddles) | Qualitative / Goniometer ($> 75^\circ$) | Visual run-off inspection / Contact angle |

---

## 5. Context Citations

- **Hydrofluoric Dip Dilution, Time & Hydrophobic Transition:**  
  *Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*  
  > *"Hydrofluoric Dip: 1:50 HF:H2O dip for 15-30 seconds to strip native oxide; surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic."*  
  > *"Intermediate Rinse: Dump rinse with 18.2 MOhm-cm deionized water for 3 minutes."*  
  > *"Final Step: Nitrogen (N2) blow-dry with high-purity."*

- **Native Oxide Etch Timing & Safety Protocols:**  
  *Source: Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates*  
  > *"Native oxide: Etched in 10 to 15 seconds."*  
  > *"Safety Protocols: HF Hazard: HF penetrates skin deeply, dissociated fluoride ions bind serum [calcium/magnesium]."*

- **Calcium Gluconate & Ambient Conditions:**  
  *Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*  
  > *"Caution: Hydrofluoric acid penetrates skin and binds calcium; calcium gluconate gel must be present at all times."*  
  > *"Etch rate ... at 25°C is approximately 100 nm/minute (1000 Å/min)."*
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates (Williams, K. - Journal of Microelectromechanical Systems (JMEMS))
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-WET-180-042`  
**Title:** PTFE/PFA Acid-Resistant Wafer Dipping Cassette and Handle Fixture Procurement  
**Context:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip | Gen 2 (µm) | Mechanical Assembly & Tooling  
**Action Type:** Make / Procurement & Incoming Acceptance  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the procurement specifications, material validation, physical inspection, and chemical compatibility qualification for high-purity virgin Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) and Perfluoroalkoxy alkane (PFA) wafer dipping cassettes and detachable handle fixtures. These fixtures are required to transfer 150 mm/200 mm silicon wafers through the pre-gate oxidation clean sequence—specifically handling the **1:50 HF:H₂O** native oxide etch (15–30 s), intermediate **18.2 MΩ·cm DI water** dump rinses, and hot **RCA-1/RCA-2** acid baths (70°C–80°C) without trace metal leaching or structural degradation.

---

### 2. Process Flow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Vendor Spec Verification & BOM Conformance Audit          |
|    - Confirm molded/machined Virgin PFA / PTFE (SEMI compliant) |
+------------------------------+-------------------------------+
                               |
                               v
+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Physical & Dimensional Metrology Inspection               |
|    - Verify wafer slot pitch, cassette clearance, handle lock|
+------------------------------+-------------------------------+
                               |
                               v
+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Pre-Conditioning & Thermal Leaching Leaktight Verification |
|    - Submerge in 18.2 MOhm-cm DIW at 70°C-80°C (SC bath test) |
+------------------------------+-------------------------------+
                               |
                               v
+--------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Acid Soak & Chemical Inertness Validation                 |
|    - 1:50 HF etch simulation (room temp, 15-30 s minimum)    |
|    - Verify zero warping, non-shedding, and lock rigidity    |
+--------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Procurement Specification & Material Certification
1. Issue procurement order specifying SEMI-standard profile cassettes and ergonomic locking handles manufactured strictly from **virgin, unfilled electronic-grade PTFE/PFA** (zero colorants, plasticizers, or metal core reinforcers).
2. Require vendor Certificate of Analysis (CoA) validating trace extractable heavy metals ($\text{Fe, Cu, Ni}$) and alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) below semiconductor baseline limits.

#### Step 2: Dimensional & Mechanical Incoming Inspection
1. Inspect cassette wafer pocket pitch and slot edge tolerances using an optical comparator or coordinate measuring machine (CMM) to prevent edge pinch on 180nm production wafers.
2. Engage the detachable PFA/PTFE handle fixture into the cassette latching lugs. Verify positive dual-pin or snap-lock engagement with zero lateral play under load.
3. Verify fluid drainage slot geometry: bottom and side drain ports must allow unrestricted chemical drainage within 3 seconds of vertical extraction.

#### Step 3: Pre-Clean and Thermal Stability Soak
1. Clean the new fixture assembly in ultra-pure DI water (18.2 MΩ·cm resistivity).
2. Subject the fixture to a simulated thermal clean cycle matching the RCA clean temperature envelope:
   - Submerge cassette and handle in heated DI water at **70°C to 80°C** for **15 minutes**.
3. Inspect for thermal creep, mechanical binding, or warping of slot rails immediately upon removal.

#### Step 4: HF Wet-Etch Immersion & Hydrophobic Compatibility Test
1. Prepare a test tank containing **1:50 HF:H₂O** dilute hydrofluoric acid solution.
2. Submerge the loaded fixture for **30 seconds** (the upper limit of the native oxide dip window).
3. Extract the cassette vertically; observe drainage and verify zero chemical retention in crevices. Confirm the handle remains rigidly coupled during transfer.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Tolerance / Limits | Inspection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Thermal Soak Temperature Rating** | **70 to 80** | **°C** | Min 70°C, Max 80°C | Calibrated In-Situ RTD Sensor |
| **Acid Immersion Duration Resistance** | **15 to 30** | **seconds (s)** | Full integrity across window | Digital Wet Bench Timer |
| **DI Water Rinse Resistivity Baseline** | **18.2** | **MΩ·cm** | $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at 25°C | In-line Conductivity/Resistivity Cell |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Custom Fluoropolymer Manual Immersion Jig & Splash-Shield Rig Fabrication
**Hierarchy Level:** Leaf SOP (Mechanical Assembly / Tooling)  
**Process Line:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip — Gate Oxide Pre-Clean & Native Oxide Wet Dip Fixturing  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the fabrication, machining, surface preparation, assembly, and dimensional validation of a dedicated virgin fluoropolymer (PTFE/PFA/PVDF) manual immersion wafer jig and transparent/chemical-resistant splash-shield enclosure rig. 

This custom tooling holds 150mm/200mm silicon wafers during the pre-oxidation dilute HF (1:50) / buffered oxide etch dip sequence designed to strip native oxide prior to ~3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth in the 180nm DRAM cell process flow.

---

### 2. Required Equipment, Materials & Safety Gear
* **Raw Stock:** Semi-crystalline virgin PTFE (polytetrafluoroethylene) or PFA (perfluoroalkoxy) rod and sheet stock (high chemical inertness to concentrated and dilute HF).
* **Splash Enclosure Stock:** High-clarity fluoropolymer / ECTFE / transparent PFA film or acrylic splash shielding treated with HF-resistant fluoropolymer coating.
* **Machining Centers:** Dedicated non-metallic / polymer CNC mill with clean ultra-sharp carbide or diamond-like carbon (DLC) coated tooling (no cutting fluid or sulfur-based lubricants).
* **Hardware:** Virgin PFA threaded fasteners, studs, and retaining nuts (strictly zero metallic fasteners in wetted zones).
* **Safety & PPE:** Cleanroom chemical apron, face shield, double nitrile gloves, and hydrofluoric acid emergency antidote: **Calcium Gluconate Gel (2.5%)** present and unexpired at the assembly and testing station.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

```text
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                      FABRICATION & ASSEMBLY FLOW                       |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1] Virgin Fluoropolymer CNC Machining (Grooves & Guide Pins)    |
|                                  |                                     |
|                                  v                                     |
|  [Step 2] Splash-Shield Containment Rig Assembly & Interlocks          |
|                                  |                                     |
|                                  v                                     |
|  [Step 3] SC-2 Compatible Pre-Assembly Leaching & Decontamination      |
|                                  |                                     |
|                                  v                                     |
|  [Step 4] Mechanical Fit, Wafer Edge Exclusion & Clearance Audit       |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Virgin Fluoropolymer CNC Machining
1. Mount virgin PTFE/PFA blank stock onto the vacuum chuck of the polymer CNC mill. Do not use standard mineral-oil coolants; use filtered clean dry air (CDA) or DI water mist cooling only.
2. Machine wafer carrier comb slots with a 60° V-groove profile configured to contact only the peripheral exclusion zone (< 3.0 mm from wafer edge) to prevent contact with active transistor channel areas ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
3. Machine drain-relief scallops along the bottom rib of the carrier to ensure zero stagnant chemical holdup and allow rapid laminar gravity drainage upon withdrawal from the etch tank.

#### Step 2: Splash-Shield Containment Rig Assembly
1. Assemble the transparent fluoropolymer splash shield onto the wet-bench rim mount using PFA threaded fasteners. Torque fasteners hand-tight to prevent thread galling or cold flow/creep of fluoropolymer threads.
2. Align the vertical manual-immersion guide rails to provide smooth, binding-free vertical translation into the immersion bath.
3. Verify that splash guard panels fully encompass the bath opening with minimum 100 mm vertical overlap above the liquid line to prevent aerosol and liquid droplet dispersion during manual transfer.

#### Step 3: Chemical Leaching & Metallic Decontamination
1. Submerge all machined fluoropolymer components in a dedicated chemical leaching bath consisting of dilute SC-2/RCA-2 solution ($\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) followed by a 1:50 HF rinse to extract surface trace metallic impurities and machining debris.
2. Rinse with Megohm-grade deionized (DI) water until effluent resistivity reaches $> 18\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
3. Dry components in a Class 100 laminar cleanhood using filtered nitrogen ($N_2$).

#### Step 4: Mechanical Fit, Hydrophobic Drain & Clearance Verification
1. Load dummy silicon wafers into the assembled jig slots. Ensure smooth wafer insertion and seating without micro-chatter or edge chipping.
2. Perform manual immersion dip cycle into a DI water tank. Observe drainage upon vertical lift: verify complete liquid run-off without trapped droplets bridging between adjacent wafer slots within 5 seconds.
3. Store jig in a cleanroom N2 dry box when not actively mounted on the wet station.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Machine-Measurable Target Metrics

| Inspection Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Measurement Instrument / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Edge Exclusion Contact Width** | $\le 2.0\text{ mm}$ inward from bevel edge (leaves active $L=180\text{ nm}$ array uncontacted) | Optical Toolmaker's Microscope / Non-contact CMM |
| **Jig Slot Pitch & Spacing Accuracy** | $4.76\text{ mm} \pm 0.05\text{ mm}$ uniform pitch | Calibrated Digital Height Gauge / Optical Comparator |
| **Drain Relief Run-Off Time** | $< 5.0\text{ seconds}$ for full gravity clearing | High-speed video / Digital Optical Timer |
| **Enclosure Splash Aerosol Containment** | $100\%$ liquid droplet containment ($\le 0$ exterior droplet strikes at transfer speed $0.15\text{ m/s}$) | UV-Fluorescent Tracer Liquid Inspection |

---

### 5. Context & Literature Citations
* **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):** Hydrofluoric acid safety handling protocols; hydrofluoric acid skin penetration hazard requiring mandatory presence of calcium gluconate gel at all times during fabrication, assembly, and testing.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Defines pre-clean criticality where ~3.5 nm physical thickness dry gate oxide ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$) requires non-contaminating, metal-free fluoropolymer tooling prior to thermal oxidation.
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Transistor active dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) dictating strict exclusion-zone edge-gripping fixturing to eliminate mechanical abrasion across active silicon patterns.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-FAB180-WET-MET-042`
**Title:** Fixture Mechanical Clearance, Drainage & Hydrophobic De-wetting Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification > Precision Tooling & Fixturing > Fixture Mechanical Clearance, Drainage & Hydrophobic De-wetting Verification  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm tooling scale)

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP establishes the verification procedure for cassette/carrier fixturing mechanical clearances, fluid drainage pathways, and wafer de-wetting behavior following dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF 1:50 / BOE prep) native oxide removal on 180nm DRAM wafers prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth.

```
       +---------------------------------------------+
       |   1. Fixture Mechanical Clearance Check     |
       |      - Feeler gauge wafer slot gaps         |
       +----------------------v----------------------+
       |   2. Chemical Immersion & Drainage Run      |
       |      - Controlled bath withdrawal / runoff  |
       +----------------------v----------------------+
       |   3. Optical Hydrophobic De-wetting Metrol. |
       |      - Sheeting check / Contact angle       |
       +----------------------v----------------------+
       |   4. Safety & Ca-Gluconate Station Audit    |
       |      - First-aid readiness check            |
       +---------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Check Safety & Personal Protective Equipment (PPE):**
   - Don acid-rated apron, heavy-duty neoprene/nitrile gauntlets, and face shield.
   - Verify that Calcium Gluconate Gel (topical antidote for HF exposure) is unexpired, fully stocked, and located directly adjacent to the wet station before processing.

2. **Fixture Mechanical Clearance Inspection:**
   - Mount the PTFE/PFA fluoropolymer carrier fixture onto the automated wet-bench transfer arm.
   - Inspect wafer pocket clearances and support teeth using calibrated feeler gauges. Verify zero wafer pin-binding or mechanical interference during cassette loading/unloading cycles.

3. **Fluid Drainage & Runoff Verification:**
   - Submerge fixture in the DI water / rinse staging tank and simulate vertical lift at controlled withdrawal velocity.
   - Visually and sensorially verify laminar fluid evacuation through bottom drainage slots; confirm no chemical pooling, meniscus entrapment, or dead-zone retention on fixture ribs.

4. **In-Situ Dilute HF Exposure & Surface De-wetting Metrology:**
   - Execute native oxide strip dip in dilute HF (1:50) / buffered fluoropolymer bath at 25°C.
   - Upon vertical extraction, perform immediate optical de-wetting verification: observe transition from hydrophilic sheeting to complete hydrophobic surface beading/de-wetting across the active DRAM silicon area (preparing channel regions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
   - Measure contact angle on test wafer monitoring spots to verify full native oxide removal before dry gate oxidation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Acceptance Criteria Target Verification
Metric                                      Target Value
-----------------------------------------------------------------
Bath Operating Temperature                  25.0 °C
Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness Target   3.5 nm
Silicon Channel Width (Transistor Site)     220.0 nm
Silicon Channel Length (Transistor Site)    180.0 nm
```

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target | Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dilute HF Bath Temperature** | `25.0 ± 0.5` | `°C` | In-tank calibrated PT100 RTD sensor |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Target** | `3.5` | `nm` | Post-oxidation spectroscopic ellipsometry |
| **Active Transistor Channel Length ($L$)** | `180` | `nm` | In-line CD-SEM verification |
| **Active Transistor Channel Width ($W$)** | `220` | `nm` | In-line CD-SEM verification |
| **Safety Readiness Metric** | Calcium Gluconate Gel present | Boolean (`Pass`/`Fail`) | Direct visual safety interlock log |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**: Defines access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), stacked capacitor layout, and refresh leakage requirements.
- **[Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)]**: Specifies process bath baseline temperature ($25^\circ\text{C}$), bubble elimination protocols in micro-features, and mandatory immediate presence of calcium gluconate gel for hydrofluoric acid safety.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**: Confirms thermal dry gate oxide target physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ following surface native oxide clearing.
