# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-WET-180-042: Process Parameter Benchmarking for Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Post-RCA1 Wafer     │
│  (Hydrated Native     │
│      SiO2 Film)       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Dilute HF (1:50)     │
│   Native Oxide Dip    │
│    (15 s - 30 s)      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│ Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)│
│  18.2 MOhm·cm DI H2O  │
│        (3 min)        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│ Hydrophobic Surface & │
│ Dewetting Inspection  │
│  (Complete Sheeting)  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│ Transfer to RCA-2 /   │
│  Dry Gate Oxidation   │
│       (3.5 nm)        │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chemical Bath Preparation (Dilute HF 1:50)**:
   - Prepare a 1:50 volumetric solution by mixing 1 part concentrated Hydrofluoric Acid (49% HF) with 50 parts ultra-pure Deionized (DI) Water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
   - Maintain wet-bench ambient bath temperature at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Ensure safety readiness: confirm the immediate availability of calcium gluconate gel ($2.5\%$) and inspect personal protective equipment (heavy Neoprene/PVDF gloves, face shield, and chemical apron).

2. **Native Oxide Etch Immersion**:
   - Transfer wafers from the post-RCA-1 rinse into the 1:50 Dilute HF immersion tank.
   - Execute the dip for **$15\text{ to }30\text{ seconds}$** (native oxide requires $10\text{ to }15\text{ seconds}$ to clear under standard oxide etch conditions).
   - Agitate mildly to ensure uniform acid contact across all active silicon areas and trench features without bubble entrapment.

3. **Intermediate Quench & Dump Rinse**:
   - Immediately transfer wafer cassette into the Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) tank filled with ultra-pure DI water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
   - Perform cascade dump rinse for **$3\text{ minutes}$** to completely quench the reaction and remove residual fluoride ions ($F^-$).

4. **Hydrophobic Surface Verification & Drying**:
   - Withdraw the wafer slowly from the DI rinse. Verify immediate surface dewetting: complete water sheeting off the bare silicon surface indicates full hydrogen termination (transition from hydrophilic $\text{Si-OH}$ to hydrophobic $\text{Si-H}$).
   - Perform high-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry immediately to prevent water mark formation prior to the subsequent RCA-2 (SC-2) metallic clean or $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxidation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Native Oxide Thickness** | $0.0\text{ nm}$ | $\le 0.1\text{ nm}$ ($1\text{ \AA}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Surface Hydrophobic Dewetting / Contact Angle** | $> 75^\circ$ | $\ge 70^\circ$ (Rapid, uniform water bead sheeting) | Optical Goniometry / Automated Contact Angle Tool |
| **Bath Immersion Residence Time** | $20\text{ s}$ | $15\text{ s} - 30\text{ s}$ | Automated Wet Bench Robotic Immersion Timer |
| **Rinse Resistivity Recovery** | $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-Line QDR Conductivity/Resistivity Probe |

---

### 4. Literature References & Citations

1. **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
   - Dilute HF formulation: *1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ dip for 15–30 seconds to strip native oxide; surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic*.
   - Intermediate rinse: *Dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for 3 minutes*.
   - Final dry: *High-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry*.
2. **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates**:
   - Native oxide clearance window: *Native oxide etched in 10 to 15 seconds*.
   - Safety protocol: *HF penetrates skin deeply and binds calcium; calcium gluconate gel must be present at all times*.
citations: Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates (Williams, K. - Journal of Microelectromechanical Systems (JMEMS))
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Dilute HF (1:50) Chemical Bath Preparation & Etch Bath Temperature Stabilization
**Context Path**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification > Process Parameter Benchmarking for Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification > Dilute HF (1:50) Chemical Bath Preparation & Etch Bath Temperature Stabilization  
**Technology Generation**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Safety & PPE Protocols
> [!CAUTION]
> **Hydrofluoric Acid Hazard**: HF penetrates biological tissue rapidly and complexes systemic calcium ions. Calcium gluconate 2.5% antidote gel must be stationed directly at the chemical bench within arm's reach. Full acid PPE required: heavy neoprene gloves, face shield, chemical-resistant apron, and dedicated HF-rated wet-bench exhaust hoods.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
[Step 1: Bath Purge & DIW Charge]
  │── Verify clean PTFE/PVDF tank integrity.
  └── Dispense 50 parts semiconductor-grade 18.2 MΩ·cm Deionized Water (DIW).
         ▼
[Step 2: Dilute HF Acid Dispensing (1:50 Ratio)]
  │── Slowly add 1 part concentrated 49% Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) into DIW ("Acid into Water").
  └── Maintain recirculating magnetic drive pump / PTFE overflow filtration.
         ▼
[Step 3: Bath Thermal Stabilization & Control]
  │── Engage circulating PFA inline immersion heat exchanger / chiller loop.
  └── Stabilize bath setpoint at nominal room temperature (25°C).
         ▼
[Step 4: Operational Readiness Verification]
  └── Perform pre-run coupon check (15–30 s dip) ensuring native oxide clearance & hydrophobicity.
```

1. **Vessel Inspection and Initial DI Water Charge**:
   - Ensure the dedicated PVDF/PTFE wet-bench bath vessel is purged and clean.
   - Dispense **50 volumetric parts** of high-purity deionized water (resistivity: **18.2 MΩ·cm**) into the tank. *Always add acid to water, never water to acid.*

2. **Chemical Metering and Addition**:
   - Accurately measure **1 volumetric part** of cleanroom electronic-grade **49% HF (Hydrofluoric Acid)**.
   - Slowly meter the 1 part 49% HF into the 50 parts DIW under continuous laminar exhaust to formulate the **1:50 HF:H₂O** dilution.

3. **Recirculation & Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Engage PTFE-encapsulated recirculation pump and temperature-control bath chiller/heater unit.
   - Circulate the bath until uniform mixing is achieved and the bath temperature stabilizes at **25°C**.
   - Confirm bath temperature uniformity across weir overflow zones using a calibrated PFA-sheathed RTD sensor.

4. **Batch Ready Sign-Off**:
   - Verify bath is ready for downstream wafer carrier insertion (targeting native oxide removal duration of **15–30 seconds** prior to SC-2 sequence).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Feed Resistivity** | 18.2 MΩ·cm | ≥ 18.2 MΩ·cm | Inline resistivity sensor at bath inlet |
| **Dilution Ratio (HF : DI H₂O)** | 1 : 50 | 1:50 (49% HF : 18.2 MΩ·cm H₂O) | Automated chemical metering pump / titrator |
| **Bath Etch Temperature** | 25°C | ± 0.5°C | Inline PFA-jacketed RTD immersion probe |
| **Process Native Oxide Dip Window** | 15–30 s | 15 s – 30 s | Automated wet-bench recipe timer |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References
- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - Specified 18.2 MΩ·cm deionized water standard.
  - Specified 1:50 HF:H₂O dip ratio for 15–30 seconds to strip native oxide and transition wafer surfaces from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.
- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
  - Specified 49% HF stock concentration benchmark and nominal room-temperature baseline of 25°C for oxide etch stability.
  - Mandated safety rule: Hydrofluoric acid calcium-binding precautions and mandatory availability of calcium gluconate gel.
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** Benchmarking Native Oxide Stripping Rate Across Timed Immersion Matrix (10s–45s)  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Prep Post SC-1  │
│         Rinse          │
└───────────┬────────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   1:50 HF Immersion    │
│     Matrix 10s-45s     │
└───────────┬────────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Dump Rinse 18.2     │
│    MOhm-cm DI Water    │
└───────────┬────────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     High-Purity N2     │
│        Blow-Dry        │
└───────────┬────────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Ellipsometry &     │
│      Hydrophobic       │
│       Assessment       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Timed Immersion Split Matrix

```text
               Immersion Matrix Exposure Time (s)       
         ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────┐
         │█████████████████████████████████████████████│
45s Split┤█████████████████████████████████████████████│
         │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓               │
30s Split┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓               │
15s Split┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                             │
         │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                             │
10s Split┤░░░░░░░░░░░                                  │
         │░░░░░░░░░░░                                  │
         └┬──────────┬──────────┬──────────┬──────────┬┘
         0.0       11.2       22.5       33.8      45.0 
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Readiness:**
   - Verify that Calcium Gluconate gel is present and accessible at the wet bench prior to handling Hydrofluoric Acid (HF).
   - Ensure the chemical bath contains a 1:50 volume dilution of $49\%\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ at ambient cleanroom conditions ($25^\circ\text{C}$).

2. **Pre-Etch Native Oxide Thickness Baseline:**
   - Measure starting native oxide thickness across pre-cleaned 180nm monitor silicon wafers (post-SC-1 and intermediate dump rinse) via spectroscopic ellipsometry.

3. **Timed Immersion Matrix Execution:**
   - Submerge wafer coupons/lots into the 1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ bath across experimental duration splits:
     - **Split A:** $10\text{ s}$
     - **Split B:** $15\text{ s}$ (nominal lower process window)
     - **Split C:** $30\text{ s}$ (nominal upper process window)
     - **Split D:** $45\text{ s}$ (over-etch margin)
   - Agitate gently to prevent localized stagnant boundary depletion.

4. **Quench & DI Water Dump Rinse:**
   - Immediately transfer wafers within $\le 2\text{ s}$ transfer latency into the dump rinse tank.
   - Execute dump rinse cycling with high-purity $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for $3\text{ minutes}$.

5. **Drying & Hydrophobic Surface Verification:**
   - Dry wafers using high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry until moisture is completely eliminated.
   - Inspect surface dewetting characteristics; confirm transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic behavior (complete water sheeting beading/repulsion indicating full removal of oxide).

6. **Post-Etch Metrology & Rate Calculation:**
   - Re-measure residual oxide thickness via spectroscopic ellipsometry to determine the precise strip rate ($\text{nm/s}$ or $\text{\AA/s}$) and establish the minimum clearance duration before subsequent SC-2 metallic decontamination or gate oxidation.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dilute HF Etch Bath Ratio** | $1:50 \pm 1\%$ | Volumetric ratio ($\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) |
| **Immersion Process Window** | $15\text{ to }30$ (within matrix range $10\text{ to }45$) | $\text{s}$ (seconds) |
| **Dump Rinse Deionized Water Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |
| **Dump Rinse Duration** | $3.0 \pm 0.1$ | $\text{min}$ (minutes) |
| **Surface Wetting State Transition** | Hydrophilic $\rightarrow$ Fully Hydrophobic (zero water sheeting retention) | Qualitative / Contact Angle State |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Dilute HF formulation: *1:50 HF:$\text{H}_2\text{O}$ dip*.
  - Standard baseline immersion window: *15–30 seconds to strip native oxide; surface transitions from hydrophilic to hydrophobic*.
  - Rinse specifications: *Dump rinse with 18.2 MOhm-cm deionized water for 3 minutes*.
  - Drying specification: *Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry with high-purity*.
- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**
  - Safety protocol: *Hydrofluoric acid penetrates skin and binds calcium; calcium gluconate gel must be present at all times*.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-042`  
**Title:** Post-Etch Water Contact Angle Goniometry & Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Verification  
**Module Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation > Metrology Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Safety Alert:** HF residue risk. Calcium gluconate gel must be immediately accessible at the metrology station in accordance with chemical hygiene protocols.

---

### Metrology Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Wafer N2 Dry      │
│       Complete        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Spectroscopic     │
│     Ellipsometry      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Water Contact Angle  │
│      Goniometry       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────◇───────────┐
│    Pass Criteria?     │
└─────┬───────────┬─────┘
   Yes│         No│
      │           ▼
      │     ┌───────────────────────┐
      │     │   Rework / Re-Etch    │
      │     └───────────────────────┘
      ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Immediate Dry Gate   │
│    Oxidation Queue    │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Inspection Handling & Queue Window:**
   - Transfer wafer cassette from the 1:50 HF dip and high-purity $N_2$ blow-dry station to the metrology bench in a Class 10/100 laminar flow hood.
   - Execute verification within a strict queue-time limit ($< 15\text{ minutes}$) to avoid ambient native oxide re-growth prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.

2. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (Non-Destructive Residual Film Measurement):**
   - Perform optical stage auto-alignment and baseline calibration.
   - Execute a multi-wavelength spectroscopic sweep ($\lambda = 250\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$) across a 5-point/9-point wafer mapping pattern (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right).
   - Fit $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ spectra using a calibrated $\text{Si} / \text{SiO}_2$ Cauchy/Tauc-Lorentz optical model to verify complete native oxide clearance down to baseline zero thickness.

3. **Sessile Droplet Water Contact Angle (WCA) Goniometry (Hydrophobic Surface Test):**
   - Place wafer on the automated goniometer stage (test on sacrificial/scribe line zones to prevent micro-contamination of active 180 nm channel areas).
   - Dispense a precision micro-droplet ($2.0\text{ }\mu\text{L} \pm 0.5\text{ }\mu\text{L}$) of ultra-pure $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.
   - Capture droplet profile using the high-resolution CCD camera and calculate the static tangent contact angle via Young-Laplace fitting. Hydrophobic H-terminated silicon must exhibit contact angles significantly exceeding hydrophilic hydroxylated surfaces ($> 70^\circ$).

4. **Disposition & Transfer:**
   - **Pass:** Route directly to the thermal processing furnace for the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth step.
   - **Fail:** Tag for native oxide strip rework or contamination investigation if the surface demonstrates residual oxide or hydrophilic pinning ($< 70^\circ$).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Native Oxide Thickness** | `0.0` | $\text{\AA}$ (or $\text{nm}$) | $\le 2.0\text{ \AA}$ (Target $0.0 \pm 1.5\text{ \AA}$) |
| **Deionized Water Rinse Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Minimum specification standard |
| **Post-Etch Water Contact Angle (WCA)** | `> 75.0` | degrees ($^\circ$) | $\ge 70.0^\circ$ (Pass/Fail hydrophobic threshold) |
| **W-plug & Transistor Channel Clearance**| `180` / `220` | $\text{nm}$ ($L \times W$) | Free of oxide bridging and particulate defects |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure:**
  - Standardizes the $1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ native oxide dip (15–30 s), specifying surface transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic, intermediate dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water, and high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):**
  - Specifies silicon dioxide etch behavior and strict personnel safety mandates (calcium gluconate gel must be present at all times for HF handling).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Unit cell dimensional boundary conditions for access transistor channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$), channel width ($W = 220\text{ nm}$), and tungsten plug (W-plug) drain contacts.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Quality Acceptance & Metrology Protocol for Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification

**Document ID:** `SOP-QA-WET-180NM-042`  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation Surface Prep > Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Buy / In-Line Metrology  

---

### 1. Process & Metrology Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Dilute HF 1:50 Dip   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Quick Dump Rinse QDR  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Spin Rinse Dry SRD   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Ellipsometry Native   │
│          SiO2          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Water Contact Angle   │
│       Goniometry       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Surface Defect     │
│       Inspection       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) Check:**
   - Confirm mandatory presence of Calcium Gluconate 2.5% topical gel at the wet bench workstation prior to bath initiation.
   - Inspect chemical apron, face shield, and heavy-duty Neoprene/Viton gloves.

2. **Chemical Bath Immersion & Native Oxide Etch:**
   - Submerge the wafer cassette into the Dilute HF (DHF 1:50 / 49% HF:DI water) bath maintained at $25.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Process immersion duration: **15 seconds** (ensuring complete strip of 10–15 Å native oxide with $>100:1$ selectivity toward single-crystal silicon).

3. **Cascade Quick Dump Rinse (QDR):**
   - Transfer wafer carrier within $\le 5\text{ s}$ transit time to the QDR vessel.
   - Cycle 4 consecutive dump-and-fill sequences using ultra-pure deionized (DI) water until effluent resistivity reaches $\ge 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

4. **Spin-Rinse-Dry (SRD):**
   - Transfer to SRD chamber under high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$ purge ($>99.999\%$, $0.02\ \mu\text{m}$ filtered).
   - Execute dry cycle at 2200 RPM for 180 seconds; inspect wafer surface visually for macro water droplet retention/dewetting.

5. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Inspection:**
   - Transfer sample to the multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometer.
   - Perform 49-point wafer mapping to measure residual $\text{SiO}_2$ equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) across the 180nm transistor active channel areas ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

6. **Hydrophobic Surface Verification (Session Contact Angle Goniometry):**
   - Dispense a calibrated $2.0\ \mu\text{L}$ droplet of deionized water using a motorized micro-syringe at 5 designated test sites (Center, North, South, East, West).
   - Capture sessile drop profile within 10 seconds of droplet dispense to measure static contact angle ($\theta_c$).

7. **Laser Surface Particle Scanning:**
   - Inspect wafers under darkfield laser scatterometry for post-etch surface defects and particle count at $\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ sensitivity.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Tolerance / Upper Limit | Measurement Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Native Oxide Thickness** | $0.0\text{ \AA}$ (Complete Strip) | $\le 1.5\text{ \AA}$ (Residual $\text{SiO}_2$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (49-point map) |
| **Water Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** | $75.0^\circ$ (Hydrogen-terminated Si) | $\ge 70.0^\circ$ (Minimum acceptable hydrophobicity) | Automated Optical Goniometer ($2.0\ \mu\text{L}$ DI droplet) |
| **Etch Duration & Bath Selectivity** | $15\text{ s}$ dip duration | Selectivity to Si $> 100:1$ | Process Timer / In-line chemical bath control |
| **Defectivity Adder ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$)** | $0\text{ particles/wafer}$ | $\le 5\text{ adders/wafer}$ ($180\text{ nm}$ threshold) | Darkfield Laser Surface Particle Scanner |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

1. **Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates:**
   - *Selectivity & Etch Rates:* Verified native oxide strip duration of **10 to 15 seconds** with single-crystal silicon selectivity **$> 100:1$** at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
   - *Safety Protocol:* HF deep tissue hazard requiring dedicated safety PPE and strict protocol enforcement.
2. **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):**
   - *Safety Precondition:* Calcium gluconate gel must be present and verified at the station at all times prior to HF/BOE operations.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - *Dimensional Baseline:* Defined active transistor area dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) requiring uniform native oxide clearance prior to the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth to maintain sub-threshold/junction leakage targets below $1\text{ fA/cell}$.
citations: Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE 6:1 & 7:1) Silicon Dioxide Wet Etch Rates (Williams, K. - Journal of Microelectromechanical Systems (JMEMS))
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Preparation and Calibration of Metrology Apparatus for DHF Etch Rate Verification

**Protocol ID:** `SOP-MET-DHF-180NM-001`  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean & In-Situ HF Dip Surface Prep > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 Sequence > Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip & Hydrophobic Surface Verification > Quality Acceptance & Metrology Protocol > Preparation & Calibration of Metrology Apparatus for DHF Etch Rate Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm Node)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Setup  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Cleanroom Prep & Cal  │
│       Standards        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Spectroscopic      │
│      Ellipsometer      │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Reference        │
│    Calibration Run     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Baseline Measurement  │
│    on Thermal Oxide    │
│         Pilot          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        DHF Etch        │
│     Verification &     │
│    Thickness Delta     │
│        Analysis        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Tool Environmental Stabilization**
   - Confirm Cleanroom Class environment and verify temperature stabilization at **25°C**.
   - Ensure personal protective equipment (PPE) is donned for wet-station interface; confirm **calcium gluconate gel** is stocked and immediately accessible in the work bay prior to handling any HF/DHF sample holders.

2. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometer Power-Up & Optical Alignment**
   - Power on the broadband light source and optical spectrometer array.
   - Load the standard reference silicon substrate ($Si\langle100\rangle$ with certified reference thermal oxide).
   - Adjust the motorized goniometer to standard angle of incidence ($70^\circ$ or $75^\circ$). Perform auto-collimation and autofocus alignment to optimize beam reflection intensity onto the detector.

3. **Dispersion Modeling & Reference Calibration Calibration**
   - Initialize the optical dispersion model utilizing the **Cauchy** or **Sellmeier** dispersion formulation to parameterize film refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
   - Measure polarization parameter angles $\Psi$ (Psi) and $\Delta$ (Delta) defined by the fundamental ellipsometric ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
   - Run system verification against certified reference wafers to achieve sub-Angstrom precision ($<\pm0.05\text{ nm}$).

4. **Pilot Wafer Baseline Thickness Mapping**
   - Load the pre-etch monitor pilot wafer (thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ test wafer).
   - Execute an automated **9-point** or **49-point** wafer thickness map across the wafer to record baseline thickness ($T_0$) and verify radial film non-uniformity across the substrate.

5. **In-Line Etch Measurement & Etch Rate Computation**
   - Following timed immersion in dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF 1:50) at $25^\circ\text{C}$, rinse with DI water, blow dry with ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$, and transfer the wafer onto the ellipsometer vacuum chuck.
   - Re-run the identical 9-point or 49-point automated thickness map to obtain post-etch thickness ($T_1$).
   - Calculate etch rate via:
     $$\text{Etch Rate} = \frac{T_0 - T_1}{\Delta t}$$

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Acceptance Boundary | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Metrology Measurement Precision** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal ($t_{ox}$) | $\pm0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Bath / Metrology Ambient Temperature** | $25$ | $\pm0.5$ | $^{\circ}\text{C}$ |
| **Wafer Non-Uniformity Mapping** | Automated 9-point or 49-point grid | Radial uniformity $< 1.5\%$ ($1\sigma$) | points / $\%$ |
| **Comparative Reference BOE 6:1 Etch Rate** | $100$ | $100\pm5$ ($1000\pm50\text{ \AA/min}$) | $\text{nm/min}$ |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - *Governing physical relationship*: Polarized reflection ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$.
  - *Optical modeling*: **Cauchy** or **Sellmeier** dispersion equations parameterized for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Accuracy & Mapping*: Sub-Angstrom precision threshold of **$\pm0.05\text{ nm}$** on ultra-thin oxides ($3.5\text{ nm}$ target) and automated **9-point or 49-point** wafer mapping tracking radial film non-uniformity.
- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**:
  - Reference thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate baseline at **$25^{\circ}\text{C}$** of **$100\text{ nm/minute}$** ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$).
  - Cleanroom personal safety mandate: continuous availability of **calcium gluconate gel** due to systemic calcium-binding hazards of hydrofluoric acid.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Establishes the 180nm device baseline, access transistor dimensions ($L=180\text{ nm}$, $W=220\text{ nm}$), and dielectric boundary limits for the gate integration sequence.

# Standard Operating Procedure: Execution and Process Qualification of Dilute HF (1:50) Native Oxide Dip Recipe

**Module:** Pre-Oxidation Wet Chemistry / Gate Oxide Preparation  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Safety Notice:** Hydrofluoric acid penetrates skin and binds calcium. **Calcium gluconate gel must be present and verified at the wet bench at all times.**

---

### Process Execution Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   SC-1 Pre-Cleaned    │
│         Wafer         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Dilute HF 1:50 Dip:  │
│     15-30s at 25C     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    QDR Rinse: 18.2    │
│   MOhm-cm DI Water    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│        Surface        │
│     Verification:     │
│   Hydrophobic State   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     N2 Blow-Dry &     │
│   Transfer to SC-2    │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Safety & Bath Preparation:**
   - Confirm safety readiness: Inspect wet bench ventilation and ensure calcium gluconate antidote gel is stocked on-station.
   - Verify bath formulation: Dilute HF bath prepared at **1:50 volumetric ratio (1 part 49% HF : 50 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$)** maintained at **25°C**.
2. **Wafer Staging & Immersion:**
   - Receive wafer lot immediately following RCA-1 (SC-1) clean and intermediate dump rinse.
   - Immerse wafer carrier smoothly into the 1:50 Dilute HF tank for **15 to 30 seconds** with gentle continuous agitation to uniformly etch native oxide.
3. **Deionized Water Rinse:**
   - Immediately transfer the carrier to the Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) bath using ultrapure deionized water with a resistivity of **18.2 $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**.
   - Cycle rinse for 3 minutes until effluent resistivity stabilizes.
4. **Hydrophobic Surface Verification:**
   - Conduct in-situ surface inspection: Upon pull-out from the rinse tank, verify complete dewetting (beading of water / complete lack of liquid film adhesion), confirming that the surface has transitioned from hydrophilic to **hydrophobic** (hydrogen-terminated silicon).
5. **Drying & Transfer:**
   - Dry wafer using filtered, high-purity **Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry**.
   - Queue wafer lot directly for subsequent RCA-2 (SC-2: 6:1:1 $\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ at 70°C–80°C) metallic decontamination prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth.

---

```text
          Dip Duration Max (s)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
             Bath Temp (deg C)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓    │
                              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓    │
DI Water Resistivity (MOhm-cm)┤███████████████         │
                              │███████████████         │
                              └┬─────┬─────┬────┬─────┬┘

```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dilute HF Dip Time** | **22.5 s** | **15 – 30 s** | Automated recipe timer |
| **Bath Temperature** | **25°C** | $\pm 1.0\text{°C}$ | In-line thermal sensor |
| **Rinse DI Water Resistivity** | **18.2 $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** | $\ge 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Resistivity sensor probe |
| **Surface Wetting State** | **Hydrophobic** | Complete dewetting (no water sheeting) | Optical dewetting inspection / Contact angle |

---

### 3. Citations & Context Tracing

- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure:**
  - 1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ dilution ratio.
  - Native oxide strip immersion duration: 15–30 seconds.
  - Surface transition verification: hydrophilic to hydrophobic.
  - Intermediate / QDR rinse resistivity standard: 18.2 $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
  - High-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry requirement.
- **Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):**
  - HF bath temperature baseline (25°C) and handling precautions (calcium gluconate gel presence requirement).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-QA-MET-180-042
**Title:** Post-Etch Hydrophobic Surface Verification and Ellipsometric Oxide Clearance Metrology  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation  
**Action Type:** Buy / In-line Metrology Inspection  
**Safety Alert:** Hydrofluoric acid residue hazards; ensure Calcium Gluconate gel is accessible at metrology and wet bench stations.

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Metrology Wafer Transfer & Alignment:**
   - Unload the wafer cassette directly from the post-HF/RCA clean N2 spin/blow-dry station.
   - Stage wafers in a Class 1 cleanroom environment under laminar flow. Maintain queue time under 15 minutes to prevent airborne organic re-contamination and native oxide re-growth.
   - Load wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer / Goniometer cluster.

2. **Automated Deionized Water Contact Angle (WCA) Verification:**
   - Dispense a calibrated 2.0 µL sessile droplet of 18.2 MΩ·cm ultra-pure deionized (DI) water onto designated test sites (5-point pattern: Center, North, South, East, West with 5 mm edge exclusion).
   - Capture droplet profile within 5 seconds of dispense via high-resolution optical goniometry.
   - Compute contact angle using the Young-Laplace fitting algorithm to confirm surface termination conversion from hydrophilic (Si-OH) to hydrophobic (Si-H).

3. **Multi-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (Native Oxide Clearance):**
   - Align the ellipsometer laser/broadband light beam at an angle of incidence of $\Phi_0 = 70^\circ$ (wavelength range 250 nm – 800 nm).
   - Acquire $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ spectra at 9 sample points across the wafer surface.
   - Fit acquired data to a standard optical model: Substrate (Si $\langle100\rangle$) + Interfacial native oxide ($SiO_2$, Cauchy layer, $n = 1.46$).
   - Determine remaining equivalent oxide thickness ($T_{ox}$) to verify complete native oxide clearance prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.

4. **Surface Particle & Defect Scan:**
   - Perform laser surface scattering inspection to ensure zero drying watermarks, haze, or residual micro-droplets.
   - Release lot to furnace queue for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth upon passing all criteria.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $\le 0.2$ (Clearance verified) | nm | 9-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Surface Water Contact Angle (WCA)** | $\ge 75$ (Hydrophobic Si-H state) | degrees ($^\circ$) | Sessile Drop Optical Goniometry |
| **Post-Etch Water Rinse Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line Resistivity Sensor |
| **Queue Time to Gate Oxidation** | $\le 15$ | minutes | Automated Lot Tracking (MES) |

---

### 3. Sourced Context & Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - *Context verified:* Dilute HF dip (1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) transitions the silicon surface termination from hydrophilic to hydrophobic; intermediate rinse specification is established using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water followed by high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)**
  - *Context verified:* Safety protocols requiring calcium gluconate gel presence due to skin penetration and calcium binding characteristics of HF chemistry; surface wetting and micro-trench clearing constraints.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document Code:** SOP-WET-180NM-RCA2-001  
**Title:** RCA-2 (SC-2) Acidic Metallic Decontamination & Hot Megasonic Clean  
**Process Integration:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gate Oxide Pre-Clean Module)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Buy  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Wafer Cassette     │
│       Transfer        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      RCA-2 Bath       │
│      Preparation      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Hot Megasonic Clean  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   18.2 MOhm-cm QDR    │
│         Rinse         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  High-Purity N2 Dry   │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Check & Wet Bench Staging**:
   - Verify previous dilute HF (1:50 HF:H₂O) strip completion and surface hydrophobicity.
   - Inspect quartz immersion vessel, megasonic transducer coupling, and recirculation plumbing for chemical compatibility.

2. **Bath Preparation & Chemical Proportioning**:
   - Fill the quartz bath with **6 parts Deionized Water (DI H₂O)**.
   - Add **1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% HCl)** slowly under active exhaust.
   - Add **1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% H₂O₂)** to establish the `6:1:1` RCA-2 (SC-2) formulation.

3. **Thermal Conditioning & Megasonic Decontamination**:
   - Heat the chemical bath to **70°C – 80°C**.
   - Submerge wafer cassette into the heated solution and engage megasonic agitation.
   - Maintain immersion for **10 minutes** to strip ionic alkali metals ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metal contaminants ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).

4. **Deionized Water Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)**:
   - Transfer wafer cassette immediately into the dump rinse tank.
   - Perform dump rinse cycles using ultra-pure deionized water with a resistivity of **18.2 MΩ·cm** for **3 minutes**.

5. **Drying Sequence**:
   - Transfer wafers into the spin-rinse dryer or surface marangoni dry module.
   - Execute final wafer dry using filtered, high-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) gas blow-dry until all moisture is eliminated.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Inspection / Validation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Chemical Ratio** | `6 : 1 : 1` ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl } 37\% : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\text{ } 30\%$) | Volumetric parts ratio | Automated chemical dispense flowmeter |
| **Process Bath Temperature** | `70 to 80` | °C | In-situ quartz-sheathed RTD thermocouple |
| **Decontamination Duration** | `10` | minutes | Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) recipe timer |
| **DI Water Rinse Resistivity** | `18.2` | MΩ·cm | In-line resistivity probe at QDR outlet |

---

### 3. Source Context Citations

* **Bath Composition, Chemistry, and Immersion Duration**:  
  Cited directly from *Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*:
  > *"RCA-2 (SC-2): 6 parts Deionized H2O, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% HCl), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% H2O2). Temperature: 70°C-80°C for 10 minutes. Eliminates alkali ions (Na+, K+) and heavy metals (Fe, Cu, Ni)."*
* **Rinse Specifications & Drying Medium**:  
  Cited directly from *Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*:
  > *"Intermediate Rinse: Dump rinse with 18.2 MOhm-cm deionized water for 3 minutes."*  
  > *"Final Step: Nitrogen (N2) blow-dry with high-purity"*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** RCA-2 (SC-2) Chemical Bath Preparation & Megasonic Tank Degassing  
**Process Step:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > RCA-2 (SC-2) Acidic Metallic Decontamination & Hot Megasonic Clean > RCA-2 (SC-2) Chemical Bath Preparation & Megasonic Tank Degassing  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    UPW Charging: 6     │
│   parts 18.2 MOhm-cm   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Thermal Preheating:   │
│      75 C +/- 2 C      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Acid Addition: 1    │
│  part 37 percent HCl   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Peroxide Activation:  │
│   1 part 30 percent    │
│          H2O2          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Megasonic Degassing:  │
│    1 MHz Transducer    │
│       Idle Pulse       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Process         │
│  Qualification: Bath   │
│  Ready for Wafer Load  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Vessel Inspection & Pre-Rinse**:
   - Verify the quartz/PTFE immersion tank is free of residual chemical stains.
   - Flush the vessel with Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) of resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ before charging.

2. **Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) Primary Fill**:
   - Dispense **6 volumetric parts** of UPW ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) into the heated immersion bath.
   - Initiate bath recirculation and inline quartz immersion heating toward target temperature ($75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$).

3. **Acid Addition (Hydrochloric Acid Injection)**:
   - Once UPW is preheated, meter and inject **1 volumetric part** of electronic grade **$37\%\text{ HCl}$** into the circulating UPW stream.
   - *Safety Note*: Always introduce acid into water to ensure controlled thermal dissipation without acid splattering.

4. **Oxidizer Addition (Hydrogen Peroxide Activation)**:
   - Slowly inject **1 volumetric part** of semiconductor grade **$30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$** to finalize the $6:1:1$ ratio.
   - Maintain continuous circulation to homogenize the ternary solution without excessive local effervescence.

5. **Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Stabilize the mixed chemical bath temperature strictly within **$75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$** (operating window $70^\circ\text{C}$–$80^\circ\text{C}$).

6. **Megasonic Transducer Degassing & Acoustic Field Setup**:
   - Energize the bottom-mounted megasonic transducer array at **$1\text{ MHz}$**.
   - Run the megasonic field at idle power in the freshly charged bath prior to wafer cassette introduction.
   - Degas the solution until microbubble entrapment at transducer radiation surfaces is expelled, preventing acoustic shading during subsequent $10\text{-minute}$ metallic desorption runs.

---

### Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Volumetric Bath Ratio ($\text{UPW} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)** | $6 : 1 : 1$ | Exact volumetric dispensation ($\pm 2\%$) | Calibrated chemical flowmeter / level sensor |
| **Bath Temperature** | $75^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ (Allowable range: $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$) | Dual inline fluoropolymer-sheathed PT100 RTD |
| **UPW Feed Water Resistivity** | $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$ | Inline resistivity meter |
| **Megasonic Agitation Frequency** | $1\text{ MHz}$ | $\pm 0.05\text{ MHz}$ | Megasonic RF generator frequency readout |

---

### Literature Citations

- **Source: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**:
  - *SC-2 Chemistry*: 6 parts UPW : 1 part 37% HCl : 1 part 30% H2O2.
  - *Temperature & Duration*: $75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$; 10 minutes immersion time for metallic desorption ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+, \text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}, \text{Au}$).
  - *UPW Specification*: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water baseline.
  - *Agitation Platform*: Immersion bath with megasonic agitation at 1 MHz.
- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - *Ratio & Temp*: 6 parts Deionized H2O : 1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% HCl) : 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% H2O2) at $70^\circ\text{C}$–$80^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Semiconductor-Grade Chemical Reagents & Megasonic Tank Quartz Bath Setup (RCA-2 / SC-2)

### Process Flow Diagram
```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Quartz Bath       │
│      Inspection &      │
│       Pre-Rinse        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    18.2 MΩ·cm UPW      │
│    Dilution Charge     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Semiconductor-Grade   │
│    37% HCl Addition    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Semiconductor-Grade   │
│   30% H2O2 Addition    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Bath Immersion     │
│    Heating 70°C-80°C   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Megasonic Transducer  │
│      Degas Cycle       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Quartz Tank Inspection & Pre-Rinse**:
   - Verify the high-purity fused quartz bath chamber is free of particulate debris, chemical staining, or mechanical damage.
   - Pre-rinse the quartz tank thoroughly using ultra-pure deionized (DI) water with an inline resistivity of $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ for a minimum of 3 minutes.
2. **Deionized Water Baseline Charge**:
   - Charge the quartz bath vessel with exactly 6 volume parts of $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water prior to introducing concentrated acid reagents (strict protocol: always add acid to water).
3. **Semiconductor-Grade Acid Addition (RCA-2 / SC-2 Chemistry)**:
   - Slowly meter in 1 volume part of semiconductor-grade Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$, $37\%$) under continuous laminar exhaust.
   - Introduce 1 volume part of semiconductor-grade Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, $30\%$) into the solution to complete the $6:1:1$ ($\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) bath matrix.
4. **Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Activate the quartz immersion heating loops. Ramp and stabilize the chemical solution to a target operating range of $70^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }80^\circ\text{C}$.
5. **Megasonic Degassing & Bath Readiness**:
   - Energize the megasonic transducers at low power before loading wafers to initiate bath degassing.
   - Dislodge microbubbles and entrapped dissolved gases to ensure uniform acoustic pressure transmission and prevent cavitation voids prior to wafer immersion.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Inline deionized water resistivity sensor |
| **Chemical Volumetric Ratio** | $6:1:1$ ($\text{H}_2\text{O} : 37\%\text{ HCl} : 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$) | Volume parts ($\pm 2\%$) | Calibrated chemical metering delivery system |
| **Operating Bath Temperature** | $70 \text{ to } 80$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Quartz-sheathed thermocouple immersion probe |
| **SC-2 Immersion Duration Ready-State** | $10$ | $\text{minutes}$ | Automated process bath timer |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **[Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure]**:
  - *RCA-2 (SC-2) Formulation*: 6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid ($37\%\text{ HCl}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$).
  - *Thermal & Time Parameters*: Heated to $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for 10 minutes.
  - *Rinse & Fluid Specifications*: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water used for contamination-free dilution and intermediate rinsing.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-WET-RCA2-001`
**Title:** RCA-2 (6:1:1 $\text{DI}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) Bath Formulation, Heating (75°C) & Megasonic Degassing Cycle  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > RCA-2 (SC-2) Chemical Bath Preparation & Megasonic Tank Degassing  
**Target Dielectric Layer:** 3.5 nm to 4.0 nm Thermal Gate Dielectric ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$)  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Charge 18.2 MOhm-cm  │
│       DI Water        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Spike 37% HCl Acid   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Engage In-Line     │
│  Immersion Heater to  │
│       75 deg C        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Spike 30% H2O2     │
│       Peroxide        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Megasonic Tank     │
│   Degassing Cycle 5   │
│          min          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Bath Ready for SC-2  │
│    Wafer Immersion    │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Check & Tank Purge**:
   - Inspect the quartz recirculating bath. Ensure drain valves are sealed and the quartz immersion heater is interlocked with liquid level sensors.
   - Verify exhaust plenum velocity meets acidic wet bench containment standards.

2. **Deionized Water Charge**:
   - Dispense **6 volume parts** of high-purity Ultra-Pure Water (resistivity = $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) into the quartz tank until the lower liquid level sensor is fully tripped.

3. **Hydrochloric Acid Addition**:
   - Carefully dose **1 volume part** of **37% Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$)** into the DI water bath under continuous low-flow circulation.  
   - *Rule:* Always add acid to water to prevent localized exothermic splashing.

4. **Thermal Ramp to Target Operating Setpoint**:
   - Engage the immersion heating elements with controller setpoint configured to **$75^\circ\text{C}$** (operating range: $70^\circ\text{C}$ to $80^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Allow closed-loop circulation until the bath stabilizes within $\pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ of setpoint.

5. **Hydrogen Peroxide Addition**:
   - Once the stabilized temperature reaches $\ge 70^\circ\text{C}$, dispense **1 volume part** of **30% Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)** to establish the final volumetric ratio of **6:1:1 ($\text{DI}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.
   - *Note:* Adding $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ after initial heating minimizes thermal decomposition of the oxidant before wafer processing.

6. **Megasonic Degassing Cycle**:
   - Turn on the bath megasonic transducer array (power: ~50–60% forward power, frequency: 0.8–1.0 MHz) without wafers loaded for **5 minutes**.
   - Megasonic degassing drives out dissolved microbubbles generated during $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ initial reaction, eliminating cavitation pinning and bubble-masking defects prior to wafer immersion.
   - Ready state: The bath is held at $75^\circ\text{C}$ for subsequent 10-minute wafer metallic decontamination runs.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance Window | Units | Verification Equipment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Temperature** | `75.0` | `70.0 to 80.0` | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Calibrated PTFE-sheathed In-situ RTD / Thermocouple |
| **Bath Chemical Volumetric Ratio** | `6 : 1 : 1` | `(± 2% per component)` | Volume Ratio ($\text{DI}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | High-precision automated chemical delivery flowmeters |
| **DI Water Feed Resistivity** | `18.2` | `≥ 18.0` | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line resistivity monitor cell at 25°C |
| **Wafer Treatment Immersion Time** | `10.0` | `10.0 to 15.0` | minutes | Wet bench automated recipe timer interlock |

---

### Context Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Chemical formulation: *6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% $\text{HCl}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)*.
  - Temperature window & duration: *70°C–80°C for 10 minutes* (with DI water spec at *$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$*).
  - Target mechanism: Elimination of alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metal contaminants ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
  - Target gate oxide thickness for 180nm node: *3.5 to 4.0 nm* grown in dry $\text{O}_2$ to ensure high-field reliability ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).

```text
│    Acoustic Power     │
│  Mapping across Tank  │
│      Coordinates      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Chemical Bath     │
│  Titration: HCl and   │
│         H2O2          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│       Metrology       │
│    Qualification:     │
│  Pre-Oxidation RCA-2  │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Bath Thermal Stabilization & Degas Verification**
   - Ensure the RCA-2 (SC-2) tank is filled with the qualified standard volumetric mixture: **6 parts Deionized $H_2O$ (18.2 $M\Omega\cdot cm$), 1 part Hydrochloric Acid ($37\% \text{ HCl}$), and 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\% \text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.
   - Heat the tank immersion heaters to achieve and stabilize a bath temperature between **$70^\circ\text{C}$ and $80^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Activate the megasonic transducers at nominal operational frequency to degas dissolved microbubbles prior to spatial profiling.

2. **Megasonic Acoustic Power Uniformity Mapping**
   - Mount a multi-point piezoelectric hydrophone / acoustic power sensor array onto the automated wafer-carrier inspection fixture.
   - Submerge the sensor grid across the active immersion volume corresponding to the wafer boat slot zone.
   - Record acoustic power density (in $\text{W/cm}^2$) across load, center, and end coordinates over a continuous cycle.
   - Compute spatial acoustic power non-uniformity:
     $$\text{Non-Uniformity (\%)} = \frac{P_{\text{max}} - P_{\text{min}}}{2 \times P_{\text{mean}}} \times 100$$
   - Verify that no dead spots or hot spots exceed tolerance limits that could cause localized particle re-deposition or gate pattern damage.

3. **Chemical Concentration Titration Verification**
   - Extract a $20\text{ mL}$ aliquot sample from the recirculating weir of the RCA-2 bath using an automated PTFE sampling syringe.
   - **Acid-Base Titration for $\text{HCl}$:** Titrate the sample with standardized $0.1\text{ N NaOH}$ using potentiometric end-point detection to determine active $\text{HCl}$ molarity against the nominal 6:1:1 volumetric dilution target ($12.5\text{ vol\% HCl}$ component).
   - **Redox Titration for $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$:** Quench a second aliquot in sulfuric acid matrix and titrate against standardized $0.1\text{ N KMnO}_4$ (or ceric sulfate) to determine the concentration of active oxidizer ($12.5\text{ vol\% H}_2\text{O}_2$ component).

4. **Metrology Tool Qualification & Sign-off**
   - Compare measured physical values to the target acceptance envelope.
   - Log acoustic map uniformity and chemical concentration assays into the SPC/MES tracking logbook before releasing the tank for pre-oxidation metallic decontamination lots.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                 Acceptance Criteria & Bath Metrics     
             ┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
             │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░        │
    Bath Temp┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░        │
             │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Acoustic Unif┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  H2O2 Target┤▓▓▓▓▓▓                                   │
             │▓▓▓▓▓▓                                   │
   HCl Target┤██████                                   │
             │██████                                   │
             └┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬─────────┬┘
             0.0      23.8      47.5      71.2     95.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Operating Temperature** | **$70.0 - 80.0$** | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-spec range ($70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$) | Encased PTFE/Quartz RTD thermocouple |
| **$\text{HCl}$ Concentration ($37\%$ stock)** | **$12.5$** ($1:8$ volume ratio in $6:1:1$ solution) | $\text{vol\%}$ | $\pm 0.8\text{ vol\%}$ | Potentiometric acid-base titration ($0.1\text{ N NaOH}$) |
| **$\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ Concentration ($30\%$ stock)** | **$12.5$** ($1:8$ volume ratio in $6:1:1$ solution) | $\text{vol\%}$ | $\pm 1.0\text{ vol\%}$ | Redox titration ($0.1\text{ N KMnO}_4$) |
| **Acoustic Power Spatial Uniformity** | **$\le 10.0$** (Non-uniformity across tank volume) | $\%$ | Max $10.0\%$ non-uniformity | Calibrated hydrophone probe grid array |

---

### 3. Context Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Chemical composition ratio: *6 parts Deionized $H_2O$, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid ($37\% \text{ HCl}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\% \text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$)*.
  - Temperature operational window: *Heated to $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for 10 minutes*.
  - Process intent: *Eliminates alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metals ($\text{Fe, Cu, Ni}$) prior to dry gate oxidation*.
  - Water baseline resistivity: *$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water*.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title:** Hot SC-2 Acidic Metallic Stripping & In-Situ Megasonic Decontamination
- **Process Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > RCA-2 (SC-2) Acidic Metallic Decontamination & Hot Megasonic Clean
- **Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Process Overview & Chemistry
The Standard Clean 2 (SC-2 / RCA-2) acidic bath strips ionic alkali impurities ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and transition/heavy metal contaminants ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$, $\text{Au}$) through soluble coordination complex formation, preventing trace metallic contamination and premature breakdown in the subsequent $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry thermal gate oxide furnace growth.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                               Process Flow (SC-2)                               |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
   +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   | 1. Bath Preparation & Chemistry Setup                                     |
   |    - Fill tank: 6 parts UPW (18.2 MOhm-cm)                                |
   |    - Add: 1 part 37% HCl, then 1 part 30% H2O2 (Ratio: 6:1:1)             |
   +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
   +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   | 2. Bath Heating & Thermal Stabilization                                   |
   |    - Stabilize quartz/PTFE bath at 75 deg C (+/- 2 deg C; range 70-80 deg C) |
   +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
   +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   | 3. Wafer Immersion & Megasonic Clean                                      |
   |    - Transfer hydrophobic wafers immediately post-HF dip                  |
   |    - Process for 10 minutes (10-15 min window)                            |
   +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
   +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
   | 4. Cascade Overflow Dump Rinse & Marangoni/IPA Dry                        |
   |    - Quick-dump overflow rinse using 18.2 MOhm-cm UPW                     |
   |    - Continue until effluent resistivity > 16 MOhm-cm (target: 18.2)      |
   |    - High-purity filtered N2 Marangoni / IPA vapor dry                     |
   +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Chemical Bath Formulation
1. In a designated ultra-pure quartz or fluoropolymer (PTFE) wet bench tank, introduce **6 parts Ultra-Pure Water (UPW)**.
2. Carefully add **1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% $\text{HCl}$)** followed by **1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**, yielding a volumetric ratio of **$6:1:1$ ($\text{UPW} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.

#### Step 2: Thermal Equilibration
1. Engage the bath immersion heaters and bring the bath temperature to the target setpoint of **$75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$** (operating window: **$70^\circ\text{C}$ to $80^\circ\text{C}$**).
2. Verify temperature stability across the wet bench immersion well prior to boat loading.

#### Step 3: Wafer Boat Immersion & Megasonic Agitation
1. Transfer wafer cassettes immediately following the dilute HF native oxide strip into the heated SC-2 bath without drying or surface stalling.
2. Submerge the wafers for an immersion duration of **10 minutes** (qualified window: **$10\text{ to }15\text{ minutes}$**).
3. The acidic peroxide solution desorbs trace metallic contaminants ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$, $\text{Au}$, $\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) into stable, soluble chloride complexes.

#### Step 4: Cascade Dump Rinse & Surface Drying
1. Transfer the cassette to the adjacent cascade dump/overflow rinse tank filled with **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** UPW.
2. Execute dump rinse cycles (minimum 5 cycles / overflow flush) until bath effluent resistivity recovers to **$> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** (target: **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**).
3. Transfer wafers into the final drying station; execute drying using filtered high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry, Marangoni dry, or isopropyl alcohol (IPA) vapor dry.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Chemical Volumetric Ratio** | $6 : 1 : 1$ | UPW ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) : $37\%\text{ HCl}$ : $30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$ | Volumetric Ratio |
| **Bath Operating Temperature** | $75$ | $\pm 2$ (Allowable: $70 - 80$) | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Immersion Process Duration** | $10$ | $10 - 15$ | $\text{minutes}$ |
| **Post-Rinse Effluent Water Resistivity** | $> 16.0$ | Target $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Sources
- **Source 1:** *RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering*
  - Validates SC-2 chemistry ($6\text{ parts UPW} : 1\text{ part } 37\%\text{ HCl} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$), bath temperature ($75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$), processing duration ($10\text{ minutes}$), metallic complexing target ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+, \text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}, \text{Au}$), and rinse endpoint resistivity ($> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ / $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
- **Source 2:** *Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*
  - Confirms standard bath temperature span ($70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$), duration window ($10 - 15\text{ minutes}$), target contaminants, and high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$/Marangoni dry sequence.
citations: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: SC-2 Chemical Bath Formulation & Megasonic Transducer Calibration
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > RCA-2 (SC-2) Acidic Metallic Decontamination & Hot Megasonic Clean > Hot SC-2 Acidic Metallic Stripping & In-Situ Megasonic Decontamination > SC-2 Chemical Bath Formulation & Megasonic Transducer Calibration  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
To formulate the Standard Clean-2 (SC-2 / RCA-2) acidic bath and calibrate the in-situ megasonic transducer array. This procedure removes alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and heavy metal contaminants ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$) prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth on 180nm DRAM access transistor active areas without causing cavitation damage or micro-trench pattern collapse.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-------------------------------------------------------+
|  1. DI Water Pre-Fill: 6 parts 18.2 MΩ·cm UPW         |
+-------------------------------------------------------+
                           |
                           v
+-------------------------------------------------------+
|  2. Reagent Metering: 1 part 37% HCl : 1 part 30% H2O2|
+-------------------------------------------------------+
                           |
                           v
+-------------------------------------------------------+
|  3. Bath Thermal Stabilization: Heat to 70°C - 80°C   |
+-------------------------------------------------------+
                           |
                           v
+-------------------------------------------------------+
|  4. Megasonic Transducer Array Power & Acoustic Tuning|
+-------------------------------------------------------+
                           |
                           v
+-------------------------------------------------------+
|  5. 10-Minute Metallic Strip Run & Dump Rinse Handover|
+-------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Safety & Personal Protection Inspection:**
   - Verify that the acid-fume exhaust face velocity is active ($\ge 0.5\text{ m/s}$).
   - Ensure emergency eye-wash stations and safety showers are clear and certified.

2. **Deionized Water Pre-Fill:**
   - Dispense **6 volumetric parts** of ultra-pure deionized (DI) water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) into the PVDF/quartz immersion tank.

3. **Reagent Dispense & Mixing:**
   - Carefully meter and dispense **1 volumetric part** of electronic-grade **Hydrochloric Acid (37% $\text{HCl}$)** into the DI water under gentle circulation.
   - Dispense **1 volumetric part** of electronic-grade **Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)** to complete the nominal **6:1:1** ratio ($\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).

4. **Thermal Stabilization:**
   - Engage the in-line chemical immersion bath heaters.
   - Ramp and stabilize the bath temperature between **70°C and 80°C** before initiating wafer boat loading.

5. **Megasonic Transducer Calibration:**
   - Activate the bottom-mounted megasonic transducer array (nominal high-frequency acoustic range ~0.9 to 1.0 MHz).
   - Calibrate RF forward power and ensure transducer acoustic power density uniformity ($\le \pm 5\%$ variation across the carrier plane) to prevent physical gate damage while dislodging metallic trace complexes.
   - Verify sensor telemetry indicates zero impedance mismatch / reflected RF power within tolerance.

6. **Decontamination Sequence & Processing:**
   - Submerge wafer cassette into the stabilized SC-2 bath for a calibrated duration of **10 minutes**.
   - Upon completion, immediately transfer to the high-purity $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water dump rinse tank for subsequent processing and dry.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Volumetric Bath Formulation Ratio** | **6 : 1 : 1** ($\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | Dimensionless parts ratio | Calibrated chemical flowmeter dispense logging |
| **Bath Operating Temperature** | **70.0 – 80.0** | **°C** | In-situ calibrated Teflon-sheathed RTD sensor |
| **Clean Process Duration** | **10** | **minutes** | Automated wet bench recipe cycle timer |
| **DI Water Resistivity** | **18.2** | **$\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** | In-line resistivity probe at point-of-use |

---

### 4. Context Source Citations
- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure:**
  - *Formulation ratio:* 6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% $\text{HCl}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
  - *Temperature:* Heated to 70°C–80°C.
  - *Duration:* Processed for 10 minutes.
  - *Rinse Specification:* Intermediate and dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.
  - *Target Contaminants:* Eliminates alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Hot SC-2 Acidic Immersion & In-Situ Megasonic Stripping Execution
**Module:** Wet Chemistry / Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean Sequence  
**Technology Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2)

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Hot SC-2 Immersion   │
│       Bath Prep        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Bath Stabilization   │
│        70°C-80°C       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Megasonic Transducer  │
│      Activation &      │
│       Immersion        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    10-min Megasonic    │
│   Metallic Stripping   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Substrate Withdrawal  │
│  & 18.2 MΩ·cm Quick    │
│       Dump Rinse       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chemical Dispense & Bath Preparation**:
   - Charge the immersion quartz tank with **6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$** ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ resistivity).
   - Carefully meter and inject **1 part Hydrochloric Acid ($37\%\text{ HCl}$)** followed by **1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$)** to maintain the volumetric ratio of $6:1:1$ ($\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
2. **Bath Thermal Stabilization**:
   - Engage the in-line bath circulation and quartz immersion heater.
   - Ramp and stabilize the bath temperature target strictly to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.
3. **In-Situ Megasonic Activation & Substrate Immersion**:
   - Power on the bath megasonic transducer array.
   - Transfer the wafer cassette robotically into the chemical bath, ensuring uniform acoustic wave propagation and laminar chemical exposure across all wafer surfaces.
4. **Acidic Metallic Stripping Execution**:
   - Perform continuous acidic immersion and in-situ megasonic stripping for **10 minutes** to dissolve alkali ionic traces ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and strip transition/heavy metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
5. **Cassette Withdrawal & Quench Rinse**:
   - Slowly withdraw the cassette from the hot SC-2 tank to minimize chemical drag-out.
   - Immediately transfer wafers into a Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) tank primed with **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water** to quench residual acid prior to final high-purity $\text{N}_2$ drying.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Machine-Measurable Target | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-2 Bath Temperature** | `70 to 80` | $^{\circ}\text{C}$ | In-situ calibrated thermocouple sensor |
| **Immersion Stripping Duration** | `10` | $\text{min}$ | Automated wet bench recipe timer ($\pm 5\text{ s}$) |
| **Chemical Volumetric Ratio** | `6 : 1 : 1` ($\text{DI }\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | Dimensionless (vol/vol) | Flowmeter verification ($37\%\text{ HCl}, 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$) |
| **DI Rinse Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line resistivity probe at QDR intake |

---

### 4. Literature Source Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Chemical composition: $6\text{ parts Deionized }\text{H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part Hydrochloric Acid }(37\%\text{ HCl}) : 1\text{ part Hydrogen Peroxide }(30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2)$.
  - Process parameters: Bath temperature heated to $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ minutes}$.
  - Contaminant elimination targets: Alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
  - Water purity standard: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.
citations: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
