# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## TXRF Trace Metallic Impurity & Surface Particle Metrology Inspection

**Process Node & Architecture**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Cell Architecture Context**: 1T1C Stacked Capacitor over Bitline (COB), Channel Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, Gate Dielectric Target Physical Thickness $3.5\text{ nm}$  
**Module**: Metrology (Post-SC-2 Clean / Pre-Dry Gate Oxidation)  
**Action Type**: Make / Inspection  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wafer Transfer from   │
│     SC-2 / N2 Dry      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Wafer Alignment &    │
│    Vacuum Clamping     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Angle Calibration &   │
│   Incident Critical    │
│      Angle Tuning      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Multi-Point TXRF    │
│  Trace Metal Spectrum  │
│      Acquisition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Surface Laser      │
│  Scattering Particle   │
│          Scan          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Threshold  │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮Fail
         Pass│                              │
             ▼                              ▼
┌────────────────────────┐     ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │     │                        │
│   Transfer to 180nm    │     │   Rework / Re-Clean    │
│   Dry Gate Oxidation   │     │  Flag: Alert Council   │
│        Furnace         │     │                        │
│                        │     │                        │
└────────────────────────┘     └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **FOUP / Cassette Ingestion & Environmental Verification**:
   - Transfer wafer batch immediately from the upstream RCA-2 (SC-2: 6 parts DI H2O, 1 part 37% HCl, 1 part 30% H2O2, followed by high-purity N2 blow-dry) station into the Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) metrology loadlock within a maximum cleanroom queue time of $\le 30\text{ min}$ to prevent native oxide regrowth and airborne re-contamination.
   - Verify cassette load port mini-environment maintains Class 1 cleanroom filtration with downflow velocity $0.45 \pm 0.05\text{ m/s}$.

2. **Pre-Alignment & Stage Vacuum Chucking**:
   - Robot end-effector transfers the silicon substrate onto the TXRF optical rotary stage.
   - Align wafer notch/flat to $0^\circ \pm 0.05^\circ$ reference position.
   - Engage backside vacuum chucking at $-80\text{ kPa}$ relative vacuum, verifying substrate surface flatness deviation $\le 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$.

3. **Critical Angle Optical Calibration**:
   - Set the monochromatic X-ray beam source (Mo-K$\alpha$ or W-L$\beta$ radiation target) to an incident grazing angle below the silicon total reflection critical angle ($\phi_c \approx 0.08^\circ - 0.13^\circ$).
   - Perform automatic reflective intensity peak scan to establish precise total external reflection condition, ensuring beam penetration depth is restricted to the top $3\text{ to }5\text{ nm}$ near-surface boundary without exciting bulk silicon substrate background.

4. **Multi-Point Surface Metallic Contamination Measurement**:
   - Execute a 9-point surface sampling inspection pattern (1 center, 4 half-radius, 4 edge exclusion zones at $3\text{ mm}$ edge border).
   - Dwell time per point: $300\text{ s}$ per site under Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) integration.
   - Extract spectral peak fluorescence counts for transition metal contaminants targeted by the SC-2 clean:
     - Iron ($\text{Fe}$) K$\alpha$ peak ($6.40\text{ keV}$)
     - Copper ($\text{Cu}$) K$\alpha$ peak ($8.04\text{ keV}$)
     - Nickel ($\text{Ni}$) K$\alpha$ peak ($7.47\text{ keV}$)
     - Alkaline ions: Sodium ($\text{Na}$) and Potassium ($\text{K}$).

5. **Laser Surface Particle Scanning & Defect Inspection**:
   - Transfer wafer to integrated dark-field surface laser scattering inspection module.
   - Execute full-surface spiral scan across the wafer at sensitivity threshold corresponding to critical lithography dimension ($L = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Log total light point defect (LPD) count, particle size distribution ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$), and spatial coordinate map.

6. **Acceptance Evaluation & Downstream Dispatch**:
   - Correlate TXRF areal density and particle counts against acceptance criteria.
   - **Disposition**:
     - *Pass*: Generate automated inspection certificate and dispatch wafer lot to the thermal oxidation tube for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide growth ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$).
     - *Fail*: Quarantine lot; flag for RCA-1 / SC-2 re-clean loop and alert the DRAM Foundation VN council.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                           ┌───────────────────────────┐
                           │███████████████████████████│
        Upstream SC-2 Rinse┤███████████████████████████│
                           │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓     │
Defect / Particle (>0.18um)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓     │
        Cu / Ni Trace Level┤▒▒▒▒▒                      │
                           │▒▒▒▒▒                      │
             Fe Trace Level┤░░░░░░░░                   │
                           │░░░░░░░░                   │
                           └┬──────┬─────┬──────┬─────┬┘
                           0.0    4.5   9.1   13.6 18.2 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Inspection Tool / Condition | Rationale & Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Surface Heavy Metal (Fe) Areal Density** | $\le 5.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF (9-point, Mo-K$\alpha$, $300\text{ s}$ dwell) | Prevents premature gate dielectric breakdown in $3.5\text{ nm}$ thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ and protects $1\text{ fA/cell}$ leakage target at $85^\circ\text{C}$. |
| **Surface Trace Metal (Cu, Ni) Areal Density** | $\le 3.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF (9-point, grazing angle $\phi < \phi_c$) | Suppresses deep-level traps and junction leakage across access transistor channel ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$). |
| **Critical Surface Particle Count ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$)** | $\le 15$ | $\text{particles/wafer}$ (200mm substrate, $3\text{ mm}$ EE) | Dark-Field Laser Surface Scattering | Prevents pinholes and defects across wordline/bitline pitch ($360\text{ nm}-400\text{ nm}$). |
| **Incoming Wet Rinse Deionized Water Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-Line Resistivity Sensor ($25^\circ\text{C}$) | Ensures incoming wafer batch from SC-2 clean meets baseline ionic cleanliness. |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources Cited

1. **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
   - SC-2 chemical composition ($6\text{ parts DI H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part } 37\%\text{ HCl} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$ at $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$) formulated to eliminate alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy transition metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
   - Intermediate and final rinse specification with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water and ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Access transistor gate oxide target physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$; requires ultra-low metallic contamination to ensure dielectric integrity.
   - Bitline and wordline pitch ($360\text{ nm}-400\text{ nm}$) defining critical particle tolerance.
   - Storage capacitance requirement ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF/cell}$) and data retention ($> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
3. **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Unit cell access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Sub-threshold and junction leakage target kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, mandating rigorous surface metallic screening.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Cascade Overflow Rinse, SRD Drying & Surface Metallic TXRF Metrology

**Context & Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) > Architecture & Integration > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > RCA-2 (SC-2) Acidic Metallic Decontamination & Hot Megasonic Clean > Cascade Overflow Rinse, SRD Drying & Surface Metallic TXRF Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Post-SC-2 Acidic    │
│        Cassette        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Cascade Overflow UPW  │
│         Rinse          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Spin-Rinse-Dryer SRD  │
│         Cycle          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Surface TXRF      │
│  Metrology Inspection  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│   Metallic Criteria    │
│          Met?          │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────╮No
          Yes│                             │
             ▼                             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │    │                        │
│   Pass to 3.5nm Dry    │    │   Rework / Chemical    │
│     Gate Oxidation     │    │       Bath Audit       │
│                        │    │                        │
└────────────────────────┘    └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Cascade Overflow Deionized Water Rinse:**
   - **Transfer:** Transfer the wafer cassette immediately from the hot SC-2 acidic bath ($75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$) into the multi-stage cascade overflow rinse tank to prevent chemical dry-in.
   - **Water Quality & Flow:** Continuously supply Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) with an incoming bulk resistivity of $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $22^\circ\text{C}$.
   - **Endpoint Monitoring:** Maintain counter-current overflow rinsing until the effluent resistivity bath monitor reads $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ and stabilizes at $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$, verifying complete clearance of residual $\text{HCl}$ / $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ and desorbed transition metal/alkali chloride complexes.

2. **Spin-Rinse-Dryer (SRD) Cycle Execution:**
   - **Cassette Loading:** Transfer wafers into a balanced, dual-axis Spin-Rinse-Dryer under a Class 1 minienvironment.
   - **Low-Speed Rinse Phase:** Spin at $500\text{ RPM}$ with high-purity UPW ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) spray manifold active for 60 seconds to wash away any airborne micro-droplets.
   - **High-Speed Dry Phase:** Ramp spindle speed to $2000\text{–}2500\text{ RPM}$ while initiating heated, filtered ultra-dry $\text{N}_2$ gas purge ($0.05\,\mu\text{m}$ filtered, dew point $<-70^\circ\text{C}$) across both wafer surfaces for 180 seconds until hydrophobic/hydrophilic surfaces achieve zero boundary moisture.

3. **Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Surface Metrology:**
   - **Tool Setup:** Load representative process control wafers (center, top, bottom, and notch orientations) into the TXRF chamber under ultra-clean vacuum/ambient conditions.
   - **Glancing Angle Alignment:** Calibrate the monochromatic X-ray beam below the critical angle of total external silicon reflection ($\theta_c \approx 0.18^\circ$ for Mo-$K\alpha$ or W-$L\beta$ radiation) to isolate fluorescence emissions strictly to the uppermost atomic layers ($< 3\text{–}5\text{ nm}$).
   - **Metrology Integration:** Acquire energy-dispersive X-ray spectra across multi-point wafer coordinates to quantify residual metallic coordination complexes and alkali ion concentrations before wafers enter the high-temperature gate oxidation furnace.

---

### Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Measurement Technique / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Effluent Final Rinse Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ (Threshold: $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) | In-line Conductivity/Resistivity Probe |
| **Surface Transition Metals ($\text{Fe, Cu, Ni, Au}$)** | $< 1 \times 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ | Glancing-Angle TXRF Spectroscopy |
| **Surface Alkali Ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$)** | $< 1 \times 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF / Surface Analysis System |
| **Water Droplet / Residue Marks** | $0\text{ defects/wafer}$ (Zero localized dry-in residues) | Automated Darkfield Optical Inspection |

---

### Literature & Context Citations

- **Source:** *RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering*
  - *"Final Dump Rinse & Dry: Overflow rinse to 18.2 MOhm-cm, followed by filtered N2 Marangoni or isopropyl alcohol (IPA) vapor drying."*
  - *"Cascade Dump Rinse: 5 cycles with 18.2 MOhm-cm deionized water until bath resistivity > 16 MOhm-cm."*
  - *"RCA-2 / SC-2 (Standard Clean 2 - Acid Desorption): Action: Forms soluble coordination complexes with alkali ions (Na+, K+) and transition metals (Fe, Cu, Ni, Au), preventing furnace contamination."*
- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  - Unit cell gate oxide integration constraints ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric target $3.5\text{ nm}$) requiring sub-femtoamp leakage control ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: High-Resistivity Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) Cascade Overflow Wet Rinse Execution
**Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip | Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation (Wet Chemistry)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node  
**Action Type:** Buy / Execution  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Wafer Transfer from   │
│     SC-2 / HF Bath     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Tank 1: Primary UPW   │
│     Overflow Rinse     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Tank 2: Secondary    │
│  UPW Cascade Overflow  │
│         Rinse          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Resistivity &      │
│       Carry-Over       │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Transfer to SRD     │
│        Station         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Rinse System Verification:**
   - Confirm Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) cascade supply is actively flowing in counter-current direction (fresh UPW continuously fed into Tank 2, cascading over weir into Tank 1).
   - Ensure in-line resistivity sensors in both primary and secondary cascade weir drains are online and calibrated.
2. **Wafer Batch Transfer:**
   - Retrieve wafer cassette immediately upon completing the acidic metallic decontamination (RCA-2 / SC-2: 6:1:1 $\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) or native oxide etch bath.
   - Transfer wafer cassette via automated end-effector into Tank 1 within $< 5\text{ s}$ to prevent chemical dry-in and residue crystallization on active areas.
3. **Primary Cascade Rinse (Tank 1):**
   - Submerge cassette fully into Tank 1 under continuous overflow to strip bulk residual $\text{HCl}$ / ionic carry-over.
   - Run immersion under bottom UPW laminar displacement flow.
4. **Secondary Cascade Final Rinse (Tank 2):**
   - Elevate and index cassette into Tank 2 (fed directly with fresh incoming UPW).
   - Continue cascade overflow wet rinse until resistivity baseline target is reached.
5. **Rinse Completion & SRD Transfer:**
   - Ensure total effective rinse duration reaches $\ge 3\text{ minutes}$.
   - Once effluent resistivity meets the acceptance threshold, transfer cassette to the Spin Rinse Dryer (SRD) station for ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ drying.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Effluent Water Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line toroidal resistivity sensor at final cascade overflow weir |
| **Minimum Rinse Duration** | $\ge 3$ | $\text{minutes}$ | Automated wet bench recipe execution timer |
| **Preceding Acidic Clean Temp** | $70 - 80$ | $^{\circ}\text{C}$ | Thermocouple immersion probe in upstream RCA-2 (SC-2) bath |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - *Intermediate Rinse / Final Rinse Specification:* Prescribes dump/cascade rinsing with **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for $3\text{ minutes}$** following chemical cleaning steps.
  - *Bath Temperature & Carry-Over Chemistry:* Upstream RCA-2 (SC-2) bath composition (6 parts $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part $37\%\text{ HCl}$, 1 part $30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$) operating at **$70^{\circ}\text{C}-80^{\circ}\text{C}$ for $10\text{ minutes}$**, dictating the required removal of alkali ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metal ions ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$) prior to subsequent high-purity dry gate oxide growth.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure: Spin-Rinse Dryer (SRD) Particle-Free High-Purity $\text{N}_2$ Dehydration Recipe

**Document ID:** `SOP-WET-SRD-180NM-001`  
**Node Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip $\rightarrow$ Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) $\rightarrow$ Pre-Oxidation Wet Clean Sequence $\rightarrow$ Cascade Overflow Rinse & SRD Dehydration  
**Classification:** Manufacturing SOP (Make)

---

## 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Transfer from   │
│     Cascade Rinse      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Low-Speed Pre-Spin &  │
│      Rinse Spray       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       High-Speed       │
│  Centrifugal Spin Off  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Heated High-Purity   │
│  N2 Purge Dehydration  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Deceleration & N2    │
│     Blanket Static     │
│     Neutralization     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

### Step 1: Submersion Transfer & Rotor Loading
1. Transfer the 100mm silicon wafer cassette directly from the $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water cascade overflow rinse station into the enclosed SRD rotor chamber within 15 seconds to prevent airborne drying marks.
2. Secure cassette lock pins and seal the SRD process chamber door hermetically.

### Step 2: Low-Speed Pre-Rinse & Centrifugal Spread Cycle
1. Initiate low-speed rotor spin at $500\text{ RPM}$ for $5\text{ seconds}$ to achieve radial liquid equilibration and dislodge gross surface DI water droplets.
2. Engage atomized $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water rinse manifolds across wafer faces to sweep residual micro-droplets and particulate matter outward.

### Step 3: High-Speed Centrifugal Spin-Off
1. Discontinue DI water dispense; ramp rotor acceleration at $10{,}000\text{ RPM/s}$ up to $4{,}000\text{ RPM}$ for a duration of $30\text{ seconds}$.
2. Centrifugally shear bulk boundary liquid films away from wafer surfaces into exhaust collection channels.

### Step 4: High-Purity $\text{N}_2$ Purge Dehydration Cycle
1. Simultaneously inject heated, ultra-pure nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) gas across the spinning wafer cassette at the $4{,}000\text{ RPM}$ plateau.
2. Continue heated $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry to desorb physisorbed water molecules and prevent water-mark evaporation ring nucleation across hydrophobic/hydrophilic transition zones prior to 3.5 nm gate oxide thermal growth.

### Step 5: Deceleration & Static Neutralization
1. Decelerate rotor to $0\text{ RPM}$ under a continuous laminar high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blanket with active ionization bars engaged to neutralize centrifugal triboelectric charges.
2. Unload cassette into an inert microenvironment FOUP/carrier for surface TXRF metrology and pre-gate oxidation staging.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Resistivity (Rinse Phase)** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-situ inline resistivity sensor |
| **Initial Spin / Spread Velocity** | $500 \pm 5$ | $\text{RPM}$ | Optical shaft encoder / tachometer |
| **High-Speed Dehydration Spin Velocity** | $4{,}000 \pm 10$ | $\text{RPM}$ | Closed-loop brushless motor drive |
| **Rotor Acceleration Ramp Rate** | $10{,}000 \pm 100$ | $\text{RPM/s}$ | Drive controller feedback |
| **High-Speed Spin Duration** | $30.0 \pm 0.5$ | $\text{seconds}$ | Integrated tool timer controller |

---

## 4. Context References & Literature Citations

- **[Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure](docs/context.yaml):** Specifies the required cleanroom deionized water purity metric ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water) and the requirement for high-purity nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry as the final surface preparation step before thermal oxidation.
- **[Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming](docs/context.yaml):** Specifies the centrifugal spin dynamics: low-speed spread cycle at $500\text{ RPM}$ for $5\text{ seconds}$, acceleration ramp rate at $10{,}000\text{ RPM/s}$, and final spin speed of $4{,}000\text{ RPM}$ for $30\text{ seconds}$ on 100mm wafers, alongside thermal desorption of physisorbed water molecules.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml):** Defines the active device geometry (access transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor over bitline layout) requiring strict particle and ionic contamination-free interfaces for the critical 3.5 nm gate oxide.
citations: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming (Madou - Fundamentals of Microfabrication)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

nodes.label: Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Surface Metallic Trace Contamination Metrology
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Surface Metallic Trace Contamination Metrology
**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-180NM-TXRF-001`  
**Process Step Hierarchy:**  
`180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip` > `180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm)` > `Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation` > `Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution` > `RCA-2 (SC-2) Acidic Metallic Decontamination & Hot Megasonic Clean` > `Cascade Overflow Rinse, SRD Drying & Surface Metallic TXRF Metrology` > **Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Surface Metallic Trace Contamination Metrology**  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm) | **Action Type:** Make / Metrology

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the technical execution, beam alignment, calibration, and surface metallic trace contamination quantification via Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) metrology on 200 mm bare/cleaned silicon wafers immediately following RCA-2 / SC-2 acidic clean, megasonic treatment, and Spin-Rinse Dryer (SRD) processing. This step qualifies incoming wafer cleanliness prior to thermal 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth to prevent transition-metal-induced gate dielectric breakdown and junction/sub-threshold leakage (> 1 fA/cell).

---

### 2. Verified Context & Source Citations
* **[Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure]**:
  * RCA-2 (SC-2) solution (6:1:1 $\text{DI H}_2\text{O}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) operated at 70°C–80°C removes alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and transition heavy metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$).
  * Intermediate rinses require $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water followed by ultra-high-purity $\text{N}_2$ drying.
* **[Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  * Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  * Junction and sub-threshold leakage target must be kept $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C to preserve data refresh.
* **[Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  * Gate dielectric physical thickness target: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown via dry oxidation at 850°C–900°C.
  * Cell retention time target: $> 64\text{ ms}$ at 85°C.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```text
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                TXRF WORKFLOW                                       |
|                                                                                    |
| [1. FOUP Load & Class 1 Transfer] -> [2. High-Vacuum Chucking & Pre-Alignment]     |
|                                                     |                              |
|                                                     v                              |
| [4. Multi-Point Spectrum Acquisition] <- [3. Grazing-Angle (Phi_c) Monochromation] |
|                 |                                                                  |
|                 v                                                                  |
| [5. ROI Peak Deconvolution]        -> [6. Automated Out-of-Spec Interlock & Pass]  |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Lot Transfer & Pre-Inspection**:
   - Transfer the wafer cassette/FOUP directly from the SRD output station into the automated Class 1 TXRF load port within $\le 30\text{ minutes}$ of clean completion to prevent cleanroom atmospheric trace deposition.
   - Verify wafer surface has zero moisture spots and was dried via clean nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) and rinsed with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water.

2. **Chamber Loading & Wafer Chucking**:
   - Robotically transfer the 200 mm wafer onto the high-vacuum electrostatic or mechanical edge-grip measurement stage ($P < 5 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$).
   - Perform notch/laser flat pre-alignment ($0^\circ, 90^\circ, 180^\circ, 270^\circ$).

3. **X-Ray Source & Monochromator Optical Setup**:
   - Activate the high-flux rotating anode X-ray tube (Mo-K$\alpha$ excitation line at $17.44\text{ keV}$, or W-L$\beta$ at $9.67\text{ keV}$).
   - Set the incident grazing angle $\phi$ below the critical angle for total external reflection on bulk silicon ($\phi < \phi_c \approx 0.10^\circ - 0.18^\circ$, typical operational angle $\phi = 0.08^\circ \pm 0.01^\circ$). Total external reflection limits X-ray penetration depth into the Si bulk to $\sim 3 - 5\text{ nm}$, minimizing bulk silicon fluorescent background while maximizing surface emission from contaminants.

4. **Multi-Point Metrology Mapping**:
   - Execute an automated 5-point to 9-point surface scan pattern (wafer center, $R = 45\text{ mm}$ at $0^\circ, 90^\circ, 180^\circ, 270^\circ$, and edge exclusion zone $5\text{ mm}$ from edge bevel).
   - Collect fluorescent X-ray photons using a high-resolution Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) positioned normal to the wafer surface ($90^\circ$).
   - Integration live time: $\ge 1000\text{ seconds}$ per measurement point to achieve the requisite lower limits of detection (LLD).

5. **Spectral Analysis & Quantification**:
   - Integrate Regions of Interest (ROI) for characteristic $K\alpha$ lines:
     - $\text{Fe}$ ($K\alpha = 6.40\text{ keV}$)
     - $\text{Cu}$ ($K\alpha = 8.04\text{ keV}$)
     - $\text{Ni}$ ($K\alpha = 7.47\text{ keV}$)
     - $\text{Zn}$ ($K\alpha = 8.63\text{ keV}$)
   - Apply instrument calibration factor derived from certified single-element spin-coated/droplet reference standards to extract areal concentration in $\text{atoms/cm}^2$.

6. **Disposition & Interlock**:
   - If metallic contamination exceeds the pre-oxidation threshold, automatically flag the lot with a "Metrology Hold" and reroute the cassette to the RCA-2 bath (6:1:1 $\text{DI H}_2\text{O}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ at 70°C–80°C).
   - If clean, release wafer immediately into the 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation furnace queue.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Quantitative Targets

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Engineering Tolerance | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Surface Iron ($\text{Fe}$) Concentration** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | Max limit: $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF SDD ROI integration ($6.40\text{ keV}$) |
| **Surface Copper ($\text{Cu}$) Concentration** | $< 5.0 \times 10^{9}$ | Max limit: $\le 5.0 \times 10^{9}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF SDD ROI integration ($8.04\text{ keV}$) |
| **Surface Nickel ($\text{Ni}$) Concentration** | $< 5.0 \times 10^{9}$ | Max limit: $\le 5.0 \times 10^{9}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF SDD ROI integration ($7.47\text{ keV}$) |
| **TXRF Incident Grazing Angle ($\phi$)** | $0.080$ | $\pm 0.005$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | Automated goniometer step calibration |

*(Ensures access transistor channel sub-threshold/junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ and gate oxide integrity for $3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ at 85°C).*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Post-Clean TXRF Surface Metal Contamination & Ellipsometric Metrology
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > Post-Clean TXRF Surface Metal Contamination & Ellipsometric Metrology  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Automated In-Line Metrology Toolset)

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objectives
Following the dilute HF native oxide strip and RCA-2 (SC-2) wet chemical decontamination sequence, wafer surfaces must be verified prior to high-temperature thermal processing (850°C–900°C dry gate oxidation for 3.5 nm physical $SiO_2$). This procedure establishes the automated in-line protocol for:
1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE):** Measuring post-clean residual / chemical oxide thickness and surface uniformity to confirm bare hydrophobic/sub-monolayer chemical passivation.
2. **Total Reflection X-ray Fluorescence (TXRF):** Quantifying residual surface metallic and alkali impurities ($Fe$, $Cu$, $Ni$, $Na$, $K$) below critical threshold levels to prevent gate oxide dielectric breakdown, threshold voltage shifts, and junction/sub-threshold leakage exceeding 1 fA/cell at 85°C.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

```
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | STEP 1: Automated Wafer Transfer & FOUP/Cassette Load       |
  |         - N2-purged load lock; edge-handling end effector   |
  +-----------------------------+-------------------------------+
                                |
                                v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | STEP 2: Multi-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) Scan    |
  |         - 13-point or 49-point wafer mapping                |
  |         - Measure residual oxide thickness (target <= 0.6nm)|
  +-----------------------------+-------------------------------+
                                |
                                v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | STEP 3: In-Situ TXRF Surface Metallic Decontamination Scan  |
  |         - Mo-K-alpha / W-L-beta X-ray grazing angle beam    |
  |         - Screen Fe, Cu, Ni, Na, K areal density            |
  +-----------------------------+-------------------------------+
                                |
                                v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | STEP 4: SPC Data Ingestion, Pass/Fail Gating & Gate Run Handoff |
  |         - Confirm all acceptance thresholds met             |
  |         - Immediate route to oxidation (Q-time <= 2 hrs)    |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Tool Inspection & Cassette Loading
1. Verify tool vacuum chamber pressure, nitrogen purge flow, and calibration standards (blank reference wafer and calibrated metallic standard).
2. Transfer post-RCA cleaned and $N_2$ blow-dried wafers into the cleanroom Class 1 mini-environment automated load lock using vacuum or edge-grip robotics.

#### Step 2: In-Line Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Metrology
1. Align the notch/flat automatically to establish standard wafer orientation.
2. Perform a standardized 13-point or 49-point surface scan across the wafer radius (with a 3 mm edge exclusion).
3. Extract physical film thickness using the verified optical dispersion model ($Si/SiO_2$ Cauchy/Tauc-Lorentz model).
4. Record mean residual chemical/native oxide thickness and standard deviation ($\sigma$).

#### Step 3: TXRF Metallic Contamination Metrology
1. Position wafer under the TXRF grazing-incidence X-ray source (glancing angle below critical angle $\theta_c \approx 0.18^\circ$ for silicon substrates to maintain total external reflection and limit excitation to the top 3–5 nm).
2. Execute multi-point integration (center, middle radius, edge zones) targeting fluorescence peaks for transition metals ($Fe$, $Cu$, $Ni$) and alkali ions ($Na^+$, $K^+$).
3. Compute areal atomic concentration in $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ via reference sensitivity coefficients.

#### Step 4: Pass/Fail Evaluation & Queue-Time (Q-Time) Release
1. Verify automated feedforward flags against SPC acceptance limits.
2. If metrology passes, stamp wafer run traveler and immediately dispatch lot to the 850°C–900°C dry gate oxidation furnace. Ensure strict queue-time control (wafer transfer to furnace load within $\le 2\text{ hours}$ to prevent uncontrolled airborne organic and native oxide regrowth).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Surface Oxide Thickness** | $\le 0.6$ (Sub-monolayer / passivated) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer (SE) |
| **Surface Heavy Metal Contamination ($Fe$, $Cu$, $Ni$)** | $\le 5.0 \times 10^{9}$ (each element) | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF (Glancing Incident Angle $\le 0.18^\circ$) |
| **Surface Alkali Metal Contamination ($Na$, $K$)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF |
| **Post-Clean to Gate Oxidation Q-Time Window** | $\le 120$ | $\text{minutes}$ | Automated MES Timestamp Tracking |

---

### 4. Context References & Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Chemical decontamination sequence removes organic residues, particle contamination, and alkali/heavy metallic ionic traces ($Fe$, $Cu$, $Ni$, $Na^+$, $K^+$) via SC-1 (5:1:1 $H_2O : NH_4OH : H_2O_2$ at 70°C–80°C) and SC-2 (6:1:1 $H_2O : HCl : H_2O_2$ at 70°C–80°C) with 1:50 HF native oxide strip and high-purity $N_2$ blow-dry.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Defines the gate dielectric downstream target: thermally grown $SiO_2$ at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness. Eliminating residual metals is critical to avoid premature breakdown across this thin oxide.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Outlines strict electrical containment targets: sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below 1 fA/cell at 85°C to achieve required refresh intervals. Metallic defect density directly degrades junction leakage if not verified post-clean.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness & Native Oxide Regrowth Inspection

**Task Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > Post-Clean TXRF Surface Metal Contamination & Ellipsometric Metrology > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness & Native Oxide Regrowth Inspection  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Make  
**Document Status:** Approved SOP  

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Wafer Transfer from  │
│  DHF/RCA-2 Wet Bench  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Spectroscopic     │
│     Ellipsometer      │
│      Calibration      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Stage Loading &    │
│       Alignment       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  49-Point Automated   │
│     Spectral Scan     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Cauchy / Dispersion  │
│   Optical Modeling    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Native Oxide      │
│      Regrowth &       │
│    Non-Uniformity     │
│     Verification      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Dispatch to 180nm   │
│     Dry Oxidation     │
│        Furnace        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
Establish the standard execution procedure for measuring residual/native oxide thickness and post-growth gate oxide films using non-destructive optical spectroscopic ellipsometry. This step monitors the pre-oxidation native oxide regrowth kinetics after DHF/RCA cleaning and verifies the target 3.5 nm gate dielectric thickness with sub-Angstrom precision prior to DRAM access transistor gate stack formation (channel $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

---

## 2. Equipment, Models & Calibration
1. **Tool Setup:** Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer configured with broadband light source (UV-Vis-NIR spectral range) and rotating analyzer/compensator.
2. **Optical Formulation:**
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
   where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients, and $\Psi$ (Psi) and $\Delta$ (Delta) represent the amplitude ratio and phase difference upon reflection.
3. **Dispersion Modeling:** Cauchy / Sellmeier dispersion models parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ over bare P-type (100) Si substrate.
4. **Baseline Standardization:** Run standard reference silicon calibration wafer before every lot execution to calibrate goniometer angle and polarizer offset.

---

## 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Inspection Hand-off & Queue Time Control
1. Retrieve cassette immediately post-DHF native oxide etch and RCA-2 (SC-2) decontamination.
2. Confirm the post-etch queue time window: Wafer must be measured and loaded into the dry oxidation tube within the critical surface passivation window to limit atmospheric oxygen/moisture regrowth.

### Step 2: Wafer Handling and Stage Alignment
1. Transfer wafer via vacuum wand (handling backside only) onto the automated vacuum chuck of the spectroscopic ellipsometer.
2. Initiate auto-tilt and vacuum lock. Verify optical reflection intensity signal to ensure wafer flatness and stage alignment.

### Step 3: Spectral Acquisition & Automated Wafer Mapping
1. Select the **49-point automated wafer mapping recipe** (polar/radial distribution across the wafer surface, covering center, half-radius, and edge exclusion zone).
2. Measure spectra across broadband wavelengths at fixed angle of incidence (e.g., $70^\circ$–$75^\circ$).
3. Record raw $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ across all 49 measurement sites.

### Step 4: Dispersion Model Fitting & Thickness Extraction
1. Apply the **Cauchy / Sellmeier optical dispersion model**:
   - Model the substrate as crystalline silicon (c-Si).
   - Model the surface layer as ultra-thin dielectric ($\text{SiO}_2$ native layer or grown dry oxide).
2. Execute regression fit minimization (MSE minimization) to extract physical thickness $t_{ox}$ and parameterize $n(\lambda)$.
3. Quantify wafer radial non-uniformity across all 49 points.

### Step 5: Post-Measurement Disposition
1. Compare measured values against the acceptance limits.
2. If post-DHF native oxide regrowth exceeds the threshold, route lot back for re-dip in dilute HF.
3. If within specification, release cassette immediately to the 180nm dry gate oxidation furnace.

---

## 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                      ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                      │░░                              │
      MOSCAP C-V Equiv┤░░                              │
Ellipsometer Precision┤▒                               │
                      │▒                               │
      Target Thickness┤████████████████████████████████│
                      │████████████████████████████████│
                      └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                      0.0     0.9     1.8    2.6    3.5 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Unit | Target / Limit | Inspection Method / Tool |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Measurement Precision (Dry Gate Oxide)** | $\text{nm}$ | **$\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$** (sub-Angstrom precision) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi$, $\Delta$ regression fit) |
| **Nominal Dry Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $\text{nm}$ | **$3.5\text{ nm}$** | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Cauchy Model |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Resolution** | points | **$49\text{-point}$** (or $9\text{-point}$) automated radial map | Automated stage scan mapping |
| **MOSCAP High-Frequency C-V Correlation Precision** | $\text{nm}$ | **$\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$** | Stage 2 Reality Gate Planar MOSCAP $C_{ox}$ Extraction ($1\text{ MHz}$) |

---

## 5. Literature & Context Citations
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Provides the fundamental polarization equation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - Defines Cauchy and Sellmeier dispersion modeling for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Specifies dry gate oxide (3.5 nm) measurement precision of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ and automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping for radial non-uniformity tracking.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Confirms the 180nm node integration context with access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) requiring tight gate dielectric control.
- **Source: Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
  - Establishes cross-validation with physical oxide thickness extraction via accumulation capacitance $C_{ox} = (\varepsilon_{ox} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{ox}$ yielding physical thickness validation with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision.
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction (Nicollian & Brews - MOS Physics and Technology)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-180-49PT
**Title:** Automated 49-Point Wafer Mapping for Residual Oxide & Thickness Uniformity Recipe Execution  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Classification:** Metrology / Non-destructive Thin Film Characterization  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objectives
This SOP outlines the automated wafer-handling and spectroscopic ellipsometry sequence for 49-point surface mapping of residual/native oxide regrowth and subsequent thermal gate dielectric thin films (~3.5 nm physical thickness target) on 200 mm silicon wafers prior to and after thermal processing.

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
|                 49-POINT POLAR/CARTESIAN MAP                |
|                                                             |
|                          *   *   *                          |
|                      *   *   *   *   *                      |
|                  *   *   *   *   *   *   *                  |
|                *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *                |
|                *   *   *   * (0,0) *   *   *                |
|                *   *   *   *   *   *   *   *                |
|                  *   *   *   *   *   *   *                  |
|                      *   *   *   *   *                      |
|                          *   *   *                          |
|                                                             |
|        [Center] -> [Inner Ring] -> [Mid] -> [Edge Ring]     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Alignment and Cassette Loading
1. Verify the nitrogen-purged FOUP/SMIF pod containing the post-RCA/post-HF clean wafers is docked to the automated load port.
2. Engage the automated robotic end-effector to transfer the wafer to the optical pre-aligner station.
3. Perform notch detection and align the wafer notch to $180^\circ$ (downward orientation).

#### Step 2: Stage Transfer & Vacuum Chucking
1. Transfer the aligned wafer onto the high-precision vacuum chuck of the Spectroscopic Ellipsometer.
2. Engage vacuum hold-down and confirm chuck vacuum differential.
3. Execute auto-focus and auto-tilt alignment using the laser quadrant sensor to ensure perpendicularity to the incident optical beam ($\Psi$, $\Delta$ signal optimization).

#### Step 3: Optical Model & Recipe Selection
1. Load the metrology recipe: `DRAM180_GATE_OX_49PT_MAP`.
2. Configure the optical dispersion model:
   - **Substrate:** Silicon (`Si_jaw`).
   - **Top Layer:** Silicon Dioxide (`SiO2_jaw`) parameterized via Cauchy dispersion:
     $$n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0$$
   - Set the measurement wavelength range across UV-Visible-NIR spectra.
   - Set nominal physical thickness seed value: $3.5\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 4: Automated 49-Point Mapping Execution
1. Initiate the 49-point measurement pattern (Cartesian/polar grid across the wafer surface up to a 3 mm edge-exclusion boundary).
2. For each site, record the complex reflectance ratio:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
3. Perform non-linear regression fitting to extract physical film thickness $t$, mean square error (MSE), and surface refractive index $n$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$.
4. Record coordinate-specific measurements across concentric radial zones (Center, $R/3$, $2R/3$, Outer Edge).

#### Step 5: Post-Scan Uniformity Calculation & Unload
1. Calculate the wafer-level radial non-uniformity metrics using standard percent non-uniformity (%NU):
   $$\% \text{NU} = \frac{t_{\max} - t_{\min}}{2 \cdot t_{\text{avg}}} \times 100$$
2. Disengage vacuum chuck, transfer the wafer via vacuum wand/robot arm back into the nitrogen-purged carrier, and mark the cassette batch status in the MES.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\le \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ (sub-Ångström) | Repeatability check ($1\sigma$ over 10 cycles on reference site) |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness Target** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.15$ | $\text{nm}$ | 49-point wafer average ($t_{\text{avg}}$) from Cauchy fit |
| **Gate Oxide Equivalent Thickness (EOT)** | $3.0\text{ to }4.0$ | $3.0 \le \text{EOT} \le 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Optical model fit verified against electrical $C\text{-}V$ correlation |
| **Thickness Uniformity ($1\sigma$ / %NU)** | $< 1.5$ | $\le 2.0$ | $\%$ | 49-point radial map calculation ($(t_{\max} - t_{\min}) / (2 t_{\text{avg}}) \times 100$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
   - Physical Principle: Measurement of polarization changes upon reflection ($\Psi$ and $\Delta$), quantified via $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
   - Dispersion modeling: Cauchy or Sellmeier models parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
   - Measurement Precision: Sub-Ångström precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide films.
   - Mapping pattern: Automated 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs.
2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
   - Gate dielectric target: Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
   - Dielectric thickness scale: Equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) maintained at $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
   - Geometry integration: Access transistor gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ establishing dimensional constraints for underlying gate dielectric uniformity.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Immediate Baseline Measurement ($t = 0\text{ hr}$):**
   - Transfer monitor and product wafers directly from the dilute HF etch and post-rinse/dry module to the Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) load port within $< 15\text{ min}$.
   - Load wafer under cleanroom ambient ($21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, $\text{RH} = 40 \pm 3\%$) or clean FOUP/SMIF pod.
   - Execute a 13-point or 49-point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry wafer map measuring $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ across $250\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$ wavelengths to fit initial chemical/native oxide thickness ($t_0$). Confirm initial hydrogen passivation ($x_0 < 0.2\text{ nm}$).

2. **Kinetic Regrowth Interval Tracking:**
   - Expose the designated monitor wafer to the monitored cleanroom staging environment (or staging pod with N₂ purge).
   - Re-measure native oxide film thickness ($x_{\text{native}}$) using the identical SE recipe at predefined queue intervals: $t = 1\text{ hr}$, $2\text{ hr}$, $4\text{ hr}$, $8\text{ hr}$, and $12\text{ hr}$.
   - Extract the regrowth rate curve fitting the thin-regime surface kinetics:
     $$\Delta x_{\text{native}}(t) = x(t) - x_0$$

3. **Queue-Time (Q-Time) Limit Evaluation:**
   - Compare measured oxide regrowth against the pre-oxidation gate dielectric budget. Because the total gate oxide target is $3.5\text{ nm}$ grown via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$, uncontrolled native oxide prior to furnace loading must not exceed $0.5\text{ nm}$ to avoid interface defect density degradation ($D_{\text{it}} \ge 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$) and EOT shift.
   - Establish and log the hard furnace entry Queue-Time Limit ($t_{\text{Q-limit}}$). Mark lots exceeding the threshold for mandatory re-clean through the dilute HF dip.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Baseline Target | Tolerance / Upper Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Initial Post-HF Oxide Thickness ($t_0$)** | $0.10$ | $\le 0.25$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi, \Delta$) |
| **Native Oxide Regrowth at Q-Time Expiry** | $\le 0.40$ | $\le 0.50$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Hard Queue-Time (Q-Time) Window** | $4.0$ | $\le 6.0$ | $\text{hr}$ | MES / Station Automated Q-Timer |
| **Subsequent Dry Gate Oxide Physical Target** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / TEM ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ tube furnace) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  - Confirms gate dielectric target: *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness."*
- **Source:** *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*  
  - Defines kinetic limits and interface requirements: *"In the thin regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$), oxidation is interface reaction-rate limited... Thickness target for 180nm gate dielectric is $3.5$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$... Minimal interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$)."*
- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - Identifies access transistor dimensions and device integrity context: *"Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$."*
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document Code:** SOP-MET-TXRF-180NM-001  
**Title:** TXRF Wafer Surface Transition Metal Trace Contamination Screening ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Ni}$, $\text{Cu}$)  
**Hierarchy Level:** Metrology Leaf SOP  
**Technology Generation:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2)  
**Target Unit Cell Impact:** Access Transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), Gate Oxide ($t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$)

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Pre-Oxidation RCA-2   │
│  / DHF Cleaned Wafer   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Load into TXRF     │
│      Sample Stage      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Set Grazing Angle    │
│  below Critical Angle  │
│    phi_c ~0.10 deg     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Acquire X-ray      │
│      Fluorescence      │
│      Spectrum at       │
│       500-1000s        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Quantify Fe, Ni, Cu   │
│        Surface         │
│     Concentration      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│     Contamination      │
│    Threshold Check     │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             │
             ├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮Fail: Exceeds Target
             │Pass: Metals < 1e10 atoms/cm2                          │
             ▼                                                       ▼
┌────────────────────────┐                              ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │                              │                        │
│  Release to 180nm Dry  │                              │   Rework: Recycle to   │
│     Gate Oxidation     │                              │  SC-2 Clean Sequence   │
│        Furnace         │                              │                        │
│                        │                              │                        │
└────────────────────────┘                              └────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Screening Verification & Queue Handling:**
   - Receive the wafer lot immediately following the `Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation` (SC-1 rinse $\rightarrow$ 1:50 DHF etch $\rightarrow$ RCA-2 / SC-2 metallic strip $\rightarrow$ ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ spin dry).
   - Ensure the wafer queue time to TXRF inspection is strictly controlled to prevent uncontrolled ambient re-oxidation or airborne trace metal adsorption.

2. **Substrate Loading & Chamber Vacuum/Purge:**
   - Transfer the dry silicon wafer via robotic non-contact edge-grip end effector onto the Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) metrology vacuum stage.
   - Evacuate or purge the measurement chamber with high-purity dry $\text{N}_2$ to suppress air scattering of low-energy characteristic fluorescent X-rays.

3. **Optics Alignment & Grazing Incident Angle Setting:**
   - Power on the microfocus X-ray source (typically equipped with a Molybdenum or Tungsten anode and monochromatizing multilayer mirror).
   - Align the incident grazing angle $\phi$ below the critical angle of total external reflection for silicon ($\phi < \phi_c \approx 0.10^{\circ}\text{ to }0.18^{\circ}$ depending on X-ray energy) to limit penetration depth to the top $\sim 3\text{ to }5\text{ nm}$ of the substrate surface.

4. **Multi-Point Spectral Acquisition:**
   - Execute an automated 5-point to 9-point surface scan (center, half-radius, edge exclusion zone $> 3\text{ mm}$).
   - Set signal integration live time between $500\text{ s}$ and $1000\text{ s}$ per measurement site to optimize signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) down to trace detection limits.

5. **Spectral Deconvolution & Quantitation:**
   - Deconvolve the acquired energy-dispersive X-ray spectra across primary $K_\alpha$ and $K_\beta$ transition peaks:
     - **Iron ($\text{Fe}$):** $K_\alpha \approx 6.40\text{ keV}$
     - **Nickel ($\text{Ni}$):** $K_\alpha \approx 7.47\text{ keV}$
     - **Copper ($\text{Cu}$):** $K_\alpha \approx 8.04\text{ keV}$
   - Calculate areal concentration ($\text{atoms/cm}^2$) using reference standard sensitivity calibration curves.

6. **Lot Disposition:**
   - If trace concentrations of $\text{Fe}$, $\text{Ni}$, and $\text{Cu}$ comply with threshold metrics, release the lot directly to the `180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm)` quartz tube furnace run.
   - If any site fails the threshold, reject the lot and route to rework: recycle through the Standard RCA-2 (SC-2: $6\text{ parts }\text{H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part }\text{HCl} : 1\text{ part }\text{H}_2\text{O}_2\text{ at }70^{\circ}\text{C}-80^{\circ}\text{C}$) metallic strip sequence.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Surface Transition Metal Contamination ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Ni}$, $\text{Cu}$)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF 9-point surface scan deconvolution |
| **Incident X-Ray Grazing Angle ($\phi$) Setting Accuracy** | $\le 0.10 \pm 0.01$ | $\text{degrees } (^{\circ})$ | High-resolution goniometer stage alignment |
| **Downstream Gate Oxide Thickness Range** | $3.5\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometry |
| **Downstream Oxide Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Post-gate oxide MOS capacitor breakdown testing |
| **Cell Leakage Current Target (at $85^{\circ}\text{C}$)** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Automated parametric tester (WAT / PCM) |

---

## 4. Context & Literature Citations

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - Confirms the pre-oxidation RCA sequence: RCA-1 ($5\text{ parts }\text{H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part }\text{NH}_4\text{OH} : 1\text{ part }\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ at $70^{\circ}\text{C}-80^{\circ}\text{C}$ for $10-15\text{ min}$), intermediate $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water rinse, $1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ dip ($15-30\text{ s}$), and RCA-2 ($6\text{ parts }\text{H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part }\text{HCl} : 1\text{ part }\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ at $70^{\circ}\text{C}-80^{\circ}\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$) targeting heavy metal elimination ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$) prior to thermal processing.
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
  - Establishes the downstream thermal oxidation requirements: dry oxidation at $900^{\circ}\text{C}-1000^{\circ}\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$ achieving high dielectric breakdown ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$), minimal interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$), and targeted 180nm gate dielectric thickness of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Establishes unit cell geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and the critical DRAM leakage current target ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^{\circ}\text{C}$), which requires ultra-clean pre-gate oxide interfaces free from metallic recombination-generation centers.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Pre-Gate Surface Cleanliness Quality Qualification & Queue-Time Certification

**Task Node Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Dilute HF Native Oxide Etch & RCA-2 (SC-2) Metallic Decontamination Sequence Execution > Post-Clean TXRF Surface Metal Contamination & Ellipsometric Metrology > **Pre-Gate Surface Cleanliness Quality Qualification & Queue-Time Certification**  
**Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Buy / Metrology Certification  
**Author**: Domain Expert AI (DRAM Foundation VN Council)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Lifecycle Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Post-Clean Wafer Lot  │
│       Inspection       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     TXRF Metallic      │
│    Contamination &     │
│      Ellipsometry      │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│        Quality         │
│     Qualification      │
│        Passed?         │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────╮
             │                             │
          Yes│                           No│
             ▼                             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐    ┌────────────────────────┐
│    Queue-Time Clock    │    │   MRB Hold & Rework    │
│    Activation <= 2     │    │   (Scrub / Re-clean)   │
│         Hours          │    │                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘    └────────────────────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Transfer into Dry    │
│     Gate Oxidation     │
│    Furnace 850-900C    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Lot Intake & FOUP Nitrogen Environment Verification**:
   - Transfer wafer carrier (FOUP) immediately from the Dilute HF / RCA-2 wet-clean bench to the metrology dock under Class 1 mini-environment cleanroom conditions.
   - Maintain continuous $N_2$ purge purge pressure ($\ge 0.05\text{ MPa}$, relative humidity $< 5\%$) to inhibit uncontrolled native oxide regrowth prior to gate oxidation.
2. **TXRF Surface Metallic Contamination Measurement**:
   - Load qualified sample wafers into the Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) chamber.
   - Measure 5-point to 9-point surface maps across the wafer, focusing on critical heavy metal contaminants ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}, \text{Zn}$) across active diffusion areas (channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, length $L = 180\text{ nm}$).
3. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness Inspection**:
   - Position wafer in the automated spectroscopic ellipsometer to verify complete removal of chemical/native oxides.
   - Validate that residual interfacial oxide thickness across the active gate channel does not exceed critical threshold limits before thermal oxidation.
4. **Automated Defect & Particle Inspection**:
   - Inspect frontside active silicon area with laser surface particle scanning.
   - Ensure zero critical fatal particle defects within active array channels to prevent pinholes and localized breakdown in the target $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide.
5. **Quality Disposition & Queue-Time Certification**:
   - If TXRF metallic levels, residual oxide thickness, and particle thresholds pass: certify lot disposition in MES (Manufacturing Execution System) as **Pre-Gate Qualified**.
   - **Queue-Time Clock Activation**: Stamp and start hard queue-time window ($\le 2\text{ hours}$ maximum exposure limit) for delivery and boat loading into the dry thermal oxidation furnace ($850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - If queue time expires ($> 2\text{ hours}$) or contamination limits fail: tag lot with MRB Hold; route lot to dilute HF dip re-strip and pre-gate surface preparation loop.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Acceptance Metric | Target Specification | Measurement Method | Verification Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Interfacial / Native Oxide Thickness** | $\le 0.50\text{ nm}$ (ensuring target $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide growth control) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Surface Heavy Metal Contamination ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ per element | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ |
| **Pre-Gate Hard Queue-Time Limit** | $\le 2.0\text{ hours}$ (clean-to-furnace idle window) | MES Automated Queue-Time Dispatcher | $\text{hours}$ |
| **Surface Particle Count ($\ge 0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ size on 200mm/300mm wafer)** | $\le 15\text{ defects/wafer}$ | Laser Scattering Particle Scanner | $\text{defects/wafer}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - *Gate Dielectric Specifications*: Thermally grown dry silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - *Reliability*: Strict gate surface clean qualification required to protect the $3.5\text{ nm}$ EOT integrity, preventing excessive leakage and maintaining retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - *Access Transistor Geometry*: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ in stacked capacitor over bitline (COB) architecture.
  - *Leakage Target*: Sub-threshold and junction leakage target $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, directly reliant on defect-free gate dielectric interfaces.
- **[SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid]**:
  - *Critical Dimensions & Active Area*: Minimum active diffusion width of $0.15\ \mu\text{m}$ ($150\text{ nm}$) and manufacturing grid resolution of $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\text{ nm}$).
  - *Defect Scaling*: Maximum allowable defect threshold calibrated against minimum gate length and active pitch.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-TXRF-180NM-01
**Title:** Wafer Surface Cleanliness Metrology & TXRF Trace Metal Qualification  
**Module:** Metrology / Gate Oxidation Pre-Clean Qualification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Node)  
**Action Type:** Buy / In-Line Metrology Tool Qualification Protocol  

---

### 1. Purpose & Process Context
This SOP defines the in-line metrology and qualification protocol for monitoring post-SC-2 / pre-gate surface cleanliness on 200 mm silicon wafers prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation. In accordance with the DRAM Foundation VN 180nm architecture, access transistor leakage must not exceed critical cell retention budgets, and pre-gate metallic contamination must be certified within tight queue-time windows to prevent early dielectric breakdown ($E_{bd} < 10\text{ MV/cm}$) and elevated interface trap density ($D_{it} \ge 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Pre-Gate Cleanliness Metrology Flow                                               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1: Automated FOUP Transfer & Laser Particle Inspection]                   |
|       |                                                                           |
|       v                                                                           |
|  [Step 2: Multi-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry for Native Oxide / Residual Tox] |
|       |                                                                           |
|       v                                                                           |
|  [Step 3: Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Multi-Point Metal Scan]      |
|       |                                                                           |
|       v                                                                           |
|  [Step 4: Queue-Time Tagging & Release to 850°C-900°C Dry Gate Oxidation Furnace] |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Automated Cassette Transfer & Surface Particle Screening
1. Transfer the post-clean FOUP/cassette directly from the Dilute HF / SC-2 wet bench into the automated darkfield laser surface scanner (Class 1 minienvironment).
2. Execute a 100% surface inspection scan to verify defect density and ensure no gross residual slurry or liquid droplets remain post-spin-rinse-dry (SRD).

#### Step 2: In-Situ Native Oxide & Chemical Oxide Ellipsometric Metrology
1. Load the pilot qualification wafer onto the motorized multi-angle spectroscopic ellipsometer vacuum chuck.
2. Acquire 13-point or 49-point polar map measurements across the wafer diameter (5 mm edge exclusion).
3. Extract physical native/chemical oxide thickness ($T_{ox}$) using a Cauchy dispersion model calibrated for thin interface films ($< 1.0\text{ nm}$). Ensure minimal native oxide regrowth before dry thermal gate oxidation (target: 3.5 nm to 4.0 nm).

#### Step 3: TXRF Trace Metal Contamination Spectroscopy
1. Transfer wafer into the Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) spectrometer loadlock chamber ($P < 5 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$).
2. Align the incident monochromatic X-ray beam (Mo-$K_\alpha$ or W-$L_\beta$) at an incident angle below the critical angle of total external reflection ($\phi_c \approx 0.10^\circ - 0.18^\circ$ on Si) to excite only the outermost surface atomic layers (~3–5 nm depth).
3. Collect energy-dispersive X-ray spectra across 5 designated test points (Center, North, South, East, West at $R = 70\text{ mm}$):
   - Quantify transition metals: Iron (Fe), Nickel (Ni), Copper (Cu), and Zinc (Zn).
   - Ensure integration counting time is calibrated to yield a Lower Limit of Detection (LLD) $\le 5 \times 10^{9}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$.

#### Step 4: Q-Time Certification & Automated Furnace Dispatch
1. Record and digitally log measurement timestamps into the Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
2. Validate that the total wet-clean-to-oxidation queue time (Q-time) is within specification.
3. Automatically lock/release the lot for direct transfer into the 850°C–900°C dry oxidation quartz tube furnace.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Metal Contamination (Fe, Ni, Cu)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF Spectroscopy (5-point wafer map) |
| **Interface Trap Density Potential ($D_{it}$ Proxy)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$ | Post-gate C-V / TXRF pre-qual correlation |
| **Post-Etch Native Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $\le 0.8$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (13-point map) |
| **Pre-Oxidation Queue Time ($Q\text{-Time}$)** | $\le 2.0$ | $\text{hours}$ | Factory Automation / MES Time-Stamp Tracking |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
  - Dry oxidation target for 180nm gate dielectric is $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ grown at $900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$.
  - Demands dense breakdown characteristics ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$, strictly mandating pre-oxidation sub-$10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ metallic trace thresholds.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Access transistor gate dielectric is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Channel geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) requiring sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, emphasizing stringent metallic contamination control to eliminate metal-induced junction leakage pathways.

Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Carrier Transfer & Environmental Control Initialization**:
