   - Automatically trigger the MES automated Queue-Time (Q-time) tracker linked to the furnace loading scheduler.

2. **Native Oxide Regrowth & Ellipsometric Metrology**:
   - Sample monitor wafers across slotted exposure intervals ($t = 0.5\text{ h}, 1.0\text{ h}, 2.0\text{ h}, 4.0\text{ h}$) using multi-wavelength Spectroscopic Ellipsometry to quantify interfacial native oxide growth prior to dry oxidation.
   - Verify native oxide baseline does not disrupt target gate dielectric physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ (or up to $1000^\circ\text{C}$) in pure dry $\text{O}_2$.

3. **Airborne Molecular Contamination (AMC) Metrology**:
   - Deploy Ion Mobility Spectrometry (IMS) and Thermal Desorption Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry (TD-GC-MS) witness wafers inside the cleanroom ambient and FOUP micro-environments.
   - Detect and quantify Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs), airborne molecular bases/amines (which suppress uniform oxidation kinetics), and trace halogens.

4. **Queue-Time Boundary Validation & Gate Furnace Ingestion**:
   - Correlate ellipsometric regrowth curves against the Deal-Grove thin-regime linear oxidation rate constant ($k_l = B/A$).
   - Confirm queue-time does not exceed the validated window; dispatch wafer lots directly to the quartz tube furnace load lock for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry thermal gate oxide growth.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                  Pre-Gate Metrology & Q-Time Limits    
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░░░░░░░░░                               │
Inorg AMC (ng)┤░░░░░░░░░                               │
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
  Org AMC (ng)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
    Q-Time (h)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓        │
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓        │
  Regrowth (A)┤████████████████████████████████████    │
              │████████████████████████████████████    │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
              0.0       1.2       2.5      3.8      5.0 
```

1. **Pre-Gate Native Oxide Regrowth**: $\le 4.5 \text{ \AA}$ ($0.45 \text{ nm}$) across monitor wafers measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry prior to thermal gate oxide growth.
2. **Maximum Allowable Pre-Gate Queue Time**: $\le 4.0 \text{ h}$ total elapsed time between final HF rinse/dry and furnace tube idle-temperature load ($T_{\text{idle}} \le 650^\circ\text{C}$).
3. **Organic AMC Deposition on Active Area**: $\le 5.0 \text{ ng/cm}^2$ total organic carbon (TOC) detected via TD-GC-MS / witness wafer metrology.
4. **Inorganic/Amine AMC Level**: $\le 1.0 \text{ ng/cm}^2$ total basic molecular contamination inside carrier micro-environment.

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Contextual Basis

- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms target gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness; keeping pre-gate native oxide strictly bounded ensures total oxide thickness stability and prevents sub-threshold leakage exceeding $1\text{ fA/cell}$.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Establishes that in the ultra-thin regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$), oxidation follows linear kinetic control with linear rate constant $k_l = B/A$. Uncontrolled pre-gate native oxide growth and AMC chemisorption perturb $x_0$ and interface trap density, threatening the baseline $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ and target breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) dictate that threshold voltage shifts induced by variable native oxide queue-time directly compromise refresh retention targets ($>64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Certified Cleanroom Nitrogen Purge FOUP Carrier Procurement & Qualification
**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB180-MET-FOUP-001`  
**Classification:** Industrial Standard Operating Procedure (Gen 2 / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture)  
**Parent Process Hierarchy:** Architecture & Integration > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation > Pre-Gate Surface Cleanliness Quality Qualification & Queue-Time Certification > **Certified Cleanroom Nitrogen Purge FOUP Carrier Procurement & Qualification**

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This SOP establishes the protocol for procuring, testing, and qualifying cleanroom Nitrogen ($N_2$) Purge Front Opening Unified Pod (FOUP) / SMIF carriers. At the 180nm technology node, gate oxide target thickness is strictly ~3.5 nm grown at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation following RCA-1, dilute HF (1:50 native oxide strip), and RCA-2 wet surface preparation. Minimizing post-clean native oxide regrowth and airborne molecular contamination (AMC) during queue time prior to thermal oxidation requires positive-pressure ultra-high-purity (UHP) $N_2$ purged mini-environments.

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Procurement &      │
│  Receiving Inspection  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Particle &       │
│  Outgassing Baseline   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    N2 Purge Flow &     │
│  Pressure Validation   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        O2 & RH         │
│   De-enrichment Rate   │
│          Test          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Production       │
│  Qualification & Tool  │
│        Tagging         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Procurement & Incoming Physical Inspection
1. Verify procurement specifications for ultra-clean polycarbonate or carbon-filled PEEK FOUP shells featuring dual bottom-valve $N_2$ purge ports and low-outgassing fluoroelastomer perimeter seals.
2. Unpack FOUP units in ISO Class 4 (or cleaner) incoming inspection bay under vertical laminar flow.
3. Inspect kinematic coupling plates, robot handling flanges, door clamping latches, and purge check valves for mechanical integrity and micro-scratching.

#### Step 2: Mechanical Docking & Door Seal Interface Verification
1. Dock FOUP onto automated Load Port Unit (LPU) interface.
2. Engage kinematic pins and execute 20 consecutive door opening/closing cycles.
3. Validate door perimeter seal compression and verify purge port valve sealing under leak test mode.

#### Step 3: Purge Flow Rate & Internal Overpressure Balancing
1. Connect carrier purge ports to automated UHP $N_2$ supply (gas purity grade $\ge 99.999\%$, filtered to $\le 0.05\ \mu\text{m}$).
2. Regulate $N_2$ purge flow rate between 20 to 50 SLM (standard liters per minute).
3. Confirm positive internal pod differential pressure relative to the cleanroom ambient ($\Delta P = +5\text{ to }+25\text{ Pa}$) to prevent particle infiltration.

#### Step 4: Environmental De-enrichment Metrology ($O_2$ & Relative Humidity)
1. Load optical trace oxygen analyzer and capacitive relative humidity sensors into monitor slots inside the sealed FOUP.
2. Initiate purge and record the time to achieve target residual levels ($O_2 \le 1.0\text{ ppm}$, Relative Humidity $\text{RH} \le 1.0\%$).
3. Perform static seal-decay test: disconnect active purge and track oxygen re-ingress rate over 2 hours.

#### Step 5: Cleanliness Baseline & Dynamic Particle Airborne Qualification
1. Run airborne particle counter (optical particle counter, minimum sensitivity $0.1\ \mu\text{m}$) hooked to pod exhaust port during rapid door actuation and 50 SLM purge flow.
2. Certify FOUP internal particle count remains $\le 2\text{ particles/m}^3$ at $\ge 0.1\ \mu\text{m}$.
3. Affix automated RFID tracking tag and clear carrier for pre-gate oxide wafer transport queue.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Purge $O_2$ De-enrichment Concentration** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{ppm}$ (parts per million) | In-situ Cavity Ring-Down Spectroscopy (CRDS) / Optical $O_2$ Sensor |
| **Purge Moisture / Relative Humidity (RH)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\%$ (relative humidity) | Trace Moisture Dew-Point Sensor / Capacitive Hygrometer |
| **Internal Positive Differential Pressure ($\Delta P$)** | $+5.0\text{ to }+25.0$ | $\text{Pa}$ (pascals) | High-precision differential pressure transducer at purge interface |
| **Dynamic Particulate Cleanliness** | $\le 2.0$ | $\text{particles/m}^3$ ($\ge 0.1\ \mu\text{m}$) | Laser Airborne Optical Particle Counter (OPC) at exhaust port |

---

### 4. Source Citations & Context Justification
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Context:* Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, stacked capacitor over bitline (COB). Minimum cell capacitance of $28\text{ fF}$ and sub-threshold/junction leakage target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C.
  - *SOP Link:* Minimizing sub-threshold and interface trap leakage on 180nm access gates requires uncompromising gate oxide interface quality and queue-time protection.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - *Context:* Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C}–900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - *SOP Link:* A physical oxide layer of only $3.5\text{ nm}$ is highly susceptible to uncontrolled native oxide growth; uncontrolled air/ambient exposure can add 0.5–1.0 nm of defective native oxide, severely skewing the $3.5\text{ nm}$ thermal gate oxide target thickness and breakdown voltage.
- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure:**
  - *Context:* Dilute hydrofluoric dip (1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) strips native oxide, transitioning the silicon surface from hydrophilic to hydrophobic ($Si\text{-}H$ passivated), followed by $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry with high-purity nitrogen.
  - *SOP Link:* Freshly stripped, hydrophobic $Si\text{-}H$ surfaces are chemically active. Transporting wafers in certified $N_2$ purge FOUP carriers maintains an inert ambient ($O_2 \le 1.0\text{ ppm}$, $\text{RH} \le 1.0\%$), preserving passivation and preventing surface re-oxidation before entering the $850^\circ\text{C}–900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation furnace.

## Title: Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology
**Branch Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Thermal Processing (180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth, 3.5 nm) > Wet Chemistry (Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation) > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Inline Metrology Toolset)

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Wafer Ingress      │
│      Post-RCA/HF       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sessile Drop Contact  │
│         Angle          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Laser Surface      │
│     Particle Scan      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    TXRF Heavy Metal    │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Release to Gate     │
│    Oxidation (3.5nm    │
│         SiO2)          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Lot Ingress & Nitrogen Purge Transfer:**
   - Unload wafer cassette directly from the automated spin-rinse-dry (SRD) module following the pre-oxidation RCA clean and dilute HF dip sequence.
   - Stage the cassette in a Class 1 minienvironment under continuous ultra-high purity (UHP) $N_2$ purge ($O_2 < 10\text{ ppm}$, relative humidity $< 30\%$).
   - *Time constraint:* Total queue time ($\text{Q-Time}$) from final HF rinse to metrology and furnace ingress must not exceed $60\text{ minutes}$ to prevent native oxide regrowth.

2. **Automated Sessile Drop Water Contact Angle (WCA) Measurement:**
   - Load the pilot/monitor wafer onto the automated goniometer chuck.
   - Dispense a deionized (DI) water droplet of $1.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$ using an automated micro-syringe at 5 distinct site locations (Center, North, South, East, West with $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).
   - Capture droplet profile at $t = 2.0\text{ s}$ post-dispense via high-resolution CCD camera. Measure tangent angle to verify surface hydrophobicity ($Si\text{-}H$ bond passivation after HF dip vs. hydrophilic chemical oxide).

3. **Laser Surface Particle Inspection (LSIS / Light Scattering):**
   - Transfer monitor and production wafers onto the darkfield laser surface inspection station (calibrated against NIST PSL spheres).
   - Execute full-surface spiral scan with defect threshold set to bin particles $\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ (corresponding to the minimum critical feature size $L = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Generate defect density map and record total particle count per wafer across the active area ($3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).

4. **Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Metallic Defect Sampling:**
   - Transfer the dedicated control wafer into the high-vacuum TXRF chamber ($P < 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$).
   - Position grazing-incidence X-ray beam ($\text{Mo-K}\alpha$ or $\text{W-L}\beta$ source at angle $\theta < \theta_c \approx 0.1^\circ$) across 3 test sites (Center, Mid-radius, Edge).
   - Integrate fluorescence energy spectrum for $300\text{ s}$ per site to quantify surface trace metal contaminants ($Fe, Cu, Ni, Zn$).

5. **Pass/Fail Disposition & Gate Oxide Lot Release:**
   - Aggregate metrology data via inline SECS/GEM interface.
   - If all criteria are met, release the wafer lot to the thermal oxidation bay for immediate loading into the vertical oxidation furnace for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $SiO_2$ gate oxide growth ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                     ┌─────────────────────────────────┐
                     │░░                               │
   Gate Ox Target EOT┤░░                               │
                     │▒▒▒                              │
    Fe/Cu/Ni Impurity┤▒▒▒                              │
Part. Count (>0.18um)┤▓▓▓▓▓                            │
                     │▓▓▓▓▓                            │
  Water Contact Angle┤█████████████████████████████████│
                     │█████████████████████████████████│
                     └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                     0.0    18.8    37.5    56.2   75.0 
```

| Parameter ID | Metrology Parameter | Target / Limit Value | Unit | Instrument / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-01** | Water Contact Angle (WCA) | $\ge 70.0^\circ$ (Hydrophobic $Si\text{-}H$ surface) | Degrees ($^\circ$) | Automated Optical Goniometer (5-point) |
| **AC-02** | Critical Surface Defect Count | $\le 10$ defects per wafer ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ PSL equivalent) | Counts/Wafer | Laser Surface Particle Scanner (LSIS) |
| **AC-03** | Transition Metal Contamination ($Fe, Cu, Ni$) | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | Grazing-Incidence TXRF |
| **AC-04** | Queue Time to Gate Oxidation | $\le 60$ | Minutes | Inline MES / Dispatch Timer |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  - Gate dielectric requirement: *Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($SiO_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.*
  - Minimum critical feature dimension: *Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (matching the particle sensitivity lower bound).*
- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: *Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Leakage current target $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ directly mandates zero metallic-defect and particle-induced dielectric breakdown in the gate region.*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Goniometer Water Contact Angle Metrology for HF-Last Hydrophobicity & Surface Passivation Verification  
**Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation Surface Prep > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Commercial Automated Contact Angle Goniometer System)

---

## 1. Process Flowchart

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Sample Loading:     │
│    HF-Dipped Wafer     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Automated Sessile DI  │
│    Water Dispensing    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Optical Profiling &   │
│    Tangent Fitting     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│     Contact Angle      │
│    Acceptance Check    │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├───────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
             │ Pass: θ ≥ 70°                                     │ Fail: θ < 70° (Oxide regrown/wetting)
             ▼                                                   ▼
┌────────────────────────┐                          ┌────────────────────────┐
│  Release to 850°C-900°C│                          │  Quarantine & Rework:  │
│   Dry Gate Oxidation   │                          │     Re-dip BOE 6:1     │
└────────────────────────┘                          └────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Protective Pre-Checks:**
   - Verify that personal protective equipment (PPE) is donned and Calcium Gluconate gel is present at the wet prep / transfer station prior to handling any HF-treated or BOE 6:1 residual surfaces (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
2. **Wafer Transfer & Queuing:**
   - Immediately following the pre-oxidation wet clean and in-situ HF / BOE 6:1 oxide etch dip (etch rate ~100 nm/min or 1000 Å/min at 25°C), load the dry, hydrogen-passivated silicon test/monitor wafer onto the automated goniometer vacuum chuck within ≤ 15 minutes to minimize atmospheric native oxide re-growth.
3. **Droplet Dispensing (Sessile Drop Method):**
   - Position the motorized micro-syringe containing ultra-pure deionized (DI) water (resistivity ≥ 18.2 MΩ·cm) 2.0 mm above the wafer target die location.
   - Dispense a precision sessile droplet of $2.0\text{ }\mu\text{L} \pm 0.2\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ at ambient cleanroom conditions ($25^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$).
4. **Image Acquisition & Baseline Fitting:**
   - Capture high-resolution droplet silhouette imaging within 3 to 5 seconds of surface contact using the telecentric lens camera.
   - Execute baseline detection and Young-Laplace / circle-tangent fitting algorithm to calculate the left and right contact angles ($\theta_L$, $\theta_R$).
5. **Multi-Site Mapping & Lot Release:**
   - Execute a 5-point measurement across the wafer diameter (Center, North, South, East, West at 10 mm edge exclusion).
   - If mean contact angle meets acceptance criteria ($\theta \ge 70^\circ$), release the batch directly to the dry oxidation furnace for 3.5 nm physical gate oxide growth at 850°C–900°C.
   - If contact angle fails ($\theta < 70^\circ$), quarantine the lot for re-cleaning and surface re-etching in BOE 6:1.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Action on Failure |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Water Contact Angle ($\theta$)** | $\ge 70.0$ | Degrees ($^\circ$) | Min: $70.0^\circ$ (Hydrophobic, H-terminated Si) | Quarantine lot; re-dip in BOE 6:1 |
| **Metrology Dispense Temperature** | $25$ | Celsius ($^\circ\text{C}$) | $\pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ | Suspend measurement until thermal equilibrium |
| **Pre-Oxidation Etch Rate Verification** | $100$ ($1000$) | $\text{nm/min}$ ($\text{\AA/min}$) | $\pm 10\text{ nm/min}$ (BOE 6:1 at $25^\circ\text{C}$) | Re-qualify BOE 6:1 bath composition |
| **Post-Passivation Target Gate Oxide** | $3.5$ | Nanometers ($\text{nm}$) | Physical thickness target for subsequent dry oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$) | Adjust oxidation thermal budget |

```text
Key Physical Metrics Baseline (Normalised Values / Scale)
                            ┌──────────────────────────┐
                            │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
BOE 6:1 SiO2 Etch Rate (25C)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│

                            │▒▒                        │
        Target Contact Angle┤███████████████████       │
                            │███████████████████       │
                            └┬─────┬──────┬─────┬─────┬┘
                             0    25     50    75   100 
```

---

## 4. Source Context Citations

- **Etchant Composition, Thermal Rate & Safety:** *Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — BOE 6:1 (6 parts 40% $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ and 1 part 49% $\text{HF}$), etch rate of thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at 25°C is ~100 nm/min (1000 Å/min); Calcium Gluconate gel mandate.
- **Downstream Thermal Gate Dielectric:** *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* — Pre-oxidation passivated surface targets thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness.
- **Access Transistor Dimension & Layout Integration:** *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* — Gate oxide integration controls the 180nm node access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

```text
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Microsyringe Dosing   │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Baseline Drop      │
│     Contact Angle      │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Vibration Isolation & Macro Stage Mechanical Leveling**
   - Mount the goniometer assembly onto a vibration-damped optical breadboard.
   - Place a precision spirit bubble level on the sample stage. Adjust the three-point kinematic leveling thumbscrews until the stage pitch and roll tilt are within $\pm 0.1^\circ$.

2. **Optical Rail & Telecentric Illumination Alignment**
   - Align the diffuse LED monochromatic backlight (365 nm / green-pass filtered or white collimated backlight) along the primary optical rail.
   - Adjust the camera and microscope objective (Plan Achromat, $10\times$, NA 0.25) so that the optical axis runs precisely parallel to the sample stage surface baseline.
   - Verify that the stage edge projects as a crisp, razor-thin horizontal baseline across the CMOS sensor without vignetting or parallax tilt.

3. **Optical Scale & Magnification Spatial Calibration**
   - Place a certified optical calibration reticle / micro-scale on the stage along the focal plane.
   - Focus the optics using the fine Z/X stage micrometers. Calibrate the image analysis software pixel-to-micrometer scale ratio ($\mu\text{m}/\text{pixel}$) to conform to the Gen 2 positional alignment tolerance ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).

4. **PTFE Dispenser Needle Alignment & DI Water Purge**
   - Install a 30-gauge blunt-end PTFE-coated stainless steel dispensing needle onto the motorized micro-syringe dispenser.
   - Align the needle tip perpendicularly directly above the stage center of field-of-view (FOV) along the Y-axis.
   - Purge the micro-syringe with ultra-pure deionized (DI) water for 5 dispense cycles to eliminate trapped air bubbles and micro-particulates.

5. **Sessile Drop Dosing Calibration & Baseline Validation**
   - Program the motorized stepper drive to dispense a calibrated droplet volume ($2.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.2\ \mu\text{L}$).
   - Lower the needle toward a clean test substrate until the droplet touches the surface, then withdraw the needle to complete sessile drop detachment without mechanical droplet agitation.
   - Fit the droplet shadowgraph profile using the Young-Laplace / circle-fitting algorithm to ensure baseline optical symmetry (left-right contact angle differential $\le 1^\circ$).

---

### Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Context Source & Tolerance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gen 2 Optical Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* |
| **Microscope Objective Resolution Setup** | $10\times$ (NA 0.25) | Magnification / NA | *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)* |
| **Sessile Droplet Target Volume** | $2.0 \pm 0.2$ | $\mu\text{L}$ | Dispenser volumetric accuracy |
| **Left/Right Contact Angle Asymmetry** | $\le 1.0$ | $\text{deg}\ (^\circ)$ | Optical baseline parallelism & telecentric alignment |

---

### Context Citations

- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**: Provides the optical microscope objective baseline ($10\times$ Plan Achromat, NA 0.25), rigorous deionized (DI) water clean/rinse protocols, and the Gen 2 micrometer-scale alignment tolerance ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$, improved from Gen 1 macro-scale $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**: Establishes high-precision thin-film optical metrology standards, non-destructive surface parameter tracking, and interface reflection modeling.

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Micro-Syringe Inspection and DI Water Priming**:
   - Inspect the precision gastight micro-syringe and blunt PTFE/stainless steel dispensing needle (gage 30–32) for bubble entrapment or particulate contamination.
   - Purge and prime with ultra-pure deionized (DI) water (following pre-clean HF-last rinse standards) to establish a stable meniscus with zero air pockets.
2. **Dispense Volume & Optical Pixel Calibration**:
   - Place a certified optical calibration sphere or reference wire in the optical axis. Adjust illumination and the telecentric/macro lens focus until edge contrast is maximized.
   - Perform needle outer diameter (OD) optical edge calibration to correlate pixel coordinates ($\mu\text{m/pixel}$).
   - Set the automated micro-stepper motor displacement to dispense calibrated sessile droplets (1.0 to 2.0 $\mu\text{L}$). Verify dispensed drop volume repeatability across 5 consecutive trial dispenses.
3. **Multi-Site Substrate Stage Mapping**:
   - Mount the post-HF dip silicon wafer onto the vacuum stage.
   - Program a multi-site coordinate map (Center, North, South, East, West, and peripheral die locations) to evaluate surface hydrophobicity uniformity across the wafer prior to loading into the 850°C–900°C dry oxidation tube.
   - Align stage coordinates to Gen 2 precision standards, ensuring automated X-Y stage motion maintains focus across all pre-mapped test sites.
4. **Baseline Planarity and Needle Clearance Z-Indexing**:
   - Execute automated Z-axis homing to position the dispensing tip at a fixed clearance above the wafer plane.
   - Verify stage tilt and baseline horizon alignment across all mapped coordinates to avoid contact angle baseline distortion.
5. **Multi-Site Transient Sessile Drop Capture**:
   - Command the automated stage to step through each mapped target location.
   - Dispense sessile droplet, execute gentle touch-off onto the hydrophobic Si-H surface, and trigger high-speed camera acquisition to capture the dynamic contact angle profile before liquid evaporation occurs.

---

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-WCA-GEN2-001`
**Title:** Automated Multi-Site Deionized Water Micro-Droplet Dispensing Recipe Execution  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology > Goniometer Water Contact Angle Metrology for HF-Last Hydrophobicity & Surface Passivation Verification > Multi-Site Sessile Drop Dispense & Contact Angle Transient Profile Capture > Automated Multi-Site Deionized Water Micro-Droplet Dispensing Recipe Execution  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the automated recipe execution for multi-site sessile micro-droplet dispensing of ultra-pure deionized (DI) water onto silicon wafers following pre-oxidation clean and HF-last etching. The objective is to verify surface termination and hydrophobicity/passivation across the wafer diameter prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide thermal growth.

---

### 2. Materials & Equipment
- **Goniometer / Contact Angle Metrology System**: Equipped with an automated motorized X-Y-Z wafer stage and synchronized high-speed digital video camera.
- **Micro-Dispense Module**: Automated motorized syringe pump with a PTFE-coated stainless steel blunt micro-needle.
- **Metrology Fluid**: High-purity deionized (DI) water (18.2 MΩ·cm resistivity).
- **Substrate**: 100 mm silicon wafers processed through RCA and HF-last clean.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
  [Stage Initialization] 
           │
           ▼
 [Purge & Baseline Check] 
           │
           ▼
[Automated Recipe Execution] (Multi-Site Move & Dispense)
           │
           ▼
[Transient Profile Capture] 
           │
           ▼
  [Clean & Standby Reset]
```

#### Step 1: Pre-Operational Alignment & Environmental Baseline Check
1. Power on the automated goniometer metrology station, optical illumination source, and syringe delivery pump.
2. Initialize and zero the motorized stage in X, Y, and Z axes. Confirm Gen 2 stage travel repeatability baseline within **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$**.
3. Inspect the DI water delivery reservoir and tubing lines to ensure no micro-bubbles or particulate contamination are present.

#### Step 2: Automated Syringe Purge & Droplet Calibration
1. Command an automated pre-dispense purge of DI water into the waste receptacle to eliminate stagnant air or meniscus drying at the needle orifice.
2. Form a calibrated pendant micro-droplet at the needle tip to verify symmetric droplet detachment dynamics and volume metering repeatability.

#### Step 3: Wafer Loading & Automated Multi-Site Recipe Execution
1. Transfer the 100 mm post-HF cleaned wafer onto the vacuum chuck; activate vacuum retention.
2. Execute the automated multi-site dispensing recipe:
   - Program a standard multi-point radial grid (e.g., center, top, bottom, left, right edge sites across the 100 mm wafer substrate).
   - For each programmed inspection site, step the motorized stage to target coordinates maintaining stage positioning tolerance within **$\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$**.
   - Lower the dispensing tip to the target dispense height above the wafer surface.
   - Actuate the micro-dispenser to deliver the sessile DI water droplet onto the wafer surface.
   - Retract the dispensing tip smoothly along the Z-axis without inducing secondary splashing or droplet vibration.

#### Step 4: Synchronized Video/Profile Capture & Metrology Interface
1. Concurrently trigger optical video capture at droplet touchdown to record the transient spreading profile and baseline sessile contact angle.
2. Index to the subsequent coordinate on the 100 mm substrate until all target sites are dispensed and captured.

#### Step 5: Post-Execution Clean & Reset
1. Deactivate chuck vacuum and unload the wafer to the staging cassette.
2. Execute an automated tip rinse cycle with fresh DI water to avoid residue buildup, then return the goniometer stage to its origin home position.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment & Positioning Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Motorized stage linear encoder feedback |
| **Wafer Substrate Diameter Compatibility** | 100 | $\text{mm}$ | Automated vacuum chuck specification verification |
| **Purge & Rinse Fluid Resistivity** | 18.2 | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line DI water resistivity sensor reading |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**: Stage alignment and positioning tolerance standards across generations (establishing Gen 2 alignment tolerance at $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ compared to Gen 1 at $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$); integration of deionized (DI) water rinsing protocols.
- **Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming**: Substrate geometry baseline referencing 100 mm wafer processing.

Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming (Madou - Fundamentals of Microfabrication)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Transient Contact Angle Video Profiling & Surface Hydrophobicity Uniformity Analysis

**Process Module:** Metrology / Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation  
**Target Device Generation:** Gen 2 (180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip, DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Parent Process:** [180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm)](docs/knowledge/transient_contact_angle_profiling.md) via 850°C–900°C Dry Thermal Oxidation  
**Documentation:** Knowledge persisted to [transient_contact_angle_profiling.md](docs/knowledge/transient_contact_angle_profiling.md)

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Wafer Load & N2     │
│         Purge          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

│                        │

             │
             │
             ▼

│                        │
│    High-Speed Video    │
│     Acquisition &      │
│   Baseline Tracking    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Transient Dynamic    │
│      Angle θ_t &       │
│  Uniformity Profiling  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acceptance Screening  │
│  & Gate Oxide Release  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Environmental & Metrology Stage Stabilization:**
   - Verify automated optical goniometer chamber environment at $23.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and $45\% \pm 3\%\text{ RH}$.
   - Ensure stage laminar box maintains clean $N_2$ purge to prevent airborne hydrocarbon adsorption and premature native oxide regrowth post-HF clean.

2. **Automated Wafer Alignment & Recipe Loading:**
   - Transfer wafer immediately post-HF dip / BOE clean via robot end-effector.
   - Align notch and map a 5-site layout: **Site 1 (Center), Site 2 (Top), Site 3 (Right), Site 4 (Bottom), Site 5 (Left)** with a 5 mm edge exclusion zone.

3. **Multi-Site Sessile Drop Dispense:**
   - Dispense Ultra-Pure Water (UPW, resistivity $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$, degassed) at $2.0\text{ }\mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ using an automated micro-syringe at $1.0\text{ }\mu\text{L/s}$.
   - Lower the needle to initiate automated touch-down contact with zero droplet oscillation.

4. **High-Speed Video Capture & Real-Time Baseline Edge Fitting:**
   - Trigger camera synchronization at $\ge 60\text{ fps}$ for $10.0\text{ s}$ immediately upon needle detachment.
   - Utilize automated polynomial baseline tracking and Young-Laplace contour profile fitting across left/right triple contact points.

5. **Transient Decay & Uniformity Extraction:**
   - Extract contact angle $\theta(t)$ from $t = 0\text{ s}$ to $t = 10\text{ s}$. 
   - Record the stabilized contact angle $\theta_0$ at $t = 1.0\text{ s}$ and dynamic relaxation $|\Delta \theta|$ over the interval $[1.0\text{ s}, 5.0\text{ s}]$.
   - Compute across-wafer uniformity ($3\sigma$ / Mean).

6. **Cassette Release to Gate Oxidation:**
   - Qualify wafer if within acceptance windows; route wafer cassette to the dry oxidation furnace for 3.5 nm gate oxide growth within the 2-hour queue-time (Q-time) window.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text

               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
  Site 5 (Left)┤███████████████████████████████████████│

 Site 3 (Right)┤███████████████████████████████████████│
               │███████████████████████████████████████│
   Site 2 (Top)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│

               │███████████████████████████████████████│
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘

```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Engineering Tolerance / Unit | Metrology Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sessile Droplet Dispense Volume** | $2.0\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ | $\pm 0.1\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ | Calibrated Micro-Syringe Dispenser |
| **Passivated Water Contact Angle ($\theta_0$ at $t = 1.0\text{ s}$)** | $\ge 75.0^\circ$ | Min Threshold ($\theta \ge 75.0^\circ$) across all 5 sites | Young-Laplace Video Edge Fitting |
| **Across-Wafer Hydrophobicity Uniformity ($3\sigma$)** | $\le 3.0\%$ | Max Allowable Spread | 5-Site Statistical Analysis |
| **Transient Relaxation Rate ($|\Delta\theta|$ from $1\text{ s}$ to $5\text{ s}$)** | $\le 1.5^\circ$ | Dynamic Drift Limit | Video Frame Time-Series Tracking |
| **Post-Etch Substrate Release Status** | Clean Si-H passivated | Ready for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide @ $850^\circ\text{C}–900^\circ\text{C}$ | In-line Go/No-Go Gate |

---

### 4. Context & Literature Citations

- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Defines the downstream target where access transistors require gate dielectric thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}–900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness (with access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
- **Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE):** Specifies the upstream wet surface preparation chemistry (BOE 6:1 with $\text{NH}_4\text{F}$ and $\text{HF}$ with etching rate of $\sim 100\text{ nm/min}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$), producing the required hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated silicon surface verified by this metrology step.

```text
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮Fail
         Pass│                              │
             ▼                              ▼
┌────────────────────────┐     ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │     │                        │
│  Release to 3.5nm Dry  │     │  Rework: RCA Clean &   │
│        Gate Ox         │     │         HF Dip         │
│                        │     │                        │
└────────────────────────┘     └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the quantitative optical goniometry and axisymmetric drop shape analysis (ADSA) procedure using Young-Laplace profile fitting to screen surface hydrogen termination ($\text{Si-H}$ passivation) and cross-wafer uniformity on bare silicon surfaces directly following RCA cleaning and in-situ dilute HF dipping. Ensuring complete native oxide removal and homogeneous hydrophobicity is required prior to dry thermal oxidation of the 3.5 nm gate dielectric for 180nm DRAM access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$).

---

### 2. Physical Principles & Equipment Setup
* **Metrology Tool:** Automated Optical Contact Angle Goniometer with motorized stage and high-speed telecentric CMOS camera.
* **Liquid Medium:** Degassed Ultra-Pure Water (UPW), resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $25.0^\circ\text{C}$, surface tension $\gamma_{LV} = 72.8\text{ mN/m}$.
* **Theoretical Fitting Model:** Full axisymmetric Young-Laplace equation:
  $$\Delta P = \gamma \left( \frac{1}{R_1} + \frac{1}{R_2} \right) = \Delta P_0 + \Delta \rho g z$$
  where the profile is numerically fitted to account for hydrostatic gravitational deformation and determine the equilibrium static contact angle $\theta$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Environmental & Tool Equilibrium:**
   * Verify metrology chamber environment: temperature at $21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, relative humidity at $45.0 \pm 3.0\%$.
   * Confirm camera optical magnification calibration using the precision standard calibration sphere ($4.000 \pm 0.001\text{ mm}$ diameter).

2. **Substrate Handling & Queue Time:**
   * Load the 200 mm wafer directly onto the vacuum chuck within a maximum post-HF queue time ($\text{Q-Time}$) of $\le 30\text{ minutes}$ in an $N_2$-purged minienvironment to prevent native oxide regrowth.

3. **Automated Multi-Site Dispense Routine:**
   * Program a standard 9-site cross-wafer map: Center, 4 points at $R = 45\text{ mm}$, and 4 edge points at $R = 90\text{ mm}$ ($10\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).
   * Actuate the micro-syringe with a 30-gauge blunt PTFE-coated needle: dispense a sessile droplet of $2.0 \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$ UPW at a dispensing rate of $0.5\ \mu\text{L/s}$.
   * Lower the stage to detach the droplet cleanly without mechanical kinetic perturbation.

4. **Image Acquisition & Young-Laplace Profile Fitting:**
   * Acquire digital silhouette images at $t = 3.0\text{ seconds}$ post-deposition (avoiding droplet evaporation skew).
   * Perform sub-pixel edge detection along the droplet profile and establish the horizontal solid-liquid baseline.
   * Execute non-linear regression using the Young-Laplace model from baseline intercept to apex, extracting the left angle ($\theta_L$), right angle ($\theta_R$), and mean equilibrium contact angle ($\theta = \frac{\theta_L + \theta_R}{2}$).
   * Verify fit error: root-mean-square error ($\text{RMSE}$) of the contour fit must be $< 0.02\text{ mm}$.

5. **Passivation Screening & Lot Disposition:**
   * Evaluate the site values against threshold limits.
   * If all 9 sites meet the acceptance criteria, clear the wafer for transfer to the quartz tube furnace for 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ in dry $\text{O}_2$).
   * If contact angle falls below the screening limit, flag lot as "Incomplete H-passivation / Native Oxide Residue" and route to rework (RCA Clean & dilute HF dip).

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Control Limit | Unit | Physical Significance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mean Water Contact Angle ($\theta_{\text{mean}}$)** | $\ge 75.0$ | $\ge 72.0$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | Confirms complete removal of hydrophilic native $\text{SiO}_2$ and complete hydrophobic $\text{Si-H}$ passivation. |
| **Cross-Wafer Contact Angle Uniformity ($1\sigma$)** | $\le 1.5$ | $\le 2.0$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | Ensures homogeneous pre-oxidation surface across center-to-edge. |
| **Profile Fit Residual ($\text{RMSE}$)** | $\le 0.015$ | $< 0.020$ | mm | Validates Young-Laplace contour convergence free from particulate interference or asymmetry. |
| **Subsequent Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5$ | $3.5 \pm 0.2$ | nm | Validates pre-clean interface quality enabling uniform thermal growth targeting $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$. |

---

### 5. Context Citations
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; sub-threshold/junction leakage targets require pristine gate interfaces.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
* **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:** Interface reaction-rate limited regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$) producing dense, high-dielectric breakdown gate oxide ($E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) with minimal interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$) at $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ target thickness. Clean initial silicon surface termination ensures uniform interface reaction rate constant $k_l = B/A$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-WCA-002`
**Title:** Automated Multi-Point Sessile Droplet Dispense & Optical Profile Acquisition  
**Context / Scope:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Gate Dielectric Clean Metrology (Pre-Dry Gate Oxidation: ~3.5 nm physical thickness target) > Goniometer Contact Angle Metrology for HF-Last Hydrophobicity & H-Passivation Screening  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Wafer Vacuum Chuck   │
│   Load & Alignment    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Automated Syringe   │
│   Priming & 2.0 µL    │
│   Droplet Formation   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Controlled Z-Axis   │
│  Touch-Off & Sessile  │
│       Dispense        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Multi-Point Stage   │
│  Step: 9-Pt / 49-Pt   │
│         Grid          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Telecentric      │
│  Tele-Macro Optical   │
│  Profile Acquisition  │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Load and Stage Referencing:**
   - Transfer the post-HF cleaned 200 mm bare Si wafer from the nitrogen-purged FOUP/cassette onto the automated goniometer vacuum chuck.
   - Engage chuck vacuum and execute optical notch/flat alignment to establish the wafer origin $(X_0, Y_0, Z_0)$.
2. **Deionized (DI) Water Syringe Priming & Purge:**
   - Prime the automated micro-syringe (PTFE/glass barrel with hydrophobic fluoropolymer-coated needle) using high-purity $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.
   - Purge 3 dummy droplets to clear trapped micro-bubbles and stabilize the meniscus at the tip.
3. **Pendant Droplet Dosing & Controlled Deposition:**
   - Command the automated micro-pump to extrude a calibrated pendant droplet of $2.0\text{ }\mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ at the needle tip.
   - Lower the $Z$-axis stage at a controlled rate ($0.5\text{ mm/s}$) until droplet touch-off occurs on the silicon surface without mechanical needle impact ($Z$-clearance $\ge 0.5\text{ mm}$).
   - Retract the needle along the $Z$-axis to release the sessile droplet cleanly onto the H-passivated silicon substrate.
4. **Automated Multi-Point Stepping (9-Point / 49-Point Grid):**
   - Execute programmed stage displacement across the predefined wafer coordinates following the standard 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping protocol (center, mid-radius, edge exclusion $\ge 3\text{ mm}$).
   - Allow droplet baseline equilibration for $1.0\text{ s}$ prior to image capture to minimize transient hydrodynamic oscillation.
5. **High-Speed Optical Profile Image Acquisition:**
   - Trigger the monochrome CMOS camera equipped with a telecentric tele-macro lens and diffused LED backlight.
   - Capture side-view optical shadowgraph profiles at 30 fps for 60 frames under freeze-frame exposure ($< 1\text{ ms}$).
   - Stream raw uncompressed TIFF frames with embedded spatial scale calibration ($\mu\text{m/pixel}$) to the Young-Laplace fitting buffer.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dispense Droplet Volume** | `2.0` | $\mu\text{L}$ | $\pm 0.1\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ | Automated micro-dispenser optical volumetric calibration |
| **Multi-Point Stage Grid Pattern** | `9` or `49` | points / wafer | Exact discrete points (`9-pt` or `49-pt` grid) | Recipe encoder verification across wafer radial coordinates |
| **Optical Spatial Resolution** | `± 0.05` | $\mu\text{m/pixel}$ | $\le 0.05\text{ }\mu\text{m/pixel}$ calibrated optical uncertainty | Telecentric optical grid target magnification calibration |
| **Pre-Oxidation Target Surface Layer** | `3.5` | $\text{nm}$ | Physical gate oxide target: $3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ | Post-oxidation spectroscopic ellipsometry validation |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

- **Source: *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology***:
  - *Context applied:* Direct justification for automated **9-point or 49-point wafer mapping** to evaluate radial film and surface uniformity across spin-coating/furnace operations, as well as metrology precision requirements targeting dry gate oxide physical thickness of **$3.5\text{ nm}$** with sub-Angstrom precision (**$\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$**).
- **Source: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering***:
  - *Context applied:* Defines the thermal gate dielectric integration target: **thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness**, which requires pre-oxidation HF-last surface H-passivation and hydrophobicity qualification.
- **Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench***:
  - *Context applied:* 180nm access transistor channel geometry (**$L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$**) and gate integrity constraints required to maintain sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-YLC-180NM`
**Title:** Young-Laplace Baseline Contour Extraction & Contact Angle Fitting Calibration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm physical thickness) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean & In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Defect Metrology > Goniometer Water Contact Angle Metrology > Young-Laplace Fitting & Surface H-Passivation Uniformity Screening > Young-Laplace Baseline Contour Extraction & Contact Angle Fitting Calibration  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
Establish a high-precision, automated optical baseline contour extraction and Young-Laplace profile-fitting calibration routine for sessile deionized (DI) water droplets. This calibration ensures quantitative verification of hydrogen termination ($Si\text{--}H$ passivation) and removal of native/chemical oxide across the silicon substrate prior to 850°C–900°C furnace loading for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).

---

### 2. Equipment, Materials & Environmental Controls
- **Tooling:** Automated optical contact angle goniometer equipped with telecentric lens, sub-pixel edge detection CCD/CMOS camera, and automated micro-syringe dispenser (accuracy $\pm 0.05\ \mu\text{L}$).
- **Calibration Standard:** Certified optical contact angle calibration grid/target with precision glass-etched sessile drop profiles ($60.00^\circ$, $90.00^\circ$, $110.00^\circ$ standard drop baselines, traceable certified tolerance $\pm 0.1^\circ$).
- **Fluid & Dispenser:** Ultra-pure Deionized Water (resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at 25°C, dispense droplet volume $2.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$).
- **Environment:** Cleanroom class 10/100, ambient temperature $22.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, relative humidity $45\% \pm 3\%$.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|           Young-Laplace Contour Calibration & Metrology Flow                     |
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  [ Step 1: Optical Alignment ]
        |  --> Level stage (pitch/roll < 0.05°), focus telecentric optics
        v
  [ Step 2: Pixel-to-Micron Calibration ]
        |  --> Measure certified calibration ball/grid (scaling in µm/pixel)
        v
  [ Step 3: Baseline Detection & Tilt Calibration ]
        |  --> Sub-pixel edge detection (Canny/Sobel) & reflection mirror baseline
        v
  [ Step 4: Young-Laplace Fitting Execution ]
        |  --> Integrate axisymmetric Young-Laplace equation across contour
        v
  [ Step 5: Residual Error & Drift Verification ]
        |  --> Verify RMSE < 0.05 px; confirm automated pass/fail gate
+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Optical System Alignment & Leveling:**
   - Mount the optical calibration reticle on the motorized sample stage.
   - Adjust stage tilt and goniometer roll/pitch until stage horizon tilt angle is $\le 0.05^\circ$ from true horizontal.
   - Calibrate the telecentric illumination back-light to prevent optical blooming or diffraction artifacts along droplet edges.

2. **Pixel-to-Micrometer Magnification Calibration:**
   - Image a certified calibration sphere/target of known physical diameter ($D = 4.000\text{ mm} \pm 0.001\text{ mm}$).
   - Set software optical scaling factor ($\mu\text{m}/\text{pixel}$) across orthogonal axes ($X$ and $Y$ aspect ratio distortion $< 0.1\%$).

3. **Sub-Pixel Edge & Solid-Liquid Baseline Extraction:**
   - Position the calibration drop target. Execute derivative sub-pixel edge detection (Sobel/Canny filter combined with polynomial interpolation).
   - Detect the solid-liquid interface baseline utilizing the drop profile and its mirror reflection on the reflective silicon substrate. Enforce baseline position repeatability within $\pm 0.5\ \mu\text{m}$.

4. **Axisymmetric Young-Laplace Differential Curve Fitting:**
   - Fit the extracted boundary coordinates to the theoretical Young-Laplace equation balancing capillary and hydrostatic pressure:
     $$\Delta P = \gamma \left( \frac{1}{R_1} + \frac{1}{R_2} \right) = \Delta P_0 + \Delta \rho g z$$
   - Numerically integrate the profile shape from the apex radius of curvature ($R_0$) down to the detected triple-phase contact line to extract left/right contact angles ($\theta_L$, $\theta_R$).

5. **Repeatability Verification & Reference Run:**
   - Execute five consecutive automated droplet captures and fittings on the certified $90.00^\circ$ calibration target.
   - Confirm residual fit errors and drift meet acceptance thresholds before unlocking the tool for post-HF dip silicon wafer screening.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Goniometer Baseline Tilt** | $0.00^\circ$ | $\le \pm 0.05^\circ$ | Software optical horizon calculation |
| **Calibration Target Fit Accuracy** | Certified standard angle ($90.00^\circ$) | $\le \pm 0.20^\circ$ | Young-Laplace contour fit vs. standard target |
| **Contour Edge Extraction Residual (RMSE)** | $0.00\text{ pixels}$ | $\le 0.05\text{ pixels}$ | Least-squares residual of optical edge coordinates |
| **Dispense Volume Precision** | $2.00\ \mu\text{L}$ | $\pm 0.10\ \mu\text{L}$ | Micro-syringe optical droplet volume metrology |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:** Transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; unit cell area $8F^2$ or $6F^2$; dielectric layers require ultra-clean interfaces to maintain leakage targets $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** 1T1C architecture; dry gate oxidation targeting physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at 850°C–900°C.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:** Interface reaction-rate limited regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$) for ultra-thin 3.5 nm to 4.0 nm dry gate oxides; dictates minimal interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$) and breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, strictly dependent on uniform pre-oxidation HF-dip surface preparation and accurate hydrophobicity verification.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Full-Wafer Hydrophobicity Uniformity Mapping & H-Passivation Defect Screening

**Process Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip > Post-Clean Metrology  
**Node:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm) | **Action Type:** Buy (Automated Goniometer Metrology Tool)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Load Wafer into     │
│  Automated Goniometer  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  49-Point Polar Grid   │
│   Dispense 1 uL DIW    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Young-Laplace      │
│   Contour & Baseline   │
│        Fitting         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Uniformity &      │
│  H-Passivation Defect  │
│       Screening        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│  Criteria Check: Mean  │
│     WCA >= 75 deg,     │
│    Non-Unif <= 2.5%    │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮Fail
         Pass│                              │
             ▼                              ▼
┌────────────────────────┐     ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │     │                        │
│  Transfer to Dry Gate  │     │  Quarantine & Rework:  │
│   Oxidation Furnace    │     │     Re-Dip / Strip     │
│                        │     │                        │
└────────────────────────┘     └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Tool Initialization & Cleanroom Ambient Control**:
   - Ensure the automated contact angle goniometer enclosure is purged with filtered $N_2$ (or Class 1 mini-environment airflow) at $21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and relative humidity $40 \pm 2\%$.
   - Verify calibrated automated micropipette/syringe dosing module loaded with ultra-pure degassed deionized water (DIW, resistivity $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
2. **Wafer Loading & Alignment**:
   - Transfer the post-HF dip wafer directly via robotic end-effector onto the motorized $R$-$\theta$ vacuum chuck within a queue time limit $\le 15\text{ min}$ to prevent native oxide regrowth.
   - Perform automated optical notch/flat pre-alignment.
3. **Automated Multi-Point Droplet Dispensing**:
   - Execute an automated 49-point full-wafer polar inspection map (center, mid-radius concentric rings, and edge exclusion zone $\ge 3\text{ mm}$).
   - Dispense a sessile drop of $1.0 \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$ DIW at each inspection site using automated needle lift-off to eliminate kinetic impact distortion.
4. **Image Acquisition & Young-Laplace Contour Fitting**:
   - Capture high-resolution telecentric side-profile optical images within $1.5\text{ s}$ of droplet deposition to avoid evaporation artifacts.
   - Execute automated baseline edge detection and apply the Young-Laplace axisymmetric droplet shape fitting algorithm to determine left/right contact angles ($\theta_L$, $\theta_R$) and compute mean site Water Contact Angle (WCA).
5. **Uniformity Calculation & Defect Screening**:
   - Calculate full-wafer mean WCA, standard deviation ($\sigma$), and percent non-uniformity:
     $$\text{Non-Uniformity (\%)} = \frac{\theta_{\max} - \theta_{\min}}{2 \times \theta_{\text{mean}}} \times 100\%$$
   - Flag any local drop anomaly where $\theta < 70^\circ$ as an unpassivated native oxide patch / rinsing chemical residue defect.
6. **Pass/Fail Disposition**:
   - If within criteria, clear the wafer lot for immediate entry into the quartz tube furnace for dry gate oxidation (target: $3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}$–$900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - If non-conforming, quarantine the lot for re-clean/re-dip investigation.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Sampling / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mean H-Passivated Surface WCA** | $\ge 75.0^\circ$ (Nominal $78^\circ \text{--} 84^\circ$) | Degrees ($^\circ$) | 49-point full-wafer polar map |
| **Full-Wafer Contact Angle Non-Uniformity** | $\le 2.5\%$ ($1\sigma \le 1.2^\circ$) | Percent ($\%$) | Across all 49 measured sites |
| **Dispense Droplet Volume Precision** | $1.00 \pm 0.05$ | Microliters ($\mu\text{L}$) | Micro-solenoid / syringe doser |
| **Post-Clean Queue Time to Furnace Loading** | $\le 45$ | Minutes ($\text{min}$) | MES lot tracker timestamp |

---

### Literature & Context Citations

- **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  - Baseline gate dielectric target requires thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness; complete elimination of native oxide and uniform H-passivation via HF-last clean is critical to gate oxide integrity.
- **Source:** *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*  
  - In the thin oxidation regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$), oxidation kinetics are strictly interface reaction-rate limited ($k_l = B/A$). Unpassivated patches or uneven H-termination cause initial oxide thickness disparities, degraded breakdown field ($E_{bd} < 10\text{ MV/cm}$), and elevated interface trap density ($D_{it} > 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).
- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - Access transistor channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) requires sub-threshold and junction leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$; uniform pre-gate surface termination guarantees threshold voltage ($V_{th}$) uniformity across the memory array.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Laser Light Scattering Particle Scanning & Defect Density Mapping (<180nm Threshold)

**Module:** Pre-Gate Oxidation Metrology / Defect Inspection  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Target Critical Dimension (CD):** Access Transistor Channel Length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, Channel Width $W = 220\text{ nm}$  
**Substrate State:** Post-RCA Clean & In-Situ HF Dip prior to Dry Gate Oxide Growth ($3.5\text{ nm}$)

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│   Load Wafer & Vacuum Chuck Clamping (FOUP)  │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Dark-Field Laser Optics Auto-Calibration    │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Full-Wafer Polar/Spiral Surface Scan        │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Coordinate Registration & PSL Sphere Binning │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Pass/Fail Verification vs Gate Oxide Spec    │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Chamber Loading:**
   - Transfer wafer from the wet bench FOUP into the Laser Surface Scanning Inspection chamber using an edge-grip robotic end-effector (exclusion edge zone: $3\text{ mm}$).
   - Engage backside vacuum chucking to hold flatness within $\le 0.5\text{ }\mu\text{m}$.

2. **Optical Calibration & Gain Normalization:**
   - Initialize solid-state/argon-ion dark-field laser source ($488\text{ nm}$ or UV laser beam).
   - Perform auto-calibration against an in-situ Polystyrene Latex (PSL) standard wafer with sensitivity calibrated to resolve light point defects (LPD) at the critical threshold $d_{\text{particle}} < 180\text{ nm}$.
   - Balance narrow and wide collection photomultiplier tube (PMT) gains for Rayleigh scattering signal discrimination against bare silicon background haze.

3. **Full-Wafer Polar/Spiral Surface Scan:**
   - Execute continuous rotation and radial translation stage scan across the 200mm wafer surface.
   - Scan velocity synchronized to maintain 100% surface inspection coverage without dead bands.
   - Capture scattered intensity profiles and detect light scattering anomalies across both center and edge dies.

4. **Defect Coordinate Mapping & Size Binning:**
   - Translate scattering cross-sections into equivalent optical diameters using Mie scattering calibration curves.
   - Bin detected particles into standard categories:
     - **Critical Gate Defect Bin:** $d_{\text{particle}} \le 180\text{ nm}$ (risk to $L=180\text{ nm}$ access transistor channel and $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide breakdown).
     - **Sub-Micron Channel Bin:** $180\text{ nm} < d_{\text{particle}} \le 220\text{ nm}$ (bridging risk for channel width $W=220\text{ nm}$).
     - **Macro Killer Defect Bin:** $d_{\text{particle}} > 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Generate $(X, Y)$ coordinate defect map and compute localized Defect Density ($D_0$).

5. **Acceptance Evaluation & Lot Disposition:**
   - Compare total defect count and localized cluster density against gate-dielectric pre-clean thresholds.
   - If acceptance criteria pass, transfer wafer lot immediately to the dry oxidation furnace tube ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$). If failed, route wafer for re-cleaning.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Target / Limit | Engineering Rationale & Node Context |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimum Detectable Defect Threshold** | $\le 180\text{ nm}$ equivalent PSL sphere diameter | Resolves killer particles matching the access transistor channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$) |
| **Critical Defect Density ($d \le 180\text{ nm}$)** | $\le 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$ ($\le 15\text{ counts/200mm wafer}$) | Prevents pinholes and early dielectric breakdown in the $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide |
| **Killer Macro Particle Count ($d > 220\text{ nm}$)** | $\le 2\text{ particles/wafer}$ | Protects against shorting across active channel width ($W = 220\text{ nm}$) |
| **Optical Haze (Surface Micro-Roughness)** | $\le 0.12\text{ ppm}$ normalized haze signal | Confirms clean hydrogen-passivated silicon surface post-HF dip prior to oxidation |

---

### 4. Typical Defect Distribution Benchmark

```text
Defect Density Distribution (counts/wafer)
                   ┌───────────────────────────────────┐
                   │███████████████████████████████████│
     Crit (<0.18um)┤███████████████████████████████████│
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
Bin 3 (0.18-0.22um)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
Bin 2 (0.22-0.50um)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                         │
                   │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                         │
    Bin 1 (>0.50um)┤░░░░                               │
                   │░░░░                               │
                   └┬────────┬───────┬────────┬───────┬┘
                    0        3       6        9      12 
```

---

### 5. Literature Citations & Context Grounding

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ establishes the primary threshold for laser light scattering sensitivity.
  - Access transistor channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ establishes the upper critical defect boundary where particles cause terminal bridging or source/drain leakage.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Dry gate dielectric thickness is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ to a physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$, mandating ultra-low particulate contamination to prevent gate oxide integrity (GOI) breakdown.
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
  - Establishes the downstream non-destructive optical monitoring framework and sub-Angstrom precision requirements ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) for the $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide film.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title:** Calibration Standard Wafer Setup & Laser Scatter Recipe Tuning (<180nm PSL Threshold)
- **Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology > Laser Light Scattering Particle Scanning & Defect Density Mapping (<180nm Threshold) > Calibration Standard Wafer Setup & Laser Scatter Recipe Tuning (<180nm PSL Threshold)
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type:** Make

---

## 1. Objective & Scope
Establish, calibrate, and tune the laser light scattering surface inspection recipe using certified Polystyrene Latex (PSL) sphere calibration wafers to reliably detect particle defects down to the sub-180 nm threshold on bare and cleaned silicon substrates prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth.

---

## 2. Process Flow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  1. Inspection & Stage Verification                                   |
|     Inspect PSL calibration standard wafer; verify stage alignment.   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                  |
                                  v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  2. Optical Recipe Setup & Gain Calibration                           |
|     Configure laser incident beam and tune PMT detector sensitivity.  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                  |
                                  v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  3. Multi-Point Mapping & Size Calibration                            |
|     Execute automated wafer scan across mapping points.               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                  |
                                  v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  4. Recipe Locking & Handoff                                          |
|     Confirm sizing bin peak and lock recipe for production.           |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### Step 1: Inspection & Stage Alignment Setup
1. Transfer the certified PSL sphere reference wafer (deposition standard for <180 nm equivalent diameter) from its sealed pod to the automated inspection stage under ISO Class 1 mini-environment / laminar hood.
2. Verify stage translation alignment and zero reference position to ensure mechanical travel is within the Gen 2 alignment specification of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.

### Step 2: Optical Calibration & Detector Gain Tuning
1. Initialize the solid-state laser light source and verify beam intensity and polarization alignment across the incident optics.
2. Align dark-field collection optics (ellipsoidal mirror / photomultiplier tube (PMT) collector) to capture Rayleigh/Mie scattered light from the substrate surface.
3. Tune detector pre-amplifier gain and threshold voltage curves using the known scattering cross-section of the sub-180 nm PSL reference peaks.

### Step 3: Automated Wafer Mapping & Signal Response Verification
1. Program the recipe coordinate system to perform a high-density automated surface scan using standard 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping protocols to verify radial defect detection uniformity across the substrate.
2. Execute the scan on the standard wafer; collect raw scatter counts and map pulse-height distributions against coordinate locations.
3. Verify that the scattering intensity histogram resolves the primary PSL sphere calibration peak distinctly above the substrate background optical haze/noise floor.

### Step 4: Recipe Validation & Basemapping
1. Repeat 3 consecutive scans on the calibration standard to determine repeatability and sizing resolution.
2. Lock the laser inspection recipe threshold and export baseline particle coordinates for production in-line screening before gate oxidation.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical stage encoder / fiducial alignment |
| **Particle Detection Threshold Sizing** | $< 180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Laser scatter pulse-height histogram vs. PSL standard |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Resolution** | $9 \text{ to } 49$ | points / sectors | Automated wafer map recipe inspection log |
| **Pre-Oxide Gate Film Thickness Control** | $3.5$ (tolerance $\pm 0.05$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry validation |

---

## 4. Context References & Citations
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Prescribes automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping for radial non-uniformity tracking and defines dry gate oxide measurement precision at 3.5 nm with sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\ \text{nm}$).
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**: Sets Gen 2 mechanical alignment tolerance bounds at $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Defines access transistor channel scaling constraints ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$) establishing the requirement for sub-180 nm defect threshold mapping.
