# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-LSS-001`
**Title:** Full-Wafer Laser Surface Particle Scanning & Spatial Coordinate Registration  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This procedure outlines the full-wafer laser light scattering (darkfield/brightfield) inspection and high-precision spatial coordinate registration protocol for 200 mm bare and pre-gate-oxidation silicon wafers following RCA clean and in-situ HF dip. Defect localization must resolve killer particle sizes under the 180 nm lithographic minimum feature threshold to safeguard the subsequent 3.5 nm dry gate oxide integrity.

---

### 2. Equipment & Calibration Setup
1. **Scanning Tool:** Automated Laser Surface Particle Scanner (Darkfield/Brightfield Scattering Metrology System).
2. **Optics & Source:** DUV / Solid-State Blue-UV Laser (matching sub-micron sensitivity regime).
3. **Stage Motion:** High-precision air-bearing polar/Cartesian $r\text{--}\theta$ or $X\text{--}Y$ motion stage aligned to the manufacturing placement grid.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```text
[Stage 1: Notch/Flat Optical Alignment]
  │  (Wafer alignment, center offset <= 5 um)
  ▼
[Stage 2: Focus & Height Leveling Calibration]
  │  (Multi-point z-height map; focus travel <= 10 nm)
  ▼
[Stage 3: Full-Surface Laser Spiral/Raster Scan]
  │  (Edge exclusion = 3.0 mm; spatial scan pitch <= 5 nm)
  ▼
[Stage 4: Darkfield Scattering Signal Acquisition]
  │  (Differential Rayleigh scattering detection; threshold < 180 nm)
  ▼
[Stage 5: Coordinate Registration & KLARF Generation]
  │  (X-Y mapping registered against 5 nm physical grid)
```

#### Step 1: Pre-Scan Load and Stage Mechanical Center Alignment
- Transfer the wafer from the sealed FOUP/cassette onto the cleanroom end-effector and vacuum chuck under Class 1 laminar flow.
- Execute optical notch/flat detection to establish wafer orientation $\theta = 0.00^\circ$.
- Align wafer geometric center with the chuck rotation axis to achieve a center-offset error budget $\le 5\ \mu\text{m}$.

#### Step 2: Z-Height Autofocus & Dynamic Leveling
- Perform multi-point optical leveling across the wafer diameter to establish the baseline focal plane.
- Maintain dynamic optical autofocus during translation with a vertical drift envelope not exceeding $\pm 10\ \text{nm}$ to prevent false intensity drops or spurious scatter counts.

#### Step 3: Full-Surface Laser Scanning
- Set the inspection recipe edge exclusion zone to $3.0\ \text{mm}$ from the wafer physical edge.
- Scan the entire active surface using continuous high-speed Chuck rotation combined with linear stage translation (spiral/raster path).
- Maintain stage step resolution synchronized to the physical manufacturing grid resolution of **$0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\ \text{nm}$)**.

#### Step 4: Light Scattering Signal Collection & Threshold Binning
- Direct the laser beam incident upon the wafer surface and capture scattered intensity via high-angle and low-angle PMT/photodiode collectors.
- Filter and register particle defect events using Rayleigh scattering intensity calibration curves, binning defects against the **$< 180\ \text{nm}$** critical dimension threshold (corresponding to the minimum transistor channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$ and active feature rules).

#### Step 5: Coordinate Transformation & KLARF Spatial Mapping
- Convert raw polar/encoder scan data into Cartesian ($X, Y$) coordinates referenced directly from the wafer center $(0, 0)$.
- Verify that registered defect spatial coordinates conform to the foundry physical placement grid ($5\ \text{nm}$ increments).
- Export the inspection run into a standardized Wafer Defect Map (e.g., KLARF file) detailing total count, bin size, radial position, and $(X, Y)$ coordinate tables for subsequent review.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Placement Grid Alignment** | **$0.005$ (5)** | $\mu\text{m}\ (\text{nm})$ | Automated stage encoder verification against design grid |
| **Defect Size Sensitivity Threshold** | **$< 180$** | $\text{nm}$ | Calibrated PSL equivalent scattering cross-section |
| **Stage Spatial Coordinate Resolution** | $\le 5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Interferometer-tracked stage feedback |
| **Pre-Oxidation Killer Particle Count** | $\le 0.05$ | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Full-wafer integrated darkfield count ($>180\ \text{nm}$) |

---

### 5. Context Citations
- **SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid:**
  - *Manufacturing Grid:* Physical placement grid resolution is $0.005\ \mu\text{m}$ ($5\ \text{nm}$).
  - *Critical Dimensions & Limits:* Feature resolution and gate limits at $150\ \text{nm}$ to $180\ \text{nm}$ range.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Unit Cell Geometry:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, bitline contact shared topology defining killer defect thresholds.
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
  - *Wafer Mapping & Thickness Baseline:* Wafer-level radial spatial map correlation before growing the $3.5\ \text{nm}$ dry gate oxide.
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
SkyWater SKY130 Open PDK Design Rules & Lithography Grid (SkyWater Technology / Google Open Source Silicon)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Laser Surface Particle Scanner Calibration and Sensitivity Threshold Setup (<180nm)  
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-OPT-180-007`  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology > Laser Light Scattering Particle Scanning & Defect Density Mapping (<180nm Threshold) > Full-Wafer Laser Surface Particle Scanning & Spatial Coordinate Registration  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Node:** 180 nm DRAM Integration  
**Tool Type:** Darkfield / Light Scattering Unpatterned Surface Particle Inspection System  

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Scanner Optical     │
│   Cleanliness Check    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Load NIST PSL      │
│     Standard Wafer     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Beam Alignment and   │
│    Laser Power Lock    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Gain Calibration and  │
│    Threshold Setup     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Verification Scan    │
│  and Sizing Precision  │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Release Scanner to   │
│   Pre-Oxidation Line   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Tool Pre-Flight & Optical Cavity Verification:**
   - Inspect environmental conditions in the mini-environment (Class 1 laminar clean enclosure). Verify continuous purge with filtered dry nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$).
   - Check collecting optics, photomultiplier tube (PMT) / avalanche photodiode (APD) channels, and scanning mirrors for zero contamination.
   - Power on the laser source (solid-state ultraviolet or blue/green diode laser). Allow a 30-minute warm-up cycle for thermal equilibrium.

2. **Standard Reference Wafer Loading:**
   - Transfer a certified NIST-traceable Polystyrene Latex (PSL) sphere calibration standard wafer (bare Si wafer deposited with calibrated monodisperse PSL spheres, e.g., sizing standard at or below $180\text{ nm}$, such as $100\text{ nm}$ and $150\text{ nm}$ / $180\text{ nm}$) from the calibration carrier onto the automated wafer chuck using non-contact Bernoulli/vacuum edge-grip handling.

3. **Laser Beam Alignment & Incident Power Normalization:**
   - Initiate auto-alignment of the incident laser spot on the wafer center fiducial.
   - Measure incident optical power at the reference photodiode detector. Lock laser output power stability to within $\le \pm 1.0\%$ across the continuous scan cycle.
   - Adjust dynamic autofocus tracking to maintain focal depth across radial wafer coordinate travels.

4. **Sensitivity Gain Tuning & Channel Calibration ($<180\text{ nm}$ Cutoff):**
   - Execute an initial dark-count acquisition on a bare super-clean reference silicon wafer (haze/background baseline scan).
   - Configure optical scattering collection channels (wide-angle and narrow-angle darkfield scatter detectors).
   - Calibrate the scattering cross-section signal (Rayleigh scattering regime, where scattered power $I_{\text{scat}} \propto d^6 / \lambda^4$) against the known PSL reference peaks.
   - Adjust PMT/APD gain and analog-to-digital converter (ADC) binning so that the lower detection limit sensitivity threshold is firmly established below the node feature size: set bin floor threshold to register defects $<180\text{ nm}$ (e.g., lower threshold bin established down to $90\text{--}100\text{ nm}$).

5. **Full-Wafer Verification Scan & Coordinate Registration Check:**
   - Execute a spiral/raster full-wafer calibration scan on the NIST standard wafer.
   - Map defect coordinates $(\theta, r)$ and convert to Cartesian coordinates $(X, Y)$ with notch/flat orientation registration.
   - Verify that the standard PSL peak position matches certified physical sphere diameters within sizing limits and confirm capture rate.

6. **Recipe Lock & Release:**
   - Verify that false-event count on prime bare test monitor wafers does not exceed baseline limits.
   - Lock calibration recipe `RECIPE_CAL_PSL_180NM_REV2` into the tool SECS/GEM host control system.
   - Release the particle scanner for incoming post-clean bare silicon inspection prior to $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate dielectric thermal oxidation.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Laser Output Power Stability** | $\le \pm 1.0$ | $\%$ drift over 60 min | Internal Reference Photodiode Monitor |
| **Defect Sizing Precision (PSL standard)** | $\le \pm 3.0$ | $\%$ of nominal standard diameter | Histogram peak fit on NIST PSL wafer scan |
| **Lower Detection Sensitivity Cutoff** | $< 180$ (calibrated down to $\le 100$) | $\text{nm}$ (equivalent PSL sphere diameter) | Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) $\ge 3:1$ over background haze |
| **False Count Rate (Background Noise)** | $\le 0.05$ | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ ($\le 15$ counts on $200\text{ mm}$ wafer) | Bare super-clean Si monitor baseline scan |

```text
Calibration Metrics Compliance (%)
                      ┌────────────────────────────────┐
                      │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│

   PSL Sizing Accuracy┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                      │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Laser Output Stability┤████████████████████████████████│
                      │████████████████████████████████│
                      └┬───────┬───────┬──────┬───────┬┘
                       0      25      50     75     100 
```

---

## 4. Context & Literature Citations

- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**  
  *Application in Context:* Emphasizes high-precision non-destructive optical metrology, optical modeling, and wafer coordinate mapping. The pre-gate surface readiness verified by laser particle scattering directly dictates the interfacial dielectric integrity of subsequent dry thermal gate oxidation grown to target thickness ($3.5\text{ nm}$ with sub-Angstrom precision $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**  
  *Application in Context:* Establishes critical unit cell geometry where access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Particulate contamination approaching or exceeding $180\text{ nm}$ directly causes gate oxide shorting, junction leakage degradation ($> 1\text{ fA/cell}$ target violation), or capacitor plug patterning defects.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**  
  *Application in Context:* Confirms the physical baseline for the $180\text{ nm}$ node where bitline and wordline pitch is $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$, gate dielectric is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness, requiring defect threshold calibration strictly below $180\text{ nm}$ to safeguard thin dielectric reliability and yield.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-DFS-001`
**Title:** Automated Full-Wafer Darkfield Spiral Surface Scanning Recipe Execution  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Branch:** Architecture & Integration > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Post-Clean Metrology > Laser Light Scattering Particle Scanning & Defect Density Mapping (<180nm Threshold)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Load Wafer & Notch  │
│        Align         │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Laser Darkfield    │
│     Spiral Scan      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Radial & Angular   │
│    Coordinate Map    │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│    Surface Defect    │
│    Density Check     │
└──────────────────────┘
```

The automated darkfield spiral scanning recipe directs a focused laser light scattering beam across the rotating, linearly translating wafer surface. Rayleigh/Mie scattered photons from surface anomalies and sub-micron particulates are captured by off-axis darkfield photomultiplier detectors, registering precise polar coordinates $(r, \theta)$ to qualify surface cleanliness prior to thermal gate dielectric formation.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Loading & Chuck Vacuum Lock:**
   - Transfer the post-RCA cleaned silicon wafer onto the darkfield metrology spindle chuck using cleanroom non-contact edge-grip handling.
   - Engage backside vacuum chuck; verify stable hold-down pressure before stage movement.

2. **Fiducial & Notch Center Alignment:**
   - Initiate automated optical notch/flat finder routine to set the angular origin ($\theta = 0.0^\circ$).
   - Execute center homing to lock the mechanical rotation axis within the Gen 2 macroscopic stage alignment tolerance of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.

3. **Optics & Detector Parameter Initialization:**
   - Initialize the solid-state inspection laser and verify beam alignment through the collection optics.
   - Set photomultiplier tube (PMT) / darkfield detector integration time and background noise thresholds to resolve light scattering anomalies at the $<180\ \text{nm}$ critical defect scale (protecting the $L = 180\ \text{nm}$, $W = 220\ \text{nm}$ gate channel area).

4. **Spiral Scanning Execution:**
   - Spin the wafer chuck at controlled rotational velocity while stepping the optical head radially from notch perimeter inward to the wafer center (constant linear velocity spiral track).
   - Capture continuous off-axis darkfield light scattering pulses across all radial tracks.

5. **Coordinate Registration & Spatial Binning:**
   - Correlate encoder counts (radial position $r$ and angular position $\theta$) to map coordinate locations for every scattering event.
   - Generate automated radial defect density maps (tracked across radial zones similar to automated 49-point wafer mapping schemes) to inspect post-clean surface readiness for 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.

6. **Unload & Lot Pass/Fail Flagging:**
   - Decelerate spindle to complete rest, release chuck vacuum, and return the wafer to the closed transport pod.
   - Tag wafer state in MES for downstream thermal processing.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical notch and stage origin encoder registration |
| **Monitored Dielectric Oxide Target** | $3.5$ (tolerance $\pm 0.05$) | $\text{nm}$ | Downstream spectroscopic ellipsometry validation |
| **Access Transistor Dimension Guardband** | $L = 180$, $W = 220$ | $\text{nm}$ | Defect spatial coordinate binning vs. cell layout layout overlay |
| **Radial Mapping Point Distribution** | $49$ (or minimum $9$) | points / wafer | Automated multi-point polar coordinate defect density map |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
  - *Context applied:* Measurement and tolerance benchmarks for dry gate oxide ($3.5\ \text{nm}$ with $\pm 0.05\ \text{nm}$ sub-Angstrom precision) and automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping methodologies for tracking radial surface non-uniformity across processing runs.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
  - *Context applied:* Tooling alignment constraints transitioning from Gen 1 ($\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$) down to Gen 2 alignment tolerance ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$) on macroscopic precision stages.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - *Context applied:* Target layout dimensions for unit cell access transistor channel length ($L = 180\ \text{nm}$) and width ($W = 220\ \text{nm}$), establishing the defect sensitivity threshold required to prevent gate oxide punch-through and sub-threshold leakage exceeding $1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP Title: Defect Coordinate Spatial Registration and KLARF Polar-to-Cartesian Mapping
**Module / Area:** Metrology / Defect Inspection & Yield Analysis  
**Node / Target:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) — Pre-Gate Oxide / Post-Clean Surface Qualification  
**Process Action Type:** Make  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation [Wet Chemistry] > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology [Metrology] > Laser Light Scattering Particle Scanning & Defect Density Mapping (<180nm Threshold) [Metrology] > Full-Wafer Laser Surface Particle Scanning & Spatial Coordinate Registration [Metrology] > Defect Coordinate Spatial Registration and KLARF Polar-to-Cartesian Mapping [Metrology]

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│     Laser Surface Particle Detection          │
│   (Optical Scattering in Polar Space: r, θ)   │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│          Notch & Center Registration          │
│       (Physical Notch Angle θ_0 Offset)       │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│     Polar-to-Cartesian Transformation         │
│  x = r·cos(θ - θ_0),  y = r·sin(θ - θ_0)      │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│       Die Origin Indexing & Grid Snapping     │
│  (Wordline / Bitline Pitch Alignment Context) │
└───────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                        │
                        ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│          KLARF Record Generation              │
│    (Defect List, Die Pitch, Wafer Map)        │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Substrate Centering and Notch Fiducial Registration:**
   - Load the pre-oxidation cleaned wafer onto the optical scanning chuck.
   - Detect the wafer mechanical edge and notch fiducial using the optical edge-detection sensor to establish the physical coordinate center $(0,0)$ and reference notch vector $\theta_0$.
   - Confirm rotational zero-point alignment against system mechanical fiducials.

2. **Raw Polar Defect Acquisition:**
   - Initiate full-wafer laser light scattering scan across the substrate surface prior to dry gate oxide growth (targeting pre-oxidation contamination control).
   - Log each defect event triggered by scattering amplitudes exceeding the detection threshold into raw polar coordinate vectors: $(r_i, \theta_i, S_i)$, where $r_i$ is radial distance from wafer center, $\theta_i$ is scanning spindle angle, and $S_i$ is scattering cross-section.

3. **Polar-to-Cartesian Coordinate Transformation:**
   - Execute spatial projection from spindle space $(r, \theta)$ to wafer Cartesian coordinates $(X_{\text{wafer}}, Y_{\text{wafer}})$:
     $$X_{\text{wafer}} = r_i \cdot \cos(\theta_i - \theta_0)$$
     $$Y_{\text{wafer}} = r_i \cdot \sin(\theta_i - \theta_0)$$
   - Correct for systematic stage eccentricities, radial runout, and angular stage encoder drift.

4. **Die Pitch Partitioning and Intra-Die Mapping:**
   - Overlay the 180nm DRAM cell layout grid incorporating configured reticle and die dimensions.
   - Assign each defect $(X_{\text{wafer}}, Y_{\text{wafer}})$ to its corresponding die index $(IndexX, IndexY)$ and intra-die relative coordinate $(X_{\text{die}}, Y_{\text{die}})$:
     $$X_{\text{die}} = X_{\text{wafer}} - [IndexX \cdot DiePitchX + OffsetX]$$
     $$Y_{\text{die}} = Y_{\text{wafer}} - [IndexY \cdot DiePitchY + OffsetY]$$
   - Correlate coordinates with sensitive DRAM array areas containing 180nm transistor channels and memory cell array bounds.

5. **KLARF File Formatting and Export:**
   - Compile the transformed defect records into standard KLA Results File (KLARF) format (specifying `FileVersion 1 2` or `FileFormat 1.0/1.1`).
   - Populate KLARF header attributes: `WaferID`, `LotID`, `DiePitch`, `WaferCenter`, and `SampleSize`.
   - Append data block `DefectList` containing `DEFECTID`, `XREL`, `YREL`, `XINDEX`, `YINDEX`, and defect size binning.
   - Transmit file to the Yield Management System (YMS) for defect density distribution analysis and review-station dispatch.

---

### Acceptance Criteria

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gate Oxide Interface Pre-Clean Thickness Baseline** | $3.5 \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Reflectometry $(\Delta, \Psi)$ |
| **DRAM Array Critical Dimension Pitch Reference** | $360\text{ to }400$ | $\text{nm}$ | Grid Registration / Metrology Stage Layout Alignment |
| **Radial Wafer Non-Uniformity & Mapping Precision** | $9\text{-point or }49\text{-point}$ | grid points | Multi-point automated thin-film wafer mapping run |
| **Defect Spatial Registration Repeatability ($3\sigma$)** | $\le 0.5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Repeat-pass laser scattering fiducial alignment |

---

### Source Citations
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Physical principle of polarization angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$; dry gate oxide target thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ measured with sub-Angstrom precision $(\pm 0.05\text{ nm})$; automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracking radial film non-uniformity.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Gate dielectric specifications for thermally grown dry silicon dioxide ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness); bitline and wordline pitch references between $360\text{ nm}$ and $400\text{ nm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Unit cell geometry (access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$); layout topology integration references for 180nm DRAM arrays.
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Defect Density Spatial Mapping, Radial Clustering Analysis & Go/No-Go Gate Oxide Qualification

- **Node Title:** Defect Density Spatial Mapping, Radial Clustering Analysis & Go/No-Go Gate Oxide Qualification
- **Context:** `180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN)` > `Thermal Processing (180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth)` > `Wet Chemistry (Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean & In-Situ HF Dip)` > `Metrology (Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Defect Metrology)` > `Metrology (Laser Light Scattering Particle Scanning <180nm Threshold)` > `Metrology (Go/No-Go Gate Oxide Qualification)`
- **Generation:** Gen 1 (mm diagnostic scale / initial baseline qualification)
- **Action Type:** Make
- **Domain Role:** Domain Expert AI, DRAM Foundation VN Council

---

### 1. Process Workflow & Decision Tree

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Post-Clean Wafer    │
│         Entry         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Laser Light      │
│      Scattering       │
│      Inspection       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Spatial Coordinate   │
│   Binning & Defect    │
│        Mapping        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Radial Clustering &  │
│  Edge Zone Analysis   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────◇───────────┐
│                       │
│     Go/No-Go Gate     │
│     Qualification     │
│                       │
└───────────◇───────────┘
            │
            │
            ├─────────────────────────────╮Fail
        Pass│                             │
            ▼                             ▼
┌───────────────────────┐     ┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │     │                       │
│    Release to Gate    │     │     Quarantine &      │
│      Polysilicon      │     │   Strip/Rework Flow   │
│      Deposition       │     │                       │
│                       │     │                       │
└───────────────────────┘     └───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Node Parameter Overview

```text
                         ┌─────────────────────────────┐
                         │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■              │
     Max Defect Threshold┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■              │
                         │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
   Wordline/Bitline Pitch┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
          Channel Width W┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒           │
                         │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒           │
         Channel Length L┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
                         │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓              │
Gate Oxide Thickness t_ox┤█                            │
                         │█                            │
                         └┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                          0     90     180    270   360 
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

#### Step 1: Laser Light Scattering Scan Coordinate Ingestion
1. Mount the post-clean/pre-gate oxidation or post-gate-oxidation P-type (100) Si wafer onto the laser surface particle scanner chuck with a fixed 3 mm edge exclusion.
2. Ingest the point defect list generated by laser light scattering with detection sensitivity set down to the critical feature threshold of $180\text{ nm}$ (matching access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and below wordline/bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$).
3. Record each defect's raw coordinate position $(x_i, y_i)$ and optical scattering cross-section calibrated against standard polystyrene latex (PSL) sphere equivalents.

#### Step 2: Spatial Coordinate Polar Binning
1. Transform planar Cartesian coordinates $(x_i, y_i)$ to wafer-centric polar coordinates $(r_i, \theta_i)$:
   $$r_i = \sqrt{x_i^2 + y_i^2}, \quad \theta_i = \arctan2(y_i, x_i)$$
2. Divide the active wafer area into three concentric radial zones:
   - **Inner Core Zone:** $0 \le r < 0.5 R_{\text{wafer}}$
   - **Mid-Annulus Zone:** $0.5 R_{\text{wafer}} \le r < 0.85 R_{\text{wafer}}$
   - **Outer Perimeter Zone:** $0.85 R_{\text{wafer}} \le r \le (R_{\text{wafer}} - 3\text{ mm})$

#### Step 3: Radial Clustering & Density Evaluation
1. Calculate local defect density $D_{\text{zone}} = \frac{N_{\text{defects, zone}}}{\text{Area}_{\text{zone}}}$ across each radial section.
2. Run nearest-neighbor spatial clustering (DBSCAN / density reachability) with an interaction radius $\epsilon = 500\text{ \mu m}$ (aligned with diagnostic circular dot MOSCAP diameters of $200\text{ \mu m}$, $500\text{ \mu m}$, and $1000\text{ \mu m}$).
3. Flag any localized cluster having $\ge 5$ defect points within a $500\text{ \mu m}$ radius as an active killer cluster (indicative of rinse drying streaking, HF precipitation, or boat slot thermal contact artifacts).

#### Step 4: MOSCAP C-V Diagnostic Correlation
1. Cross-reference localized defect clusters against planar MOS capacitor (MOSCAP) test structures with circular gate dots ($200\text{ \mu m}$, $500\text{ \mu m}$, $1000\text{ \mu m}$).
2. Perform high-frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static C-V profiling in the accumulation region ($V_G < V_{fb}$) to ensure the maximum oxide capacitance validates the physical oxide thickness:
   $$t_{ox} = \frac{\epsilon_{ox} \cdot \epsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}}{C_{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.1\text{ nm}$$
3. Confirm that localized defect clusters do not manifest as anomalous interface trap stretches in the depletion region ($V_{fb} < V_G < V_T$).

#### Step 5: Go/No-Go Gate Oxide Qualification Disposition
1. **PASS (Go):** Total defect density $< 0.05\text{ defects/cm}^2$ at $\ge 180\text{ nm}$ threshold, zero killer clusters in active core/mid regions, and measured $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.1\text{ nm}$. Release lot immediately to dry gate oxidation / polysilicon gate stack deposition.
2. **FAIL (No-Go):** Defect density exceeding threshold, or presence of radial edge-streak clusters. Tag lot with red-flag quarantine status, trigger rework wet strip (dilute HF oxide etch), and initiate cleanroom wet-bench spray nozzle inspection.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric ID | Parameter Description | Acceptance Target Value | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AC-MET-01** | Defect Size Sensitivity Threshold | $\le 180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Laser Light Scattering Metrology |
| **AC-MET-02** | Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$) | $3.5 \pm 0.1$ | $\text{nm}$ | Accumulation $C_{ox}$ High-Frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) C-V Profiling |
| **AC-MET-03** | Global Area Defect Density ($D_{\text{defect}}$) | $< 0.05$ | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Automated Coordinate Spatial Binning |
| **AC-MET-04** | Critical Cluster Radial Limit ($\ge 5$ defects / $500\text{ \mu m}$ radius) | $0$ (Zero Tolerance in Core/Mid Zones) | clusters / wafer | Spatial Clustering Algorithm (DBSCAN) |

---

### 5. Citations & Literature Traceability

1. **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**  
   - Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.  
   - Justifies the critical defect threshold of $\le 180\text{ nm}$ to avoid bridge/short anomalies across access transistor gates.
2. **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**  
   - Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.  
   - Wordline and bitline pitch of $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$.
3. **`Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction`**  
   - Planar MOSCAP circular gate dot geometries ($200\text{ \mu m}$, $500\text{ \mu m}$, $1000\text{ \mu m}$) on P-type (100) Si substrate.  
   - High-frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static C-V profiling extraction: $C_{ox} = (\epsilon_{ox} \cdot \epsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{ox}$ yielding $t_{ox}$ with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction (Nicollian & Brews - MOS Physics and Technology)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Info
- **Task Title**: Klarf Particle Defect Map Coordinate Translation & Spatial Binning Pipeline
- **WBS Path**: `Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation [Wet Chemistry] > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology [Metrology] > Laser Light Scattering Particle Scanning & Defect Density Mapping (<180nm Threshold) [Metrology] > Defect Density Spatial Mapping, Radial Clustering Analysis & Go/No-Go Gate Oxide Qualification [Metrology] > Klarf Particle Defect Map Coordinate Translation & Spatial Binning Pipeline [Metrology]`
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Role**: Domain Expert AI (DRAM Foundation VN Multi-Agent Council)

---

## 1. Process Overview & Architecture

This procedure establishes the software and metrology translation workflow to ingest raw laser scattering defect records (KLARF format), convert wafer polar/stage coordinates to die-relative Cartesian coordinates, and execute spatial binning across critical active area arrays prior to dry gate oxidation (3.5 nm target).

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Laser Scattering    │
│         Scan          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      KLARF File       │
│      Generation       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Stage-to-Die      │
│       Alignment       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Coordinate       │
│      Translation      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Spatial Binning &   │
│      Density Map      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Go/No-Go Gate Oxide  │
│      Gatekeeper       │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: KLARF Record Parsing & Header Ingestion
1. Ingest the raw laser light scattering inspection file (`.klarf`, version 1.2 / 1.8).
2. Validate file header metadata:
   - Verify `SampleCenterLocation` $(X_0, Y_0)$ in microns ($\mu\text{m}$).
   - Extract `DiePitch` $(D_x, D_y)$ set matching the 180nm reticle stepping map.
   - Confirm scan sensitivity threshold is configured at particle diameter $< 180\text{ nm}$.

### Step 2: Wafer Stage-to-Die Coordinate Transformation
1. Extract defect records list: defect ID $k$, stage polar/Cartesian coordinates $(X_{\text{stage}}, Y_{\text{stage}})$, and optical scattering size.
2. Apply coordinate translation from wafer center to die-index matrix:
   $$\text{DieIndex}_X = \left\lfloor \frac{X_{\text{stage}} - X_0 + \frac{D_x}{2}}{D_x} \right\rfloor, \quad \text{DieIndex}_Y = \left\lfloor \frac{Y_{\text{stage}} - Y_0 + \frac{D_y}{2}}{D_y} \right\rfloor$$
3. Compute in-die local origin coordinates $(x_{\text{rel}}, y_{\text{rel}})$:
   $$x_{\text{rel}} = X_{\text{stage}} - \left(X_0 + \text{DieIndex}_X \cdot D_x\right)$$
   $$y_{\text{rel}} = Y_{\text{stage}} - \left(Y_0 + \text{DieIndex}_Y \cdot D_y\right)$$
4. Assert transformation alignment accuracy within $\pm 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ to ensure alignment with active array layouts (channel $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$; pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$).

### Step 3: Spatial Binning & Defect Clustering Pipeline
1. Discretize wafer active area into spatial grid bins:
   - Primary macro bins: $1\text{ mm} \times 1\text{ mm}$ for wafer-level radial non-uniformity tracking.
   - Micro cell bins: Bitline/wordline array grid ($360\text{ nm} - 400\text{ nm}$ pitch blocks).
2. Filter and categorize detected defects:
   - Isolated defects ($N < 3$ within $5\ \mu\text{m}$ radius).
   - Radial / edge ring clusters (characteristic of spin-clean/rinse drying streaks).
   - Dense array cluster defects affecting 1T1C storage node plugs and active area junctions.

### Step 4: Metrology Verification & Gate Oxide Gatekeeper Routing
1. Overlay spatial defect density with radial spectroscopic ellipsometry maps (tracking dry gate oxide thickness across 9-point or 49-point maps).
2. Compute spatial defect density $D_{\text{ox}}$ across the gate active areas:
   - Trigger **HOLD / RE-CLEAN** if fatal killer particle ($> 180\text{ nm}$) coincides with dry gate oxide regions ($3.5\text{ nm}$ physical target).
   - Release wafer lot to 850°C–900°C dry oxidation furnace only if active area cluster density meets gatekeeper limits.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                         Metrology & Translation Limits 
                        ┌──────────────────────────────┐
                        │░                             │
     Delta Thk Prec (nm)┤░                             │
     Gate Oxide Thk (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
                        │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Defect Loc Accuracy (um)┤██                            │
                        │██                            │
                        └┬──────┬───────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                        0.0    0.9     1.8    2.6   3.5 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Value | Tolerance / Control Limit | Exact Unit | Metrology / Tool Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Defect Localization & Translation Accuracy** | $\le 0.18$ | Max offset $\pm 0.18$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Automated Stage-to-Layout Alignment |
| **Particle Size Detection Threshold** | $< 180$ | Upper cutoff: $180$ | $\text{nm}$ | Laser Light Scattering Metrology |
| **Downstream Gate Oxide Physical Thickness** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (Cauchy/Sellmeier) |
| **Gate Oxidation Process Temperature Window** | $850 \text{ to } 900$ | Setpoint stability $\pm 1.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Dry Thermal Oxidation Furnace Pyrometry |

---

## 4. Literature & Context Citations

1. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml)**:
   - Channel geometry: Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
   - Array architecture: Stacked capacitor over bitline (COB), cell capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage limit $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
2. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering](docs/context.yaml)**:
   - Pitch & dielectric: Bitline and wordline pitch $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$; gate dielectric physically grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
3. **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology](docs/context.yaml)**:
   - Formulation: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ using Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models.
   - Precision: $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide verification with sub-Ångström precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) across standard 9-point/49-point automated wafer maps.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-042`
**Title:** Radial Zone Clustering & Nearest-Neighbor Spatial Defect Point Process Analysis  
**Module:** Post-Clean & Pre-Gate Oxidation Defect Metrology  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 / 0.18 µm)  
**Process Action Type:** Metrology / Gate Oxide Qualification  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the automated protocol for post-RCA/HF clean surface defect point-process analysis on 200 mm silicon wafers prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth. By utilizing laser light scattering coordinate data ($X, Y$) filtered to defects $\ge 180\text{ nm}$, this procedure executes radial concentric zone segmentation, nearest-neighbor spatial point clustering (Clark-Evans $R$ metric and spatial density variance), and radial zone yield gating to ensure gate dielectric integrity across the 180nm access transistor channel ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

---

### 2. Context & Literature Citations
* **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]:** Access transistor channel dimensions are length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, requiring strict elimination of critical particulate defects $\ge 180\text{ nm}$ across active gate regions to prevent sub-threshold dielectric breakdown and excessive junction leakage.
* **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]:** 180nm 1T1C DRAM cells require gate oxide thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ to a physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$; particulate clustering directly triggers catastrophic gate dielectric punch-through.
* **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]:** Establishes radial zone non-uniformity tracking standards across wafer topologies (comparable to automated multi-point radial wafer mapping).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| FLOW: Spatial Point-Process Defect Analysis & Radial Zone Clustering           |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                       |
                                       v
        [Step 1] Ingest KLARF / Coordinate Map (Threshold >= 180 nm)
                                       |
                                       v
        [Step 2] Define Concentric Radial Annular Zones (Z1 - Z4)
                                       |
                                       v
        [Step 3] Calculate Clark-Evans Nearest-Neighbor Metric (R_CE)
                                       |
                                       v
        [Step 4] Compute Radial Zone Defect Densities (D_z)
                                       |
                                       v
        [Step 5] Go/No-Go Decision Gate for 3.5 nm Dry Oxidation
```

#### Step 1: Ingest Defect Spatial Coordinates
1. Import the inspection coordinate file (`.001` / KLARF) generated by the laser light scattering surface particle inspection tool.
2. Apply hardware bin filtering to isolate critical defect sizing $\ge 180\text{ nm}$ (matching minimum gate length $L = 180\text{ nm}$).
3. Establish wafer center $(X_0, Y_0) = (0.000\text{ mm}, 0.000\text{ mm})$ with an exclusion edge-bevel zone of $3.0\text{ mm}$ (clear aperture radius $R_{\text{usable}} = 97.0\text{ mm}$).

#### Step 2: Concentric Radial Annular Zoning
1. Segment the usable wafer surface into 4 equal-area concentric annular zones ($Z_1$ to $Z_4$):
   * **Zone 1 (Inner Center):** $r \in [0, 48.5\text{ mm})$
   * **Zone 2 (Inner Ring):** $r \in [48.5, 68.6\text{ mm})$
   * **Zone 3 (Outer Ring):** $r \in [68.6, 84.0\text{ mm})$
   * **Zone 4 (Edge Zone):** $r \in [84.0, 97.0\text{ mm})$
2. Calculate spatial defect count $N_k$ and area $A_k$ ($\text{cm}^2$) for each zone $k \in \{1, 2, 3, 4\}$.

#### Step 3: Nearest-Neighbor Distance (NND) Point-Process Analysis
1. For each defect $i$ with coordinates $(x_i, y_i)$, compute the Euclidean distance to its closest neighbor:
   $$d_i = \min_{j \ne i} \sqrt{(x_i - x_j)^2 + (y_i - y_j)^2}$$
2. Calculate the mean observed nearest-neighbor distance:
   $$\bar{r}_{\text{obs}} = \frac{1}{N} \sum_{i=1}^N d_i$$
3. Compute the expected nearest-neighbor distance for a random Poisson point distribution:
   $$\bar{r}_{\text{exp}} = \frac{1}{2\sqrt{\lambda}}, \quad \text{where } \lambda = \frac{N}{A_{\text{usable}}}$$
4. Calculate the Clark-Evans aggregation index:
   $$R_{\text{CE}} = \frac{\bar{r}_{\text{obs}}}{\bar{r}_{\text{exp}}}$$
   *(Note: $R_{\text{CE}} < 1.0$ indicates spatial clustering; $R_{\text{CE}} = 1.0$ is completely random; $R_{\text{CE}} > 1.0$ denotes regular/dispersed ordering).*

#### Step 4: Radial Density Differential & Go/No-Go Qualification
1. Compute the defect density $D_k = \frac{N_k}{A_k}$ ($\text{defects/cm}^2$) per zone.
2. Calculate radial defect density gradient ratio:
   $$\Delta_{\text{radial}} = \frac{D_{\text{Zone 4}}}{D_{\text{Zone 1}}}$$
3. Check for localized micro-clusters: Flag any cluster where $> 5$ defect points reside within a radius $\le 500\text{ µm}$.
4. If acceptance thresholds pass, tag wafer as **QUALIFIED** for furnace dispatch into the 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation tube ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$). If failed, route wafer to rework (re-clean or scrap).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Engineering Tolerance | Physical Units | Inspection / Qualification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Minimum Critical Particle Size Cutoff** | $180$ | $\pm 0.0$ (Hard lower bound) | $\text{nm}$ | Laser Light Scattering Channel Threshold |
| **Clark-Evans Clustering Index ($R_{\text{CE}}$)** | $\ge 0.85$ | $+0.15 / -0.00$ ($R < 0.85$ rejected) | Dimensionless ratio | Spatial Point Process Nearest-Neighbor Engine |
| **Zone Defect Density ($D_{\text{Zone 1-3}}$)** | $\le 0.05$ | $\le 0.08$ Max | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Automated Coordinate-Area Integration |
| **Edge Radial Gradient Ratio ($\Delta_{\text{radial}}$)** | $\le 2.0$ | $\pm 0.3$ | Dimensionless ratio | $D_{\text{Zone 4}} / D_{\text{Zone 1}}$ Concentric Bin Ratio |
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Die-Level Killer Defect Correlation & Go/No-Go Gate Oxidation Lot Disposition
**Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`)  
**Node**: Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm) | **Action Type**: Make | **Area**: Metrology & Quality Disposition

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Laser Scattering    │
│     Metrology Map      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Coordinate Overlay   │
│  on 180nm Die Layout   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│    Defect in Active    │
│  Channel / Gate Oxide  │
│         Area?          │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────────────────╮ No (Field Oxide / Scribe Line)
             │ Yes (L = 180 nm, W = 220 nm Area)       │
             ▼                                         ▼
┌────────────────────────┐                ┌────────────────────────┐
│     Flag as Killer     │                │   Flag as Non-Killer   │
│         Defect         │                │         Defect         │
└───────────┬────────────┘                └────────────┬───────────┘
            │                                          │
            ▼ ◄────────────────────────────────────────╯
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Calculate Die-Level   │
│    Yield & Cluster     │
│         Index          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│   Disposition Check:   │
│  Metrology & Breakdown │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├─────────────────────────────────────────╮ Fail / Out of Spec
             │ Pass                                    │
             ▼                                         ▼
┌────────────────────────┐                ┌────────────────────────┐
│   GO: Release Lot to   │                │  NO-GO: Strip, Rework  │
│  Gate Poly Deposition  │                │    Clean, or Scrap     │
└────────────────────────┘                └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Metrology Map Ingestion & Coordinate Alignment**:
   - Ingest wafer-level particle coordinate maps obtained from post-oxidation laser light scattering inspection (< 180 nm detection threshold).
   - Perform sub-micron coordinate transformation and fiducial alignment to map laser defect coordinates onto the 180nm DRAM cell layout topology (8F² / 6F² folded bitline grid).

2. **Die-Level Active Pattern Critical Area Masking**:
   - Overlay defect coordinates with the critical gate oxide active area mask: specifically access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and wordline/bitline boundary areas (pitch $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$).
   - Classify each localized particle:
     - **Killer Defect**: Particle coordinates intersecting access transistor channel regions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) or gate dielectric regions, leading to localized dielectric punch-through, pinhole formation, or junction shorting.
     - **Non-Killer / Nuisance Defect**: Particle landing on inactive field oxide, outer isolation regions, or sacrificial scribe line streets.

3. **Spatial Clustering & Defect Density Calculation**:
   - Run radial nearest-neighbor clustering analysis to isolate localized particle bursts or radial ring patterns indicative of furnace thermal gradient or gas slipstream disturbances.
   - Calculate gross defect density ($D_0$) and net killer defect density ($D_{\text{killer}}$) per wafer and across the entire oxidation furnace lot.

4. **Die-Level Electrical & Breakdown Correlation**:
   - Correlate test-die electrical monitoring structures (split CV / IV test structures from the dry oxidation step grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$) to verify breakdown field reliability ($E_{\text{bd}}$) and interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}}$).

5. **Go / No-Go Lot Disposition**:
   - **GO Decision**: If physical gate oxide thickness meets target ($3.5\text{ nm to } 4.0\text{ nm}$), interface trap density is below threshold ($D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$), dielectric breakdown field exceeds target ($E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$), and killer defect count is within allowable yield threshold, release lot forward to gate polysilicon deposition.
   - **NO-GO Decision**: If killer defect clustering occurs across active access transistor channels ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) or $E_{\text{bd}} \le 10\text{ MV/cm}$, place lot on engineering hold for oxide strip and pre-oxidation RCA clean rework, or scrap affected wafers.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Metrology / Tool Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness** | **$3.5\text{ to } 4.0$** (nominal **$3.5$**) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / TEM |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{\text{bd}}$)** | **$> 10$** | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Fast Voltage Ramp Breakdown ($V_{\text{bd}} / T_{\text{ox}}$) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$)** | **$< 10^{10}$** | $\text{cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$ | High-Low Frequency C-V Metrology |
| **Critical Channel Feature Overlay** | Access channel $L = \mathbf{180}$, $W = \mathbf{220}$ | $\text{nm}$ | Defect Inspection CAD Overlay Metrology |

---

### 3. Source Context Citations

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - Access transistor channel dimensions defined as length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Bitline contact sharing and folded bitline layout architecture used for killer defect overlay boundary definition.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Dry oxidation parameters ($900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$) producing physical gate thickness target of $3.5\text{ nm to } 4.0\text{ nm}$.
  - Electrical qualification standards: dielectric breakdown field $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and interface trap density $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Confirms gate dielectric thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - Wordline and bitline pitch reference spacing of $360\text{ nm to } 400\text{ nm}$ for pattern masking.

nodes.sop_content:
### Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Metallic Contamination (Fe/Cu/Ni) Baseline Analysis  
**Node Path:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and In-Situ HF Dip Surface Preparation > Post-Clean Contact Angle & Surface Particle/Metallic Defect Metrology > Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Metallic Contamination (Fe/Cu/Ni) Baseline Analysis  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

#### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Wafer Load &      │
│     Pre-Alignment      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  X-Ray Beam Alignment  │
│  & Angle Calibration   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    TXRF Full-Wafer     │
│   Scanning Fe/Cu/Ni    │
│       Baselines        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Data Processing &    │
│        Spectral        │
│     Deconvolution      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Acceptance       │
│     Verification &     │
│    Pass/Fail Gating    │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

#### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Chamber Transfer:**
   - Transfer post-RCA cleaned and in-situ HF-dipped wafers via automated vacuum end-effector to the TXRF sample stage to prevent airborne metallic cross-contamination.
   - Evacuate metrology chamber to high-vacuum mode (< $10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$) or purge with high-purity inert He gas to reduce air scattering and background noise.

2. **Optical Alignment & Critical Angle Setting:**
   - Calibrate the goniometer and grazing incidence angle below the critical angle of silicon ($\phi_c \approx 0.18^\circ$ for Mo-$K_\alpha$ radiation at $17.44\text{ keV}$) to ensure total internal reflection and limit X-ray penetration depth strictly to the top surface (~3 to 5 nm).
   - Perform automated height and tilt pre-alignment using the optical reflection sensor.

3. **Multi-Point Mapping Acquisition:**
   - Execute an automated wafer surface mapping routine (sampling center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zone $> 3\text{ mm}$).
   - Set detector dwell/integration time to $t = 1000\text{ s}$ per site using a liquid nitrogen-cooled or silicon drift detector (SDD) to achieve baseline detection limits.

4. **Fluorescence Spectral Deconvolution:**
   - Record characteristic fluorescent emissions:
     - Iron: $\text{Fe-}K_\alpha$ at $6.40\text{ keV}$
     - Nickel: $\text{Ni-}K_\alpha$ at $7.47\text{ keV}$
     - Copper: $\text{Cu-}K_\alpha$ at $8.04\text{ keV}$
   - Deconvolute overlapping peaks and subtract silicon substrate escape/background scatter peaks.

5. **Areal Concentration Calculation & Interlock Check:**
   - Convert net fluorescence photon counts to absolute surface areal concentration ($\text{atoms/cm}^2$) using reference calibration standards.
   - Verify that metallic levels do not exceed pre-oxidation thresholds to protect 3.5 nm dry gate oxide integrity and cell retention times.

---

#### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

1. **Iron ($\text{Fe}$) Surface Contamination Baseline:**  
   $$\text{Areal Density} \le 1.0 \times 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$$  
   *(Prevents mid-gap trap states and premature gate dielectric breakdown in 3.5 nm thermal gate oxide).*

2. **Copper ($\text{Cu}$) and Nickel ($\text{Ni}$) Surface Baselines:**  
   $$\text{Areal Density} \le 5.0 \times 10^{9}\text{ atoms/cm}^2\text{ per element}$$  
   *(Ensures junction and sub-threshold leakage remain below the critical target of $< 1\text{ fA/cell at } 85^\circ\text{C}$).*

3. **X-Ray Incidence Grazing Angle Precision:**  
   $$\phi = 0.10^\circ \pm 0.01^\circ \text{ (below }\phi_c \approx 0.18^\circ\text{ for Si substrate)}$$  
   *(Guarantees total internal reflection, restricting penetration depth to $< 5\text{ nm}$).*

4. **Metrology Repeatability / Coefficient of Variation:**  
   $$\text{CV} \le 5.0\% \text{ at } 1\sigma \text{ across } 1000\text{ s integration time}$$  

---

#### 4. Context Citations

- **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  - *Cited Parameter:* Thermal gate dielectric grown at 850°C–900°C with **~3.5 nm physical thickness**; cell retention target **> 64 ms at 85°C**.
- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - *Cited Parameter:* Leakage current target: **junction and sub-threshold leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell at } 85^\circ\text{C}$**; access transistor dimensions $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$.
- **Source:** *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*  
  - *Cited Parameter:* Sub-Angstrom dry gate oxide measurement precision benchmark (**$\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ for 3.5 nm oxide**); automated surface mapping tracking radial film uniformity.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$)

- **Module**: Thermal Oxidation / Gate Dielectric Engineering
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Generation**: Gen 1 (mm)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Target Dielectric**: Pure Dry $\text{SiO}_2$ Gate Oxide ($t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$)

---

### 1. Process Overview & Thermal Recipe Steps

```
[Wafer Loading & N2 Purge: 600°C]
               │
               ▼
[Ramp-Up: 600°C ➔ 850°C (N2 Ambience)]
               │
               ▼
[Dry O2 Oxidation: 850°C, 22 min, 100% Dry O2]
               │
               ▼
[Post-Oxidation Anneal: N2 Flush, 850°C, 15 min]
               │
               ▼
[Ramp-Down: 850°C ➔ 600°C & Unload]
```

#### Step 1: Pre-Furnace Tube Conditioning & Wafer Loading
- **Tube Ambience**: High-purity nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$, purity $\ge 99.9999\%$).
- **Idle / Insertion Temperature**: $600^\circ\text{C}$ to prevent premature thermal stress or native oxide thickening.
- **Action**: Slowly push the quartz boat containing pre-cleaned (100) silicon wafers into the flat zone of the horizontal quartz tube furnace at a controlled push rate ($100\text{ mm/min}$).

#### Step 2: Temperature Ramp-Up
- **Gas Ambient**: $\text{N}_2$ carrier at atmospheric pressure ($1\text{ atm}$).
- **Ramp Rate**: $+10^\circ\text{C/min}$ from $600^\circ\text{C}$ to target process temperature of $850^\circ\text{C}$ (or $900^\circ\text{C}$ upper limit per qualification).
- **Stabilization**: Soak at $850^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$ under $\text{N}_2$ to ensure thermal equilibrium across all furnace heating zones.

#### Step 3: Dry Thermal Oxidation Execution
- **Reaction Gas**: Switch gas inlet from $\text{N}_2$ to $100\%$ ultra-dry $\text{O}_2$ (moisture $< 1\text{ ppb}$).
- **Temperature**: $850^\circ\text{C}$ constant ($\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Duration**: **$22\text{ minutes}$** in $100\%$ dry $\text{O}_2$.
  - *Kinetic Note*: Operating in the thin/initial linear regime dominated by interface reaction rate ($B/A = 0.018\ \mu\text{m/hr}$ at $850^\circ\text{C}$, $B = 0.0031\ \mu\text{m}^2\text{/hr}$).

#### Step 4: Post-Oxidation Nitrogen Anneal (POA) & Ramp-Down
- **Gas Ambient**: Cut off $\text{O}_2$; immediately purge tube with high-purity $\text{N}_2$.
- **POA**: Soak in $\text{N}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}$ for $15\text{ minutes}$ to passivate unreacted dangling bonds and minimize interface trap charge ($D_{it}$).
- **Ramp-Down**: Ramp furnace temperature down to $600^\circ\text{C}$ at $-5^\circ\text{C/min}$ under continuous $\text{N}_2$ flow.
- **Unload**: Pull boat at $100\text{ mm/min}$ into nitrogen-purged load lock.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | `3.5` | $\pm 0.2$ ($3.3 - 3.7$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (multi-point wafer map) |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10.0$ | Min: $10.0$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Voltage-Ramp Time-Zero Dielectric Breakdown (TZDB) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | Max: $1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Low Frequency Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) |
| **Oxidation Temperature Uniformity** | `850.0` | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-zone thermocouple profile log |

---

### 3. Local Literature Citations

1. **Deal-Grove Silicon Oxidation Kinetic Coefficients & Gate Oxide Thickness**:
   - Arrhenius dry $\text{O}_2$ oxidation constants for (100) Silicon at $850^\circ\text{C}$: $B = 0.0031\ \mu\text{m}^2\text{/hr}$, $B/A = 0.018\ \mu\text{m/hr}$.
   - Recipe specification: Dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}$ for $22\text{ minutes}$ in $100\%$ dry $\text{O}_2$ yielding physical thickness $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.2\text{ nm}$.
2. **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
   - Dielectric quality targets for dry thermal gate oxide: Dielectric breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$.
3. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - 180nm node transistor gate dielectric standard: thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Deal-Grove Silicon Oxidation Kinetic Coefficients & Gate Oxide Thickness (Deal & Grove (1965) / Plummer Silicon VLSI Technology)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1 / DHF Dip / SC-2)

- **Context / Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip)
- **Generation**: Gen 1 (mm)
- **Action Type**: Make
- **Module**: Wet Chemistry Clean

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     SC-1 Alkaline      │
│    Oxidation Clean     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Cascade Dump Rinse   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Dilute HF Native    │
│       Oxide Dip        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Intermediate Dump    │
│         Rinse          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  SC-2 Acidic Metallic  │
│         Clean          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Final DI Dump Rinse   │
│       and N2 Dry       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

#### Step 1: RCA-1 / SC-1 (Standard Clean 1 – Alkaline Oxidation & Particle Stripping)
- **Chemical Formulation**: $5\text{ parts } \text{UPW} : 1\text{ part } 29\% \text{ NH}_4\text{OH} : 1\text{ part } 30\% \text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$.
- **Bath Equipment & Agitation**: Heated quartz or PTFE immersion tank with megasonic agitation at $1\text{ MHz}$.
- **Process Temperature**: $70^\circ\text{C}$ to $75^\circ\text{C}$ (permissible baseline window up to $80^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Immersion Time**: $10\text{ minutes}$ (window: $10\text{ to } 15\text{ minutes}$).
- **Mechanism**: Solubilizes organic surface films via simultaneous oxidative dissolution and microscopic controlled silicon etching ($\sim 0.5\text{ nm}$); dislodges sub-micron particles via zeta potential electrostatic repulsion.

#### Step 2: Intermediate Cascade Dump Rinse 1
- **Rinse Water Quality**: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water (UPW).
- **Rinse Cycles**: $5\text{ dump rinse cycles}$ (minimum $3\text{ minutes}$).
- **Process Endpoint**: Rinse bath effluent resistivity reaching $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

#### Step 3: Native Oxide Strip (Dilute HF Dip)
- **Chemical Formulation**: $1:50\text{ HF} : \text{UPW}$ ($0.5\%\text{ to } 1.0\%\text{ Hydrofluoric Acid}$).
- **Bath Temperature**: $22^\circ\text{C}$ (ambient cleanroom control).
- **Immersion Time**: $15\text{ to } 30\text{ seconds}$.
- **Mechanism & Physical Endpoint**: Complete dissolution of native chemical oxide; transition of the wafer surface from hydrophilic sheeting to complete hydrophobic dewetting (water-beading / sheeting-off).

#### Step 4: Intermediate Dump Rinse 2
- **Rinse Water Quality**: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.
- **Rinse Duration**: Dump rinse for $3\text{ minutes}$ until residual fluoride traces are purged.

#### Step 5: RCA-2 / SC-2 (Standard Clean 2 – Acidic Metallic Trace Extraction)
- **Chemical Formulation**: $6\text{ parts } \text{UPW} : 1\text{ part } 37\% \text{ HCl} : 1\text{ part } 30\% \text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$.
- **Bath Temperature**: $70^\circ\text{C}$ to $80^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Immersion Time**: $10\text{ minutes}$.
- **Mechanism**: Solubilizes and complexes alkali ionic species ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and heavy metallic impurities ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$) into soluble metal chlorides, preventing incorporation into the gate dielectric.

#### Step 6: Final Cascade Dump Rinse & Nitrogen Dry
- **Cascade Rinse**: Multi-cycle dump rinse with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water until resistivity $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
- **Drying**: Ultra-pure high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry / spin-rinse-dry (SRD). Immediate transfer into the oxidation furnace stage.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target Threshold | Measurement Method / Sensor | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cascade Rinse Water Resistivity** | $> 16.0$ (final target $\ge 18.2$) | In-line toroidal conductivity/resistivity cell | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |
| **SC-1 Cleaning Bath Temperature** | $70.0 - 75.0$ | Calibrated PTFE-sheathed thermocouple / RTD sensor | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **DHF Immersion Duration** | $15 - 30$ | Automated wet bench pneumatic recipe timer | $\text{seconds}$ |
| **Post-DHF Surface State Transition** | Hydrophobic dewetting (water sheeting off) | Machine-vision contact angle / optical dewetting sensor | Qualitative / Dewetting status |

---

### 3. Literature Sources & Citations
1. **Source: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**:
   - Bath stoichiometry ($5:1:1$ $\text{UPW}:\text{NH}_4\text{OH}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$), megasonic frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$), temperature range ($70^\circ\text{C} - 75^\circ\text{C}$), immersion time ($10\text{ min}$), cascade rinse metric ($> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$), dilute HF recipe ($1:50$ to $1:100$, $15 - 30\text{ s}$, $22^\circ\text{C}$), and hydrophobic dewetting endpoint.
2. **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
   - SC-2 chemistry ($6:1:1$ $\text{UPW}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$), SC-2 process temperature ($70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$, $10\text{ min}$), dump rinse duration ($3\text{ minutes}$ with $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ water), alkali/heavy metal stripping targets, and $\text{N}_2$ drying protocol.

# Standard Operating Procedure: SC-1 Alkaline Organic and Particle Removal Bath Execution

**Context Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > **SC-1 Alkaline Organic and Particle Removal Bath Execution**  
**Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Prepare Bath: 5:1:1   │
│     DI:NH4OH:H2O2      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Heat Solution: 70°C   │
│         - 80°C         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Immerse Wafers: 10 -  │
│         15 min         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Post-Clean Rinse:    │
│    18.2 MOhm-cm DI     │
│      Water, 3 min      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Reagent Formulation & Volumetric Batching:**
   - Measure high-purity Deionized (DI) $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, $29\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH}$ (Ammonium Hydroxide), and $30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ (Hydrogen Peroxide) in a volumetric ratio of **5 : 1 : 1**.
   - Charge a clean quartz or PVDF bath with 5 parts DI $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, followed by 1 part $29\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH}$, and carefully add 1 part $30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$.

2. **Bath Thermal Stabilization:**
   - Activate bath immersion heater and heat the mixture until bath temperature stabilizes between **$70^\circ\text{C}$ and $80^\circ\text{C}$**.

3. **Substrate Immersion & Cleaning Cycle:**
   - Load wafer carrier into the heated SC-1 solution.
   - Maintain full immersion for **$10\text{ to }15\text{ minutes}$** to oxidize and solubilize surface organics and trace metallic particulates.

4. **Intermediate Dump Rinse:**
   - Transfer wafers immediately to an intermediate dump rinse tank charged with **$18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** resistivity deionized water.
   - Execute dump rinse cycle for **$3\text{ minutes}$** to eliminate chemical drag-out before subsequent processing.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Volumetric Ratio** | $5 : 1 : 1\ (\text{DI }\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH}\ [29\%] : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ [30\%])$ | Volumetric Parts |
| **Process Bath Temperature** | $70\text{ to }80$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Immersion Process Time** | $10\text{ to }15$ | $\text{min}$ |
| **Intermediate Rinse Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |
| **Intermediate Rinse Duration** | $3$ | $\text{min}$ |

---

### Literature Citations

- **Source Reference:** *Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure*
  - Reagent composition: $5\text{ parts DI }\text{H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part } 29\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$.
  - Thermal parameters & soak duration: $70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{--}15\text{ minutes}$.
  - Intermediate rinse specification: $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}\ \text{DI water}$ for $3\text{ minutes}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Semiconductor-Grade Reagent Metering and Pre-Mix Dosing
**Context Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) > SC-1 Alkaline Organic and Particle Removal Bath Execution > SC-1 Chemical Bath Formulation and Thermal Stabilization (5:1:1 DIW/NH4OH/H2O2 at 75°C) > Semiconductor-Grade Reagent Metering and Pre-Mix Dosing  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|               SC-1 CHEMICAL METERING & PRE-MIX DOSING SEQUENCE                    |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1] Dispense UPW / DIW (18.2 MOhm-cm) base volume (5 parts) into tank       |
|                                       |                                           |
|                                       v                                           |
|  [Step 2] Meter Semiconductor-Grade 29% NH4OH (1 part) via inline mass flow meter|
|                                       |                                           |
|                                       v                                           |
|  [Step 3] Initiate pre-mix recirculating loop & thermal ramp (target: 70°C-80°C)   |
|                                       |                                           |
|                                       v                                           |
|  [Step 4] Meter Semiconductor-Grade 30% H2O2 (1 part) prior to wafer run dispatch |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Safety & Wet Bench Interlock Verification:**
   - Confirm chemical wet bench exhaust face velocity is active with negative pressure. Verify PPE and fluoropolymer (PTFE/PFA) metering lines are free of leaks.
2. **Deionized Water (DIW) Base Charge:**
   - Meter ultra-pure deionized water (UPW/DIW) with resistivity $\ge 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ into the PFA/quartz immersion bath tank to establish a base of exactly 5 volume parts.
3. **Ammonium Hydroxide Metering:**
   - Dose semiconductor-grade 29% Ammonium Hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$) through a calibrated fluoropolymer positive-displacement meter/inline flow controller into the DIW at a volumetric ratio of 1 part relative to the 5 parts DIW.
4. **Thermal Pre-Mixing & Circulation:**
   - Engage the inline chemical recirculation filter pump loop.
   - Activate the immersion bath heater to initiate thermal ramp toward the process window ($70^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }80^\circ\text{C}$).
5. **Hydrogen Peroxide Dosing:**
   - Once the heated mixture stabilizes, dose semiconductor-grade 30% Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) at 1 part volumetric ratio to finalize the 5:1:1 ($\text{DIW} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) SC-1 formulation, preventing premature peroxide thermal decomposition prior to wafer dispatch.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DIW Resistivity** | 18.2 | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |
| **Reagent Volumetric Mix Ratio** | $5 : 1 : 1$ ($\text{DIW} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | Parts ratio by volume | Precise volumetric metering of 29% $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$ and 30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ |
| **Bath Thermal Stabilization Range** | 70 to 80 | ${^\circ}\text{C}$ | Continuous temperature within $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Subsequent Gate Oxide Thickness** | 3.5 to 4.0 | $\text{nm}$ | Target thickness post-clean dry oxidation |

---

### 3. Context Citations

* **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  * *Volumetric Ratio & Reagent Grades:* 5 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ ($18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$), 1 part Ammonium Hydroxide ($29\%\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
  * *Thermal Window:* Heated to $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for 10–15 minutes to solubilize organic surface films and oxidize light trace metals.
* **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
  * *Downstream Interface Specification:* Pre-clean surface conditioning ensures dielectric breakdown $E_{bd} > 10\ \text{MV/cm}$ and $D_{it} < 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\ \text{eV}^{-1}$ for dry gate oxide target thickness of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\ \text{nm}$ on 180nm channel structures.
