nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Info
- **Title**: Chemical Bath Potentiometric Assay and Thermal Uniformity Profiling
- **Hierarchy Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) > SC-1 Alkaline Organic and Particle Removal Bath Execution > SC-1 Chemical Bath Formulation and Thermal Stabilization (5:1:1 DIW/NH4OH/H2O2 at 75°C) > Chemical Bath Potentiometric Assay and Thermal Uniformity Profiling
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node
- **Action Type**: Make / Metrology & Process Control

---

## 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the metrology protocol for potentiometric assay validation and spatial thermal profiling of the Standard Clean-1 (SC-1) bath prior to wafer cassette immersion. Accurate concentration assay and spatial temperature uniformity within the bath are necessary to ensure controlled organic solubilization and uniform particle removal without non-uniform micro-roughening prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth.

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Measurement Sensor Calibration & Pre-Check
1. Inspect the chemical bath vessel to verify nominal charge of 5:1:1 volumetric ratio ($5\,\text{parts}\,\text{DIW} : 1\,\text{part}\,\text{NH}_4\text{OH}\,(29\%) : 1\,\text{part}\,\text{H}_2\text{O}_2\,(30\%)$ formulated with ultra-pure deionized water ($18.2\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
2. Perform a 3-point calibration of the alkaline-rated glass combination pH/redox electrode using certified buffer solutions ($\text{pH } 7.00$, $\text{pH } 10.00$, and $\text{pH } 12.00$) at $25^\circ\text{C}$ with automatic temperature compensation (ATC).
3. Verify that the 5-point submerged RTD (Pt100/Pt1000) thermal profiling jig (4 corners + 1 center) is clean and jacketed with high-purity fluoropolymer (PTFE/PFA).

### Step 2: Spatial Thermal Uniformity Profiling
1. Mount the multi-point thermal profiling array into the active wafer immersion zone of the quartz/PVDF bath tank.
2. Confirm the recirculating immersion heater and overflow weir circulation are active at the process setpoint of $75^\circ\text{C}$ (within the qualified process operating envelope of $70^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }80^\circ\text{C}$).
3. Log steady-state temperature across all 5 immersion points continuously for 3 minutes.
4. Calculate maximum spatial thermal gradient:
   $$\Delta T_{\text{spatial}} = T_{\max} - T_{\min}$$
5. Confirm bath temperature stabilizes within $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ and spatial variation does not exceed $\pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$.

### Step 3: Potentiometric Bath Composition Assay
1. Using an automated PFA siphon or chemical-resistant pipettor, draw a $10.0\,\text{mL}$ aliquot from the mid-depth overflow zone of the bath.
2. Quench the sample into $50.0\,\text{mL}$ of chilled ($<10^\circ\text{C}$) $18.2\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water to suppress catalytic $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ decomposition during assay.
3. **Acid-Base Titration for $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$ Content**:
   - Titrate potentiometrically against standardized $0.50\,\text{N}\;\text{HCl}$ to the inflection endpoint ($\text{pH } \sim 5.2$ to $4.8$) to quantify active ammonium hydroxide concentration.
4. **Redox Titration for $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ Content**:
   - Acidify a second $10.0\,\text{mL}$ quenched aliquot with dilute sulfuric acid and potentiometrically titrate against standardized $0.10\,\text{N}\;\text{KMnO}_4$ or $\text{Ce}(\text{SO}_4)_2$ using a platinum ORP electrode to detect the oxidation-reduction potential equivalence inflection.
5. Record bath active assay values to confirm chemical ratio conformity before releasing the bath to wafer processing.

### Step 4: Metrology Sign-Off & Tool Interlock Release
1. Enter the calculated temperatures and volumetric/normality assay concentrations into the wet bench Statistical Process Control (SPC) station.
2. If all acceptance criteria pass, clear the wet bench process interlock to allow wafer boat transfer into the SC-1 bath for the 10–15 minute cleaning cycle.

---

## 3. Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Limits | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Process Temperature** | $75.0^\circ\text{C}$ | $70.0^\circ\text{C} \le T \le 80.0^\circ\text{C}$ | Submerged multi-point Pt100 RTD array |
| **Spatial Thermal Uniformity ($\Delta T_{\text{spatial}}$)** | $\le 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ | Max across 5-point immersion profiling zone | Profiling RTD array (4 corners + center) |
| **Dilution Water Resistivity** | $18.2\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.0\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$ | In-line resistivity cell |
| **Nominal Chemical Formulation Ratio** | 5:1:1 ($\text{DIW} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) | $\pm 5.0\%$ active reagent concentration equivalent | Two-stage potentiometric endpoint titration |

---

## 4. Context References

- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - SC-1 composition: 5 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Ammonium Hydroxide ($29\%\;\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\;\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
  - Thermal range: $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$; clean duration: 10–15 minutes.
  - Intermediate rinse requirement: $18.2\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Pre-oxidation surface preparation criteria for growing dense gate oxide with $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\,\text{MV/cm}$ and low interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\,\text{cm}^{-2}\,\text{eV}^{-1}$).
  - Target physical gate oxide thickness: $3.5\text{ to }4.0\,\text{nm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Node architecture requirements defining gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ via dry thermal oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-WET-RCA1-MEGA-001`
**Title:** Megasonic Bath & Solvent Degreasing Protocol for Megasonic Immersion Cleaning and Cascade Dump Rinse Cycle Execution  
**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 / Gate Oxide Pre-Clean)  
**Classification:** Leaf SOP — Wet Chemical Processing  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP defines the operational protocol for organic film solubilization, acoustic boundary-layer micro-particle dislodgement, and quick-dump cascade rinsing during the pre-gate oxidation clean sequence. It prepares silicon wafer surfaces for subsequent high-integrity thermal dry gate oxide growth ($3.5\,\text{nm}\,\text{SiO}_2$).

---

### 2. Required Chemical Formulations & Tools
* **SC-1 (RCA-1) Bath:** Deionized (DI) Water : Ammonium Hydroxide ($29\%\,\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$) : Hydrogen Peroxide ($30\%\,\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) at a **$5:1:1$ volume ratio**.
* **Cascade Dump Rinse:** High-purity ultra-pure water (UPW) maintaining $\ge 18.2\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ resistivity.
* **Transducer System:** Submerged quartz/PTFE megasonic array ($0.8 - 1.0\,\text{MHz}$) mounted to the bath base.
* **Drying System:** Filtered ultra-high purity (UHP) $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry nozzle / surface tension dry station.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Sequence

#### Step 1: Bath Preparation & Chemical Ratio Check
1. Fill the quartz cleaning tank with $5\text{ parts}$ DI water ($\ge 18.2\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
2. Heat the DI water under recirculating flow until bath stabilization begins.
3. Meter in $1\text{ part}$ $29\%\,\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$, followed by $1\text{ part}$ $30\%\,\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$.
4. Stabilize the bath temperature to the target operating window of **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.

#### Step 2: Megasonic Bath Immersion & Degreasing
1. Transfer wafer cassettes into the tank via slow mechanical arm immersion to avoid splashing or acoustic bubble entrapment.
2. Activate the megasonic transducer array.
3. Process the wafer cassette under megasonic agitation in the heated SC-1 solution for **$10 - 15\text{ minutes}$** to simultaneously strip trace organic surface films, oxidize light trace metals, and drive acoustic cavitation boundary-layer particle removal.

#### Step 3: Cascade Quick-Dump Rinse (QDR)
1. Immediately transfer the wafer carrier into the cascade dump rinse tank to prevent chemical dry-in and bath redeposition.
2. Initiate cyclic dump rinses using continuous $18.2\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water flush.
3. Maintain cascade cycle for a duration of **$3\text{ minutes}$** until effluent resistivity recovers.

#### Step 4: Wafer Dry & Transfer
1. Transfer rinsed wafers into the spin-dry station or automated nitrogen drying booth.
2. Execute **Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry with high-purity gas** until wafers are fully dried and free of water streaks or meniscus residue.
3. Stage carriers for the subsequent dilute hydrofluoric (DHF 1:50) oxide strip.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Lower Limit | Upper Limit | Unit | Verification Tool / Sensor |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-1 Bath Operating Temperature** | $70.0$ | $80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | In-situ quartz-sheathed thermocouple / bath PID |
| **SC-1 Immersion & Agitation Time** | $10.0$ | $15.0$ | $\text{min}$ | Automated wet bench recipe execution timer |
| **Dump Rinse DI Water Resistivity** | $18.2$ | — | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line toroidal conductivity/resistivity sensor |
| **Cascade Dump Rinse Duration** | $3.0$ | — | $\text{min}$ | Wet bench PLC cycle counter |

---

### 5. Context Citations
* **Chemical Proportions & Bath Parameters:** Sourced from *"Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure"* ($5:1:1$ $\text{DI}\,\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{NH}_4\text{OH}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, $70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ process temperature, $10-15\text{ minutes}$ immersion time).
* **Rinse Criteria & Water Purity:** Sourced from *"Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure"* (Cascade dump rinse with $18.2\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water for $3\text{ minutes}$).
* **Drying Protocol:** Sourced from *"Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure"* ($\text{N}_2$ blow-dry with high-purity gas).

nodes.sop_content:
An industrial Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) tailored for the **PTFE Acid Immersion Cassette & Neutralizer** during Megasonic Immersion Cleaning and Cascade Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) execution within the 180nm DRAM pre-oxidation cleaning sequence:

```text
================================================================================
STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE: SOP-WET-180-044
PTFE ACID IMMERSION CASSETTE & NEUTRALIZER FOR MEGASONIC & CASCADE DUMP RINSE
DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Architecture & Integration (Thermal Processing Flow)
================================================================================
```

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure defines the pre-operational inspection, load handling, wet bench transfer, megasonic bath immersion, and cascade dump rinse cycle using dedicated virgin PTFE/PFA wafer cassettes. It establishes exhaust/drain neutralization protocols to prevent cross-contamination, acoustic shading, thermal-chemical degradation, and toxic acid/alkaline off-gassing prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: PTFE Immersion Cassette Pre-Inspection & Chemical Compatibility Check
1. Inspect the 150mm/200mm wafer cassette fabricated from virgin fluoropolymer (PTFE / molded PFA) for structural wear, chemical pitting, warping, or robotic pickup flange deformation.
2. Verify cassette teeth slot pitch (ensuring parallel clearance to minimize acoustic shadow during megasonic transducer coupling).
3. If switching from previous clean batches, pre-leach the cassette in hot UPW (>70°C) for 10 minutes to eliminate surface residual anions.

#### Step 2: Wafer Batch Loading & Robotic Arm Transfer
1. Transfer wafers (post-LOCOS / pre-gate oxidation bare silicon) into the PTFE cassette using automated PFA-tipped transfer wands or end-effectors.
2. Ensure active front surfaces face uniformly toward the megasonic transducer propagation vector.
3. Lock the cassette retainer bar to prevent wafer floatation induced by high megasonic acoustic streaming and fluid agitation.

#### Step 3: SC-1 Megasonic Immersion Cycle Execution
1. Transfer the cassette into the quartz/PTFE SC-1 tank containing 5:1:1 $\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{NH}_4\text{OH}\,(29\%) : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\,(30\%)$ stabilized at **70°C – 80°C**.
2. Submerge the cassette to the calibrated immersion depth ($Z$-axis travel lock).
3. Engage the 800 kHz – 1.0 MHz megasonic bottom transducer array for **10 to 15 minutes** to solubilize organic surface films and release sub-micron particulates via acoustic cavitation streaming.

#### Step 4: Rapid Transfer to Cascade Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) Tank
1. Disengage megasonics and lift the PTFE cassette from the chemical tank at a controlled extraction rate ($\le 5\text{ mm/s}$) to minimize liquid drag-out.
2. Perform overhead transfer to the Cascade Dump Rinse tank within $< 5\text{ seconds}$ to prevent chemical dry-spots on hydrophobic/hydrophilic boundary areas.
3. Submerge cassette into Ultra-Pure Water (UPW). Trigger high-flow bottom/top spray nozzles and execute **minimum 3 dump-fill cycles** over **3 minutes** using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water.

#### Step 5: Effluent Drain Neutralization & Exhaust Scrubbing
1. Route concentrated drag-out and dump-drain overflow to the automated Acid-Waste Neutralization (AWN) system.
2. For SC-1 alkaline streams ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}/\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$), ensure neutralizer inline dosing injects dilute neutralizing agents to target effluent discharge $\text{pH}$ within $6.5 – 8.5$.
3. For downstream HF dip (1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) and SC-2 acid steps ($6:1:1\ \text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$), route fluorine/chlorine streams to fluoride precipitation / acid drain scrubbers, ensuring lip exhaust differential velocity is $\ge 0.5\text{ m/s}$.
4. Finish wafer processing with high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry / spin rinse dry.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SC-1 Bath Operating Temperature** | **$70.0 - 80.0$** | **°C** | Inline calibrated PFA-sheathed RTD thermocouple |
| **Dump Rinse Deionized Water Resistivity** | **$\ge 18.2$** | **$\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** | Inline conductivity/resistivity sensor at QDR drain weir |
| **SC-1 Immersion Bath Duration** | **$10 - 15$** | **$\text{min}$** | Wet bench PLC process execution timer |
| **Cascade Dump Rinse Cycle Duration** | **$3.0$** | **$\text{min}$** | Automated dump cycle counter / PLC sequence timer |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations
* **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - *Chemical Bath Composition & Temp:* RCA-1 (SC-1) with 5 parts $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$ (29%), 1 part $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ (30%) heated to **70°C–80°C** for **10–15 minutes** to solubilize organic surface films and light trace metals.
  - *Cascade Dump Rinse Parameters:* Intermediate dump rinse using **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** deionized water for **3 minutes**.
  - *Subsequent Steps:* 1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$ dip for 15–30 s, RCA-2 (6:1:1 $\text{H}_2\text{O}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ at 70°C–80°C for 10 min), and final filtered $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Module:** Metrology / Surface Science  
**Task Title:** Pre-Oxidation Particle Scanning and Surface Microroughness Metrology Verification  
**Context & Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Architecture & Integration > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Thermal Oxidation > SC-1 Alkaline Organic and Particle Removal Bath Execution > Pre-Oxidation Particle Scanning and Surface Microroughness Metrology Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    SC-1 Post-Clean     │
│      Wafer Unload      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Particle Scanning by  │
│    Darkfield Laser     │
│       Scattering       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     AFM 3D Surface     │
│     Microroughness     │
│       Metrology        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│     Pre-Oxidation      │
│  Particle & Roughness  │
│          Gate          │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             ├──────────────────────────────╮Fail
         Pass│                              │
             ▼                              ▼
┌────────────────────────┐     ┌────────────────────────┐
│  Proceed to 850C Dry   │     │  Trigger Cascade Dump  │
│   O2 Oxidation t_ox    │     │  Rinse / SC-1 Rework   │
│         3.5nm          │     │                        │
└────────────────────────┘     └────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Scan Environmental & Tool Qualification**:
   - Ensure the metrology FOUP transfer chamber and stage are maintained at ISO Class 1 cleanroom environment.
   - Verify unpatterned surface inspection laser scanner (Darkfield Laser Scattering) calibration using certified polystyrene latex (PSL) sphere standards.

2. **Automated Wafer Handling & Darkfield Particle Inspection**:
   - Transfer the wafer directly from the SC-1 cascade dump rinse / Marangoni dryer stage.
   - Execute darkfield laser scattering surface inspection over the active 200 mm P-type (100) Si wafer area with a 3 mm edge exclusion.
   - Scan for sub-micron defect light scattering (LSE) bins: count total particle density down to the critical defect threshold ($\ge 0.16\ \mu\text{m}$ / sub-micron particle regime).

3. **Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) Surface Microroughness Metrology**:
   - Load wafer into automated tapping-mode AFM equipped with high-aspect-ratio ultra-sharp silicon tips (tip radius $\le 10\text{ nm}$).
   - Perform 3D topographical scans at 5 designated sites across the wafer (Center, North, South, East, West at 70% radius).
   - Scan area: $1.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ and $2.0\ \mu\text{m} \times 2.0\ \mu\text{m}$ with 512 $\times$ 512 lines at a scan frequency of $0.5\text{–}1.0\text{ Hz}$.
   - Extract Root-Mean-Square microroughness ($R_q$ / RMS) and average surface roughness ($R_a$). Confirm controlled base etching from SC-1 did not exceed the nominal ~0.5 nm removal budget or induce micro-pitting.

4. **Surface Cleanliness & Dewetting Boundary Check**:
   - Confirm pre-furnace surface integrity: Ensure no chemical cross-contamination, organic film haze, or bath drag-out remains following the SC-1 Megasonic clean and dump rinse.
   - Wafer must proceed to the pre-furnace thermal queue within a strict queue time ($\le 2\text{ hours}$) to prevent airborne hydrocarbon recontamination.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Upper Limit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sub-micron Particle Density** ($\ge 0.16\ \mu\text{m}$) | $< 0.05\text{ particles/cm}^2$ | $\le 15\text{ defects / 200 mm wafer}$ | Automated Darkfield Laser Particle Scanner |
| **Surface Microroughness ($R_q$ / RMS)** | $0.10\text{ nm}$ | $\le 0.15\text{ nm}$ | High-Resolution Tapping-Mode AFM ($1 \times 1\ \mu\text{m}$) |
| **SC-1 Controlled Etch Removal** | $0.50\text{ nm}$ | $\le 0.60\text{ nm}$ cumulative | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / AFM Step Profiling |
| **Post-Rinse Bath Resistivity (Cleanliness Gate)** | $> 16.0\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW baseline | Inline Resistivity Sensor (Cascade Dump Rinse) |

---

### 3. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

- **Source: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**:
  - *Parameters applied*: 1 MHz megasonic agitation, alkaline base micro-etching depth of silicon at ~0.5 nm, zeta potential particle repulsion mechanism, and cascade dump rinse resistivity requirement ($> 16\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ with $18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ UPW).
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Oxidation Kinetic Coefficients & Gate Oxide Thickness**:
  - *Parameters applied*: P-type (100) Si orientation; establishes the physical gate dielectric target of $t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ (grown at $850^\circ\text{C}$ in dry $\text{O}_2$), for which sub-0.15 nm RMS surface microroughness is required to prevent localized electric-field crowding.
- **Source: Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
  - *Parameters applied*: Directly affects interface trap density ($D_{it}$) and physical accumulation capacitance saturation ($C_{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_{ox} \varepsilon_0 \text{Area}}{t_{ox}}$) with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Full-Wafer Dark-Field Defect Inspection Post-SC-1 Clean

**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) > SC-1 Alkaline Organic and Particle Removal Bath Execution > Pre-Oxidation Particle Scanning and Surface Microroughness Metrology Verification > Full-Wafer Dark-Field Defect Inspection Post-SC-1 Clean  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm node)  
**Action Type:** Make (Metrology Inspection Execution)

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Load 200mm Wafer Cassette into Dark-Field Laser Scanner"] --> B["Align Wafer Notch & Scan Surface with Grazing Laser (P/S Polarized)"]
    B --> C["Collect & Bin Rayleigh Scatter Signals by Equivalent PSL Size"]
    C --> D["Map Spatial Defect Coordinates & Cluster Density"]
    D --> E{"Disposition Check: Particle Thresholds & Gate Critical Dimensions"}
    E -- Pass --> F["Proceed to Pre-Gate SC-2 / DHF Surface Conditioning"]
    E -- Fail --> G["Trigger Hold: Route to SC-1 Megasonic Reclean Bath"]
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Tool Setup & Recipe Selection:**
   - Verify dark-field laser surface inspection system (UV/visible solid-state laser, grazing incidence) is calibrated against certified Polystyrene Latex (PSL) sphere calibration standards.
   - Load recipe `DF_PRE_OX_180NM_POST_SC1` configured for bare/chemical-oxide silicon surface scan with 3 mm edge exclusion.

2. **Wafer Transfer & Notch Alignment:**
   - Robotic end-effector transfers 200 mm silicon wafer from the post-SC-1 spin-rinse-dry (SRD) cassette to the vacuum chuck.
   - Perform automated optical notch alignment to establish wafer coordinate baseline $(x, y) = (0, 0)$.

3. **Full-Wafer Laser Dark-Field Surface Scanning:**
   - Spin and translate the chuck under the dark-field optical head.
   - Illuminate wafer surface using high-angle/grazing-incidence laser beams; collect scattered light via wide-angle and narrow-angle photomultiplier tube (PMT) detectors.
   - Bin scattered Rayleigh signals into localized light scatterer (LLS) channels corresponding to latex sphere equivalent diameter sizes ($> 90\text{ nm}$, $> 180\text{ nm}$, and $> 360\text{ nm}$).

4. **Coordinate Defect Mapping & Spatial Analysis:**
   - Automatically compile full-wafer coordinate map of defect signatures (particles, pits, drying residues, micro-streaks).
   - Evaluate cluster count across active memory array regions (distinguishing periphery from 1T1C memory array fields).

5. **Defect Disposition & Gating:**
   - Compare total defect adder count and size bins against pre-oxidation gate dielectric threshold limits.
   - If acceptance criteria pass, discharge wafer to the cassette to proceed to SC-2 acid clean and pre-gate DHF dip prior to 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.
   - If out-of-spec, flag wafer status as `HOLD_SC1_REWORK` and send notification for bath megasonic check and re-cleaning.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Defect Sensitivity Cutoff ($D_{crit}$)** | $\le 90$ (half of min channel length $L = 180$) | $\text{nm}$ (PSL equivalent) | Calibrated Dark-Field PMT Detector |
| **Critical Defect Density ($D_{size} \ge 180\text{ nm}$)** | $\le 0.05$ | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ ($\le 15$ defects/200mm wafer) | Automated Dark-Field Full-Wafer Particle Counter |
| **Large Killer Particle Count ($D_{size} \ge 360\text{ nm}$)** | $\le 3$ (scaled to bitline/wordline pitch) | $\text{count/wafer}$ (absolute) | Grazing-Incidence Laser Scatter Defect Map |
| **Wafer Edge Exclusion Margin** | $3.0 \pm 0.5$ | $\text{mm}$ | Automated Edge Detection Sensor |

---

## 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Transistor Geometry & Defect Scaling:** Access transistor channel length is $L = 180\text{ nm}$ with active width $W = 220\text{ nm}$; bitline and wordline pitch is $360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ in a 1T1C stacked capacitor architecture (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*; *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*). Inspection bins and sensitivity cutoffs are pinned to channel length ($180\text{ nm}$) and interconnect pitch ($360\text{ nm}$) to mitigate fatal shorting and gate oxide pinhole defects.
- **Pre-Oxidation Cleanliness Requirements:** Gate dielectric physical thickness is $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ grown by dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ requiring strict interface integrity ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$ and breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) (*Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*; *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*). Residual SC-1 particulate contamination must be verified below critical killer thresholds prior to oxide growth.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dilute HF Oxide Strip and SC-2 Heavy Metal Decontamination Sequence

**Process Domain**: Wet Chemistry & Surface Preparation  
**Parent Integration**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip — 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm)  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Pre-Oxidation Wet    │
│      Bench Ready       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 1: Dilute HF    │
│    Dip 50:1 / 100:1    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 2: Quick Dump   │
│   Rinse QDR DI Water   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 3: SC-2 Bath    │
│    HCl:H2O2:H2O at     │
│         75-80C         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Step 4: Final      │
│   Overflow Rinse DI    │
│         Water          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Step 5: Surface     │
│  Surface Conditioning  │
│         Check          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Dry Thermal       │
│  Oxidation: 850C-900C  │
│     for 3.5nm SiO2     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Pre-Inspection & Chemical Tank Setup**:
   - Verify wet bench tank temperatures and circulation flow rates.
   - Prepare DHF tank with ultra-pure dilute hydrofluoric acid ($50:1$ to $100:1$ $\text{DI H}_2\text{O}:\text{HF}$, $0.5\%-1.0\%\text{ HF}$ by volume) at ambient temperature ($21^\circ\text{C} \pm 1^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Prepare Standard Clean 2 (SC-2 / RCA Clean Part 2) tank with $\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2:\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$ mixture heated to $75^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Native Oxide Strip (Dilute HF Dip)**:
   - Submerge the wafer cassette into the DHF bath for $60\text{ s}$ to $90\text{ s}$ to completely strip native and chemical surface oxide layers.
   - Etch reaction strips the chemical oxide down to bare single-crystal silicon substrate, forming a hydrogen-terminated, hydrophobic silicon surface.

3. **Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)**:
   - Transfer cassette immediately (< 5 seconds transit) to the QDR tank.
   - Execute 4 dump-and-fill cycles using high-purity deionized water ($\text{resistivity} \ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) to stop acid carryover.

4. **Heavy Metal Decontamination (SC-2 Bath)**:
   - Immersion in the SC-2 tank ($\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2:\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$ at $75^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$) for $10\text{ minutes}$.
   - Solubilize and complex metallic contaminants (alkali, iron, copper, and heavy metals) into soluble metal chlorides, simultaneously passivating the silicon with a controlled, pristine chemical oxide protective layer.

5. **Final Overflow Rinse & Surface Dry**:
   - Transfer to cascade overflow DI rinse tank; rinse until tank discharge effluent achieves resistivity $> 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
   - Dry wafers using Surface Tension gradient / Marangoni or Isopropanol (IPA) vapor dry to prevent watermarks and particle redeposition.
   - Stage directly into clean dry $\text{N}_2$ pod for transfer to the quartz tube furnace within a maximum queue time ($Q\text{-time} < 2\text{ hours}$).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                 Acceptance & Thermal Process Criteria  
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░                                       │
D_it Threshold┤░                                       │
              │▓                                       │
  Physical Tox┤▓                                       │
Oxidation Temp┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
   E_bd Target┤█                                       │
              │█                                       │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
               0        225       450      675      900 
```

1. **Downstream Gate Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)**:
   - **Target**: $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$
   - **Unit**: $\text{MV/cm}$
   - *Source Verification*: Verified literature context (*Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*).

2. **Downstream Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)**:
   - **Target**: $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$
   - **Unit**: $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$
   - *Source Verification*: Verified literature context (*Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*).

3. **Subsequent Dry Thermal Oxidation Process Temperature**:
   - **Target**: $850^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }900^\circ\text{C}$ (dry oxidation regime in pure dry $\text{O}_2$)
   - **Unit**: $^\circ\text{C}$
   - *Source Verification*: Verified literature context (*Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* and *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*).

4. **Target Grown Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)**:
   - **Target**: $3.5\text{ nm}$ (acceptable range $3.5\text{ nm to }4.0\text{ nm}$)
   - **Unit**: $\text{nm}$
   - *Source Verification*: Verified literature context (*Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace* and *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).

---

### Verified Context Citations
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Citations for dry oxidation temperature ($900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ / dry $\text{O}_2$), high-dielectric breakdown target ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$), minimal interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$), and physical thickness target ($3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Citations for gate dielectric thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Integration context for 180nm access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-FAB-WET-180-DHF01`  
**Title:** Precision Tooling & Fixturing for Dilute HF Native Oxide Strip and Hydrophobic Surface Transition Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm SiO₂) > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > Dilute HF Oxide Strip and SC-2 Heavy Metal Decontamination Sequence > Dilute HF Native Oxide Strip and Hydrophobic Surface Transition Verification > **Precision Tooling & Fixturing [Mechanical Assembly]**  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This procedure specifies the mechanical assembly, setup, alignment, and execution parameters for the precision fluoropolymer (PTFE/PFA) wafer carrier fixture used during the pre-gate oxidation dilute hydrofluoric acid (DHF/BOE) native oxide strip. It provides direct verification protocols for the chemical hydrophobic transition (H-passivated bare silicon) prior to 850°C–900°C dry gate thermal oxidation (3.5 nm SiO₂ target).

---

### 2. Required Tooling, Fixtures & Safety Equipment
* **Precision Chemical Fixturing:** CNC-machined PFA/PTFE immersion cassette with 25-wafer capacity, slot pitch matching standard 180nm front-end handling, and minimal contact edge-exclusion grips (< 3.0 mm).
* **Wet Bench Immersion Tank:** Recirculating, filtered bath with temperature control maintained at **25°C**.
* **Chemical Safety & First Aid:**
  * Hydrofluoric acid PPE: Acid-resistant neoprene/nitrile double gloves, face shield, and chemical apron.
  * **First Aid Requirement:** Calcium gluconate gel must be present and verified at the bench station at all times (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
* **Process Chemicals:**
  * BOE 6:1 formulation: 6 parts 40% NH₄F (Ammonium Fluoride) to 1 part 49% HF (Hydrofluoric Acid) (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
  * Wetting surfactant: 0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad added to eliminate micro-trench bubble entrapment (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
* **Inspection & Metrology:** Deionized water (DIW) cascade overflow rinse tank, optical contact-angle goniometer / optical beading inspection station, and clean dry N₂ blow gun.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Step 1: PFA/PTFE Fixture Inspection & Bath Prep (25°C)"] --> B["Step 2: Wafer Loading into Precision Edge-Grip Carrier"]
    B --> C["Step 3: Controlled Immersion & Native Oxide Etch (100 nm/min baseline)"]
    C --> D["Step 4: Cascade DI Water Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)"]
    D --> E["Step 5: Surface Dewetting / Hydrophobic Beading Verification"]
    E --> F["Step 6: Controlled N2 Spin/Dry & Transfer to 850°C-900°C Furnace"]
```

#### Step 1: Fixture Inspection and Bath Setup
1. Inspect the PFA/PTFE immersion carrier for micro-cracks, mechanical distortion, or particulate buildup. Verify slot perpendicularity and latching mechanism.
2. Confirm the BOE / Dilute HF bath temperature stabilizes at **25°C** (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).
3. Verify bath surfactant addition (0.1% Triton X-100 or Fluorad) to ensure complete wetting without bubble entrapment.
4. Verify the physical presence of unexpired calcium gluconate gel at the wet bench operator console.

#### Step 2: Wafer Loading and Edge-Exclusion Alignment
1. Load 180nm DRAM patterned/test wafers into the PTFE cassette with active device surfaces facing the recirculating laminar chemical flow.
2. Ensure edge-gripping contact is restricted strictly to the outer perimeter exclusion zone (< 3.0 mm) to protect active memory cell access regions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

#### Step 3: Controlled Chemical Immersion & Etch Execution
1. Using the automated pneumatic hoist fixture, lower the carrier cassette into the 25°C BOE/DHF bath at a controlled immersion rate of 15–20 mm/s.
2. Agitate vertically with a travel stroke of $\pm 5\text{ mm}$ at 0.5 Hz to maintain uniform etchant replenishment across the wafer array.
3. Maintain etch contact time tailored to clear native oxide (~1.5–2.0 nm) and residual interface oxide based on the 25°C BOE etch rate baseline of **100 nm/minute (1000 Å/min)** (*Source: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)*).

#### Step 4: Rapid Transfer and DI Water Quench
1. Elevate the fixture smoothly from the etch bath and transfer within < 5 seconds to the Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) / Cascade DI water overflow tank.
2. Execute 4 QDR cycles followed by continuous cascade rinse until bath resistivity reaches $\ge 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

#### Step 5: Hydrophobic Surface Transition Verification
1. Inspect the silicon surface upon carrier withdrawal from the final rinse:
   * **Hydrophilic State (Incomplete Etch / Oxide Present):** Continuous, unbroken liquid water sheet clinging to the wafer face.
   * **Hydrophobic State (Complete Oxide Strip / H-Terminated Si):** Complete, spontaneous liquid dewetting; DI water immediately beads up into discrete droplets and rolls off the active Si surface with zero wetting sheath.
2. For analytical qualification lots, transfer coupon/monitor wafer to the goniometer and record DI water contact angle (target $> 75^\circ$).

#### Step 6: Fixture Spin-Drying & Furnace Staging
1. Transfer the carrier to the automated wafer spin-rinse dryer (SRD) or N₂ marangoni drying station.
2. Immediately seal the dried wafers in an ultra-pure N₂ purged FOUP/pod to prevent room-air native re-oxidation.
3. Transfer the lot to the thermal oxidation queue for immediate 850°C–900°C dry gate oxide growth to deposit the nominal 3.5 nm SiO₂ layer (*Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance | Source Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **BOE / DHF Bath Temperature** | $25\text{ °C}$ | $\pm 0.5\text{ °C}$ | *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* |
| **Thermally Grown SiO₂ Reference Etch Rate** | $100\text{ nm/min}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$) | $\pm 5\text{ nm/min}$ | *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* |
| **Post-Strip Thermal Gate Oxide Physical Thickness** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |
| **Target Dry Gate Oxidation Processing Temp** | $850\text{ °C to } 900\text{ °C}$ | $\pm 2\text{ °C}$ | *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
* **Etch Rates, Wetting Agent, and HF Safety:** Sourced directly from *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* (BOE 6:1 composition, 100 nm/min etch rate at 25°C, 0.1% Triton X-100 / Fluorad surfactant, and mandatory calcium gluconate gel).
* **Thermal Gate Dielectric Target & Temperature:** Sourced directly from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (Gate dielectric physical thickness of ~3.5 nm SiO₂, grown via dry oxidation at 850°C–900°C).
* **Active Cell Geometry & Alignment Integrity:** Sourced from *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* (Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Process Parameter Benchmarking for Dilute HF Native Oxide Strip and Hydrophobic Surface Transition Verification  
**Module:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) — Wet Chemistry / Surface Conditioning  
**Target Node / Generation:** 180nm (Gen 2 µm)  
**Downstream Dependency:** 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm to 4.0 nm at 850°C–900°C)

---

### Process Flow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Pre-Clean Inspection  │
│      & Bath Prep       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  DHF Oxide Strip Dip   │
│        at 25 C         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   QDR DI Water Rinse   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Surface Dewet &     │
│  Contact Angle Check   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Surface Conditioning  │
│   for Gate Oxidation   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Safety Protocol & PPE Verification**
   - Confirm dedicated HF personal protective equipment (heavy neoprene gloves, face shield, chemical apron) is donned.
   - Verify unexpired calcium gluconate gel is stationed directly adjacent to the wet bench.
   - Ensure the wet bench exhaust face velocity is operational and monitored.

2. **Chemical Bath Benchmarking & Thermal Stabilization**
   - Prepare the dilute HF / buffered oxide etch station maintained strictly at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ to lock thermal kinetic drift.
   - Add $0.1\%$ surfactant wetting agent (e.g., Triton X-100 or Fluorad) to ensure complete wetting without bubble entrapment across dense 180nm layout micro-trenches (channel width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$).

3. **Immersion Etch & Native Oxide Strip**
   - Immerse 180nm wafer lot into the dilute HF bath with continuous nitrogen agitation to eliminate mass-transport boundary layer starvation.
   - Time the dip based on the benchmarked thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ etch rate baseline ($\approx 100\text{ nm/min}$ / $1000\text{ \AA/min}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$) to strip surface native oxide ($1.0\text{--}1.5\text{ nm}$) with controlled $20\text{--}30\%$ overetch, avoiding excessive pitting of the single-crystal silicon substrate.

4. **Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)**
   - Transfer wafer carrier within $\le 5\text{ seconds}$ to the Quick Dump Rinse tank filled with high-purity deionized (DI) water ($> 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
   - Execute 4 dump-and-fill cycles to arrest etching and completely remove fluoride complexes.

5. **Hydrophobic Surface Transition Verification**
   - Perform in-line visual and automated dewetting inspection upon wafer withdrawal from DI water:
     - Bare hydrophilic silicon ($\text{SiO}_2$-terminated) exhibits complete water film sheeting.
     - Fully stripped silicon is hydrogen-terminated ($\text{Si-H}$ passivation) and exhibits instantaneous water roll-off / dewetting (hydrophobic behavior with DI water contact angle $\ge 70^\circ$).
   - Confirm complete hydrophobic transition across the entire active array ($W = 220\text{ nm}$, $L = 180\text{ nm}$ access transistor regions).

6. **Post-Strip Decontamination Queue**
   - Route immediately to SC-2 heavy metal decontamination clean and subsequent dry oxidation furnace queue ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$, target thickness $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$) to prevent uncontrolled ambient native oxide regrowth.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Temperature** | $25.0 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Immersion thermocouple / RTD sensor |
| **Baseline Thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ Etch Rate** | $\approx 100$ ($\approx 1000$) | $\text{nm/min}$ ($\text{\AA/min}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry on monitor wafer |
| **Wetting Agent Concentration** | $0.1$ | $\% \text{ (vol)}$ | Precision metered chemical dosing |
| **Surface Dewet Contact Angle** | $\ge 70$ (Hydrophobic) | $\text{degrees } (^\circ)$ | Automated Optical Goniometer / Dewet sensor |
| **Post-Strip Target Dielectric Thickness** | $3.5 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-situ / Ex-situ Ellipsometer (post-dry ox) |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Etch Chemistry, Wetting Agent, and Safety:** *Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE)* — Etch rate of thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$ is approximately $100\text{ nm/minute}$ ($1000\text{ \AA/min}$). Addition of $0.1\%$ wetting agent (Triton X-100 / Fluorad) eliminates micro-trench bubble entrapment. Safety requirement mandates calcium gluconate gel on site at all times.
- **Topological Layout Constraints:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench* — Unit cell access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ in $8F^2 / 6F^2$ folded bitline layout.
- **Gate Dielectric Target:** *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace* — Dry oxidation regime ($900^\circ\text{C}\text{--}1000^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$) with target thickness for 180nm gate dielectric specified at $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ to achieve $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$.
citations: Silicon Dioxide Etching with Buffered Oxide Etch (BOE) (Semiconductor Chemical Processing Handbook)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

## SC-2 Acidic Peroxide Immersion for Alkali and Heavy Metal Desorption

**Context Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm SiO₂) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > Dilute HF Oxide Strip and SC-2 Heavy Metal Decontamination Sequence > **SC-2 Acidic Peroxide Immersion for Alkali and Heavy Metal Desorption**

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Wafers from Dilute HF Native Oxide Strip (Hydrophobic)"] --> B["SC-2 Bath Immersion (6:1:1 UPW:HCl:H₂O₂)"]
    B --> C["Desorption & Chelation Reaction (75°C ± 2°C, 10 min)"]
    C --> D["Cascade Dump / Overflow Rinse (18.2 MΩ·cm UPW)"]
    D --> E["Surface Dry (Filtered N₂ Marangoni or IPA Vapor)"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Bath Preparation & Chemical Charging**:
   - In a quartz or fluoropolymer immersion tank, dispense Ultra-Pure Water (UPW), 37% Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$), and 30% Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$) in a strict volume ratio of **$6 : 1 : 1$** ($\text{UPW} : \text{HCl} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
   - Heat the mixture to a controlled target temperature of **$75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$** (operating envelope $70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$).

2. **Wafer Transfer & Chemical Immersion**:
   - Transfer wafer cassettes directly from the post-DHF rinse/dewet stage into the heated SC-2 solution.
   - Maintain full immersion for exactly **$10\text{ minutes}$**.
   - *Reaction Mechanism*: The acidic oxidative solution solubilizes and complexes alkali cations ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and transition/heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$, $\text{Au}$) into soluble coordination chloride complexes, preventing high-temperature cross-contamination in subsequent thermal oxidation tubes.

3. **Cascade Dump / Overflow Rinse**:
   - Transfer cassette to the quick-dump overflow rinse tank using high-purity deionized water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
   - Run cascade dump/overflow rinse until the effluent resistivity stabilizes at $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

4. **Surface Drying**:
   - Transfer wafers immediately to the drying station.
   - Execute surface dry using filtered high-purity $\text{N}_2$ Marangoni drying or Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) vapor drying to prevent water marks and particle redeposition.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bath Volumetric Ratio** ($\text{UPW} : \text{HCl}\,[37\%] : \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\,[30\%]$) | $6 : 1 : 1$ | $\pm 5\%$ volumetric dosing | Ratio |
| **Bath Operating Temperature** | $75$ | $\pm 2$ (Envelope: $70\text{--}80$) | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Immersion Residence Time** | $10$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $\text{min}$ |
| **Final Rinse Effluent Resistivity** | $18.2$ | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources

- **RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**:
  - *Chemistry*: $6\text{ parts UPW} : 1\text{ part } 37\%\text{ HCl} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$.
  - *Bath Temperature*: $75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Immersion Time*: $10\text{ minutes}$.
  - *Mechanism & Cleanliness*: Soluble coordination complex formation with alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and transition metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$, $\text{Au}$); rinse to $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$, followed by filtered $\text{N}_2$ Marangoni / IPA vapor drying.
- **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - Confirms RCA-2 chemical formulation ($6 : 1 : 1$), operating temperature range ($70^\circ\text{C}\text{--}80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ minutes}$), targeted elimination of $\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+, \text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$, and high-purity $\text{N}_2$ dry.

**Context Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) > Dilute HF Oxide Strip and SC-2 Heavy Metal Decontamination Sequence > SC-2 Acidic Peroxide Immersion for Alkali and Heavy Metal Desorption > Precision Tooling & Fixturing  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)  
**Action Type**: Make / Mechanical Assembly & Fixturing

### Process Workflow

```text

│  High-Purity N2 Dry   │
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Precision Fixture & Cassette Preparation**:
   - Inspect and clean the high-purity Perfluoroalkoxy (PFA) / virgin PTFE wafer carrier cassette and immersion arm fixturing. Ensure zero trace metallic or halogenated contamination.
   - Verify carrier teeth alignment, pocket slot pitch, and clamping fixtures under cleanroom laminar flow hood (Class 1 / ISO 3).

2. **Cassette Loading & Wafer Orientation**:
   - Transfer DHF-treated wafers (with native oxide stripped, hydrophobic surface state) into the dedicated acid-resistant PFA immersion cassette.
   - Maintain precise, parallel edge-grip alignment to eliminate surface abrasion and mechanical stress on active DRAM cell access transistor regions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

3. **SC-2 Acidic Peroxide Solution Make-up & Verification**:
   - Formulate the SC-2 chemical bath at a volume ratio of **6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ : 1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% $\text{HCl}$) : 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$)**.
   - Ensure the chemical bath heating controller ramps and stabilizes the solution between **70°C and 80°C**.

4. **Motorized Fixture Immersion & Dwell**:
   - Engage the robotic precision vertical drive to submerge the fixtured cassette smoothly into the heated SC-2 bath at a controlled descent rate.
   - Maintain full immersion for precisely **10 minutes** to desorb alkali mobile ionic contaminants ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and solubilize heavy transition metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$), protecting pre-oxidation interfaces prior to dry gate oxide growth (target $3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C).

5. **Cassette Extraction, Dump Rinse & High-Purity $\text{N}_2$ Drying**:
   - Actuate the fixtured hoist arm to retract the wafer carrier vertically at uniform velocity to minimize fluid drag and surface micro-droplet pinning.
   - Transfer directly to the quick-dump rinse (QDR) station using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water, followed by non-contact spin/blow drying using high-purity pressurized nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$).

---

| **SC-2 Chemical Immersion Duration** | `10.0` | $\pm 0.5$ ($9.5 \text{ to } 10.5$) | min |
| **SC-2 Volumetric Mixture Ratio ($\text{DI }\text{H}_2\text{O} : \text{HCl}_{37\%} : \text{H}_2\text{O}_{2, 30\%}$)** | `6 : 1 : 1` | $\pm 5\%$ per aliquot | volumetric ratio |
| **Rinse Deionized Water Resistivity** | `18.2` | $\ge 18.0$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ |

---

- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - *RCA-2 (SC-2) Bath Composition*: 6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid (37% $\text{HCl}$), 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide (30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$).
  - *Thermal & Dwell Specifications*: Heated to 70°C–80°C for 10 minutes.
  - *Contaminant Desorption Targets*: Desorption of alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$).
  - *Rinse & Drying Requirements*: Intermediate/post dump rinse using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ deionized water; high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering** & **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology**:

2. **SC-2 Chemical Formulation & Dispense:**

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Pre-Immersion Verification**:
   - Verify incoming wafers completed DHF dip (1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) and intermediate dump rinse.
   - Confirm SC-2 bath chemical formulation: strictly $6\text{ parts } \text{DI }\text{H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part } \text{HCl (37%)} : 1\text{ part } \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\text{ (30%)}$.
   - Ensure immersion bath temperature controller reads within $70^\circ\text{C}$ to $80^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **SC-2 Acidic Peroxide Immersion**:
   - Immerse wafer carrier fully into the SC-2 quartz tank for exactly $10\text{ minutes}$ under continuous recirculation and filtration.
   - Desorb alkali ionic contaminants ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and dissolve heavy transition metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$) via chloride-metal complexation and peroxide passivation.

3. **Post-Clean Deionized Rinse**:
   - Transfer carrier immediately via automated transfer arm into the Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) / overflow cascade tank.
   - Rinse thoroughly with high-purity deionized water until effluent resistivity reaches $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ (minimum 3 dump cycles).

4. **Nitrogen Drying**:
   - Transfer wafers into the spin-rinse dryer (SRD) or isopropyl alcohol (IPA) / Marangoni drying unit using high-purity filtered $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.

5. **Analytical Metrology Sampling & Lot Disposition**:

1. **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
   - Bath chemistry: $6\text{ parts } \text{DI }\text{H}_2\text{O} : 1\text{ part } \text{HCl (37%)} : 1\text{ part } \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\text{ (30%)}$.
   - Process parameters: $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ minutes}$.
   - Decontamination targets: Alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and heavy metals ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$).
   - DI water rinse benchmark: $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ intermediate/final rinse with high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.
2. **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
   - Dry oxidation produces dense, high-dielectric breakdown gate oxide ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-FAB-WET-180-044`
**Title:** High-Purity Marangoni/N2 Dry and Post-Clean Surface Contamination Metrology  
**Context / Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > Dilute HF Strip & SC-2 Metal Decontamination Sequence > High-Purity Marangoni/N2 Dry and Surface Metrology  
**Technology Node:** Gen 1 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Buy (Standard Commercial Equipment)

---

### 1. Process Flow & Step-by-Step Procedure

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Substrate Inflow from SC-2 Decontamination"] --> B["Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) Overflow Dump Rinse"]
    B --> C["Marangoni IPA / N2 Vapor Drying"]
    C --> D["Laser Surface Particle Scanning (LSIS Metrology)"]
    D --> E["TXRF Trace Metal Metrology"]
    E --> F["Clean Wafer Delivery to Gate Oxidation Furnace"]
```

#### Step 1: Final Ultra-Pure Water (UPW) Dump & Overflow Rinse
1. Transfer wafer lot directly from the SC-2 chemical bath to the final quick-dump/overflow rinse vessel.
2. Maintain continuous flow of ultra-pure water (UPW) with inline resistivity monitoring.
3. Rinse until effluent bath resistivity reaches $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$ to ensure complete neutralization and stripping of residual $\text{HCl}/\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ ionic species.

#### Step 2: High-Purity Marangoni IPA / Heated $N_2$ Drying
1. Slowly withdraw the wafer cassette across the nitrogen-diluted isopropyl alcohol (IPA) vapor interface at a steady pull rate ($1.0 - 2.0\text{ mm/s}$).
2. The surface tension gradient (Marangoni effect) created between the pure water film and the IPA-enriched meniscus pulls liquid off the silicon surface without droplet pin-off or evaporation watermarks.
3. Follow with filtered, heated ultra-high purity (UHP) $\text{N}_2$ purge ($0.05\,\mu\text{m}$ filtered, purity $\ge 99.9999\%$, $50 - 65^\circ\text{C}$) to eliminate trace organic moisture.

#### Step 3: Post-Clean Particle Inspection Metrology (Laser Scattering)
1. Transfer cassette directly to the automated Laser Surface Particle Scanner (e.g., KLA/Tencor Surfscan class).
2. Measure light point defects (LPD) across the full wafer aperture with an edge exclusion of $3\text{ mm}$.
3. Inspect defect sizes down to the critical defect threshold for the 180nm node ($\ge 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ / $180\text{ nm}$).

#### Step 4: Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Metal Inspection
1. Sample pilot wafers from the batch to quantify residual transition and heavy metal contamination ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}, \text{Au}$) and mobile alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$).
2. Confirm metals are below the critical furnace threshold to prevent degradation of the subsequent 3.5 nm thermal gate oxide.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Effluent Rinse Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | Inline UPW Resistivity Sensor ($25^\circ\text{C}$) |
| **Surface Particle Adders** | $\le 10\text{ particles/wafer}$ ($\ge 180\text{ nm}$ size) | Laser Surface Particle Scanner (LPD Metrology) |
| **Trace Transition Metal Residue ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$)** | $< 5 \times 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ | Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) |
| **Target Pre-Oxidation Dielectric Film Thickness** | $0.0\text{ nm}$ Native Oxide (Pre-Gate Ox baseline for 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer |

---

### 3. Sourced Context Citations
* **RCA-2 / SC-2 Metal Desorption & Final Rinse / Dry:** Bath chemistry ($6:1:1$ $\text{UPW}:\text{HCl}:\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$), $75^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ immersion, target decontamination of alkali ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and transition metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}, \text{Au}$), final overflow rinse to $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$, and filtered $\text{N}_2$ Marangoni / IPA vapor drying (*Source: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering*).
* **Thermal Gate Oxide Integration & Physical Parameters:** Gate dielectric target physical thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ grown by dry thermal oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$, gate channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology & Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).

nodes.label: Marangoni Dry Recipe Optimization with Ultra-Pure DI Water and IPA Vapor
nodes.sop_content:
```text
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|       DRAM FOUNDATION VN - STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE (SOP)            |
| Module: Wet Chemistry / Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation                |
| Target: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2) - 3.5 nm Gate Dielectric Node     |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### Document Title:
**Marangoni Dry Recipe Optimization with Ultra-Pure DI Water and Isopropyl Alcohol (IPA) Vapor**

---

### 1. Scope & Theoretical Background
In 180nm DRAM fabrication, pre-oxidation cleaning requires stripping native oxides and removing metallic impurities via RCA cleans (SC-1, DHF, SC-2). Post-DHF/SC-2 silicon surfaces transition between hydrophobic and hydrophilic states. Conventional spin-drying or aggressive dry-nitrogen blowing creates high capillary forces and liquid droplet pinning, leaving drying marks (watermarks) and particle residue that degrade gate oxide breakdown voltage ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) and interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).

The **Marangoni Drying** technique utilizes the surface tension gradient ($\Delta \gamma$) established at the three-phase meniscus boundary (silicon wafer, ultra-pure DI water, and carrier $N_2$/IPA vapor):
$$\Delta \gamma = \gamma_{\text{DIW}} - \gamma_{\text{DIW/IPA}} > 0$$
This surface tension gradient drives a convective Marangoni flow that pulls liquid away from the wafer surface back into the bulk DI water reservoir during slow, controlled wafer withdrawal, achieving a completely dry, watermark-free surface.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Step 1: UPW Overflow Rinse & Resistivity Verification (18.2 MΩ·cm)"] --> B["Step 2: Nitrogen Carrier Gas & IPA Vaporizer Pre-Conditioning"]
    B --> C["Step 3: Slow Wafer Cassette Withdrawal & Marangoni Boundary Formation"]
    C --> D["Step 4: Hot Ultra-High-Purity N2 Purge & Shroud Evacuation"]
    D --> E["Step 5: Post-Dry Metrology & Pre-Oxidation Transfer"]
```

#### Step 1: UPW Final Rinse Tank Preparation
1. Ensure the quartz rinse tank is filled with continuous overflow Ultra-Pure Deionized Water (UPW).
2. Maintain resistivity of UPW at strictly **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** at $25^\circ\text{C}$ with dissolved oxygen (DO) $< 10\text{ ppb}$.
3. Submerge wafer lot (following DHF/SC-2 pre-oxidation sequence) with an overflow cascade rinse cycle of $\ge 3\text{ minutes}$ until rinse-effluent resistivity reaches $> 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.

#### Step 2: IPA Vapor Delivery System Pre-Conditioning
1. Set the bubbler/vaporizer heating jacket temperature to generate steady-state IPA vapor using semiconductor-grade (VLSI/Megabit grade) Isopropanol.
2. Direct semiconductor ultra-high-purity (UHP) carrier gas $N_2$ (99.9999% purity, filtered to $< 0.05\ \mu\text{m}$) through the IPA delivery hood above the water meniscus.
3. Establish a laminar vapor blanket across the liquid surface with an IPA vapor flow concentration of $1.5\% - 2.5\%$ in $N_2$.

#### Step 3: Controlled Marangoni Meniscus Pull (Withdrawal Phase)
1. Initiate the robotic vertical lift arm at an ultra-low, vibration-damped withdrawal velocity of **$1.0 - 2.0\text{ mm/s}$**.
2. Ensure the steady three-phase contact line (wafer / UPW meniscus / IPA vapor) is strictly uniform across the entire wafer diameter without meniscus tear or wave oscillation.
3. Allow the Marangoni flow to continuously sweep the boundary liquid film into the tank bath without leaving micro-droplets on the hydrophobic/hydrophilic silicon surface.

#### Step 4: Dry Nitrogen Purge & Headspace Evacuation
1. Once wafer tops clear the meniscus completely, switch off the IPA vapor line.
2. Ramp UHP $N_2$ purge flow to dry wafer edges and carrier cassette teeth.
3. Evacuate exhaust shroud for $60\text{ seconds}$ to prevent condensation or volatile organic re-deposition on the nascent 180nm channel silicon.

#### Step 5: Post-Dry Inspection & Transfer to Gate Thermal Oxidation
1. Transfer the lot in a sealed FOUP/pod directly to the pre-oxidation quartz furnace staging area to minimize Q-time ($< 60\text{ minutes}$ prior to dry thermal oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ to grow target $3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Inspection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Rinse Water Resistivity** | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line conductivity/resistivity sensor at tank overflow weir |
| **Wafer Lift/Withdrawal Speed** | $1.5 \pm 0.3$ | $\text{mm/s}$ | Programmable linear servo encoder log |
| **Post-Dry Particle Adders ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$)** | $\le 5$ adders/wafer | counts / wafer ($200\text{ mm}$) | Automated Laser Surface Particle Scanner (SPX/Surfscan) |
| **Watermark / Residual Droplet Defect Count** | $0$ (Zero defects detected) | counts / wafer | Bright-field / dark-field optical inspection |

---

### 4. Verified Source Citations

1. **Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
   - Deionized water resistivity specification ($\mathbf{18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}}$) for rinse cycle purity.
   - Hydrofluoric dip (1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$) inducing surface transition from hydrophilic to hydrophobic states requiring watermark-free drying.
   - Elimination of metallic/organic residue prior to high-temperature steps.
2. **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
   - Gate oxide dielectric targets for 180nm DRAM: dry thermal gate oxide thickness of $\mathbf{3.5\text{ nm}}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ requiring pristine, particle-free, defect-free silicon surfaces to guarantee breakdown field ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) and interface state quality ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor geometry ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) and sub-femtoampere cell leakage constraints requiring minimal pre-oxidation surface damage and zero watermark-induced lattice defects.
citations: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-042`  
**Title:** COTS Surface Particle Counter & Laser Scattering Defect Inspection Tool Calibration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > Dilute HF Strip & SC-2 Sequence > High-Purity Marangoni/N2 Dry Metrology > **COTS Surface Particle Counter & Laser Scattering Defect Inspection Tool Calibration**  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text

│                        │
│  Tool Warm-Up & Dark   │
│    Current Baseline    │
│                        │

│          Load          │

             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Radial Stage      │
│     Scanning & PMT     │
│      Sensitivity       │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼

│                        │
│         Haze &         │

│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Calibration Sign-off  │
│     & Tool Release     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Tool Warm-Up & Optical Baseline Stabilization**:
   - Power on the laser scattering inspection subsystem (solid-state laser source at $\lambda = 488\text{ nm}$ or $532\text{ nm}$) and allow thermal stabilization for 30 minutes.
   - Run a dark-field optical baseline check without a wafer to establish the baseline dark current on the photomultiplier tube (PMT) and avalanche photodiode (APD) channels.

2. **Standard Calibration Wafer Loading**:
   - Transfer an authenticated NIST-traceable Polystyrene Latex (PSL) sphere calibration standard wafer (bare silicon substrate deposited with monodisperse PSL spheres matching the minimum defect detection threshold, nominal diameter calibrated to critical feature dimensions $\le 180\text{ nm}$, e.g., $100\text{ nm}$ and $180\text{ nm}$) onto the automated end-effector.
   - Align wafer notch/flat to the spindle chuck with vacuum clamping ($\ge 65\text{ kPa}$).

3. **Stage Scanning & Radial Optical Alignment**:
   - Initialize the $r$-$\theta$ rotational/translational stage. Perform an automated 9-point or 49-point optical alignment scan across the wafer surface.
   - Calibrate the laser incident beam angle, focal spot waist, and collection optics gain across center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zones.

4. **PMT Sensitivity & Scattering Cross-Section Calibration**:
   - Measure Rayleigh and Mie scattering signal intensities from the deposited PSL spheres.
   - Construct the scattering intensity-to-sphere diameter calibration curve using Mie scattering response tables. Adjust PMT high-voltage bias until the measured sphere peak channel matches the certified standard diameter within $\pm 2.0\%$.

5. **Repeatability, Haze, & Background Defect Qualification**:
   - Execute five consecutive automated scans over the calibration wafer. Record particle count, spatial coordinate repeatability, and background substrate optical haze.
   - Verify that background particle adder counts and false-positive scatter events meet cleanroom baseline targets before releasing the tool to inspect pre-gate oxidation wafers ($3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide line).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
                                                        
                               ┌───────────────────────┐
                               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
   Background Dark Count (/wfr)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
       Edge Exclusion Zone (mm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Count Repeatability (1-sigma %)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                               │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
   PSL Size Sizing Accuracy (%)┤███████████████████████│
                               │███████████████████████│
                               └┬─────┬────┬─────┬─────┘
                               0.0  24.8 49.5  74.2     
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Acceptance Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Verification Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PSL Particle Sizing Accuracy** | Peak channel at certified diameter (180 nm / 100 nm) | $\pm 2.0\%$ | $\%$ | Mie scattering pulse height analysis (PMT/APD collection) |
| **Defect Count Repeatability ($1\sigma$)** | Repeatability across 5 consecutive runs | $< 3.0\%$ | $\%$ ($1\sigma / \text{Mean}$) | Consecutive 5-run surface map differential analysis |
| **Wafer Edge Exclusion Margin** | 3.0 | $\pm 0.5$ | $\text{mm}$ | Automated radial optical stage travel limiter |
| **Background Dark / False Adder Count** | $\le 5$ | Max limit $\le 5$ | particles/wafer | Bare silicon reference wafer scan ($\ge 100\text{ nm}$ threshold) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Technical Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Contextual Alignment:* The access transistor geometry is defined at channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$. Establishing laser scattering defect sensitivity calibrated to detect particulate defects down to the gate length scale ($180\text{ nm}$ and sub-threshold) is essential to prevent channel bridge defects and gate oxide punch-through.
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - *Contextual Alignment:* Utilizes automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film non-uniformity across spin coating and furnace runs, directly informing the stage coordinate calibration and spatial mapping routines across the cleanroom wafer chuck.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Contextual Alignment:* Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness. Sub-micron particulate contamination prior to thermal oxidation directly degrades the $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide breakdown field, mandating rigorous pre-oxidation particle counter calibration.
