nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-042`
**Title:** Post-Clean Pre-Oxidation Surface Metallic and Particle Metrology Qualification  
**Context:** DRAM Foundation VN | 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip | Gen 2 ($\mu$m)  
**Process Step:** Dry Thermal Oxidation Module / Wet Clean & Surface Preparation Metrology  
**Equipment Action Type:** Buy (Automated Laser Particle Inspection System & Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence / TXRF Spectrometer)

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure establishes the qualification and inline acceptance protocol for surface particle defectivity and trace transition-metal contamination on bare silicon wafers following dilute HF strip, SC-2 clean, and Marangoni/$\text{N}_2$ drying. Proper qualification ensures that the pre-oxidation silicon substrate meets defect density and metallic purity targets required prior to loading into the dry thermal oxidation furnace (850°C–900°C) for growing the critical 3.5 nm to 4.0 nm gate dielectric ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).

---

### 2. Equipment & Tooling
- **Surface Particle Scanner:** Darkfield laser surface inspection tool (e.g., KLA-Tencor Surfscan series or equivalent).
- **Surface Metallic Metrology:** Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Spectrometer with rotating anode or monochromatic W/Mo/Cr source.
- **Handling/Transfer:** Class 1 mini-environment cleanroom FOUP/SMIF pods with automated vacuum robotic arm handling.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Wafer Lot Transfer & FOUP Loading                                               |
|    - Retrieve dried wafer cassette directly from Marangoni/N2 dryer output station.|
|    - Transfer under ISO Class 1 laminar flow hood within 15 min of clean completion|
+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Automated Laser Light Scattering (Particle Metrology)                           |
|    - Load cassette into particle inspection tool; initialize edge exclusion (3 mm).|
|    - Execute full-wafer surface scan calibrating defect bin sizes >= 0.18 um (180nm)|
|    - Map defect coordinates and log total adder particle count per wafer.          |
+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. TXRF Surface Metallic Contamination Measurement                                |
|    - Transfer qualification monitor wafers to the TXRF inspection chamber.         |
|    - Run multi-point protocol (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right; r = R - 10 mm).   |
|    - Acquire surface X-ray spectra for critical metallic species: Fe, Cu, Ni, Cr.  |
|    - Quantify surface atomic density in atoms/cm^2.                                |
+-----------------------------------------+------------------------------------------+
                                          |
                                          v
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Data Verification & Pre-Oxidation Furnace Release                               |
|    - Verify metrics against Acceptance Criteria.                                   |
|    - Generate digital qualification run certificate.                               |
|    - Release lot to 850°C-900°C Dry Gate Oxidation Furnace queue within Q-time.    |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Lot Transfer & Pre-Alignment:**
   - Unload wafer cassette directly from the high-purity Marangoni/$\text{N}_2$ drying station.
   - Verify Q-time counter (maximum permissible queue time between wet clean completion and oxidation furnace entry: $\le 2\text{ hours}$).
   - Load cassette into the particle inspection tool FOUP port; align notch/flat automatically.

2. **Full-Wafer Laser Particle Scanning:**
   - Set optical recipe sensitivity threshold to detect surface defect size $\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ (corresponding to the minimum feature rule $F = 180\text{ nm}$).
   - Configure wafer edge exclusion to $3\text{ mm}$.
   - Perform full-surface spiral or raster laser darkfield scatter scan. Record total surface particle count and spatial distribution map.

3. **TXRF Trace Metallic Contamination Measurement:**
   - Transfer monitor wafers to the TXRF stage under clean high-vacuum/dry nitrogen purge.
   - Position X-ray incidence angle below the critical angle for total external reflection on Si ($\sim 0.18^\circ$).
   - Execute a 5-point measurement pattern (wafer center and 4 orthogonal points at $R - 10\text{ mm}$).
   - Measure fluorescent X-ray peaks for critical transition elements: Iron ($\text{Fe}$), Nickel ($\text{Ni}$), Copper ($\text{Cu}$), and Chromium ($\text{Cr}$).

4. **Disposition and Gate Oxide Queue Dispatch:**
   - Compare all measured parameters against section 4 acceptance metrics.
   - If values pass, digitally stamp lot as `QUALIFIED_PRE_OXIDATION` and route directly to the 850°C–900°C quartz oxidation tube.
   - If particle count or metallic density breaches control limits, flag lot as `OUT_OF_SPEC`, hold queue, and route monitor wafers for RCA clean re-work analysis.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Measurement Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Surface Particle Density** ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ defect size) | $\le 0.05$ | $\text{particles/cm}^2$ ($\le 15\text{ particles/wafer}$ for 200 mm) | Darkfield Laser Scatter Scanner |
| **Trace Heavy Metal Contamination** ($\text{Fe}, \text{Ni}, \text{Cu}$) | $< 5.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | TXRF Spectrometer |
| **Pre-Oxidation Queue Time (Q-Time)** | $\le 120$ | $\text{minutes}$ | MES / Station Timer Log |
| **Subsequent Dielectric Breakdown Field Target** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Post-oxidation MOS CV/IV Prober |

---

### 5. Context & Literature Citations
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Establishes the 180nm critical feature scale (access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, cell area $6F^2$ / $8F^2$), defining the minimum defect particle sensitivity threshold ($\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Dictates dry thermal gate oxide target thickness of $3.5\text{ nm to } 4.0\text{ nm}$ grown in dry $\text{O}_2$ at $900^\circ\text{C}$ ($850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation regime) and sets critical physical quality metrics: breakdown electric field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Validates thermal dry silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectric processing window at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ with physical thickness target $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Post-Clean Surface Contact Angle and TXRF Trace Metal Metrology
**Module Path**: `Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) [Thermal Oxidation] > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) [Wet Chemistry] > Post-Clean Surface Contact Angle and TXRF Trace Metal Metrology [Metrology]`  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm  
**Action Type**: Buy / Standard Tool Verification  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow

This procedure qualifies post-RCA/DHF cleaned silicon wafers prior to dry thermal oxidation in a quartz tube furnace (targeting ~3.5 nm gate oxide thickness). It validates surface hydrophobicity/passivation via Sessile Drop Optical Contact Angle goniometry and quantifies critical transition metal contamination (Fe, Ni, Cu) using Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF).

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Wafer Transfer from Pre-Ox Clean (DHF Dip/Marangoni Dry)"] --> B["Automated Contact Angle Metrology (Sessile Drop DI Water)"]
    B --> C{"Contact Angle Check (Passivated Si-H Surface)"}
    C -- "Fail: CA < 65° (Native Oxide / Hydrophilic)" --> R1["Reject: Re-clean / Fresh DHF Dip"]
    C -- "Pass: CA >= 70°" --> D["Load to TXRF Metrology Chamber"]
    D --> E["Glancing-Angle X-Ray Acquisition (5-Point Map: Center, N, S, E, W)"]
    E --> F{"TXRF Metal Limits Check (Fe, Ni, Cu)"}
    F -- "Fail: Heavy Metals Exceeded" --> R2["Reject: SC-2 / Acid Bath Strip & Root Cause"]
    F -- "Pass: All Criteria Met" --> G["Release Lot to 850°C-900°C Dry Gate Oxidation"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Lot Staging & Cleanroom Environment Handling**:
   - Receive the wafer cassette from the pre-oxidation wet bench immediately following the final DHF etch and Marangoni dry.
   - Maintain queue-time management ($Q\text{-time} \le 60\text{ min}$) to prevent uncontrolled native oxide regrow or airborne organic contamination.

2. **Surface Contact Angle Goniometry Execution**:
   - Transfer sample monitor wafer onto the automated goniometer vacuum chuck.
   - Dispense a precision $2.0\,\mu\text{L} \pm 0.2\,\mu\text{L}$ sessile droplet of Ultra-Pure Deionized Water (UPW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) at 5 designated points (Center, and 4 points at $R = 65\text{ mm}$ for $150/200\text{ mm}$ wafers).
   - Capture dynamic droplet profile within 5 seconds of dispense using high-resolution optical video imaging.
   - Fit Laplace-Young / tangent line profiles and record baseline water contact angles ($\theta_c$).

3. **TXRF Trace Metal Measurement**:
   - Transfer wafer into the automated TXRF (Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence) tool under high vacuum or clean He-purged measurement chamber.
   - Set excitation source (Mo-K$\alpha$ or W-L$\beta$ at $40\text{ kV}, 30\text{ mA}$) at a glancing angle below the critical angle ($\alpha_c \approx 0.10^\circ - 0.15^\circ$) for total external reflection on Si.
   - Execute 5-point measurement mapping (integration time $t = 500\text{ s}$ per site).
   - Integrate and deconvolve fluorescent spectra for transition metals ($\text{Fe-K}\alpha$, $\text{Ni-K}\alpha$, $\text{Cu-K}\alpha$).

4. **Data Logging & Cassette Release**:

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-WET-001`
**Title:** Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology for Surface Hydrophobicity and Passivation Quality  
**Process Step Hierarchy:**  
`180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration]` > `180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing]` > `Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) [Thermal Oxidation]` > `RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) [Wet Chemistry]` > `Post-Clean Surface Contact Angle and TXRF Trace Metal Metrology [Metrology]` > `Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology for Surface Hydrophobicity and Passivation Quality`  
**Node Generation:** Gen 1 (180nm, 1T1C DRAM Architecture)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Automated Optical Sessile Drop Goniometer Toolset)

---

### 1. Purpose & Context
This procedure defines the execution protocol for automated sessile drop contact angle metrology on silicon wafer surfaces immediately following the pre-gate oxidation clean (RCA SC-1/SC-2 with dilute HF final dip). At the 180nm node, growing high-integrity, ultrathin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide (thermally grown at 850°C–900°C) for access transistors ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) demands uniform hydrogen passivation and complete native oxide strip across the active channel area prior to oxidation furnace load.

---

### 2. Equipment, Tooling & Environmental Specifications
- **Metrology Tool:** Automated Optical Sessile Drop Contact Angle Goniometer with automated motorized multi-point stage ($X$-$Y$-$\theta$), environmental enclosure, and CCD camera with telecentric optics.
- **Probe Liquid:** Deionized (DI) Water, resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ at $25^\circ\text{C}$, TOC $< 5\text{ ppb}$, filtered to $0.05\ \mu\text{m}$.
- **Dispensing Subsystem:** Micro-syringe with calibrated PTFE blunt needle (gage 30 to 32); droplet volume target: $1.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$.
- **Cleanroom Ambient:** Class 1 / ISO Class 3 minienvironment; temperature $21.5^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$; relative humidity $45\% \pm 3\%$.
- **Max Permissible Q-Time:** Post-DHF rinse/dry to goniometric measurement $\le 30\text{ minutes}$ (to prevent airborne hydrocarbon re-contamination and native oxide regrowth).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```text
       [Wafer Unload: Post-RCA DHF Clean]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Transfer to Goniometer Tool Stage (Q-Time <= 30 min)]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Automated 5-Point Wafer Alignment & Recipe Load]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Sessile Drop Dispense: 1.0 uL DI Water at 21.5 deg C]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Image Capture at t = 2.0 s Post-Dispense via CCD]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Young-Laplace / Tangent Fit Evaluation of Theta (deg)]
                       │
                       ▼
       [Pass / Fail SPC Gate Validation -> Send to 850-900 deg C Furnace]
```

#### Step 3.1: Metrology Tool Preparation & Syringe Priming
1. Verify optical calibration grid using certified ruby spherical calibration standard ($\theta = 90.0^\circ \pm 0.5^\circ$).
2. Flush the micro-dispenser lines with freshly drawn $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ ultra-pure DI water for 5 cycles to eliminate micro-bubbles.
3. Verify baseline droplet volume stability by dispensing test drops onto a dummy target ($1.0\ \mu\text{L} \pm 0.1\ \mu\text{L}$).

#### Step 3.2: Wafer Loading & Spatial Mapping
1. Load the 200mm production silicon wafer post-RCA/DHF clean into the automated wafer load port.
2. Select the metrology recipe: `RECIPE_180NM_GATE_OX_PREP_WET`.
3. Auto-align wafer notch/flat and initialize a standardized 5-point measurement map across the substrate:
   - Point 1: Center $(0, 0\text{ mm})$
   - Points 2–5: North, South, East, West at radius $R = 90\text{ mm}$ ($10\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).

#### Step 3.3: Droplet Dispense and Dynamic Sessile Angle Capture
1. Move stage to coordinate location $(X_i, Y_i)$ at a vertical working distance of $2.0\text{ mm}$ between needle tip and substrate.
2. Dispense a sessile droplet of $1.0\ \mu\text{L}$ DI water at a controlled dosing rate of $0.5\ \mu\text{L/s}$.
3. Lower stage to transfer the droplet onto the Si surface gently with zero kinetic impact splashing.
4. Capture high-resolution droplet silhouette images exactly $2.0\text{ seconds} \pm 0.2\text{ seconds}$ post-surface touchdown.

#### Step 3.4: Automated Edge Fitting & Calculation
1. Apply the automated Young-Laplace contour fitting algorithm along the liquid-vapor-solid three-phase boundary line.
2. Calculate left and right contact angles ($\theta_L$, $\theta_R$); record the mean contact angle $\theta_{\text{avg}} = (\theta_L + \theta_R) / 2$.
3. Repeat steps for all remaining coordinates across the 5-point map.
4. Purge droplet via non-contact micro-vacuum aspiration if executing on production-sacrificial sites, or reject wafer if destructive contact metrology is configured without monitor sites.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Unit | Target Specification | Lower / Upper Control Limit (LCL / UCL) | Metrology Tool / Action on Out-of-Spec |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Water Contact Angle ($\theta_{\text{avg}}$)** | Degrees ($^\circ$) | $\ge 72.0^\circ$ | LCL: $70.0^\circ$ (Passivated hydrophobic Si–H surface) | Goniometer: Abort thermal furnace run; re-route wafer to DHF pre-clean if $\theta < 70^\circ$. |
| **Cross-Wafer Wetting Non-Uniformity ($1\sigma$)** | Percent ($\%$) | $\le 3.0\%$ | UCL: $4.5\%$ across 5-point radial distribution | Automated SPC alarm; flag RCA bath recirculation and spray nozzle blockage. |
| **Pre-Furnace Q-Time Exposure Window** | Minutes ($\text{min}$) | $\le 30.0$ | UCL: $45.0\text{ min}$ max queue time before 850°C–900°C furnace ramp | MES interlocking gate; lockout wafer entry to thermal oxidation cluster. |
| **Droplet Measurement Volume Precision** | Microliters ($\mu\text{L}$) | $1.00$ | $0.90\ \mu\text{L} \le V_{\text{drop}} \le 1.10\ \mu\text{L}$ | Dispenser optical verification; re-prime fluidics on deviation. |

---

### 5. Context Citations & Technical Justification

1. **Gate Dielectric Baseline & Thermal Processing:**
   - *Context:* *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide (SiO2) at 850°C-900°C dry oxidation with ~3.5 nm physical thickness."* (Source: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
   - *Process Justification:* A pristine 3.5 nm gate oxide requires complete removal of sub-oxides and chemical oxide prior to dry thermal oxidation; achieving a hydrophobic hydrogen-terminated surface ($\theta \ge 70^\circ$) prevents premature interfacial pinhole defect generation.
2. **Access Transistor Dimensions & Integrity:**
   - *Context:* *"Unit Cell Geometry: Access transistor channel length L = 180 nm, width W = 220 nm."* (Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*).
   - *Process Justification:* For $L = 180\text{ nm}$ sub-micron channels, non-uniform cleaning or trace chemical oxide residual causes threshold voltage ($V_{\text{th}}$) roll-off and catastrophic sub-threshold leakage exceeding the $1\text{ fA/cell}$ target limit.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Transmission Line Measurement (TLM) for Specific Contact Resistivity (Schroder, D. - Semiconductor Material and Device Characterization)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Goniometer Optical Alignment and Micro-Dosing Syringe Calibration

- **Process Title:** Goniometer Optical Alignment and Micro-Dosing Syringe Calibration
- **Node / Step Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Conditioning > Post-Clean Surface Contact Angle and TXRF Trace Metal Metrology > Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology > Optical Alignment & Micro-Dosing Calibration
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Stage Leveling &    │
│         Focus          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Optical Telecentric   │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Micro-Dosing      │
│     Dispenser Cal      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Baseline Water     │
│  Droplet Verification  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Vibration Isolation & Macroscopic Stage Leveling**
   - Secure the goniometer assembly onto a stable, vibration-isolated optical breadboard stage.
   - Place a precision spirit level across the wafer chuck; adjust dual-axis kinematic leveling screws until chuck tilt is planar within the Gen 2 macroscopic mechanical baseline.

2. **Optical Axis Alignment & Plan Achromat Focus**
   - Mount a certified calibration target or optical reticle onto the wafer stage.
   - Align the camera optical axis perpendicular to the droplet baseline using a high-magnification plan achromat objective (10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25).
   - Adjust the diffuse LED collimated backlight intensity to achieve a sharp, high-contrast silhouette boundary with zero edge blooming.
   - Adjust the fine Z-micrometer drive to bring the target edge into sharp focus across the optical field of view.

3. **Pixel-Scale Telecentric Calibration**
   - Measure the known dimensional feature of a certified optical grid or precision needle gauge under the 10x Plan Achromat imaging system.
   - Perform software pixel-to-micrometer calibration, confirming optical alignment precision within Gen 2 mechanical and optical tolerances (±5 µm).

4. **Micro-Dosing Syringe Preparation & Prime**
   - Load clean, semiconductor-grade Deionized (DI) water (or high-purity chemical testing fluid) into a gastight micro-syringe fitted with a clean, blunt-tip stainless needle (30–32 AWG).
   - Mount the micro-syringe into the automated micro-stepper dosing actuator.
   - Prime the dispenser by purging DI water through the fluid path until all micro-bubbles are evacuated.

5. **Droplet Dispense Calibration & Baseline Verification**
   - Execute test micro-dosing steps using the stepper motor actuator to dispense pendant droplets at controlled sub-microliter volumes (e.g., 1.0–2.0 µL).
   - Lower the needle toward the test substrate to touch off and seat the droplet.
   - Capture droplet profile images; calculate baseline baseline tilt and contact angle fitting repeatability using Young-Laplace baseline fitting.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric / Tolerance | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Optical Stage Alignment Tolerance (Gen 2)** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical reticle / micrometer gauge image scaling |
| **Imaging Numerical Aperture / Objective** | $10\times\text{ Plan Achromat, NA } 0.25$ | Dimensionless | Hardware optical specification verification |
| **Dispensed Droplet Baseline Repeatability** | Stable silhouette contrast without optical distortion | Visual / Gray-level threshold | Automated edge-detection intensity profile |

---

### Context Citations

- **[Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)]**:
  - *Stable macroscopic stage & optical objective:* Utilizes a 10x Plan Achromat, NA 0.25 objective for micron-scale feature resolution.
  - *Alignment & Positioning Tolerances:* Alignment tolerance specification at Gen 1 is $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ ($0.1\text{ mm}$), improving down to $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ in Gen 2.
  - *Deionized Water Baseline:* Rigorous deionized (DI) water rinse standards for wet clean and surface preparation conditioning.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Multi-Point Sessile Drop DI Water Wetting Recipe Execution on Pre-Oxidation Silicon

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-WET-180NM-001`  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) > Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology  
**Process Action Type:** Make / Metrology Execution  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Post-Clean Wafer    │
│          Load          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Automated Dispense:   │
│   1.0 - 2.0 uL DIW     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Optoelectronic     │
│  Edge-Fitting & Angle  │
│       Metrology        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Multi-Point Map:    │
│  Center, Middle, Edge  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Acceptance Gate Pass: │
│    H-Passivated Si     │
│   Contact Angle >75°   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Tool Setup & Purge**:
   - Verify the automated contact angle goniometer environmental chamber is equilibrated at $22.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ and $45\% \pm 5\%$ relative humidity.
   - Purge the ultra-pure deionized water (DIW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) micro-syringe delivery line to remove trapped micro-bubbles.
2. **Substrate Transfer**:
   - Transfer the post-RCA/DHF treated silicon wafer from the nitrogen purge box directly to the motorized goniometer vacuum stage within $<5\text{ minutes}$ to prevent native chemical re-oxidation.
3. **Multi-Point Recipe Execution**:
   - Run the automated 5-point/9-point polar coordinate wetting program: Center $(R=0)$, Middle $(R=r/2\text{ at } 0^\circ, 90^\circ, 180^\circ, 270^\circ)$, and Edge Exclusion zone $(3\text{ mm}$ edge margin).
   - At each site, automatically lower the PTFE-coated needle ($30\text{ gauge}$) and dispense a sessile droplet volume of $1.5\text{ }\mu\text{L} \pm 0.2\text{ }\mu\text{L}$ DI water at a controlled rate of $1.0\text{ }\mu\text{L/s}$.
4. **Acquisition & Young-Laplace Fitting**:
   - Acquire profile shadowgraphs via high-resolution telecentric CCD camera at $60\text{ fps}$ within $1.0\text{ to } 3.0\text{ seconds}$ post-surface detachment (prior to droplet evaporation effects).
   - Execute baseline detection and tangent / Young-Laplace profile fit to calculate left, right, and mean static contact angles ($\theta_c$).
5. **Post-Measurement Purge**:
   - Vacuum aspirate droplets or route wafer to dry spin/blow station prior to advancing to furnace load locks for the 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation growth.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Target Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit | Verification Tool / Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Sessile Droplet Dispense Volume** | $1.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ | $\mu\text{L}$ | Calibrated Micro-Dispenser Pump Encoder |
| **Contact Angle ($\theta_c$) Post-DHF Passivation** | $> 75.0$ | $\ge 75.0$ (Hydrophobic) | $\text{deg } (^\circ)$ | Automated Optical Goniometer (Young-Laplace fit) |
| **Across-Wafer Wetting Non-Uniformity ($1\sigma$)** | $\le 2.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $\text{deg } (^\circ)$ | 5-point/9-point Radial Distribution Standard Deviation |
| **Stage Radial Travel Positioning Accuracy** | $0.0$ | $\pm 10.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Closed-Loop Motorized Stage Linear Encoders |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Pre-oxidation surface preparation directly impacts the initial rapid oxidation regime and interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$) for target dry gate oxides of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}1000^\circ\text{C}$ with breakdown fields $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Precise gate oxide preparation governs the 180nm access transistor channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) to maintain junction and sub-threshold leakage below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**: High etch resistance to concentrated HF/BOE ($<0.5\text{ nm/min}$) confirms DHF selectivity over nitride boundaries during pre-clean surface conditioning.
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180-CA01`  
**Title:** Contact Angle Image Fitting Analysis and Hydrogen Passivation Mapping  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm DRAM, $L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$)  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > RCA Clean & Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning (SC-1/SC-2/DHF Dip) > Goniometric Contact Angle Wetting Metrology > **Contact Angle Image Fitting Analysis and Hydrogen Passivation Mapping**  
**Action Type:** Make

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Visual Execution Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Sessile DIW Drop    │
│        Dispense        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       High-Speed       │
│   Telecentric Image    │
│        Capture         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Sub-Pixel Baseline &  │
│     Edge Detection     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Young-Laplace /     │
│   Polynomial Fitting   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Multi-Site       │
│  Passivation Mapping   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Substrate Positioning & Environmental Stabilization**:
   - Transfer the post-DHF treated wafer from nitrogen purge transport pod onto the automated goniometer vacuum chuck within $< 15\text{ minutes}$ post-clean to prevent ambient hydrocarbon contamination and native re-oxidation.
   - Maintain metrology chamber environment at $22.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ and $45 \pm 5\%$ relative humidity.

2. **Automated Sessile Drop Dispensing**:
   - Dispense a calibrated $1.00 \pm 0.05\ \mu\text{L}$ sessile droplet of ultra-pure deionized water (DIW, resistivity $\ge 18.2\ \text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) using a PTFE-coated micro-needle ($30\text{-gauge}$) at a dispense rate of $0.5\ \mu\text{L/s}$.
   - Position needle tip at $1.5\text{ mm}$ above the wafer surface, auto-retract immediately upon droplet detachment to prevent vibration disturbance.

3. **High-Speed Telecentric Image Acquisition**:
   - Trigger image acquisition within $500\text{ ms}$ after droplet touchdown using a monochromatic telecentric camera ($1024 \times 768$ pixels, LED back-illumination) at a frame rate $\ge 30\text{ fps}$.
   - Capture a 10-frame sequence to verify droplet equilibrium before evaporation affects wetting geometry.

4. **Sub-Pixel Baseline Detection & Profile Fitting**:
   - Execute Canny edge detection with sub-pixel interpolation on the liquid-gas and liquid-solid boundary interfaces.
   - Establish the horizontal solid-liquid baseline by identifying the reflection mirror line.
   - Apply the **Young-Laplace drop profile fitting** (or tangent circle/polynomial fitting) algorithm to determine the left contact angle $\theta_L$ and right contact angle $\theta_R$; compute $\theta_{\text{mean}} = (\theta_L + \theta_R)/2$.

5. **Multi-Point Passivation Mapping & Die-Grid Interpolation**:
   - Perform automated 5-site or 9-site radial sampling across the wafer (Center, Inner, Middle, Outer, Edge at 3 mm edge exclusion).
   - Generate full-wafer contour map of $\theta_{\text{mean}}$ to evaluate Si-H (monohydride/dihydride) termination completeness prior to loading into the 850°C–900°C dry oxidation furnace for the 3.5 nm gate oxide growth.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■ │
  Site 5 (Edge)┤■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■■ │
               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░ │
```

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sourced Citations

1. **Gate Dielectric Thickness and Oxidation Thermal Budget**:
   - *Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Trace Metal Contamination Screening

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-MET-TXRF-180NM`  
**Process Step:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology > Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Trace Metal Contamination Screening  
**Target Structure:** Pre-Oxidation RCA Cleaned Si (100) Substrate Prior to 3.5 nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth  

---

### 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Wafer Load &      │
│     Pre-Alignment      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Incident Angle     │
│   Alignment & Tuning   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Fluorescence      │
│  Spectrum Acquisition  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Peak Deconvolution &  │
│  Contamination Check   │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Wafer Loading & Pre-Alignment:**
   - Transfer the post-RCA cleaned (SC-1/SC-2/DHF conditioned) 200 mm bare test/monitor wafer from the nitrogen-purged FOUP/SMIF pod onto the TXRF endstation vacuum chuck via robotic pick-and-place.
   - Execute mechanical notch alignment to establish the polar coordinate grid ($r, \theta$) across the wafer surface.

2. **Goniometer Z-Height & Incident Angle ($\Phi$) Calibration:**
   - Initialize the X-ray source (monochromatic Mo-$K\alpha$ or W-$L\beta$ radiation beam).
   - Perform automatic Z-height surface leveling using laser reflection sensors.
   - Sweep incident angle $\Phi$ and fix the measurement beam below the critical angle for total external reflection on silicon ($\Phi < \Phi_c \approx 0.10^\circ - 0.15^\circ$), ensuring excitation depth is confined strictly to the topmost 3–5 nm surface layer without deep substrate penetration.

3. **Multi-Point Spectral Acquisition:**
   - Position the Silicon Drift Detector (SDD) / Energy Dispersive Spectrometer directly above the sampling points.
   - Execute a multi-point measurement pattern (5-point cross or 9-point radial map including center, mid-radius, and edge-exclusion boundary of 3 mm).
   - Integrate characteristic fluorescence counts for preset live time ($t = 500\text{ s}$ to $1000\text{ s}$ per site).

4. **Spectral Deconvolution & Trace Metal Quantification:**
   - Process acquired spectra using reference sensitivity factors (RSF) for key transition metals: Iron ($\text{Fe}$), Nickel ($\text{Ni}$), Copper ($\text{Cu}$), and Zinc ($\text{Zn}$).
   - Deconvolve overlapping silicon escape peaks and compute areal contamination density in units of $\text{atoms/cm}^2$.
   - Confirm substrate cleanliness before releasing the batch into the quartz furnace for dry thermal gate oxidation at 850°C–900°C.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Verification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **X-ray Incident Glancing Angle ($\Phi$)** | $< 0.15$ (Below critical angle $\Phi_c$) | $\text{degrees } (^\circ)$ | Automated Goniometer Stage Encoder |
| **Critical Transition Metals ($\text{Fe}, \text{Ni}, \text{Cu}$)** | $\le 5.0 \times 10^{9}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | Energy Dispersive TXRF Spectrum Integration |
| **Subsequent Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Mercury Probe / MOS Cap Breakdown ($I\text{-}V$) |
| **Pre-Oxidation Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$ Limit)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Post-oxidation high/low frequency $C\text{-}V$ check |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Source Citations

- **Source: *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace***
  - *Dry Gate Dielectric Targets*: Thermal gate oxide physical thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ grown at $900^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$.
  - *Dielectric Quality*: Requires breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$, dictating strict sub-$10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ trace metal purity to eliminate premature Fowler-Nordheim oxide breakdown.
- **Source: *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering***
  - *Gate Oxide Thermal Envelope*: Gate dielectric is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **Source: *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench***
  - *Leakage Target*: Sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain required DRAM refresh cycles, prohibiting interstitial heavy-metal contamination that acts as generation-recombination centers.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: Pre-Oxidation Clean Surface Spec Verification and Furnace Loading Disposition Report
**Process Level**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Conditioning > Metrology Verification & Furnace Disposition  
**Generation**: Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Process Flow & Routing

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Post-RCA Surface    │
│       Metrology        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Water Contact Angle   │
│  & TXRF Verification   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────◇───────────┐
│                        │
│  Surface Spec Passed?  │
│                        │
└────────────◇───────────┘
             │
             │
             ├───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮Yes: Within Spec
             │No: Metallic Contamination / Native Oxide                          │
             ▼                                                                   ▼
┌────────────────────────┐                                          ┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │                                          │                        │
│   Rework / Re-clean    │                                          │  Generate Disposition  │
│      Disposition       │                                          │         Ticket         │
│                        │                                          │                        │
└────────────────────────┘                                          └────────────┬───────────┘
                                                                                 │
             ╭───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Load Quartz Furnace   │
│    Center Flat Zone    │
│         350mm          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Oxidation Metrology Inspection & Spec Verification**:
   - Inspect incoming P-type (100) Si wafer surface immediately following the RCA Clean and DHF dip sequence.
   - Run Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) spectroscopy across 5-point radial wafer coordinates to measure trace metallic impurities and mobile alkali ions (notably $\text{Na}^+$).
   - Perform sessile drop deionized water contact angle measurement to confirm complete native oxide removal and hydrogen passivation integrity post-DHF conditioning.

2. **Automated Spec Disposition Decision**:
   - Verify that metallic contamination and contact angle align with contamination-free interface limits required to achieve target interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\,\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ and breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\,\text{MV/cm}$.
   - If limits fail, quarantine the cassette and tag for SC-1/SC-2/DHF re-clean disposition.
   - If limits pass, sign off the digital Furnace Loading Disposition Report and issue a lot release barcode ticket. Maintain queue-time under cleanroom ambient control to eliminate native oxide regrowth prior to furnace load.

3. **Furnace Ambient & Zone Preparation**:
   - Set up the horizontal fused quartz process tube (outer diameter 150 mm to 200 mm, purity 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$) with 3-zone thermal regulation (Source zone, Center zone, Load zone) regulated by dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples and digital PID controllers.
   - Establish a continuous sweep of high-purity ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ / $\text{Ar}$ at 2.0 to 5.0 SLPM (standard liters per minute) laminar gas sweep velocity to prevent ambient air back-diffusion through the door end.
   - Prepare recipe mass flow controllers (MFC) calibrated for high-purity $\text{O}_2$ (99.999%) and dry $\text{HCl}$ (1% to 3% addition) for cleaning metallic impurities and mobile $\text{Na}^+$ ions.

4. **Quartz Boat Wafer Loading Disposition**:
   - Mount the passed product wafers into quartz boats positioned strictly within the middle 350 mm Center Flat Zone of the process tube (maintaining thermal uniformity within $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Insert quartz dummy/baffle wafers in the Source and Load zone ends to ensure steady-state laminar gas velocity and uniform thermal profiling before ramping to dry oxidation process conditions (850°C–900°C target growth for 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
Critical Gate Dielectric & Thermal Process Acceptance Metrics
                              ┌────────────────────────┐
                              │░░░░░░░░░               │
       Dry Tox Target (3.5 nm)┤░░░░░░░░░               │
                              │▒▒                      │
Flat Zone Uniformity (<=0.5 C)┤▒▒                      │
   Dit Spec (<10^10 cm-2 eV-1)┤▓▓▓                     │
                              │▓▓▓                     │
       E_bd Target (>10 MV/cm)┤████████████████████████│
                              │████████████████████████│
                              └┬─────┬─────┬────┬─────┬┘
                              0.0   2.5   5.0  7.5 10.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Diagnostic Validation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Center Flat Zone Thermal Uniformity** | $\le \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ across middle 350 mm | Dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh Thermocouple Profiling Array |
| **Laminar Sweep Gas Velocity Flow Rate** | $2.0 \text{ to } 5.0$ | SLPM | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) Sweep |
| **Pre-Clean Dielectric Interface Quality ($D_{it}$)** | $< 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Planar MOSCAP High-Frequency (1 MHz) & Quasi-Static C-V |
| **Physical Oxide Thickness Target ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5 \text{ to } 4.0$ ($\pm 0.1$ precision) | $\text{nm}$ | High-Frequency Maximum Accumulation Capacitance $C_{ox}$ / Ellipsometry |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | MOSCAP Breakdown Profiling / Current-Voltage ($I\text{-}V$) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery**
  - Fused quartz process tube outer diameter 150 mm to 200 mm, purity 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$.
  - 3-zone resistive heating element (Kanthal A1 or APM alloy coils) with Source, Center, and Load zones monitored via dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples.
  - Middle 350 mm Center Flat Zone uniformity specification $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Gas delivery via calibrated MFCs for 99.999% pure $\text{O}_2$, $\text{Ar}$, $\text{N}_2$, and 1%–3% dry $\text{HCl}$ with laminar gas sweep rates of 2.0 to 5.0 SLPM.
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
  - Dry thermal oxidation kinetic parameters targeting thin-regime reaction-rate limited growth ($x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$) at 850°C–1000°C.
  - High-dielectric breakdown specification $E_{bd} > 10\,\text{MV/cm}$, interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\,\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$, and gate dielectric thickness target of 3.5 to 4.0 nm.
- **Source: Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**
  - Planar MOSCAP diagnostic characterization with aluminum circular gate dots (200 $\mu\text{m}$, 500 $\mu\text{m}$, 1000 $\mu\text{m}$) on P-type (100) Si.
  - High-frequency (1 MHz) accumulation capacitance $C_{ox} = (\epsilon_{ox} \cdot \epsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{ox}$ yielding physical oxide thickness $t_{ox}$ with $\pm 0.1\,\text{nm}$ precision.
citations: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery (Thermco / Bruce Technologies Semiconductor Furnace Manual)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## TXRF Trace Metallic Contamination (Fe/Cu/Ni) and Particle Density Analysis

**Module:** Pre-Oxidation Surface Metrology & Furnace Loading Disposition  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Target Structure:** Access Transistor Gate Dielectric Pre-Conditioning (3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Characterization  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Pre-Oxidation     │
│   Cleaned Wafer Lot   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Laser Surface     │
│  Particle Inspection  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   TXRF Multi-Point    │
│     Surface Scan      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Contamination &    │
│  Defect Disposition   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Release to 850-900C  │
│  Gate Oxide Furnace   │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Lot Transfer and Environmental Quarantine:**
   - Transfer wafer cassettes directly from the pre-oxidation RCA clean bench (SC-1/SC-2/DHF) into the Class 1 mini-environment FOUP/SMIF interface under filtered laminar airflow (N₂ or clean dry air).
   - Ensure queue time between chemical surface preparation and metrology remains $< 30\text{ min}$ to prevent organic re-adsorption and airborne particulate accumulation.

2. **Automated Wafer Alignment & Non-Destructive Particle Scanning:**
   - Robotically load wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the laser surface particle scanner (LSPS).
   - Set defect inspection recipe: scanning beam $\lambda = 405\text{ nm}$ or $488\text{ nm}$, scan exclusion edge = $3.0\text{ mm}$.
   - Perform full-wafer dark-field scattering scan to count localized light scatterers (LLS) down to $\ge 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ (matching the 180nm critical feature size).

3. **Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) Calibration & Alignment:**
   - Transfer monitor and product wafers to the high-vacuum TXRF chamber ($P < 5 \times 10^{-4}\text{ Pa}$).
   - Align the primary X-ray source (W-L$\beta$ or Mo-K$\alpha$, $40\text{ kV}, 30\text{ mA}$) below the total reflection critical angle for silicon ($\theta_c \approx 0.09^{\circ}$ to $0.13^{\circ}$) to limit X-ray penetration strictly to the top surface ($\sim 3$ to $5\text{ nm}$).
   - Calibrate detector energy scale using a certified reference multielement wafer standard for $\text{Fe-K}\alpha$ ($6.40\text{ keV}$), $\text{Cu-K}\alpha$ ($8.04\text{ keV}$), and $\text{Ni-K}\alpha$ ($7.47\text{ keV}$).

4. **Multi-Point Surface Fluorescence Acquisition:**
   - Execute a 9-point or 13-point surface map across the wafer (center, half-radius, and edge exclusion boundary).
   - Integrate fluorescence spectrum for $500\text{ s}$ per measurement site to achieve a signal-to-noise ratio sufficient for lower detection limits ($\le 1 \times 10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$).

5. **Spectroscopic Deconvolution & Surface Disposition Reporting:**
   - Deconvolve fluorescent peaks against silicon background bremsstrahlung and substrate artifacts.
   - Compute areal surface concentration ($\text{atoms/cm}^2$) for Iron ($\text{Fe}$), Copper ($\text{Cu}$), and Nickel ($\text{Ni}$).
   - Cross-check defect maps and areal contamination levels against the Gate Oxide Furnace Release Specification.
   - Wafer lots meeting criteria are flagged "PASS" and immediately routed to the quartz tube furnace for dry thermal oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$); lots exceeding criteria are diverted to rework/re-clean.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Critical Transition Metal Areal Density ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{atoms/cm}^2$ | Glancing-angle TXRF ($13$-point map, dwell $\ge 500\text{ s/site}$) |
| **Surface Particle Density ($\ge 0.18\,\mu\text{m}$ LLS)** | $< 0.05$ (or $< 15$ particles on $\varnothing 200\text{ mm}$ wafer) | $\text{defects/cm}^2$ | Laser Surface Particle Scanner (LSPS, $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion) |
| **Post-Oxidation Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$ Proxy)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$ | High-frequency/Quasi-static C-V on oxidation test monitor |
| **Downstream Oxide Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10.0$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Ramp-voltage Time-to-Breakdown (TZDB/TDDB) |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Citations

1. **[Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace](docs/context.yaml):**
   - Confirms that dry oxidation produces high-density gate oxide with critical electrical targets of dielectric breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and minimal interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$ for the 3.5 to 4.0 nm gate dielectric regime.
2. **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering](docs/context.yaml):**
   - Dictates access transistor gate dielectric requirements grown via $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry thermal oxidation at $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
3. **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml):**
   - Establishes the 180nm channel length ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) requiring strict sub-threshold and junction leakage preservation ($< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) to guarantee data refresh cycles, directly mandating the sub-$10^{10}\text{ atoms/cm}^2$ suppression of lifetime-killing metal contaminants ($\text{Fe/Cu/Ni}$).
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Pre-Oxidation Surface Disposition Sign-off and Furnace Boat Loading Authorization

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-THM-180-042`  
**Process Step:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation Surface Disposition Sign-off and Furnace Boat Loading Authorization  
**Technology Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / 0.18 µm)  
**Process Action Type:** Make / Metrology Disposition & Loading Sign-off  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Visual Flow

This procedure governs the quality sign-off of post-RCA surface metrology (TXRF trace metals and surface hydrophobicity/contact angle) and the formal transfer authorization to load conditioned 180nm DRAM wafers onto the three-zone quartz tube furnace boat for 3.5 nm dry gate oxidation.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Post-Clean Surface Metrology Review\n(TXRF & Contact Angle Data)"] --> B{"Disposition Gate Check\n(Spec Compliance)"}
    B -- "Out of Spec" --> C["Hold Lot & Trigger Re-Clean\n(Scrap / Rework Analysis)"]
    B -- "Pass Spec" --> D["Sign-off MES Authorization\n(Lot Traveler Release)"]
    D --> E["Furnace Pre-Check\n(3-Zone Flat Zone Temp & N2 Purge)"]
    E --> F["Robotic Quartz Boat Loading\n(Transfer Rate < 50 mm/min)"]
    F --> G["Initiate Dry Thermal Oxidation\n(850°C-900°C Recipe Execution)"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Pre-Oxidation Clean Metrology Verification
1. Retrieve the automated metrology reports for the incoming wafer lot following RCA clean (`SC-1`, `SC-2`, and dilute `HF` dip).
2. Validate surface cleanliness via Total Reflection X-Ray Fluorescence (TXRF) and contact angle analysis:
   - Verify that metallic contamination (Fe, Cu, Ni) is below detection and contamination limits.
   - Confirm that the final DHF-terminated Si surface displays the required hydrophobic passivation profile prior to furnace introduction.
3. Verify that queue time (*Q-time*) from HF dip completion to furnace staging is within the specified boundary to prevent uncontrolled native oxide growth.

#### Step 2: Quality Disposition Sign-Off & MES Authorization
1. Cross-check metrology results against the target gate dielectric parameters for the 180nm DRAM access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
2. Electronically record and sign off the *Pre-Oxidation Clean Surface Spec Verification and Furnace Loading Disposition Report* in the Manufacturing Execution System (MES).
3. Switch the lot traveler status to **AUTHORIZED_FOR_FURNACE_LOAD**.

#### Step 3: Quartz Tube Furnace Readiness Check
1. Inspect the triple-loop digital PID controller and Type R/S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples across all three furnace heating zones (Load, Center, and Source).
2. Confirm the furnace flat zone stabilizes at standby/loading temperature with thermal uniformity across the 300 mm wafer boat region.
3. Verify laminar carrier gas delivery: confirm MFC-regulated $N_2$ purge flow is maintained between 1 to 5 SLPM to maintain an inert, oxygen-free ambient during the load sequence.

#### Step 4: Furnace Boat Loading Execution
1. Transfer the approved wafer cassettes into the furnace loading station.
2. Initialize the automated quartz boat loader. Ensure the mechanical push/insertion speed is set to $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.
3. Lock the quartz end-cap, verify laminar purge flow, and hand over control to the recipe supervisor for 850°C–900°C dry oxidation ramp.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Inspection / Control Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Zone Temperature Uniformity** | $\pm 0.5$ | °C | Triple-loop digital PID / Type R or S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples across 300 mm flat zone region |
| **Furnace Boat Loading Speed** | $< 50$ | mm/min | Multi-axis automated push/pull robotic paddle servo drive |
| **Carrier Gas Purge Flow Rate** | $1 \text{ to } 5$ | SLPM | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) under laminar flow conditions |
| **Target Gate Oxide Thickness** | $3.5 \text{ to } 4.0$ | nm | Post-oxidation Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Deal-Grove linear regime verification |

---

### 4. Verified Literature & Context Citations

1. **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
   - *PID & Thermal Uniformity*: Triple-loop digital PID control using Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells must maintain $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C.
   - *Gas Flow Dynamics*: Laminar flow of carrier gases ($N_2$ purge, ultra-pure $O_2$, or forming gas) regulated by mass flow controllers (MFC) at 1 to 5 SLPM.
   - *Thermal Shock Prevention*: Wafer boat push/pull mechanical travel velocity must be maintained at $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid crystallographic slip dislocations.
2. **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
   - *Oxide Growth Regime*: Follows $x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$. For the thin 180nm gate dielectric target ($3.5\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$), oxidation operates in the linear reaction-rate-limited regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$) with rate constant $k_l = B/A$.
   - *Electrical Quality Requirement*: Dry $O_2$ oxidation yields high dielectric breakdown ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$.
3. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - *Target Device Integration*: Access transistor channel dimensions of $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and $W = 220\text{ nm}$ requiring strict gate dielectric integrity to keep sub-threshold and junction leakages below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at 85°C.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Quartz Furnace Tube Prep, Multi-Zone Thermal Profiling & MFC Gas Calibration (850°C N2/O2)

- **Document ID:** `SOP-DIFF-180-001`
- **Node Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C) > Quartz Furnace Tube Prep, Multi-Zone Thermal Profiling & MFC Gas Calibration (850°C N2/O2)
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type:** Buy / Qualification

---

### Process Flow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 1: Quartz Tube   │
│   Inspection & Seal    │
│       Integrity        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Step 2: 3-Zone     │
│  Thermal Profiling at  │
│          850C          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 3: Mass Flow    │
│     Controller Gas     │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Step 4: Baseline    │
│       Wafer Boat       │
│      Translation       │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Quartz Tube Inspection & Cleanliness Prep:**
   - Inspect the high-purity fused silica quartz process tube for devitrification, micro-cracks, or particulate deposits.
   - Verify that quartz thermowells housing the Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples are securely seated and free from mechanical binding or thermal stress micro-fractures.
   - Seal the tube flange assembly and establish an ultra-pure nitrogen ($N_2$) carrier purge to purge ambient atmosphere prior to heating.

2. **Multi-Zone Temperature Setup & Profiling at 850°C:**
   - Configure the digital triple-loop PID controller with feedforward decoupling across all three heating zones: **Load**, **Center**, and **Source** (utilizing Kanthal-A1 or MoSi₂ elements).
   - Set the furnace target temperature setpoint to **850°C**.
   - Profile the central **300 mm (30 cm)** wafer boat flat zone using the multi-point Type R/Type S reference thermocouple array.
   - Adjust zone trim power to balance convective end-losses at the Load and Source ends until isothermal conditions are reached across the central 300 mm flat zone.

3. **Mass Flow Controller (MFC) Gas Calibration ($N_2$ and $O_2$):**
   - Connect the downstream calibration transfer standard to the process gas lines.
   - Calibrate the $N_2$ purge line MFC and ultra-pure $O_2$ line MFC across their operational laminar flow range of **1 to 5 SLPM**.
   - Confirm linear MFC response, leak-tight seat shutoff, and flow repeatability at operating pressure under stable laminar flow dynamics.

4. **Boat Loader Mechanical Speed Verification:**
   - Command the automated wafer boat loader through full insertion and withdrawal cycles under operating idle conditions.
   - Calibrate push/pull drive servos to ensure translation velocity remains strictly below the anti-shock threshold ($< 50\text{ mm/min}$) across the entire travel stroke to suppress crystallographic slip dislocations.

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\le \pm 0.5$** | **°C** | 3-Zone profiling array (Type R / Type S thermocouple) across 300 mm flat zone |
| **Wafer Boat Translation Velocity** | **$< 50$** | **mm/min** | Optical encoder / mechanical loader drive controller |
| **Process Gas Flow Rate Range ($N_2$ / $O_2$)** | **1.0 to 5.0** | **SLPM** | Calibrated thermal Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) |
| **Isothermal Flat Zone Length** | **$\ge 300$** | **mm** (30 cm) | Multi-point profiling along central tube axis |

```text
                       │░░                             │

                       0.0    12.5   25.0    37.5  50.0 
```

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Source: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**
  - Multi-zone heating (Load, Center, Source) via Kanthal-A1 or MoSi₂ coils and triple-loop digital PID with feedforward decoupling.
  - Type R / Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells.
  - Temperature uniformity requirement: **$\pm 0.5$°C** across the central **300 mm** wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C.
  - Laminar gas flow regulation via MFCs at **1 to 5 SLPM** for $N_2$ purge and ultra-pure $O_2$.
  - Mechanical boat travel velocity limit: **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
  - High-purity fused silica quartz process tube with 3-zone PID controller sustaining **$\pm 0.5$°C** over a **30 cm** flat zone for thermal oxide growth.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-DIFF-180NM-001`  
**Title:** Quartz Tube RCA-Clean, Bake-Out & MFC Flow Calibration ($N_2/O_2$)  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip — Thermal Processing & Gate Dielectric Formation  
**Furnace Type:** Horizontal 3-Zone Fused Quartz Tube ($150\text{ mm}$–$200\text{ mm}$ OD, $99.999\%\text{ SiO}_2$)

---

### Process Execution Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Stage 1: Quartz Ware  │
│    RCA Wet Cleaning    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Stage 2: High Purity  │
│       Gas Sweep        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Stage 3: Thermal    │
│      Bake Out and      │
│       Profiling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Stage 4: MFC Flow    │
│   Calibration N2 and   │
│           O2           │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Stage 1: Quartz Ware RCA Wet Chemical Cleaning
1. **SC-1 (Standard Clean 1) Bath Preparation:**
   - Formulate chemical ratio of $5\text{ parts UPW} : 1\text{ part } 29\%\text{ NH}_4\text{OH} : 1\text{ part } 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$ in a high-purity immersion bath.
   - Heat the solution to **$70^\circ\text{C}$ to $75^\circ\text{C}$** with active megasonic agitation at **$1\text{ MHz}$**.
   - Submerge the quartz tube and wafer boat for **$10\text{ minutes}$** to oxidize organics and strip surface micro-particulates via zeta potential repulsion.
2. **Cascade Dump Rinse:**
   - Execute **$5\text{ cycles}$** of Cascade Dump Rinse using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ Ultra-Pure Water (UPW). Continue rinsing until dump bath resistivity exceeds **$> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**.
3. **Native Oxide / Surface Etch Strip (Dilute HF):**
   - Immerse quartz ware in dilute hydrofluoric acid ($1:50$ to $1:100\text{ HF}:\text{UPW}$, $0.5\%$ to $1.0\%\text{ HF}$) for **$15\text{ to } 30\text{ seconds}$** at **$22^\circ\text{C}$** until complete hydrophobic dewetting is verified.
   - Perform final cascade UPW rinse and dry thoroughly with filtered hot $N_2$.

### Stage 2: Tube Installation & Inert Gas Sweep
1. **Tube Mounting & Alignment:**
   - Mount the cleaned $99.999\%\text{ SiO}_2$ fused quartz tube into the 3-zone furnace shell (Kanthal-A1 or APM alloy coils across Source, Center, and Load zones).
   - Insert dual Type R/S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells into each zone.
2. **Purge Initiation:**
   - Establish an ultra-pure carrier gas sweep ($N_2$, $99.999\%$ purity) via calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) at **$2.0\text{ to } 5.0\text{ SLPM}$** laminar velocity to prevent ambient back-diffusion. Add $1\text{–}3\%\text{ dry HCl}$ during initial bake-out steps to passivate mobile $\text{Na}^+$ ions and volatilize residual metallic impurities.

### Stage 3: High-Temperature Bake-Out & Thermal Profiling
1. **Ramp-Up Schedule:**
   - Ramp the 3-zone digital PID controller through decoupled loops from idle to bake-out temperatures between **$850^\circ\text{C}$ and $1150^\circ\text{C}$** (up to $1200^\circ\text{C}$ ceiling).
2. **Thermal Flat Zone Stabilization:**
   - Soak at target temperature to desorb entrapped hydroxyl groups and moisture from the fused quartz walls.
   - Fine-tune feedforward PID power trims across Source and Load zones to eliminate convective end-losses and maintain isothermal equilibrium.
3. **Thermal Shock Mitigation:**
   - Restrict quartz boat mechanical push/pull speed to **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** during all insertion and withdrawal maneuvers to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.

### Stage 4: Multi-Point MFC Flow Calibration ($N_2$ / $O_2$)
1. **Zero Point & Span Baseline Calibration:**
   - Check electrical zero point on the thermal mass flow controllers with upstream isolation valves closed.
2. **Multi-Point Flow Verification:**
   - Regulate ultra-pure $N_2$ and dry $O_2$ ($99.999\%$ purity) sequentially across the operating sweep band from **$1.0\text{ SLPM}$ to $5.0\text{ SLPM}$** (specifically calibrating setpoints at $1.0$, $2.0$, $3.5$, and $5.0\text{ SLPM}$).
   - Verify downstream mass displacement to maintain steady-state laminar gas velocity through the tube cross-section without turbulence.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                      Process Baseline Thresholds       
               ┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
               │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
 RCA Clean Temp┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
               │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │
     Boat Speed┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒             │
 Gas Flow Sweep┤▓▓▓▓                                   │
               │▓▓▓▓                                   │
Temp Uniformity┤█                                      │
               │█                                      │
               └┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬┘
               0.0      18.8     37.5      56.2    75.0 
```

| Parameter Metric | Target Specification | Exact Engineering Units | Verification Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Center Flat Zone Thermal Uniformity** | $\le \pm 0.5$ across $\ge 300\text{ mm}$ (up to $350\text{ mm}$) | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Profiling Type R/S Pt-Pt/Rh Thermocouple Array |
| **Laminar Process Sweep Flow Rate ($N_2 / O_2$)** | $2.0 \text{ to } 5.0$ (range: $1.0 \text{ to } 5.0$) | $\text{SLPM}$ | Calibrated Digital Thermal MFC Flow Transducer |
| **Wafer Boat Insertion / Withdrawal Speed** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Automated Stepper Lead-Screw Boat Loader |
| **RCA Dump Rinse Final Resistivity** | $> 16.0$ (Baseline: $18.2$) | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-Line Resistivity Sensor at Dump Rinse Outlet |

---

## 3. Literature Citations & Physical Constraints

- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation:**
  - *Temperature Uniformity:* Must maintain $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across central $300\text{ mm}$ boat region ($800^\circ\text{C}\text{–}1150^\circ\text{C}$).
  - *Gas Delivery Dynamics:* MFC-regulated laminar gas sweep between $1.0\text{ and } 5.0\text{ SLPM}$.
  - *Thermal Shock Barrier:* Push/pull speed strictly $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid crystallographic slip.
  - *Sensors:* Dual Type R/S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples in quartz thermowells.
- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery:**
  - *Furnace Tube Material:* Fused quartz ($150\text{ mm}$ to $200\text{ mm}$ OD, $99.999\%\text{ SiO}_2$).
  - *Zonal Division & Uniformity:* Source, Center, and Load zones maintaining flat profile $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across $350\text{ mm}$ at $1000^\circ\text{C}\text{ to } 1200^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Gas Sweep & Purge Chemistry:* Laminar sweep of $2.0\text{ to } 5.0\text{ SLPM}$ ultra-pure $O_2$ ($99.999\%$), $N_2$, and $1\text{–}3\%\text{ dry HCl}$ to inhibit air back-diffusion and volatilize $\text{Na}^+$ ions.
- **RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering:**
  - *SC-1 Formulation:* $5\text{ UPW} : 1\text{ NH}_4\text{OH} (29\%) : 1\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2 (30\%)$ at $70^\circ\text{C}\text{–}75^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ minutes}$ with $1\text{ MHz}$ megasonics.
  - *Rinse & Strip Targets:* 5-cycle cascade dump rinse to $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ (UPW source $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$); $1:50$ to $1:100\text{ HF}$ dip for $15\text{–}30\text{ seconds}$ at $22^\circ\text{C}$.
citations: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation (Levinson - Principles of Lithography & Thermal Processing)
Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery (Thermco / Bruce Technologies Semiconductor Furnace Manual)
RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Quartz Process Tube RCA-1/RCA-2 Wet Decontamination & Megasonic DI Rinse

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Immersion / Spray    │
│         RCA-1          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Intermediate DI     │
│         Rinse          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   1:50 HF Oxide Etch   │
│          Dip           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       RCA-2 Wet        │
│    Decontamination     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       Megasonic        │
│  High-Purity DI Rinse  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     High-Purity N2     │
│        Blow-Dry        │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **RCA-1 (SC-1) Organic Decontamination & Light Metal Oxidation**:
   - Prepare the SC-1 cleaning mixture in a chemical-duty tank with a volumetric ratio of `5 : 1 : 1` (5 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Ammonium Hydroxide [$29\%\text{ NH}_4\text{OH}$], 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide [$30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$]).
   - Heat and stabilize the solution at **70°C to 80°C**.
   - Submerge/expose the quartz process tube into the bath for **10 to 15 minutes** to solubilize organic surface films and oxidize light trace metal contaminants.

2. **Intermediate Dump Rinse**:
   - Transfer the quartz process tube immediately into the dump rinse station.
   - Execute a dump rinse cycle using **18.2 MΩ·cm** deionized water for **3 minutes** to wash off residual ammonia and peroxide.

3. **Hydrofluoric Acid (HF) Native Oxide Strip**:
   - Immerse the quartz tube in a **1:50 $\text{HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$** dilute solution for **15 to 30 seconds**.
   - Strip the thin native oxide layer until the surface transitions cleanly from hydrophilic to hydrophobic.

4. **RCA-2 (SC-2) Ionic & Heavy Metal Decontamination**:
   - Prepare the SC-2 cleaning mixture with a volumetric ratio of `6 : 1 : 1` (6 parts Deionized $\text{H}_2\text{O}$, 1 part Hydrochloric Acid [$37\%\text{ HCl}$], 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide [$30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$]).
   - Heat and maintain the bath temperature at **70°C to 80°C**.
   - Expose the quartz tube for **10 minutes** to eliminate alkali ions ($\text{Na}^+$, $\text{K}^+$) and heavy metal contaminants ($\text{Fe}$, $\text{Cu}$, $\text{Ni}$).

5. **Megasonic Deionized Water Final Rinse**:
   - Transfer the tube to the high-purity DI overflow tank with active megasonic transducer assistance.
   - Flush continuously with **18.2 MΩ·cm** DI water until the resistivity reaches steady state.

6. **Drying**:
   - Perform a final drying blow-down using filtered high-purity Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) gas.

---

### Target Parameter Metrics

```text
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │●●●●●●●●●                           │
```
