# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-DIFF-180-007`
**Title:** High-Temp Quartz Furnace Vacuum Bake-Out & Outgassing Desorption Cycle (1000°C)  
**Process Step:** 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Thermal Oxidation Tube Prep  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm) | **Action Type:** Buy / Facility Qualification

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Chamber Evacuation &  │
│       Leak Check       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Ramp to 1000C under   │
│       N2/Vacuum        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Isothermal High-Temp  │
│    Desorption Soak     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Controlled Ramp-Down  │
│      to Idle 800C      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Check & Quartz Tube Sealing:**
   - Confirm RCA cleaning and drying of the quartz tube and silicon carbide/quartz cantilever boat have concluded.
   - Inspect Type R/Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples in their quartz thermowells across Load, Center, and Source zones.
   - Insert empty quartz boat carrier via the mechanical transfer mechanism at a rate strictly under $50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent mechanical stress. Seal furnace end-flange.

2. **Chamber Purge & Vacuum Integrity Check:**
   - Flow ultra-high-purity (UHP) $\text{N}_2$ through the calibrated mass flow controller (MFC) at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ to establish laminar purge flow and displace ambient air.
   - Isolate purge or throttle vacuum line using the mechanical booster roots pump system to verify chamber seal integrity and baseline base pressure.

3. **Multi-Zone Temperature Ramp-Up (to 1000°C):**
   - Initialize triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling across Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ heating coils (Load, Center, Source).
   - Ramp tube temperature from idle ($800^\circ\text{C}$) to the peak desorption temperature of $1000^\circ\text{C}$ under continuous laminar $\text{N}_2$ purge ($1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$) at a controlled rate ($\le 5^\circ\text{C/min}$).

4. **Isothermal Bake-Out & Outgassing Desorption Soak:**
   - Dwell at $1000^\circ\text{C}$ for the designated desorption period to thermally outgas residual moisture ($\text{H}_2\text{O}$), hydroxyls, and volatile organic contaminants from the quartz tube inner wall.
   - Ensure dynamic triple-loop PID regulation keeps temperature uniform across the central $300\text{ mm}$ flat zone.

5. **Ramp-Down to Idle State:**
   - Ramp down furnace zones from $1000^\circ\text{C}$ to the idle holding temperature of $800^\circ\text{C}$ to $850^\circ\text{C}$ (prior to dry oxidation recipe introduction).
   - Maintain continuous carrier $\text{N}_2$ laminar flow at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ to prevent back-streaming of atmospheric contaminants.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Inspection / Telemetry Method | Target Specification | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isothermal Flat Zone Uniformity** | Multi-zone Type R/S Platinum-Rhodium Thermocouple profiling | $\pm 0.5$ across $300\text{ mm}$ central boat zone | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Peak Desorption Temperature** | Triple-loop digital PID furnace controller | $1000$ (operational range $800 - 1150$) | $^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Carrier Gas Laminar Flow Rate** | Calibrated Thermal Mass Flow Controller (MFC) | $1.0\text{ to }5.0$ | $\text{SLPM}$ |
| **Boat Mechanical Travel Speed** | Automated cantilever push/pull motor encoder | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ |

---

### 3. Literature Context Citations

- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation:**
  - Multi-zone heating (Load, Center, Source with Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ elements) and triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling.
  - Temperature uniformity requirement of $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across central $300\text{ mm}$ boat region over the $800^\circ\text{C} - 1150^\circ\text{C}$ regime using Type R or S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples.
  - Laminar carrier gas flow regulated by MFC at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
  - Wafer boat mechanical push/pull speed limit of $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Dry oxidation regime background conditions ($900^\circ\text{C} - 1000^\circ\text{C}$ dry $\text{O}_2$, target $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ gate oxide dielectric, $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).
- **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks:**
  - Vacuum booster roots pumping systems and vacuum seal integrity considerations.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-DIFF-MET-004`
**Title:** Ultra-High Purity N2/O2 Mass Flow Controller (MFC) Dynamic Flow Calibration & Leak Rate Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) > Horizontal Quartz Furnace Dry O2 Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C, Pure O2/N2 Dilution) > Quartz Furnace Tube Prep, Multi-Zone Thermal Profiling & MFC Gas Calibration (850°C N2/O2) > Quartz Tube RCA-Clean, Bake-Out & MFC Flow Calibration (N2/O2) > Ultra-High Purity N2/O2 Mass Flow Controller (MFC) Dynamic Flow Calibration & Leak Rate Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This procedure governs dynamic in-situ flow calibration and helium mass spectrometer / pressure rate-of-rise leak verification for Ultra-High Purity (UHP) carrier and process gas Mass Flow Controllers ($\text{N}_2$ purge and ultra-pure $\text{O}_2$) dedicated to the horizontal quartz tube dry gate oxide furnace ($t_{ox} = 3.5\text{--}4.0\text{ nm}$).

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Reference Standards
- NIST-traceable Molbloc/Molbox or dry piston displacement gas calibrator (working range: 0.5 to 10.0 SLPM).
- Portable Helium Mass Spectrometer Leak Detector (sniffing and vacuum hood modes).
- Capacitance Diaphragm Gauge (CDG) manifold (range: 0.1 mTorr to 1000 Torr).
- 316L VCR UHP manifold isolation valves and particulate filters ($0.003\ \mu\text{m}$).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 1: Pre-Calibration Gas Line Purge & Environmental Soak |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 2: External & Internal Seat Leak Rate Verification     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 3: Multi-Point Dynamic Flow Calibration (1 to 5 SLPM)  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
                              |
                              v
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
| Step 4: Step Response & Zero-Stability Drift Verification   |
+-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Pre-Calibration Gas Line Purge & Environmental Soak
1. Connect the NIST-traceable flow calibrator downstream of the gas delivery panel using electropolished 316L SS VCR lines.
2. Cycle-purge the delivery manifolds 10 times alternating between dry UHP $\text{N}_2$ (99.9999% purity) at 30 psig and turbo-molecular vacuum evacuation ($< 1\times 10^{-3}\text{ Torr}$).
3. Energize the thermal/pressure-based MFC control electronics for at least 60 minutes prior to calibration to achieve internal thermal equilibrium.

#### Step 2: External & Internal Seat Leak Rate Verification
1. **External Boundary Leak Check:** Enclose all MFC body seals, VCR gaskets, and upstream/downstream welds in a flexible helium shroud. Pressurize lines to 30 psig with UHP He and verify external leak rate using the mass spectrometer leak detector.
2. **Internal Shutoff Valve Seat Leakage Check:** Close the MFC integrated shutoff solenoid/piezo valve with upstream line pressurized at 30 psig. Evacuate the downstream test volume to $< 100\text{ mTorr}$, isolate the vacuum pump, and measure downstream pressure rise rate over a 10-minute hold using the high-accuracy CDG.

#### Step 3: Multi-Point Dynamic Flow Calibration (1 to 5 SLPM)
1. Set upstream gas supply pressure to regulated recipe operating pressure (typically 30.0 psig ± 0.5 psig).
2. Command the MFC controller through a 5-point calibration ladder within the validated furnace laminar flow envelope:
   - Point 1: 1.0 SLPM (20% of 5 SLPM full scale)
   - Point 2: 2.0 SLPM (40% of full scale)
   - Point 3: 3.0 SLPM (60% of full scale)
   - Point 4: 4.0 SLPM (80% of full scale)
   - Point 5: 5.0 SLPM (100% of full scale)
3. Allow each setpoint to stabilize for 60 seconds. Record the standard volumetric flow rate ($Q_{std}$ at 0°C, 101.325 kPa) from the primary reference calibrator against the MFC electrical analog/digital feedback signal.
4. Calculate flow error:
   $$\text{Error} (\%) = \frac{Q_{\text{indicated}} - Q_{\text{reference}}}{\text{Full Scale (5 SLPM)}} \times 100$$
5. Perform linear interpolation adjustment in the tool recipe controller if calibration drift exceeds permissible acceptance criteria.

#### Step 4: Step Response & Zero-Stability Drift Verification
1. Command a step transition from 0 to 5.0 SLPM and record the time to reach within ±1.0% of final target value.
2. Command setpoint back to 0.0 SLPM, wait 30 seconds, and measure the zero-flow signal drift over a 15-minute continuous monitoring window.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Calibrated Gas Flow Range** | $1.0\text{ to }5.0$ | $\text{SLPM}$ | NIST-traceable primary flow calibrator |
| **Flow Accuracy across 1–5 SLPM** | $\le \pm 1.0\%$ | $\%$ of Full Scale (5 SLPM) | Multi-point calibration average deviation |
| **MFC Integrated Seat Leak Rate** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{-6}$ | $\text{atm}\cdot\text{cm}^3/\text{sec (scc/sec He)}$ | Pressure rate-of-rise via CDG |
| **External Envelope Leak Rate** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{-9}$ | $\text{atm}\cdot\text{cm}^3/\text{sec (scc/sec He)}$ | Vacuum/shroud He mass spectrometer |
| **Flow Step Settling Time** | $< 2.0$ | $\text{seconds}$ | Step-response tracking (0 to 5 SLPM setpoint) |

---

### 5. Context Citations & Technical Justification
- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation:** Direct source for the furnace gas flow dynamics, mandating laminar carrier gas flow ($\text{N}_2$ purge, ultra-pure $\text{O}_2$) regulated by Mass Flow Controllers within the **$1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$** range to preserve uniform gas phase boundary layers without disrupting the isothermal zone.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:** Establishes the dry thermal oxidation process context where gate oxide thickness targets of **$3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$** require strictly repeatable, precise delivery of pure dry $\text{O}_2$ to maintain linear rate constant ($k_l = B/A$) stability and minimize interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Three-Zone PID Thermal Flat-Zone Profiling at 850°C (±0.5°C Uniformity)

---

### 1. Process Overview & Visual Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Purge Quartz Tube    │
│   with N2 at 2.0-5.0   │
│          SLPM          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Ramp 3 Heating Zones  │
│        to 850°C        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Stabilize Profile    │
│     Dual Type-R/S      │
│     Thermocouples      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Fine-tune Source and  │
│    Load PID Offsets    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Verify Center Flat   │
│   Zone +/-0.5°C over   │
│         300 mm         │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Purge & Gas Environment Stabilization**:
   - Establish a continuous, laminar carrier sweep of ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ through the fused quartz process tube (OD 150 mm to 200 mm, 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$) via the calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** to prevent ambient air back-diffusion.

2. **Furnace Setup & Thermocouple Verification**:
   - Verify proper positioning and signal integrity of the dual Type-R or Type-S Platinum-Rhodium ($\text{Pt}$-$\text{Pt}/\text{Rh}$) thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells across all three zones: **Source Zone** (gas inlet), **Center Zone** (wafer process flat zone), and **Load Zone** (door end).
   - Ensure wafer boat mechanical push/pull speed is set to **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to prevent mechanical vibration and thermal shock.

3. **Thermal Ramp & PID Baseline Setpoint**:
   - Energize the resistive heating element coils (Kanthal A1 / APM / MoSi$_2$) via the triple-loop digital PID temperature controller.
   - Ramp all three zones up to the target baseline setpoint of **850°C**.

4. **Multi-Zone Profiling & PID Offset Optimization**:
   - Allow the furnace to reach thermal equilibrium at 850°C.
   - Read the profile thermocouple array across the central wafer boat region.
   - Adjust feedforward decoupling and PID power output offsets on the **Source** and **Load** zones relative to the **Center** zone to counteract convective gas cooling at the inlet and radiative/convective heat losses at the furnace door.

5. **Isothermal Flat-Zone Confirmation**:
   - Record temperature measurements across a minimum span of **300 mm** (up to 350 mm) in the center zone over a 30-minute steady-state window.
   - Confirm thermal variation remains strictly within **$\pm 0.5\text{°C}$**.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text

                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
Flat-Zone Length┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │░░░░░░                                │
 Boat Push Speed┤░░░░░░                                │
    Gas N2 Sweep┤▒                                     │
                │▒                                     │
 Zone Uniformity┤█                                     │
                │█                                     │
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                 0       75        150      225     300 
```

| Parameter | Target Specification | Measurement Method / Tooling |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Center Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\le \pm 0.5\text{ °C}$** across $\ge 300\text{ mm}$ (up to $350\text{ mm}$) | Multi-point profiling Type-R/S thermocouple array |
| **Process Setpoint Temperature** | **$850.0\text{ °C}$** steady-state at center flat zone | Dual Type-R / Type-S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples in quartz thermowell |
| **Purge Gas Laminar Flow Rate** | **$2.0\text{ to }5.0\text{ SLPM}$** ($\text{N}_2$) | Digital Mass Flow Controller (MFC) |
| **Wafer Boat Drive Speed** | **$< 50\text{ mm/min}$** | Mechanical boat loader axis encoder / tachometer |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Sources

- **Source 1**: *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery*
  - Fused quartz process tube (OD 150 mm–200 mm, 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$); Kanthal A1/APM heating elements; Source/Center/Load zone division; dual Type-R/S thermocouples; digital PID control; center flat zone $\le \pm 0.5\text{°C}$ across 350 mm; laminar gas sweep rate 2.0 to 5.0 SLPM.
- **Source 2**: *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation*
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling; Type-R/S thermocouples in quartz thermowells; $\pm 0.5\text{°C}$ temperature uniformity across 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C; 1 to 5 SLPM MFC gas flow; boat drive speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip.
- **Source 3**: *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*
  - Fused silica tube with 3-zone PID controller maintaining $\pm 0.5\text{°C}$ over 30 cm flat zone.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP Title: Type-S Quartz Thermocouple Profiling Rig Setup & PID Baseline Tuning at 850°C
**Process Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C) > Horizontal Quartz Furnace Dry O2 Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C) > Quartz Furnace Tube Prep, Multi-Zone Thermal Profiling & MFC Gas Calibration > Three-Zone PID Thermal Flat-Zone Profiling at 850°C (±0.5°C Uniformity)  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type**: Make  

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Inspect Type-S     │
│  Quartz Thermocouple  │
│          Rig          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Insert Rig via     │
│    Cantilever Boat    │
│        Loader         │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Establish Pure N2   │
│      Purge Flow       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Execute Three-Zone   │
│  Baseline Tuning at   │
│         850°C         │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Log Flat-Zone     │
│  Uniformity & Verify  │
│       Criteria        │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Rig Pre-Inspection & Assembly**:
   - Inspect the profiling rig comprising multi-junction Type-S (Platinum-Rhodium) thermocouples encased in high-purity fused silica quartz thermowells.
   - Verify junction placement spans the Load, Center, and Source heating zones across the central 300 mm (30 cm) wafer boat region.
   - Connect the Type-S reference junctions to the triple-loop digital PID profiling acquisition module.

2. **Furnace Insertion & Thermal Shock Prevention**:
   - Position the quartz profiling rig onto the cantilever paddle/boat support.
   - Initiate motorized cantilever push into the high-purity quartz process tube at a mechanical insertion speed strictly controlled to $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid mechanical deformation and thermal shock.
   - Seal the tube end-cap flange and engage the process exhaust.

3. **Atmosphere Stabilization via MFC**:
   - Establish a laminar carrier gas flow by setting the ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ mass flow controller (MFC) between $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
   - Ensure tube pressure and flow dynamics stabilize before initiating high-temperature ramp sequences.

4. **PID Baseline Tuning & Feedforward Decoupling**:
   - Set the multi-zone digital PID controller setpoints to $850^\circ\text{C}$ across all three zones (Load, Center, Source).
   - Engage feedforward decoupling loops on the Load and Source zones to compensate for convective end-losses against the central flat zone.
   - Allow furnace temperature to stabilize at steady state for a minimum of 60 minutes.

5. **Thermal Flat-Zone Profiling & Verification**:
   - Acquire temperature data simultaneously across all profiling junctions.
   - Verify that all points along the 300 mm central wafer flat zone remain within target tolerance.
   - Upon completion, retract the thermocouple rig at $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Rig Mechanical Insertion / Retraction Speed** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Cantilever Drive Encoder / Controller Log |
| **Carrier Gas ($\text{N}_2$ Purge) Flow Rate** | $1 \text{ to } 5$ | $\text{SLPM}$ | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) Log |
| **Flat-Zone Length** | $300$ ($30$) | $\text{mm}$ ($\text{cm}$) | Profiling Rig Junction Map & Quartz Tube Layout |
| **Temperature Flat-Zone Uniformity at 850°C** | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-point Type-S Thermocouple Acquisition Data |

---

### Literature Citations

- **Source: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
  - *Heating & Thermocouples*: Fused silica quartz thermowells encasing Platinum-Rhodium (Type S or Type R) thermocouples across Load, Center, and Source zones; triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling.
  - *Uniformity & Flat Zone*: Maintaining $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region between $800^\circ\text{C}$ and $1150^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Gas Dynamics*: Regulated laminar carrier gas flow at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ via mass flow controller (MFC).
  - *Thermal Shock Prevention*: Cantilever boat motion speed strictly $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - *Furnace Equipment*: High-purity fused silica quartz process tube with 3-zone PID temperature control maintaining $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ over a $30\text{ cm}$ ($300\text{ mm}$) flat zone.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Multi-Zone Dynamic Feedforward Loop Optimization for 300 mm Flat Zone (±0.5°C)

**Module:** Thermal Oxidation / 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth  
**Document ID:** SOP-DIFF-OX-007  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm DRAM  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Architecture

Maintaining strict thermal uniformity across the 300 mm central wafer flat zone is critical for dry gate oxide thickness repeatability ($3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$, $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$). This procedure optimizes the triple-loop digital PID temperature controller by tuning the feedforward decoupling gain matrices across Load, Center, and Source heating zones to suppress convective and radiative end losses during gas switching and wafer boat transfers.

```mermaid
graph TD
    A["Initialize Furnace & Profiling Spike TC"] --> B["Establish Laminar Carrier Gas Baseline (N2 1-5 SLPM)"]
    B --> C["Dynamic Disturbance Injection (Gas Flow & Ramp)"]
    C --> D["Measure Cross-Coupled Thermal Gradients"]
    D --> E["Tune Multi-Zone Feedforward Decoupling Matrix"]
    E --> F["Perform Dynamic Verification Sweep at 850°C"]
    F --> G["Lock Production Thermal Profile (±0.5°C)"]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Check & Thermocouple Setup:**
   - Verify that quartz thermowells house calibrated Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples across Load, Center, and Source zones.
   - Insert a profile thermocouple test rake spanning the central 300 mm wafer boat region inside the fused silica process tube.
   - Set furnace baseline setpoint to $850^\circ\text{C}$ on all three zones.

2. **Carrier Gas Flow Stabilization:**
   - Establish a steady laminar carrier gas flow using Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) calibrated between $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ ($N_2$ purge baseline).
   - Verify chamber pressure stability and confirm laminar boundary layer flow across the tube cross-section.

3. **Feedforward Decoupling Matrix Parameter Identification:**
   - Inject step-disturbances via MFC gas transitions (switching from $N_2$ to dry $O_2$ at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$).
   - Measure thermal transient droop across the Load zone (gas inlet/convective cooling) and Source zone (exhaust radiative loss).
   - Calculate cross-zone coupling coefficients ($K_{Load\to Center}$, $K_{Source\to Center}$). Adjust feedforward gain in the digital triple-loop PID controller so power compensation applies concurrently with gas valve actuation before Center zone error manifests.

4. **Boat Motion Thermal Shock & Feedforward Compensation:**
   - Configure mechanical wafer boat push/pull insertion mechanism to a speed strictly $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
   - Characterize heat sink load as the boat enters the Load zone. Map dynamic feedforward power boost to the Load zone heater (Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$) synchronized with boat motor travel position.

5. **Closed-Loop Verification & Lock:**
   - Execute a full thermal recipe cycle at $850^\circ\text{C}$ simulating process conditions.
   - Log profile thermocouple data across the entire 300 mm boat area for $\ge 30\text{ minutes}$.
   - Ensure deviations remain within the $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ window before certifying the furnace tube for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry thermal gate oxidation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Thermal Flat Zone & Dynamic Feedforward Target Specs
                           ┌───────────────────────────┐
                           │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
           Flat Zone Length┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                           │▒                          │
     Carrier Gas Flow (MFC)┤▒                          │
       Boat Push/Pull Speed┤▓▓▓▓▓                      │
                           │▓▓▓▓▓                      │
Temp Uniformity (Flat Zone)┤█                          │
                           │█                          │
                           └┬──────┬─────┬──────┬─────┬┘
                            0     75    150    225  300 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Value / Specification | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** across $300\text{ mm}$ boat zone | Type R / Type S profile thermocouple rake |
| **Isothermal Flat-Zone Length** | **$\ge 300\text{ mm}$** ($30\text{ cm}$) central zone | Multi-point quartz profile probe |
| **Carrier Gas Mass Flow Rate** | **$1.0\text{ to }5.0\text{ SLPM}$** | Calibrated thermal MFC readback |
| **Wafer Boat Translation Speed** | **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** | Motorized cantilever push/pull drive encoder |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation:**
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling across Load, Center, and Source zones with Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ elements.
  - Temperature uniformity requirement of $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region ($800^\circ\text{C}$ to $1150^\circ\text{C}$).
  - Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells.
  - Laminar gas flow regulation via MFC at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
  - Mechanical boat push/pull speed limit of $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - High-purity quartz process tube (fused silica) with 3-zone PID controller maintaining $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ over $30\text{ cm}$ ($300\text{ mm}$) flat zone.
  - Interface dielectric target: $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ dry oxide ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Steady-State In-Situ Profiling & Thermal Flat-Zone Metrology under 5 SLPM $\text{N}_2$ Purge  
**Context:** DRAM Foundation VN | 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip | Thermal Oxidation Module  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology  

---

### Metrology & Control Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   1. N2 Purge Init 5   │
│          SLPM          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘

│                        │

│   3. In-Situ Quartz    │

│                        │
│   5. Metrology Audit   │
│  +-0.5 C across 300mm  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Purge & MFC Baseline Verification**:
   - Establish steady laminar carrier flow by configuring the Mass Flow Controller (MFC) to deliver ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ at exactly **$5\text{ SLPM}$** into the horizontal quartz furnace tube.
   - Verify downstream exhaust back-pressure and tube sealing integrity under continuous purge.

2. **Thermal Soak & Multi-Zone Stabilization**:
   - Power the furnace heating elements (Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ coils) across all three zones: **Load**, **Center**, and **Source**.
   - Engage the triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling to ramp the furnace to **$850^\circ\text{C}$**.
   - Hold at $850^\circ\text{C}$ for a minimum soak stabilization period under $5\text{ SLPM }\text{N}_2$ flow until convective end-losses reach steady-state equilibrium.

3. **In-Situ Profiling Assembly Insertion**:
   - Verify the multi-junction in-situ profiling thermocouple wand (Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium) encased in high-purity quartz thermowells.
   - Insert the calibration assembly / dummy wafer boat into the quartz tube using the mechanical cantilever paddle drive at a controlled speed strictly **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and mechanical vibration.

4. **Multi-Point In-Situ Flat-Zone Metrology**:
   - Map temperature readings across the central **$300\text{ mm}$** wafer boat region.
   - Record continuous thermal profiles at defined axial intervals to evaluate convective offsets induced by the $5\text{ SLPM }\text{N}_2$ laminar stream between the gas inlet (Source) and exhaust/door (Load).

5. **Feedforward Decoupling Adjustment & Final Sign-Off**:
   - Tune individual zone trim offsets (Load Zone bias $\Delta T_{\text{Load}}$ and Source Zone bias $\Delta T_{\text{Source}}$ relative to the Center Zone) on the multi-loop PID controller.
   - Re-acquire profile data to verify that the central $300\text{ mm}$ flat zone maintains target uniformity prior to initiating dry gate oxidation recipes ($3.5\text{ nm }\text{SiO}_2$).

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Purge Gas Flow Rate** | `5.0` | $\text{SLPM}$ ($\text{N}_2$) | Steady laminar setpoint ($1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ envelope) |
| **Nominal Soak Temperature** | `850.0` | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Operating setpoint within $800^\circ\text{C} - 1150^\circ\text{C}$ furnace range |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | `±0.5` | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Maintained across central $\mathbf{300\text{ mm}}$ wafer boat region |
| **Boat Drive Insertion/Withdrawal Speed** | `< 50` | $\text{mm/min}$ | Hard maximum velocity to prevent thermal shock / slip dislocations |

---

### 3. Context Citations

* **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
  - *Zones & Elements*: Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal molybdenum disilicide ($\text{MoSi}_2$) coils divided into Load, Center, and Source zones.
  - *Thermocouples & Instrumentation*: Platinum-Rhodium Type R or Type S thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells; triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling.
  - *Thermal Flat Zone*: Requirement to maintain $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region within $800^\circ\text{C} - 1150^\circ\text{C}$.
  - *Gas Dynamics*: Regulated laminar carrier gas purge ($\text{N}_2$) via MFC within $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
  - *Thermal Shock Prevention*: Mechanical push/pull boat ramp rate constrained to $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid crystallographic slip dislocations.
* **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Validates downstream gate dielectric target ($3.5\text{ nm }\text{SiO}_2$ for 180nm node) requiring steady-state thermal flat-zone precision at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Thermocouple Spike Validation & Baseline Oxide Growth Metrology
**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB1-OX-180NM-006`  
**Classification:** Technical / Standard Operating Procedure (Gen 1 mm / 180nm Node)  
**Parent Process:** Horizontal Quartz Furnace Dry $\text{O}_2$ Oxidation Recipe Execution ($850^\circ\text{C}$, Pure $\text{O}_2/\text{N}_2$ Dilution)

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Pre-Furnace Setup    │
│     and Test Wafer     │
│        Loading         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Spike Profile      │
│   Insertion and PID    │
│   Thermal Balancing    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      850°C N2 Flow     │
│   Stabilization and    │
│    Dry O2 Oxidation    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Controlled Boat     │
│     Extraction and     │
│        Cooling         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  In-Line Ellipsometry  │
│     and Thickness      │
│       Metrology        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Furnace Inspection & Monitor Wafer Loading**:
   - Inspect the fused quartz tube (outer diameter 150 mm to 200 mm, 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$ purity) and quartz thermowells for particulate contamination or devitrification.
   - Load pre-cleaned prime p-type test monitor wafers into the slotted quartz boat, positioning monitors across the **Load**, **Center**, and **Source** process regions.
2. **Spike Profile Insertion**:
   - Engage the profile thermocouple assembly (dual Type-R / Type-S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples per zone encased in quartz thermowells).
   - Drive the quartz wafer boat into the furnace tube at a controlled insertion speed **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and suppress crystallographic slip dislocations.
3. **Multi-Zone Thermal Profiling & PID Balancing**:
   - Set the triple-loop digital PID temperature controller to target **$850^\circ\text{C}$** across all three heating zones (Kanthal A1 / APM / $\text{MoSi}_2$ coils: Source, Center, and Load).
   - Validate thermocouple spike responses against feedforward decoupling loops until the central 300 mm to 350 mm wafer flat zone is isothermal with temperature variation $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
4. **Gas Sweep Stabilization & Dry Oxidation**:
   - Establish a baseline sweep of ultra-pure carrier $\text{N}_2$ at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** via calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs) to maintain laminar flow and prevent ambient air back-diffusion.
   - Transition gas delivery to high-purity dry $\text{O}_2$ (99.999% purity) at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** (optionally diluted with ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ and 1% to 3% dry $\text{HCl}$ to getter mobile sodium ions and metallic impurities) at $850^\circ\text{C}$ to initiate baseline gate oxide growth targeting $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal thickness.
5. **Post-Oxidation Purge & Controlled Pull**:
   - Terminate active $\text{O}_2$ delivery and switch back to dry $\text{N}_2$ purge at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** for 10 minutes.
   - Extract the quartz boat at a mechanical retraction rate **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** into the nitrogen-purged load vestibule; cool to ambient cleanroom temperature ($< 100^\circ\text{C}$).
6. **Metrology & Baseline Oxide Validation**:
   - Transfer monitor wafers to the multi-wavelength spectroscopic ellipsometer.
   - Execute a 49-point polar map across the wafer diameter to measure gate dielectric physical thickness ($\text{SiO}_2$) and cross-wafer non-uniformity.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance | Units | Validation Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Zone Temperature Uniformity** | $850.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Dual Type-R/S Spike Thermocouple Profiler across $\ge 300\text{ mm}$ center flat zone |
| **Boat Ramp In/Out Speed** | $< 50.0$ | Max allowable: $49.9$ | $\text{mm/min}$ | Stepper motor encoder / furnace drive controller |
| **MFC Process Gas Flow Rate** | $2.0\text{ -- }5.0$ | $\pm 1.0\%$ Full Scale | $\text{SLPM}$ | In-situ calibrated thermal Mass Flow Controllers ($\text{O}_2$ / $\text{N}_2$) |
| **Baseline Gate Oxide Thickness** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.2$ ($3.3\text{ -- }3.7$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (49-point wafer mapping) |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery**:
  * *Parameters cited*: Horizontal fused quartz process tube ($150\text{ mm to }200\text{ mm OD}$, $99.999\%\text{ SiO}_2$ purity); 3-zone resistive heating element (Kanthal A1 / APM coils: Source, Center, Load); dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples per zone; center flat zone uniformity $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (over $350\text{ mm}$); MFC gas delivery for high-purity $\text{O}_2$ ($99.999\%$), $\text{N}_2$, and dry $\text{HCl}$ ($1\text{--}3\%$); laminar flow sweep rate of $2.0\text{ to }5.0\text{ SLPM}$.
* **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
  * *Parameters cited*: Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling; Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells; $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ uniformity across central $300\text{ mm}$ region; gas delivery range of $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$; boat insertion/extraction speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
* **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  * *Parameters cited*: 180nm DRAM gate dielectric thermal oxide grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness target.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Type R/S Spike Thermocouple Profiling & Multi-Zone Dynamic PID Tuning

**Process Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 / µm)  
**Parent Process:** 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm physical thickness target at 850°C–900°C)  
**Action Type:** Make / Calibration & Tuning  

---

### 1. Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Furnace Prep & N2   │
│         Purge         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘

┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Spike Profiling    │
│       Insertion       │
│                       │

            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Set Dynamic      │
│   Multi-Zone Target   │
│       (850°C)         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      PID Dynamic      │
│     Autotuning &      │
│      Decoupling       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Isothermal       │
│  Verification Across  │
│      300mm Zone       │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Furnace Atmosphere & Baseline Preparation:**
   - Establish continuous laminar carrier gas flow inside the quartz tube by setting the nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) Mass Flow Controller (MFC) between **1 to 5 SLPM** to purge atmospheric contaminants.
   - Inspect quartz thermowells housing the Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples across all three physical furnace zones (Load, Center, Source).

2. **Spike Thermocouple Boat Loading:**
   - Mount multi-point Type R/S calibration spike thermocouples along the central 300 mm quartz wafer boat carrier.
   - Command the automated cantilever push/pull transfer mechanism to ramp into the furnace tube at a linear mechanical travel speed of **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to prevent mechanical tube impact and thermal shock dislocations.

3. **Thermal Setpoint Initialization:**
   - Energize the Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ heating coils.
   - Set the master recipe target temperature to **850°C** across Load, Center, and Source loops for 180nm dry gate oxidation recipe readiness.

4. **Multi-Zone Dynamic PID Calibration & Decoupling:**
   - Engage the triple-loop digital PID controller in dynamic tuning mode.
   - Tune proportional gain ($K_p$), integral reset ($T_i$), and derivative rate ($T_d$) independently for Load, Center, and Source heating zones.
   - Calibrate the feedforward decoupling matrix to compensate for convective end-losses at the quartz tube entry/exhaust flanges while stabilizing interaction effects caused by adjacent zone cross-talk.

5. **Flat-Zone Thermal Stabilization & Metrology Run:**
   - Allow thermal soaking at 850°C under steady 1–5 SLPM laminar gas flow until dynamic thermocouple derivative rates settle near zero.
   - Log spike thermocouple data across the entire 300 mm wafer boat span at 100 ms sampling intervals to confirm flat-zone compliance.
   - Once qualified, initiate boat extraction at **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** before advancing to product wafer dry oxidation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Units | Control Type | Context Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Boat Mechanical Travel Speed** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Upper Bound Limit | *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation* |
| **Carrier Gas Laminar Flow Rate ($\text{N}_2$ MFC)** | $1.0\text{ to }5.0$ | $\text{SLPM}$ | Operational Window | *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation* |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity (300 mm region)** | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Tolerance Band | *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation* |
| **Target Thermal Oxidation Calibration Setpoint** | $850$ (recipe window $850\text{--}900$) | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Absolute Setpoint | *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics...* & *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture...* |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

* **[Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation]**:
  - Validates heating elements (Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$) across Load, Center, and Source zones.
  - Dictates triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling.
  - Specifies Type R / Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells.
  - Governs flat-zone tolerance of **$\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central 300 mm wafer boat region** between 800°C and 1150°C.
  - Dictates MFC gas flow dynamics between **1 to 5 SLPM** and wafer boat insertion/retraction speed **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate crystallographic slip dislocations.
* **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - Establishes the process context for thermal dry gate dielectric growth ($\text{SiO}_2$) targeting **~3.5 nm physical thickness** at **850°C–900°C**.

Here is the actionable, industrial leaf Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) tailored for the DRAM Foundation VN 180nm process.

---

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Test Wafer Baseline Dry Oxidation Run (850°C Pure O2/N2 Dilution)

- **Process / Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm architecture)
- **Module:** Thermal Processing / Thermal Oxidation / Metrology Baseline Run
- **Target Dielectric:** Baseline Dry Gate SiO₂ (Target: 3.5 nm)

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```text
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                PROCESS FLOW                                     |
|                                                                                 |
|  [1. Quartz Boat Prep] ---> [2. Slow Push-In]  ---> [3. Thermal Stabilization]  |
|            |                      |                            |                |
|            v                      v                            v                |
|  [6. Metrology Eval]  <--- [5. Slow Pull-Out] <--- [4. Oxidation Growth]        |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Pre-Run Inspection & Boat Loading:**
   - Mount baseline silicon test wafers along with baffle/dummy wafers onto the central 300 mm quartz boat carrier. Ensure quartz thermowell Type R/S thermocouple probes are properly aligned with the load, center, and source zones.
2. **Purge & Controlled Boat Insertion (Push):**
   - Establish laminar carrier gas flow with continuous ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ purge regulated via Mass Flow Controller (MFC) between 1 and 5 SLPM.
   - Mechanically push the wafer boat into the horizontal quartz tube furnace at an insertion speed strictly $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.
3. **Multi-Zone Temperature Stabilization:**
   - Engage the triple-loop digital PID temperature controller across Load, Center, and Source zones (Kanthal-A1 or $\text{MoSi}_2$ heating coils).
   - Stabilize the isothermal flat zone at 850°C until temperature variance across the central 300 mm wafer region does not exceed $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$.
4. **Dry Thermal Oxidation Execution:**
   - Transition gas manifold from pure $\text{N}_2$ to ultra-pure $\text{O}_2$ with $\text{N}_2$ dilution via calibrated MFCs (maintaining laminar flow between 1 and 5 SLPM) to initiate Deal-Grove interface-reaction-rate-limited oxide growth ($x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$).
   - Maintain the dry oxidation recipe until the target gate dielectric thickness of 3.5 nm (within the 3.5 to 4.0 nm window) is grown.
5. **Post-Oxidation Purge & Controlled Unloading (Pull):**
   - Switch gas flow back to 100% ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ purge at 1 to 5 SLPM to arrest oxidation.
   - Mechanically ramp/pull the quartz wafer boat out at a mechanical speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ into the cooling station.
6. **Metrology & Dielectric Baseline Evaluation:**
   - Measure oxide thickness across test wafers using spectroscopic ellipsometry.
   - Validate dielectric breakdown field ($E_{bd}$) and interface trap density ($D_{it}$) on monitor samples.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Furnace Temperature Uniformity** | $850 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Triple-loop Type R / S thermocouples in quartz thermowells |
| **Wafer Boat Ramp/Travel Speed** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Automated boat push/pull mechanical drive telemetry |
| **Carrier Gas Mass Flow Rate** | $1.0\text{ to }5.0$ | $\text{SLPM}$ | Mass Flow Controller (MFC) flow sensor readouts |
| **Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5\text{ to }4.0$ (Nominal: 3.5) | $\text{nm}$ | Multi-point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Baseline MOS capacitor breakdown voltage test ($V_{bd}$) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | $< 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-frequency / Quasi-static C-V profiling |

---

### 3. Context References

- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**: Multi-zone Load/Center/Source zone heating, Type R/S thermocouple regulation, flat zone uniformity of $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central 300 mm boat, MFC laminar carrier gas flow between 1 and 5 SLPM, and boat mechanical ramp/travel speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Linear-parabolic kinetics ($x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$) governing thin-regime dry $\text{O}_2$ oxidation, 180nm gate dielectric thickness target of 3.5 to 4.0 nm, dielectric breakdown requirement $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, and interface trap density limit $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$.

Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-180-SE01
**Title:** Spectroscopic Ellipsometry 3.5 nm Baseline Gate Oxide Thickness & Uniformity Mapping  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Validation  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Objective
This SOP defines the wafer-level metrology execution for high-precision thickness measurement and across-wafer thickness uniformity mapping of ultra-thin dry thermally grown gate oxide ($\text{SiO}_2$, nominal target: $3.5\text{ nm}$) using broad-spectrum Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE). The measurement confirms the growth rate, interface stability, and thermal zone uniformity across horizontal quartz tube furnace runs prior to polysilicon gate deposition.

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Materials
- **Tool:** Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer with automated robotic wafer handling and micro-spot focusing optics (wavelength range: $190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$).
- **Substrate:** Baseline test monitor wafers ($200\text{ mm}$ p-type $\text{Si}\langle 100\rangle$) post-850°C–900°C dry thermal oxidation.
- **Reference Standard:** Certified standard $\text{SiO}_2/\text{Si}$ calibration wafer ($2.0\text{ nm}$ native oxide / $10.0\text{ nm}$ thermal oxide).
- **Environment:** Class 1 / ISO 3 cleanroom environment; clean dry nitrogen ($\text{CDA}/\text{N}_2$) purged optical path.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. System Calibration & Dark Current Offset Verification                          |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. Recipe & Optical Dispersion Model Setup (Si substrate + SiO2 Cauchy/Sellmeier) |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. Automated 49-Point Polar/Cartesian Map Acquisition (AOI: 70° & 75°)            |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Spectral Regression Fitting & Thickness Uniformity Computation                 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: System Baseline Calibration & Dark Offset
1. Verify system source lamp intensity (Xenon/Deuterium) across $190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$.
2. Run standard calibration check using certified baseline reference wafer at angle of incidence (AOI) $70.0^\circ$.
3. Perform background dark current subtraction and ensure root-mean-square error ($\text{RMSE}$) of standard fit is $< 1.0$.

#### Step 2: Optical Dispersion Model Configuration
1. Load optical stack model: $\text{Air} \rightarrow \text{SiO}_2 \text{ (Dielectric)} \rightarrow \text{Si}\langle 100\rangle \text{ (Substrate)}$.
2. Set $\text{SiO}_2$ optical dispersion parameters using pre-calibrated Sellmeier/Cauchy parameters ($n \approx 1.46$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$, $k = 0$).
3. Fix silicon substrate dielectric function ($\varepsilon_1, \varepsilon_2$) to standard single-crystal reference library at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
4. Parameterize gate oxide thickness $T_{\text{ox}}$ as the primary floating regression variable; float sub-interface roughness layer thickness as secondary variable if required.

#### Step 3: Wafer Loading & Automated Multi-Point Mapping
1. Load the dry oxidized monitor wafer onto the vacuum chuck with wafer flat/notch oriented at $0^\circ$.
2. Perform automated three-point laser optical height/tilt auto-focus leveling.
3. Execute standard automated 49-point full-wafer contour map (or 9-point cross-pattern for quick furnace zone qualification) with a $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion.
4. Acquire ellipsometric polarization parameters $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ across wavelengths $190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$ at dual angles of incidence ($70^\circ$ and $75^\circ$).

#### Step 4: Regression Fit & Data Export
1. Execute Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear regression fit on each site to extract physical thickness $T_{\text{ox}}$.
2. Calculate full-wafer mean thickness ($\bar{T}_{\text{ox}}$), standard deviation ($\sigma$), and percent non-uniformity:
   $$\text{Uniformity (\%) } = \frac{T_{\max} - T_{\min}}{2 \times \bar{T}_{\text{ox}}} \times 100\%$$
3. Flag any measurement point failing goodness-of-fit metric ($\text{GOF} < 0.990$). Log results to the DRAM Foundation VN MES database.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Tolerance / Specification Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($\bar{T}_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | $3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ (Range: $3.3 - 3.7\text{ nm}$) |
| **Across-Wafer Thickness Non-Uniformity** | $\le 1.5$ | $\%$ | $(T_{\max} - T_{\min}) / (2 \times \bar{T}_{\text{ox}}) \le 1.5\%$ (49-point map, $3\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion) |
| **Spectroscopic Fit Quality ($\text{GOF}$ / $R^2$)** | $\ge 0.995$ | Dimensionless | Minimum allowable threshold: $\ge 0.990$ across $190 - 800\text{ nm}$ |
| **Measurement Tool Beam Incidence Angle Repeatability** | $70.00$ | $\text{degrees } (^\circ)$ | $\pm 0.02^\circ$ |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations

1. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
   - *Applied Data:* Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
2. **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
   - *Applied Data:* Dry oxidation performed in pure dry $\text{O}_2$ produces dense dielectric films with thin-regime target for 180nm gate dielectric specified at $3.5\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$ (linear regime: $x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$ with $x_0 \ll A/2$).
citations: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-WET-RCA-HF-001`
**Title:** RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Passivation with HF Last Etch  
**Node Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Wet Chemistry Pre-Oxidation Surface Preparation  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Chemical Formulations
This procedure removes light organics, sub-micron particulates, trace metallic contamination, and native surface oxides while preparing an H-passivated, hydrophobic silicon surface prior to loading into the horizontal quartz oxidation furnace for 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth.

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                RCA CLEAN & HF-LAST ETCH                                 |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       |
       v
+------------------------------------+
| 1. SC-1 Organic & Particle Removal |  --> 5 UPW : 1 NH4OH (29%) : 1 H2O2 (30%) @ 70°C-75°C
+------------------------------------+
       |
       v
+------------------------------------+
| 2. Quick Dump Rinse (QDR 1)        |  --> 5 cycles UPW (18.2 MOhm-cm) until > 16 MOhm-cm
+------------------------------------+
       |
       v
+------------------------------------+
| 3. SC-2 Metallic Trace Clean       |  --> 6 UPW : 1 HCl (37%) : 1 H2O2 (30%) @ 70°C-80°C
+------------------------------------+
       |
       v
+------------------------------------+
| 4. Quick Dump Rinse (QDR 2)        |  --> 3 min / 5 cycles UPW until resistivity recovered
+------------------------------------+
       |
       v
+------------------------------------+
| 5. Dilute HF Last Oxide Strip      |  --> 1:50 HF : UPW (0.5% - 1.0% HF) @ 22°C (15 - 30 s)
+------------------------------------+
       |
       v
+------------------------------------+
| 6. Final Rinse & N2 Spin / Blow-Dry|  --> Hydrophobic dewetting verification & high-purity N2
+------------------------------------+
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: SC-1 (Standard Clean 1) Alkaline Clean
- **Chemistry:** 5 parts UPW (Ultra-Pure Water) : 1 part 29% $\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$ (Ammonium Hydroxide) : 1 part 30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ (Hydrogen Peroxide).
- **Bath Parameters:** Heat quartz/PTFE bath to $70^\circ\text{C} - 75^\circ\text{C}$ with megasonic agitation at $1\text{ MHz}$.
- **Process Duration:** Submerge wafer cassette for $10\text{ minutes}$ ($10 - 15\text{ minutes}$ process window).
- **Action:** Dissolves organic surface contaminants and lifts sub-micron particles via controlled surface micro-etching ($\sim 0.5\text{ nm}$) and electrostatic zeta potential repulsion.

#### Step 2: Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR-1)
- **Media:** High-purity deionized water ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ resistivity).
- **Cycle Count:** 5 dump rinse cycles until bath cascade effluent reaches $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ (rinse duration $\ge 3\text{ minutes}$).

#### Step 3: SC-2 (Standard Clean 2) Acidic Metal Clean
- **Chemistry:** 6 parts UPW : 1 part 37% $\text{HCl}$ (Hydrochloric Acid) : 1 part 30% $\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$ (Hydrogen Peroxide).
- **Bath Parameters:** Heat bath to $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Process Duration:** Submerge wafer cassette for $10\text{ minutes}$.
- **Action:** Strips alkali ionic contaminants ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and dissolves transition/heavy metallic traces ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$) via soluble chloride complexation.

#### Step 4: Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR-2)
- **Media:** UPW ($18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
- **Cycle Count:** 5 dump rinse cycles until effluent $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ (minimum 3 minutes).

#### Step 5: Dilute HF-Last Etch & Hydrogen Passivation
- **Chemistry:** $1:50$ to $1:100\ \text{HF} : \text{UPW}$ ($0.5\%$ to $1.0\%\ \text{HF}$ by volume).
- **Bath Parameters:** Ambient bath at $22^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Process Duration:** $15\text{ to }30\text{ seconds}$.
- **Endpoint Indication:** Visual hydrophobic dewetting transition (wafer surface completely sheds water sheets without bead formation). Native oxide strip complete.

#### Step 6: Final Rinse & Nitrogen Blow-Dry
- **Quick Rinse:** Brief 30–60 second UPW cascade rinse to eliminate residual fluoride ions without regrowing chemical oxide.
- **Drying:** Dry cassette immediately via filtered high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry or spin-rinse-dryer.
- **Queue Time Constraint:** Transfer wafer load immediately into the horizontal furnace loading station for dry $\text{O}_2$ gate oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **QDR Rinse Bath Effluent Resistivity** | $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 16.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line bath resistivity sensor |
| **SC-1 / SC-2 Bath Process Temperatures** | $70^\circ\text{C} - 75^\circ\text{C}$ (SC-1) / $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ (SC-2) | $\pm 2.0^\circ\text{C}$ | Immersion thermocouple / RTD sensor |
| **HF Etch Immersion Time** | $20\text{ s}$ | $15\text{ to }30\text{ s}$ (1:50 HF) | Automated wet bench recipe timer |
| **Pre-Oxidation Native Oxide Thickness** | $0.0\text{ nm}$ (Complete Strip) | $\le 0.2\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Dewet angle |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering**
  - SC-1 chemical composition ($5\text{ UPW} : 1\ \text{NH}_4\text{OH } [29\%] : 1\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ [30\%]$), bath temperature ($70^\circ\text{C} - 75^\circ\text{C}$), 1 MHz megasonics, $10\text{ min}$ duration, $\sim 0.5\text{ nm}$ silicon base etch, and $5\text{ cycles}$ dump rinse to $> 16\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
  - Native oxide strip dilution ($1:50\text{ to }1:100\ \text{HF} : \text{UPW}$, $0.5\% - 1.0\%$), duration ($15 - 30\text{ s}$ at $22^\circ\text{C}$), and hydrophobic dewetting endpoint.
- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**
  - SC-2 chemical formulation ($6\text{ UPW} : 1\ \text{HCl } [37\%] : 1\ \text{H}_2\text{O}_2\ [30\%]$) at $70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$ for alkali ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and heavy metal ($\text{Fe}, \text{Cu}, \text{Ni}$) removal.
  - Intermediate 3-minute dump rinse using $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ DI water and final high-purity $\text{N}_2$ drying.
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
  - Pre-oxidation surface cleanliness requirement directly enables targeted $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide growth with breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and interface state density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$.
citations: RCA Standard Clean SC-1, SC-2, and Native Oxide HF Dip Engineering (Kern, W. - Handbook of Semiconductor Wafer Cleaning Technology)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## RCA-1 (SC-1) and RCA-2 (SC-2) Chemical Bath Preparation and Organic/Metallic Decontamination

**Task Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Pre-Oxidation RCA Clean and Passivation  
**Action Type:** Make | **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  RCA-1 Clean 70-80C  │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Dump Rinse 18.2    │
│       MOhm-cm        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  HF 1:50 Dip 15-30s  │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  RCA-2 Clean 70-80C  │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Final Rinse & N2   │
│       Blow-Dry       │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **RCA-1 (Standard Clean 1 / SC-1) Formulation & Bath Preparation**:
   - In a chemical wet-bench quartz or Teflon tank, blend deionized water, ammonium hydroxide, and hydrogen peroxide in a **5 : 1 : 1** volumetric ratio:
     - 5 parts ultra-pure deionized water ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$, $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$).
     - 1 part Ammonium Hydroxide ($\text{NH}_4\text{OH}$, $29\%$).
     - 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, $30\%$).
   - Heat the chemical bath to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.

2. **RCA-1 Organic & Particle Decontamination**:
   - Immerse silicon wafer cassettes into the RCA-1 bath at **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$** for **$10 - 15\text{ minutes}$** to oxidize and dissolve organic surface contamination and light trace metals.

3. **Intermediate Quick Dump Rinse (QDR)**:
   - Transfer wafers into a dump rinse tank filled with **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$** DI water; cycle for **$3\text{ minutes}$** until baseline resistivity is recovered.

4. **Intermediate Native Oxide Strip (HF Dip)**:
   - Submerge wafers in a dilute **$1:50\text{ HF}:\text{H}_2\text{O}$** solution for **$15 - 30\text{ seconds}$** to strip chemically grown/native surface oxide until the surface exhibits complete hydrophobicity (dewetting).
   - Follow immediately with a DI water cascade rinse.

5. **RCA-2 (Standard Clean 2 / SC-2) Formulation & Bath Preparation**:
   - In a separate clean quartz immersion bath, prepare the acidic bath in a **$6 : 1 : 1$** volumetric ratio:
     - 6 parts ultra-pure deionized water ($\text{DI H}_2\text{O}$).
     - 1 part Hydrochloric Acid ($\text{HCl}$, $37\%$).
     - 1 part Hydrogen Peroxide ($\text{H}_2\text{O}_2$, $30\%$).
   - Heat the chemical solution to **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$**.

6. **RCA-2 Heavy & Alkali Metal Stripping**:
   - Immerse wafers into the heated RCA-2 solution at **$70^\circ\text{C} - 80^\circ\text{C}$** for **$10\text{ minutes}$** to solubilize and desorb alkali ionic contamination ($\text{Na}^+, \text{K}^+$) and transition/heavy metallic traces ($\text{Fe, Cu, Ni}$).

7. **Final Rinse & Spin/Drying**:
   - Transfer wafers through an ultra-pure DI rinse until effluent reaches **$18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$**.
   - Dry immediately utilizing high-purity filtered Nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) blow-dry or spin-rinse dryer.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Physical Unit | Measurement Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **RCA-1 (SC-1) Bath Temperature** | $75.0$ | $70.0 - 80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Integrated Pt-100 / Teflon thermocouple probe |
| **RCA-1 Immersion Duration** | $12.5$ | $10.0 - 15.0$ | $\text{min}$ | Wet bench robotic recipe timer |
| **Intermediate Rinse Water Resistivity** | $18.2$ | $\ge 18.2$ | $\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line conductivity / resistivity sensor |
| **1:50 HF Dip Etch Duration** | $22.5$ | $15.0 - 30.0$ | $\text{s}$ | Automated pneumatic arm process timer |
| **RCA-2 (SC-2) Bath Temperature** | $75.0$ | $70.0 - 80.0$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Tank quartz-sheathed temperature sensor |
| **RCA-2 Immersion Duration** | $10.0$ | $10.0$ | $\text{min}$ | Wet bench process controller timer |

---

### Literature Citations
- **Source: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure**:
  - *RCA-1 formulation ($5:1:1\text{ DI H}_2\text{O} : 29\%\text{ NH}_4\text{OH} : 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$), operational temperature ($70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10-15\text{ min}$), $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ dump rinse ($3\text{ min}$), $1:50\text{ HF}$ native oxide strip ($15-30\text{ s}$), RCA-2 formulation ($6:1:1\text{ DI H}_2\text{O} : 37\%\text{ HCl} : 30\%\text{ H}_2\text{O}_2$), operational temperature ($70^\circ\text{C}-80^\circ\text{C}$ for $10\text{ min}$), and high-purity $\text{N}_2$ blow-dry.*
citations: Standard RCA-1 and RCA-2 Silicon Wafer Cleaning Procedure (Kern, W. - RCA Review & Semiconductor Cleaning Science)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dilute HF (1:50) Oxide Strip and Hydrogen-Terminated Surface Passivation Dip

**Hierarchy Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > RCA Clean and Pre-Oxidation Surface Passivation with HF Last Etch > Dilute HF (1:50) Oxide Strip and Hydrogen-Terminated Surface Passivation Dip  
**Action Type**: Make  
**Technology Node**: 180nm (Gen 2)

---

### Process Architecture Workflow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["RCA Clean Output (Post SC-1 & SC-2)"] --> B["Dilute HF (1:50) Immersion Tank (20°C - 25°C)"]
    B --> C["Native / Chemical SiO2 Strip (Selective vs Si3N4)"]
    C --> D["Hydrophobic Hydrogen-Terminated (Si-H) Passivation"]
    D --> E["Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) to 18 MOhm·cm"]
    E --> F["Surface Tension / Marangoni N2 Spin Dry"]
    F --> G["Immediate Load to 850°C Gate Oxidation Furnace"]
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Bath Preparation & Temperature Stabilization**:
   - Prepare a 1:50 volumetric dilution using semiconductor-grade 49% hydrofluoric acid ($1\text{ part HF (49\%)} : 50\text{ parts UPW}$).
   - Verify recirculation and bath temperature stabilization at $22.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ in a PVDF/PTFE wet bench tank.

2. **Cassette Transfer & Pre-Wetting**:
   - Transfer wafer batch directly from the downstream RCA clean (post-SC-2 / megasonic rinse) into the process tank manipulator arm.
   - Lower the cassette into the DHF bath at a controlled immersion velocity ($15\text{ mm/s}$) to eliminate air entrapment on high-aspect DRAM micro-topologies.

3. **Oxide Etch & Surface Depassivation**:
   - Submerge wafers for $60\text{ to }90\text{ s}$ to strip native/chemical silicon oxide ($\sim 1.0\text{--}1.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Etch proceeds according to: $\text{SiO}_2 + 6\text{HF} \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{SiF}_6 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$.
   - Ensure preservation of underlying silicon nitride masks (nitride etch rate remains $< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$).

4. **Hydrogen Termination & Dewet Verification**:
   - Allow final surface fluorine desorption and surface replacement with monohydride/dihydride bonds ($\text{Si-H}$ passivation), rendering bare silicon channel areas entirely hydrophobic.
   - Confirm complete dewet ("sheeting off" of aqueous solution) upon wafer edge emergence.

5. **Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) & Marangoni Dry**:
   - Transfer within $< 5\text{ s}$ to the ambient Quick Dump Rinse (QDR) tank to arrest etching.
   - Cycle 4 dump/fill sequences with ultra-pure water (UPW) until bath resistivity reaches $\ge 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$.
   - Transfer to a surface-tension Marangoni dry or N2-purged spin rinse dryer (SRD) at $2000\text{ RPM}$ with heated filtered $\text{N}_2$ ($> 99.9999\%$ purity).

6. **Queue-Time (Q-Time) Enforcement**:
   - Transfer the passivated cassette in an enclosed, nitrogen-purged SMIF pod / wafer carrier directly to the horizontal quartz gate oxidation furnace tube.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Tolerance / Limits | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Silicon Nitride Etch Loss** | $< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$ | $\le 0.5\text{ nm/min}$ maximum | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry on $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ monitor wafer |
| **QDR Rinse End-Point Resistivity** | $18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | $\ge 18.0\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$ | In-line conductance/resistivity probe |
| **Pre-Oxidation Queue Time (Q-Time)** | $\le 60\text{ min}$ | $\le 120\text{ min}$ hard interlock abort | Automated MES lot tracking timestamp to 850°C furnace load |
| **Post-Strip Oxide Residual** | $0.0\text{ nm}$ (Hydrophobic dewet) | Native oxide $< 0.2\text{ nm}$ | In-line X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) / Ellipsometry |

---

### Verified Literature Context Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Validates the requirement of an oxide-free, passivated starting interface to execute thin-regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$) linear rate oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}$ targeting $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ gate oxide with minimal interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$) and breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
- **Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**: Confirms etch selectivity and boundary conditions where stoichiometric $\text{Si}_3\text{N}_4$ hard mask exhibits extreme resistance to dilute/concentrated HF and BOE with an etch rate $< 0.5\text{ nm/min}$ (selective preservation of LOCOS and capacitor nitride barriers).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-PREOX-001
**Title:** Pre-Oxidation Surface Hydrophobicity, Particle Inspection, and Native Oxide Ellipsometry Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Thermal Oxidation Execution (850°C Dilute Dry $O_2/N_2$) > RCA Clean & HF-Last Etch > Pre-Oxidation Metrology Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm node)  
**Action Type:** Make / Metrology Verification  

---

### 1. Scope & Objective
This SOP establishes the procedural protocol for post-RCA/HF-last metrology verification on bare silicon wafers prior to horizontal quartz furnace 3.5 nm dry gate oxide growth. Metrology inspects surface passivation completeness (hydrogen termination / hydrophobicity), airborne defect particle count, and residual native oxide thickness via spectroscopic ellipsometry to guarantee Deal-Grove thermal oxidation kinetic repeatability and gate dielectric integrity ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
  [Step 1: Hydrophobicity] ---> [Step 2: Ellipsometry] ---> [Step 3: Particle Scan] ---> [Gate Furnace Queue]
     DI Water Contact Angle       Native Oxide Thickness      Defect Density (<0.2 µm)       Q-Time < 2.0 hrs
```

#### Step 1: Surface Passivation & Hydrophobicity Assessment
1. Transfer cassette from the post-RCA/HF-last spin-rinse dryer (SRD) directly to the automated sessile-drop contact angle goniometer under an ISO Class 1 mini-environment.
2. Dispense a $1.0\ \mu\text{L}$ droplet of ultra-pure deionized (DI) water (resistivity $\ge 18.2\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) onto 5 standard test sites (Center, Top, Bottom, Left, Right; $10\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).
3. Measure static water contact angle ($\theta_c$) within 15 seconds of dispense.
4. **Verification:** Confirm complete hydrogen termination ($\text{Si-H}$) indicated by non-wetting hydrophobic behavior ($\theta_c \ge 75^\circ$). If $\theta_c < 70^\circ$, surface hydroxyl groups ($\text{Si-OH}$) or re-oxidation is present; reject lot to re-clean.

#### Step 2: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry for Native Oxide Thickness
1. Load the pilot/monitor wafer onto the automated spectroscopic ellipsometer stage.
2. Align laser beam ($\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$ He-Ne or broadband $250\text{–}800\text{ nm}$) at an incidence angle of $70.0^\circ$.
3. Acquire $\Psi$ (amplitude ratio) and $\Delta$ (phase difference) across a 9-point radial map.
4. Apply the optical dispersion model: $\text{Single-layer SiO}_2$ on $\text{c-Si}$ substrate (refractive index $n_{\text{SiO}_2} \approx 1.46$).
5. Measure native oxide thickness ($t_{\text{native}}$). Ensure baseline native oxide is $\le 0.5\text{ nm}$ before furnace entry so total gate dielectric target ($3.5\text{ nm}$) is controlled strictly by the subsequent 850°C–900°C dry oxidation step.

#### Step 3: Laser Surface Particle & Defect Scanning
1. Transfer wafer to the unpatterned surface defect inspection system (darkfield laser scattering).
2. Execute full-surface scan with calibration set for defect bin sizes $\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$ (critical dimension threshold for 180nm technology node).
3. Record total defect particle count and map spatial density across the wafer ($5\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).
4. Verify total particle count remains within acceptable cleanroom threshold.

#### Step 4: Q-Time Staging to Furnace
1. Tag wafer lot with completion timestamp.
2. Transport lot in an ultra-clean nitrogen-purged FOUP/SMIF pod to the horizontal quartz tube furnace loading bay.
3. Enforce hard Queue-Time (Q-time) limit ($\le 2.0\text{ hours}$) from HF-last etch completion to furnace dry $O_2$ push at 850°C to inhibit uncontrolled native oxide regrowth.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Tool / Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DI Water Contact Angle ($\theta_c$)** | $\ge 75.0^\circ$ | $\ge 70.0^\circ$ min (uniform hydrophobic) | Automated Goniometer ($^\circ$, degrees) |
| **Residual Native Oxide Thickness ($t_{\text{native}}$)** | $\le 0.30\text{ nm}$ | $\le 0.50\text{ nm}$ max | Spectroscopic Ellipsometer ($\text{nm}$) |
| **Particle Defect Count (size $\ge 0.18\ \mu\text{m}$)** | $< 10\text{ ea/wafer}$ | $\le 15\text{ ea/wafer}$ max | Darkfield Laser Defect Scanner ($\text{count/wafer}$) |
| **Furnace Transfer Queue Time ($t_{\text{queue}}$)** | $< 60\text{ min}$ | $\le 120\text{ min}$ ($2.0\text{ hr}$) max | CIM / MES Track-In Timer ($\text{minutes}$) |

---

### 4. Context & Source Citations
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Guides pre-oxidation surface preparation to maintain uniform interface reaction kinetics ($x_0 \ll A/2$, rate limited by $k_l = B/A$).
  - Mandates native oxide suppression ($t_{\text{native}} \le 0.5\text{ nm}$) to meet the gate oxide thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{–}900^\circ\text{C}$ in dry $O_2$, ensuring high dielectric breakdown field ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) and low interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Establishes the 180nm physical integration parameters (wordline/bitline pitch $360\text{–}400\text{ nm}$, transistor gate dielectric target $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness $\text{SiO}_2$) and defect sensitivity scale for 1T1C cells.

Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
