nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## Title: Horizontal Quartz Furnace 3.5nm Dilute $\text{O}_2/\text{N}_2$ Thermal Oxidation Run at 850°C **Process Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > Horizontal Quartz Furnace Dry $\text{O}_2$ Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C, Pure $\text{O}_2/\text{N}_2$ Dilution) > Horizontal Quartz Furnace 3.5nm Gate Oxide Growth Recipe Execution (850°C Dilute Dry $\text{O}_2/\text{N}_2$) **Action Type:** Make **Target Dielectric Layer:** High-density Dry Gate Dielectric ($\text{SiO}_2$), Target $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ --- ### 1. Process Flowchart ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Step 1: Idle & Thermal Stabilization
850°C across 3 Zones, N2 @ 2.0–5.0 SLPM"] --> B["Step 2: Wafer Boat Insertion
Load into 350 mm Flat Zone in N2 ambient"] B --> C["Step 3: Thermal Equilibration
Dwell at 850°C until uniformity ≤ ±0.5°C"] C --> D["Step 4: Oxidation Cycle
Switch to O2/N2 Dilution Sweep, Run 22 min"] D --> E["Step 5: Post-Oxidation N2 Purge
Cut O2, Purge N2 @ 2.0–5.0 SLPM"] E --> F["Step 6: Wafer Boat Unload & Metrology
Cool down and transfer to Ellipsometry"] ``` --- ### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure 1. **Pre-Run Furnace Verification & Thermal Profile Stabilization:** - Verify the fused quartz process tube (99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$, 150 mm to 200 mm OD) is purged under ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ sweep. - Set the 3-zone digital PID temperature controllers (Source, Center, Load zones monitored via dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples) to a setpoint of **850°C**. - Establish laminar carrier purge using calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) supplying ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** to prevent ambient back-diffusion. - Confirm temperature stabilization in the middle **350 mm Center Flat Zone** to within **$\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$**. 2. **Wafer Loading & Dwell:** - Load pre-cleaned (100) Si wafer boat into the 350 mm center flat zone under continuous $\text{N}_2$ blanket sweep (**2.0 to 5.0 SLPM**). - Allow a thermal recovery dwell period until all 3 zones equilibrate to **850°C $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$**. 3. **Oxidation Gas Introduction & Growth:** - Transition MFC gas delivery to introduce high-purity dry $\text{O}_2$ (99.999% purity) with $\text{N}_2$ dilution, maintaining total laminar flow at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** (optionally including 1–3% dry HCl for mobile $\text{Na}^+$ ion and metallic gettering). - Execute the oxidation step at **850°C** for a recipe duration of **22 minutes** (operating in the linear-parabolic initial thin oxide regime where parabolic rate constant $B = 0.0031\,\mu\text{m}^2/\text{hr}$ and linear rate constant $B/A = 0.018\,\mu\text{m}/\text{hr}$). 4. **Oxidation Termination & Post-Oxidation Purge:** - Shut off the $\text{O}_2$ (and HCl) MFC valves immediately upon reaching 22 minutes. - Sweep the quartz tube with ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** to completely clear residual oxidants from the tube. 5. **Unload & Transfer:** - Slowly withdraw the quartz boat from the furnace center flat zone into the load zone under positive $\text{N}_2$ purge flow. - Cool to handling temperature and transfer wafers to spectroscopic ellipsometry for dielectric thickness validation. --- ### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria | Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Method / Tool | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ ($3.3\text{ nm} - 3.7\text{ nm}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry | | **Center Flat Zone Thermal Uniformity** | $850^\circ\text{C}$ | $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across $350\text{ mm}$ length | Dual Type-R/S Thermocouple Array | | **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{\text{bd}}$)** | $> 10\text{ MV/cm}$ | Minimum threshold: $10\text{ MV/cm}$ | Fast Voltage Ramp / C-V / I-V Probe | | **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$)** | $< 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Maximum threshold: $10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Frequency / Quasi-Static C-V | --- ### 4. Verified Literature References 1. **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:** - Governed by $x_0^2 + A x_0 = B(t + \tau)$. - Validates dry oxidation targets for 180nm gate dielectric: $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$, dielectric breakdown $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, and interface trap density $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$. 2. **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery:** - 3-zone configuration (Source, Center, Load) with dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples. - Fused quartz process tube outer diameter 150mm–200mm (99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$). - Middle 350 mm flat zone uniformity requirement: $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$. - MFC gas flow range: 2.0 to 5.0 SLPM laminar gas sweep; 1–3% dry HCl capability. 3. **Deal-Grove Silicon Oxidation Kinetic Coefficients & Gate Oxide Thickness:** - Rate constants for (100) Si at 850°C in dry $\text{O}_2$: $B = 0.0031\,\mu\text{m}^2/\text{hr}$, $B/A = 0.018\,\mu\text{m}/\text{hr}$. - Recipe benchmark: 850°C dry oxidation for 22 minutes yields physical thickness $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.2\text{ nm}$.
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery (Thermco / Bruce Technologies Semiconductor Furnace Manual)
Deal-Grove Silicon Oxidation Kinetic Coefficients & Gate Oxide Thickness (Deal & Grove (1965) / Plummer Silicon VLSI Technology)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Horizontal Quartz Tube Pre-Clean, Multi-Zone Profiling & Slow-Boat Wafer Loading
**Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) | 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm)  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Tube Pre-Clean &    │
│         Purge         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Three-Zone       │
│      Profiling:       │
│  Load/Center/Source   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Slow-Boat Loading <  │
│       50 mm/min       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Flat Zone Thermal   │
│      Equilibrium      │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Horizontal Quartz Tube Purge & Pre-Conditioning**:
   - Establish continuous laminar carrier purge using ultra-pure $N_2$ via calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) regulated between **1 to 5 SLPM** to eliminate residual ambient impurities and moisture.
   - Verify quartz thermowells housing Type R / Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples are seated correctly without mechanical stress.

2. **Three-Zone Thermal Flat-Zone Profiling**:
   - Activate the triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling across all three heating segments: **Load Zone**, **Center Zone**, and **Source Zone** (Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ coils).
   - Ramp and stabilize furnace temperature within the validated operating window (**800°C to 1150°C**, targeting the baseline recipe temperature).
   - Profile the central **300 mm** wafer boat region and adjust individual zone trims until cross-zone temperature variation is within tolerance.

3. **Slow-Boat Mechanical Loading**:
   - Position the loaded quartz wafer boat onto the cantilever paddle/transfer fork.
   - Initiate motorized slow-boat insertion at a drive velocity strictly maintained at **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** into the quartz tube core to eliminate thermal shock and avoid crystallographic slip dislocations.
   - Lock boat precisely in the profiled 300 mm isothermal flat zone, seal the tube end-cap flange, and verify flow stability at 1–5 SLPM $N_2$ prior to introducing oxidation reactants.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\pm 0.5$** | **°C** | 3-Zone profiling across central 300 mm boat region (Type R/S thermocouples) |
| **Purge Gas Flow Rate** | **1 to 5** | **SLPM** | Inline calibrated thermal Mass Flow Controller (MFC) |
| **Wafer Boat Insertion Speed** | **$< 50$** | **mm/min** | Cantilever drive encoder velocity readout |
| **Process Temperature Range** | **800 to 1150** | **°C** | Triple-loop digital PID temperature controller |

---

### Citations & Literature Context
- *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation*:
  - Multi-zone heating (Load, Center, Source) via Kanthal-A1 / $\text{MoSi}_2$ coils with Type R/S Pt-Rh thermocouples.
  - Temperature uniformity requirement of $\pm 0.5\text{°C}$ across central 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C.
  - Laminar gas dynamics regulated by MFC at 1 to 5 SLPM.
  - Slow-boat mechanical insertion speed constraint of $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title
**3.5nm Dilute O2/N2 Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution at 850°C with In-Situ N2 Anneal**

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the precise execution of ultra-thin (3.5 nm) gate oxide growth in a horizontal quartz tube furnace using dilute dry $\text{O}_2/\text{N}_2$ chemistry at 850°C, followed by an immediate in-situ nitrogen anneal. This process forms the critical gate dielectric for the 180nm Open-Source DRAM node, ensuring high dielectric breakdown strength ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$) and low interface state density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).

---

### 2. Verified Literature Citations
* **[Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace]**: Establishes linear-parabolic reaction kinetics ($x_0^2 + Ax_0 = B(t + \tau)$), linear interface reaction control in the sub-5nm regime ($k_l = B/A$), 180nm gate dielectric target thickness (3.5 nm to 4.0 nm), and dielectric requirements ($E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).
* **[Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation]**: Defines 3-zone PID loop heating (Load, Center, Source), Type R/S thermocouple regulation, flat-zone uniformity ($\pm0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across central 300 mm boat), MFC laminar carrier gas control (1 to 5 SLPM), and push/pull boat transfer speed limits ($< 50\text{ mm/min}$) to suppress crystallographic slip dislocations.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                               PROCESS FLOWCHART                                    |
|                                                                                    |
|  [Step 1: Furnace Idling]  -->  N2 Purge (1-5 SLPM), Tube at 800°C - 850°C        |
|            |                                                                       |
|  [Step 2: Wafer Boat Load] -->  Paddle push speed < 50 mm/min into 300 mm Flat Zone|
|            |                                                                       |
|  [Step 3: Thermal Stab.]   -->  PID settle to 850°C (±0.5°C across 3 zones)        |
|            |                                                                       |
|  [Step 4: Dilute Dry O2]   -->  Laminar MFC injection (O2 + N2 carrier, 1-5 SLPM)  |
|            |                    Grow 3.5 nm gate oxide (Linear regime: kl = B/A)   |
|            |                                                                       |
|  [Step 5: In-Situ N2 Anneal]--> Cut O2 MFC; Pure N2 purge at 850°C (Dit reduction) |
|            |                                                                       |
|  [Step 6: Boat Pull-out]   -->  Paddle pull speed < 50 mm/min to prevent slip      |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

1. **Pre-Run Inspection & Idle State Stabilization**:
   * Verify quartz furnace tube integrity, Type R/S thermocouple positioning in quartz thermowells, and triple-loop PID controller health.
   * Maintain an idle laminar flow of high-purity $\text{N}_2$ through mass flow controllers (MFC) at **1 to 5 SLPM**.
   * Confirm furnace baseline idle temperature across Load, Center, and Source heating zones at **800°C to 850°C**.

2. **Wafer Boat Loading (Thermal Shock Prevention)**:
   * Load clean single-crystal Si production wafers and monitor test monitors into the high-purity quartz boat.
   * Initiate mechanical paddle insertion at a controlled speed strictly **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** into the central 300 mm isothermal flat zone to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.

3. **Thermal Equilibration & Profile Verification**:
   * Set triple-loop PID controller setpoints to **850°C**.
   * Allow temperature to stabilize until the flat-zone gradient satisfies **$\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** across Load, Center, and Source zones under continuous $\text{N}_2$ flow.

4. **Dilute Dry $\text{O}_2$ Oxidation Recipe Execution**:
   * Switch gas manifold to introduce ultra-pure dry $\text{O}_2$ diluted in $\text{N}_2$ carrier gas at a total combined flow of **1 to 5 SLPM** in the laminar flow regime.
   * Hold for the pre-calibrated duration to grow target **3.5 nm** $\text{SiO}_2$ via the interface reaction-rate limited regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$, $k_l = B/A$).

5. **In-Situ Post-Oxidation $\text{N}_2$ Anneal**:
   * Close the $\text{O}_2$ MFC shutoff valve immediately upon oxidation step completion.
   * Maintain laminar ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ carrier flow at **1 to 5 SLPM** at **850°C** for in-situ post-oxidation annealing to passivate dangling bonds and reduce interface trap density ($D_{it}$).

6. **Boat Unloading**:
   * Ramp furnace setpoints down if programmed, or initiate automated wafer boat extraction at **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** under continuous $\text{N}_2$ blanket purge.
   * Allow wafers to cool to room ambient under laminar flow exhaust.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Oxide Film Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | `3.5` (Tolerance range `3.5 to 4.0`) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / TEM |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | `±0.5` across central 300 mm zone | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-point Type R/S Profile Thermocouple Array |
| **Boat Push/Pull Mechanical Velocity** | `< 50` | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Automated Cantilever Drive Encoder |
| **Carrier / Process Gas Total Flow Rate** | `1 to 5` | $\text{SLPM}$ | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) Log |
| **Gate Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | `> 10` | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Mercury Probe / MOS C-V / I-V Breakdown Testing |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | `< 10^10` | $\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Frequency / Quasi-Static MOS C-V Profiling |
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)
Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation (Levinson - Principles of Lithography & Thermal Processing)

```text
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Mercury Probe / MOS   │
│     Dot Deposition     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    High-Frequency &    │
│    Quasi-Static C-V    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Acceptance Check &   │
│      Lot Release       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Wafer Loading & Pre-Alignment**:
   - Transfer the post-oxidation wafer lot from the horizontal quartz furnace transfer boat into the cleanroom Class 1 metrology FOUP/cassette under laminar flow.
   - Load the test wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the spectroscopic ellipsometer (SE) and initiate optical notch/flat centering.

2. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) Film Thickness & Uniformity Mapping**:
   - Set the SE optical model to `Air / SiO2 (Cauchy / Tauc-Lorentz model) / Si Substrate (single crystal)`.
   - Configure multi-angle spectroscopic acquisition across wavelengths $250\text{ nm} \le \lambda \le 800\text{ nm}$.
   - Execute a standard 49-point wafer mapping scan (5 mm edge exclusion) to measure physical film thickness $t_{ox}$ and calculate across-wafer thickness non-uniformity ($1\sigma$).

3. **Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) Metrology Preparation (Non-Destructive Hg-Probe / Test MOS Dot)**:
   - Mount the monitor wafer onto the automated Mercury-probe (Hg-probe) station (or shadow-mask evaporated top-contact MOS capacitor test fixture) with a calibrated gate contact area ($A = 1.00 \times 10^{-3}\text{ cm}^2$).
   - Establish ohmic contact to the back surface of the p-type substrate.

4. **High-Frequency & Quasi-Static C-V Sweep**:
   - Perform High-Frequency C-V (HF C-V) sweep at $f = 100\text{ kHz}$ to $1\text{ MHz}$ from accumulation (negative bias) to inversion (positive bias) to determine accumulation capacitance $C_{ox}$, flat-band voltage $V_{fb}$, and substrate doping density.
   - Perform simultaneous Quasi-Static C-V (QS C-V) sweep (or Castagné-Vapaille high-low frequency method) to extract the low-frequency capacitance curve $C_{lf}(V)$.

5. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) & Dielectric Breakdown ($E_{bd}$) Extraction**:
   - Calculate interface trap density across the silicon bandgap using the high-low frequency capacitance differential:
     $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{lf} / C_{ox}}{1 - C_{lf} / C_{ox}} - \frac{C_{hf} / C_{ox}}{1 - C_{hf} / C_{ox}} \right)$$
   - Execute a ramped voltage stress test (J-V breakdown test) on designated sacrificial monitor dies to extract the dielectric breakdown electric field $E_{bd}$.

6. **Lot Disposition & Pass/Fail Logging**:
   - Compare measured $t_{ox}$, $D_{it}$, and $E_{bd}$ against the acceptance targets. Release the wafer lot to gate poly-silicon deposition upon sign-off.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Range | Verification Tool / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | `3.5 nm` | `3.5 nm to 4.0 nm` ($\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (49-point map) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | `< 1.0 x 10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1` | Max `< 1.0 x 10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1` (mid-gap) | High-Low Frequency C-V Method |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | `> 10.0 MV/cm` | Min `> 10.0 MV/cm` | Ramped Voltage Breakdown ($I_{leak} > 1\text{ mA/cm}^2$) |
| **Oxide Refractive Index ($n$ at 632.8 nm)** | `1.46` | `1.455 to 1.465` | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Fit |

---

## 3. Citations & Context Alignment

1. **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
   - Confirms the dry thermal oxidation regime for thin oxides:
     - Target physical thickness for 180nm gate dielectric is explicitly **`3.5 to 4.0 nm`**.
     - High-dielectric breakdown requirement: **`E_bd > 10 MV/cm`**.
     - Minimal interface trap density target: **`D_it < 10^10 cm^-2 eV^-1`**.
2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Validates that the gate dielectric for 180nm node classic 1T1C DRAM transistors is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with **`~3.5 nm physical thickness`**.
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

nodes.primary_metric: Sub-milestone of Horizontal Quartz Furnace 3.5nm Gate Oxide Growth Recipe Execution (850°C Dilute Dry O2/N2)
nodes.sop_content:
```text
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE (SOP)                                                              |
| DRAM Foundation VN — Metrology & Characterization Leaf Node                                     |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| TITLE: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Dit Interface Metrology for 3.5nm Gate Oxide          |
| NODE: 180nm DRAM Cell Access Transistor Gate Dielectric                                          |
| REVISION: 1.0 (Gen 1 mm)                                                                         |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

### 1. Objective & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the dual-stage physical and electrical characterization protocol for ultra-thin 3.5 nm silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectrics grown via dry oxidation on P-type (100) Si test wafers. Metrology encompasses optical film thickness/refractive index extraction via multi-angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) and high-frequency (HF) / quasi-static (QS) capacitance-voltage ($C$-$V$) profiling on Planar MOS Capacitor (MOSCAP) test structures to extract interface trap density ($D_{it}$) and physical oxide thickness ($t_{ox}$).

---

### 2. Workflow Diagram
```text
  [Thermally Grown Gate Oxide Wafer (3.5 nm SiO2)]
                         │
                         ▼
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Stage 1: Multi-Angle Spectroscopic          │
  │  Ellipsometry (Optical SE Metrology)         │
  └──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                         │ Pass: tox = 3.50 ± 0.10 nm
                         ▼
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Stage 2: Planar MOSCAP Fabrication          │
  │  (Shadow Mask Sputter Al Gate Dots & Back Al)│
  └──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                         │
                         ▼
  ┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │  Stage 3: 1 MHz High-Frequency &             │
  │  Quasi-Static C-V Sweep Extraction           │
  └──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                         │ Pass: Dit < 1.0e10 cm^-2 eV^-1
                         ▼
  [Lot Acceptance / Gate Oxide Release to Poly Gate Dep]
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### Phase 1: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (Optical Verification)
1. **Tool Initialization & Calibration:**
   - Power on the broad-spectrum Xenon light source ($190\text{ nm} - 1000\text{ nm}$).
   - Perform automated baseline calibration using a standard reference silicon wafer with native oxide ($1.5 - 2.5\text{ nm}$).
2. **Measurement Setup:**
   - Load the oxidized P-type (100) Si wafer onto the vacuum chuck.
   - Configure angles of incidence ($\Phi$) to $70^\circ$ and $75^\circ$ (near Brewster's angle for $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$).
3. **Data Acquisition & Modeling:**
   - Acquire $\Psi$ (amplitude ratio) and $\Delta$ (phase difference) spectra across 13 site locations (9-point circular map + center + 3 edge-exclusion sites at $3\text{ mm}$).
   - Fit acquired spectra using a two-layer optical model:
     - Substrate: Single-crystal $\text{Si}$ (reference library).
     - Overlayer: Cauchy/Sellmeier dielectric model for thin $\text{SiO}_2$ with nominal index $n = 1.46$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$.
   - Confirm Mean Squared Error ($\text{MSE}$) of regression fit is $< 1.5$. Record average optical thickness $t_{ox, SE}$.

#### Phase 2: MOSCAP Test Structure Preparation
4. **Frontside Electrode Metallization:**
   - Mount monitor wafer into the sputtering chamber with an aligned nickel shadow mask.
   - Sputter pure Aluminum ($\text{Al}$) circular gate electrode dots with nominal diameters of $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, and $1000\ \mu\text{m}$. Sputter thickness: $300\text{ nm}$.
5. **Backside Ohmic Contact Metallization:**
   - Strip backside native oxide with dilute $\text{HF}$ (1:50) swab wipe.
   - Sputter a uniform $\text{Al}$ or $\text{Au}$ ohmic contact layer ($200\text{ nm}$) across the wafer backside.
6. **Forming Gas Anneal (FGA):**
   - Anneal test wafer at $400^\circ\text{C}$ in $90\%\ \text{N}_2 / 10\%\ \text{H}_2$ for $30\text{ minutes}$ to passivate dangling bonds and establish low-resistance ohmic contacts.

#### Phase 3: High-Frequency (1 MHz) & Quasi-Static C-V Electrical Profiling
7. **Prober & Parameter Setup:**
   - Place MOSCAP wafer onto a grounded, light-tight, shielded thermal chuck at $25^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Contact a $500\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter gate dot ($\text{Area} = 1.963 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{cm}^2$) using a micro-manipulated tungsten probe tip.
8. **High-Frequency (HF) C-V Sweep:**
   - Set LCR meter AC oscillation amplitude to $15\text{ mV}_\text{RMS}$ at $1\text{ MHz}$.
   - Sweep gate bias $V_G$ from inversion to deep accumulation: $+1.5\text{ V}$ down to $-2.5\text{ V}$ at a step size of $20\text{ mV}$.
   - In strong accumulation ($V_G < V_{fb}$), record saturated accumulation capacitance $C_{ox}$.
   - Calculate electrical thickness:
     $$t_{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_{ox} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}}{C_{ox}}$$
     *(where $\varepsilon_{ox} = 3.9$ and $\varepsilon_0 = 8.854 \times 10^{-14}\ \text{F/cm}$)*.
9. **Quasi-Static (QS) C-V Sweep:**
   - Perform slow quasi-static ramp ($dV/dt = 20\text{ mV/s}$) across $-2.5\text{ V}$ to $+1.5\text{ V}$ under zero-illumination dark condition to extract low-frequency capacitance $C_{LF}(V)$.
10. **High-Low Frequency $D_{it}$ Extraction:**
    - Extract interface trap density across bandgap using the Castagné-Vapaille high-low method:
      $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q \cdot \text{Area}} \left( \frac{C_{LF} / C_{ox}}{1 - C_{LF} / C_{ox}} - \frac{C_{HF} / C_{ox}}{1 - C_{HF} / C_{ox}} \right)$$

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Acceptable Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Instrument |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ ($3.40\text{ nm} - 3.60\text{ nm}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / 1 MHz HF $C_{ox}$ |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Maximum $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ at midgap | High-Low ($1\text{ MHz}$ vs Quasi-Static) $C$-$V$ |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10.0\text{ MV/cm}$ | Minimum $\ge 10.0\text{ MV/cm}$ ($V_{bd} \ge 3.5\text{ V}$ across $3.5\text{ nm}$) | Ramp Voltage Stress ($I$-$V$ breakdown prober) |
| **Ellipsometric Refractive Index ($n$ at $632.8\text{ nm}$)** | $1.460$ | $\pm 0.015$ ($1.445 - 1.475$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (Multi-Angle) |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
- **Planar MOSCAP & $C$-$V$ Dit Extraction:** Sourced from *Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction* (Electrode dots of $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, $1000\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter; $1\text{ MHz}$ high-frequency vs quasi-static accumulation saturation yielding $t_{ox}$ within $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$).
- **Oxide Density, Dielectric Breakdown & Interface Trap Targets:** Sourced from *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace* (Dry oxidation target thickness $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$, dielectric breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, and interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$).
- **180nm Node Gate Dielectric Architecture:** Sourced from *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering* (Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ with physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).
citations: Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction (Nicollian & Brews - MOS Physics and Technology)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## MOS Capacitor Shadow-Mask Aluminum Gate Metallization and Forming Gas Anneal (400°C H₂/N₂)

- **Document ID:** SOP-180NM-MET-007
- **Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)
- **Action Type:** Make
- **Process Step:** MOSCAP Aluminum Dot Deposition & FGA Interface Passivation

---

### 1. Equipment & Consumables
- **Thermal / E-Beam Metal Evaporator:** Load-locked PVD chamber with tungsten filaments or high-purity graphite crucibles.
- **Metal Source:** 5N purity Aluminum (Al 99.999%).
- **Shadow Mask:** Precision laser-micromachined shadow mask with circular apertures (diameter $\varnothing = 100\,\mu\text{m}$ to $500\,\mu\text{m}$).
- **Annealing Furnace:** Horizontal quartz tube furnace designated for forming gas annealing (FGA).
- **Process Gases:** Forming Gas ($5\%\text{--}10\%\ \text{H}_2 \text{ in } \text{N}_2$, semiconductor grade) and purge $\text{N}_2$ ($99.999\%$).
- **Substrate:** Single-crystal silicon test wafers post-gate oxidation ($t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-----------------------+     +-----------------------+     +-----------------------+
| 1. Mask Alignment &   | --> | 2. Top/Back Al PVD    | --> | 3. Forming Gas Anneal |
| Vacuum Pumpdown       |     | (150-300 nm Al Gate)  |     | (400°C H2/N2, 30 min) |
+-----------------------+     +-----------------------+     +-----------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Shadow-Mask Alignment and Vacuum Pumpdown
1. Inspect oxidized wafer ($3.5\text{ nm SiO}_2$) under cleanroom yellow light for surface particulates.
2. Mount wafer face-up onto the evaporator sample holder. Align the precision shadow mask gently over the polished front surface, securing with non-scratching spring clips.
3. Transfer substrate holder into the evaporation chamber.
4. Initiate roughing pumpdown, then engage high-vacuum cryopump/turbopump until base pressure reaches $\le 5 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{Torr}$.

#### Step 2: Front-Side Gate Aluminum Deposition
1. Ramp the source power gradually to melt and degas the 5N Al source with the substrate shutter closed.
2. Open shutter at stable deposition rate of $0.5\text{ to }1.0\text{ nm/s}$ monitored by quartz crystal microbalance (QCM).
3. Deposit $200\text{ nm} \pm 20\text{ nm}$ of pure Aluminum onto the oxide through the shadow mask apertures to define MOS capacitor dots.
4. Close shutter and allow 10 minutes of cool-down in high vacuum.

#### Step 3: Back-Side Substrate Ohmic Contact Metallization
1. Vent chamber with dry $\text{N}_2$, remove wafer, and carefully disengage the shadow mask.
2. Invert wafer (front face down on clean, low-tack cleanroom wafer carrier).
3. Pump down chamber to $\le 5 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{Torr}$.
4. Evaporate a continuous blanket layer of $200\text{ nm} \pm 20\text{ nm}$ Aluminum directly onto the unoxidized/etched back surface of the Si substrate to ensure low-resistance substrate grounding during C-V metrology.
5. Vent chamber with dry $\text{N}_2$ and unmount wafer.

#### Step 4: Forming Gas Anneal (FGA)
1. Load wafers into the quartz boat of the horizontal annealing tube furnace at an idling temperature of $\le 200^\circ\text{C}$ under constant $\text{N}_2$ purge ($10\text{ SLM}$).
2. Purge tube for 10 minutes, then switch gas flow to Forming Gas ($10\%\ \text{H}_2 / 90\%\ \text{N}_2$) at $5\text{ SLM}$.
3. Ramp furnace temperature to $400^\circ\text{C}$ at $10^\circ\text{C/min}$.
4. Hold furnace at $400^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes in continuous $\text{H}_2/\text{N}_2$ flow to passivate dangling silicon bonds ($\text{Si}\cdot$) and alleviate interface traps ($D_{it}$).
5. Switch process gas back to pure $\text{N}_2$ purge ($10\text{ SLM}$) and ramp down/furnace cool to $< 150^\circ\text{C}$ before unloading wafers.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter | Inspection / Metrology Method | Target Value & Tolerance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **PVD Deposition Base Pressure** | In-situ Ion Gauge | $\le 5 \times 10^{-6}\ \text{Torr}$ |
| **Gate Al Dot Thickness** | Quartz Crystal Microbalance / Stylus Profilometry | $200\text{ nm} \pm 20\text{ nm}$ |
| **FGA Anneal Soak Temperature** | Multi-zone Furnace Thermocouples | $400^\circ\text{C} \pm 2^\circ\text{C}$ (30 min soak) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | High-Frequency & Quasistatic C-V Metrology | $< 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\ \text{eV}^{-1}$ |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | Voltage Ramp / Breakdown Probing | $> 10\ \text{MV/cm}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Validates gate dielectric physical thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation, dielectric breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\ \text{MV/cm}$, and baseline interface trap density target $D_{it} < 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\ \text{eV}^{-1}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Validates integration baseline for 180nm node gate dielectrics grown via dry thermal oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) and $V_{fb}$ Flatband Profiling

### 1. Document Control & Scope
* **SOP Code:** `SOP-MET-CV-180NM-001`
* **Target Node & Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 / 180nm Node) — Gate Dielectric Characterization
* **Target Structure:** MOS Capacitor test structures (e.g., $100\,\mu\text{m} \times 100\,\mu\text{m}$ poly-Si / 3.5 nm thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ / p-Si substrate)
* **Objective:** Extract interface trap density profile ($D_{it}$ across the bandgap) via combined High-Frequency (HF, $100\,\text{kHz} - 1\,\text{MHz}$) and Quasi-Static (QS) Capacitance-Voltage ($C$-$V$) profiling, flatband voltage ($V_{fb}$), and verify equivalent gate dielectric integrity.

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Environmental Setup
1. **Probe Station:** Shielded, dark, temperature-controlled probe station ($25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$) with vacuum chuck backside ground.
2. **LCR Meter / Impedance Analyzer:** Calibrated for High-Frequency $C$-$V$ ($100\,\text{kHz}$ to $1\,\text{MHz}$, AC drive $\le 15\,\text{mV}_\text{rms}$).
3. **Electrometer / Source Measure Unit (SMU):** Calibrated for Quasi-Static $C$-$V$ leakage and displacement current ($I_\text{leak} < 0.1\,\text{pA}$).
4. **Safety & Atmosphere:** Dry $N_2$ purge inside probe enclosure to maintain relative humidity $< 30\%$ and eliminate surface moisture bias.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                        C-V METROLOGY EXECUTION PIPELINE                           |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [1] Chuck Backside Contact & Dark Shield Purge (25°C, RH < 30%)                  |
|                                         |                                         |
|  [2] Open/Short Stray Capacitance Calibration                                     |
|                                         |                                         |
|  [3] High-Frequency C-V Sweep (100 kHz - 1 MHz, Inversion -> Accumulation)        |
|                                         |                                         |
|  [4] Quasi-Static (QS) Ramp C-V Sweep (Linear dV/dt, 10-50 mV/s)                  |
|                                         |                                         |
|  [5] Extraction & Castor-Nichollian Analysis:                                     |
|      - Flatband Capacitance (C_fb) -> Extract V_fb                                |
|      - High-Low Method: D_it = (C_ox / q) * [ (C_qs / (C_ox - C_qs))             |
|                                              - (C_hf / (C_ox - C_hf)) ]           |
|                                         |                                         |
|  [6] Pass/Fail Disposition vs Acceptance Thresholds                               |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Pre-Measurement Wafer Alignment & Conditioning
1. Load test wafer onto the gold-plated vacuum chuck ensuring low-resistance ohmic substrate backside contact.
2. Align microprobes to the MOS capacitor gate pads under low-intensity microscope illumination.
3. Lower probes, verify contact resistance ($R_\text{contact} < 10\,\Omega$), turn off optical illumination, and close the dark Faraday shield enclosure.
4. Purge with dry $\text{N}_2$ for 3 minutes until relative humidity stabilizes below $30\%$.

#### Step 2: High-Frequency (HF) Capacitance-Voltage Acquisition
1. Perform open-circuit and short-circuit fixture compensation on the LCR meter.
2. Configure AC test signal: $V_\text{ac} = 15\,\text{mV}_\text{rms}$ at frequency $f = 100\,\text{kHz}$ (or $1\,\text{MHz}$).
3. Sweep DC gate bias $V_g$ from deep inversion (e.g., $-2.0\,\text{V}$ for nMOS/p-sub) through depletion to strong accumulation ($+2.0\,\text{V}$) at a step rate $\le 20\,\text{mV/step}$.
4. Record high-frequency capacitance curve $C_\text{hf}(V_g)$ and verify oxide capacitance in deep accumulation ($C_\text{ox}$).

#### Step 3: Quasi-Static (QS) Capacitance-Voltage Acquisition
1. Switch matrix to the high-precision electrometer / quasi-static C-V meter.
2. Apply linear voltage ramp rate $\frac{dV}{dt} = 20\,\text{mV/s}$ from inversion to accumulation.
3. Measure the displacement current $I(V_g)$ and compute quasi-static capacitance:
   $$C_\text{qs}(V_g) = \frac{I(V_g)}{dV/dt}$$
4. Confirm gate leakage current is within valid operational bounds ($I_\text{leak} \ll I_\text{displacement}$).

#### Step 4: Parameter Extraction & Interface Trap Profiling
1. **Accumulation Oxide Thickness Validation:** Using $C_\text{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_0 \varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} A}{t_\text{ox}}$, verify physical oxide thickness matches the nominal 3.5 nm target.
2. **Flatband Voltage ($V_{fb}$):**
   * Compute Debye length $L_D$ and flatband capacitance $C_{fb} = \frac{C_\text{ox} C_s}{C_\text{ox} + C_s}$.
   * Identify $V_{fb}$ from the $C_\text{hf}$ curve corresponding to $C_{fb}$.
3. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) via High-Low (Castor-Nichollian) Method:**
   * Calculate interface trap density across the energy bandgap:
     $$D_{it}(V_g) = \frac{C_\text{ox}}{q} \left[ \frac{C_\text{qs}(V_g)}{C_\text{ox} - C_\text{qs}(V_g)} - \frac{C_\text{hf}(V_g)}{C_\text{ox} - C_\text{hf}(V_g)} \right]$$
   * Identify the minimum interface trap density ($D_{it,\text{midgap}}$).

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Nominal Target | Acceptance Window / Tolerance | Physical Units |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$ at Midgap)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\,\text{eV}^{-1}$ |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($t_\text{ox}$)** | $3.5$ | $3.5 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_\text{bd}$)** | $> 10$ | $\ge 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title
**Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Point Mapping (3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ Physical Thickness & Across-Wafer Uniformity)**

---

## 1. Process Flowchart

```text
            │
            │
            ▼

│                       │
│        Step 4:        │
│  Levenberg-Marquardt  │
│  Regression Fitting   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼

│     Quality Gate      │
│                       │

            │

        Pass│                             │
            ▼                             ▼

│    Release to Gate    │     │  Hold Lot & Trigger   │
│  Stack Metallization  │     │        Furnace        │
│                       │     │     Recalibration     │
│                       │     │                       │
└───────────────────────┘     └───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Calibration & Baseline Initialization
1. Verify system vacuum, xenon arc lamp stability ($> 30\text{ min}$ warm-up), and detector alignment.
2. Load standard calibration reference wafer ($\text{Si}$ substrate with certified $100.0\text{ nm} \pm 0.5\text{ nm } \text{SiO}_2$ thermal oxide).
3. Execute system qualification scan across $\lambda = 250\text{ nm}$ to $850\text{ nm}$ at angle of incidence $\Phi = 70^\circ$. Ensure $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ residual errors are $< 0.05\%$.

### Step 2: Metrology Recipe & Optical Stack Definition
1. Configure optical model stack:
   - **Substrate layer:** Semi-infinite single-crystal $\text{Si}(100)$ substrate with standard temperature-corrected dielectric permittivity ($\epsilon_1, \epsilon_2$).
   - **Interfacial layer:** $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$ sub-oxide transition layer ($d \approx 0.2\text{ nm}$ to $0.4\text{ nm}$, Bruggeman Effective Medium Approximation: $50\%\ \text{Si} + 50\%\ \text{SiO}_2$).
   - **Top film layer:** Thermally grown amorphous $\text{SiO}_2$ parameterized via Cauchy dispersion equation:
     $$n(\lambda) = A_n + \frac{B_n}{\lambda^2}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0$$
     *(Nominal $n = 1.46$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$)*.
2. Set incidence angles to multi-angle acquisition ($\Phi = 65^\circ, 70^\circ, 75^\circ$) across spectral range $\lambda = 250\text{ nm}$ to $800\text{ nm}$ to maximize parameter decoupling between $t_{\text{ox}}$ and $n$.

### Step 3: Automated Multi-Point Wafer Mapping
1. Robotically load the post-oxidation 180nm DRAM test/monitor wafer onto the vacuum chuck.
2. Align wafer notch/flat and register edge exclusion zone ($3.0\text{ mm}$ edge bead exclusion).
3. Execute standard automated multi-point concentric diametric pattern (49-point or 81-point polar radial pattern across the wafer area).

### Step 4: Spectral Fitting & Parameter Extraction
1. Execute Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear regression algorithm to fit measured experimental parameters $(\Psi_{\text{exp}}, \Delta_{\text{exp}})$ to theoretical model curves $(\Psi_{\text{model}}, \Delta_{\text{model}})$.
2. Calculate goodness-of-fit Mean Squared Error:
   $$\text{MSE} \le 1.50$$
3. Extract physical gate oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$ at every mapped coordinate.

### Step 5: Statistical Quality Gating & Data Logging
1. Compute wafer-level distribution statistics:
   - Arithmetic Mean Thickness: $\mu(t_{\text{ox}})$
   - Sample Standard Deviation: $\sigma(t_{\text{ox}})$
   - Across-Wafer Non-Uniformity (NU%):
     $$\text{NU\%} = \frac{t_{\text{max}} - t_{\text{min}}}{2 \cdot \mu(t_{\text{ox}})} \times 100\%$$
2. Log full polar wafer map and summary indices into Manufacturing Execution System (MES) metrology runcard. If any acceptance metric fails, flag lot on Engineering Hold and dispatch alert to furnace module engineers.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

```text
Acceptance Threshold Metrics (Norm/Target Units)

Max Dit (cm-2.eV-1)┤░░░░                             │
                   │░░░░                             │
   Min E_bd (MV/cm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                   │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
  Thickness 1s (nm)┤▒▒                               │
      Mean Tox (nm)┤████████████                     │
                   │████████████                     │
                   └┬───────┬───────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                   0.0     2.5     5.0     7.5   10.0 
```

| # | Parameter / Metric Description | Target Specification | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Method |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **1** | Mean Physical Oxide Thickness $\mu(t_{\text{ox}})$ | **$3.5$** | $\pm 0.2$ ($3.3$ to $3.7$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi, \Delta$ Cauchy fit) |
| **2** | Across-Wafer Thickness Standard Deviation ($1\sigma$) | **$\le 0.2$** | Upper Control Limit: $0.20$ | $\text{nm}$ | Multi-point automated radial map (49/81 pts) |
| **3** | Oxide Breakdown Electric Field ($E_{\text{bd}}$) | **$> 10$** | Lower Spec Limit: $10.0$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Companion MOS C-V / I-V Ramp Voltage Breakdown |
| **4** | Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$) | **$< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$** | Upper Spec Limit: $1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Low Frequency Quasi-static C-V profiling |

---

## 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Citation 1:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  *Directly cited:* 180nm node dry thermal gate dielectric targets $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness $\text{SiO}_2$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$; cell capacitor retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
* **Citation 2:** *Deal-Grove Silicon Oxidation Kinetic Coefficients & Gate Oxide Thickness*  
  *Directly cited:* At $850^\circ\text{C}$ in $100\%$ dry $\text{O}_2$ for $22\text{ min}$, oxidation yields physical gate thickness $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ ($B = 0.0031\ \mu\text{m}^2/\text{hr}$, $B/A = 0.018\ \mu\text{m}/\text{hr}$).
* **Citation 3:** *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*  
  *Directly cited:* Dry oxidation produces dense dielectric films exhibiting breakdown field $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and minimal interface trap state density $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ with physical thickness target of $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-SE-035`
### Title: Spectroscopic Ellipsometer Optical Model Calibration & Dispersion Fitting for 3.5 nm Ultra-Thin $\text{SiO}_2$
**Process Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > Horizontal Quartz Furnace Dry $\text{O}_2$ Oxidation Recipe Execution > Post-Oxidation Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & C-V Metrology > Multi-Point Mapping > Optical Model Calibration & Dispersion Fitting  
**Target Dielectric:** Ultra-Thin Gate Oxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) on Single-Crystal Silicon Substrate  
**Action Type:** Buy / Tool Recipe Configuration & Metrology Run

---

### 1. Purpose & Physical Principle
This procedure defines the setup, hardware baseline calibration, and optical dispersion modeling required to accurately measure ultra-thin 3.5 nm dry gate oxide films on single-crystal silicon. Spectroscopic ellipsometry evaluates the change in light polarization upon reflection:
$$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients, and $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ quantify amplitude ratio and phase shift across the broadband optical spectrum.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|               SPECTROSCOPIC ELLIPSOMETER CALIBRATION & RECIPE FLOW                |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  [Step 1] Baseline Calibration: Si reference wafer (straight-through & standard) |
|                                      |                                            |
|                                      v                                            |
|  [Step 2] Optical Model Setup: Fixed Si substrate (n, k) + Cauchy / Sellmeier layer|
|                                      |                                            |
|                                      v                                            |
|  [Step 3] Parameter Constraining: Fix n(632.8 nm) ~ 1.457, k = 0, float thickness t|
|                                      |                                            |
|                                      v                                            |
|  [Step 4] Spectral Acquisition: Measure Psi(λ) & Delta(λ) from UV to NIR          |
|                                      |                                            |
|                                      v                                            |
|  [Step 5] Regression & Fit Verification: Levenberg-Marquardt MSE minimization     |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: System Baseline & Hardware Calibration
1. Power on the broadband light source (Xe arc / deuterium-halogen lamp) and allow a 30-minute thermal stabilization cycle.
2. Load a certified thermal oxide on silicon calibration wafer (or bare Si reference).
3. Execute automated stage alignment: tilt/tip autocollimator adjustment until beam reflection intensity on the quad-cell photodetector is maximized and centered.
4. Verify polarizer-compensator-analyzer offset angles against factory baseline reference.

#### Step 2: Optical Dispersion Model Construction
1. Create a 2-phase optical stack in the software:
   - **Substrate:** Single-crystal Si (tabulated standard library $n(\lambda), k(\lambda)$ at room temperature).
   - **Overlayer:** Ultra-thin $\text{SiO}_2$ dielectric layer parameterized via Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion:
     $$n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) = 0$$
   - **Ambient:** Air ($n = 1.000$).

#### Step 3: Parameter Decoupling & Regression Constraints
1. For ultra-thin films in the sub-5 nm regime, strong parameter correlation exists between refractive index $n$ and physical thickness $t$. 
2. Fix the Cauchy dispersion coefficients ($A, B, C$) to established stoichiometric thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ values ($n \approx 1.457$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$) with zero extinction coefficient ($k = 0$).
3. Configure the non-linear regression engine (Levenberg-Marquardt) to float **only** the physical oxide thickness $t$.

#### Step 4: Spectral Data Acquisition
1. Set the goniometer angle of incidence ($\theta_0$) near the Brewster angle for silicon/oxide ($\approx 70^\circ - 75^\circ$) to maximize measurement sensitivity in $\Delta$.
2. Acquire spectral curves for $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ across the UV-visible-NIR spectrum.

#### Step 5: Regression Fitting & Validation
1. Execute the optical fit minimizing the Mean Squared Error (MSE) between experimental and modeled $\Psi$ and $\Delta$.
2. Review the correlation matrix to ensure parameter independence. Verify sub-Angstrom thickness resolution.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Specification Target | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Measurement Precision (Static Repeatability)** | $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0.5\text{ \AA}$) | 30-cycle dynamic measurement at wafer center |
| **Target Physical Film Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5\text{ nm to } 4.0\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry regression fit |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{\text{bd}}$)** | $> 10\text{ MV/cm}$ | Post-gate C-V / I-V breakdown characterization |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$)** | $< 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-frequency / quasi-static C-V profiling |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology:**
  - *Physical Principle & Equation:* $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ utilizing Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion models parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Precision:* Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) measurement precision verified at $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - *Dry Oxide Target & Quality:* Dry oxidation produces dense dielectric films with target thickness of $3.5\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$, dielectric breakdown $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, and interface trap density $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$.
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-SE-49PT-180NM`
**Title:** Automated 49-Point Wafer Mapping Recipe Setup & Multi-Angle Polarization Data Acquisition  
**Target Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Process Layer / Context:** Dry Thermal Gate Oxide (3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ on Si) Post-Furnace Oxidation Metrology  
**Equipment:** Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer with motorized $R\text{-}\theta$ / $X\text{-}Y$ mapping stage and multi-angle goniometer  

---

### 1. Optical Model Setup & Calibration
1. **Instrument Initialization & Reference Alignment:**
   - Initialize the optical goniometer and automated stage.
   - Run system autocalibration using a certified standard reference wafer (Native oxide on Bare Si standard) to verify polarizer/analyzer angle offset calibration.
2. **Layer Stack Definition:**
   - Define the optical substrate and film stack:
     $$\text{Air} \ (\tilde{n}=1.000) \ \Big/ \ \text{Thermal } \text{SiO}_2 \ (\text{Nominal: } 3.5\text{ nm}) \ \Big/ \ \text{Crystalline Silicon Substrate (c-Si)}$$
   - Parameterize the optical dispersion for the ultra-thin $\text{SiO}_2$ dielectric layer using Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion parameters ($n \approx 1.457$ at $\lambda = 632.8\text{ nm}$, $k(\lambda) = 0$).
3. **Multi-Angle Optical Configuration:**
   - Configure multi-angle incidence at near-Brewster angles for silicon ($\Phi_0 = 65^\circ, 70^\circ, 75^\circ$) across the spectral range ($250\text{ nm} \le \lambda \le 850\text{ nm}$).

---

### 2. 49-Point Polar Pattern Mapping Recipe Configuration
1. **Coordinate & Edge Exclusion Setup:**
   - Configure a standard 49-point polar/radial layout across the 200 mm wafer:
     - 1 point at wafer center ($r = 0\text{ mm}$).
     - Concentric radial rings distributed at varying radii up to the maximum active aperture.
     - Enforce a strict edge exclusion zone of $5\text{ mm}$ (outermost measurement radius $r \le 95\text{ mm}$).
2. **Polarization Data Acquisition Setup:**
   - Set signal averaging and integration time per point (target acquisition: $\approx 1.5 - 2.5\text{ s}$ per site).
   - Configure the hardware detector to measure polarization state ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients, resolving raw spectra for $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$.

---

### 3. Automated Execution & Polarization Acquisition
1. **Wafer Loading & Autofocus:**
   - Transfer the dry gate oxidation wafer onto the vacuum chuck via automated end-effector.
   - Engage automated height/tilt autofocus ($Z$-alignment and tilt correction) via quad-cell position-sensitive detector (PSD) at the center die.
2. **Automated 49-Point Sequence:**
   - Initiate the 49-point mapping recipe.
   - System steps through all 49 coordinates, recording $\Psi(\lambda, \Phi_0)$ and $\Delta(\lambda, \Phi_0)$ at each location.
3. **Model Regression & Thickness Extraction:**
   - Execute Levenberg-Marquardt regression fitting across all 49 measured spectra to extract physical gate oxide film thickness ($T_{ox}$) and across-wafer thickness standard deviation ($\sigma$).

---

### Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Multi-point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry fit |
| **Measurement Precision (Sub-Angstrom)** | $\pm 0.05$ | Max $\le 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Repeatability on static point ($3\sigma$) |
| **Spectral Range** | $250 - 850$ | Exact range coverage | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic spectrometer detector check |
| **Wafer Edge Exclusion** | $5.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $\text{mm}$ | Stage recipe coordinates ($r \le 95\text{ mm}$) |

---

### Context Citations
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**: Polarization relation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$; Cauchy and Sellmeier optical dispersion modeling; 49-point automated wafer mapping for radial uniformity tracking; $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide metrology with sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Verification of gate dielectric physical target ($3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ via $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation process).
citations: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology (Tompkins & Irene - Handbook of Ellipsometry)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Radial Thickness Uniformity Extraction, Edge-Exclusion Analysis & Furnace Thermal Profile Feedback

**Module / Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Post-Oxidation Metrology > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Point Mapping  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Target Dielectric:** Ultra-thin Gate Oxide ($SiO_2$, nominal $3.5\text{ nm}$)  

---

### 1. Process & Procedural Steps

```text
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       | Step 1: Automated Multi-Point Spectroscopic Mapping   |
       |  - 49-point polar grid (0 deg to 360 deg, r <= 97mm)  |
       +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       | Step 2: Dispersion Model Fitting & Refractive Index   |
       |  - Cauchy/Sellmeier model (lambda: 190 nm - 800 nm)   |
       |  - Validate Psi, Delta and MSE (Goodness of Fit)      |
       +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       | Step 3: Radial Uniformity & Edge-Exclusion Extraction |
       |  - 3 mm edge exclusion zone filter                    |
       |  - Calculate mean thickness (T_mean) and 1-sigma / NU%|
       +---------------------------+---------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
       | Step 4: Closed-Loop Furnace Thermal Profile Feedback  |
       |  - Calculate delta-T across Load/Center/Source zones  |
       |  - Feed offset into horizontal quartz furnace recipe  |
       +-------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Automated Multi-Point Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Mapping
1. Load the oxidized 200 mm production/pilot monitor wafer onto the vacuum stage of the spectroscopic ellipsometer.
2. Select the automated **49-point wafer mapping** routine consisting of concentric polar rings (center, radial intermediate zones, and outer rim points up to $r = 97\text{ mm}$).
3. Measure the ellipsometric angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ across the spectral range from UV to visible ($\lambda = 190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$) where:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$

#### Step 2: Dispersion Model Fitting & Refractive Index Verification
1. Parameterize the dielectric film using a pre-calibrated **Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion model** on top of the single-crystal silicon substrate.
2. Fit physical oxide thickness ($t_{ox}$) simultaneously with dielectric refractive index $n(\lambda)$. Ensure the mean squared error (MSE) of the regression fit satisfies tool qualification standards.

#### Step 3: Radial Uniformity & Edge-Exclusion Analysis
1. Apply a standard **$3\text{ mm}$ edge-exclusion filter** to disregard mechanical handling clamp artifacts and edge-bead boundaries ($r > 97\text{ mm}$).
2. Extract the radial profile data across concentric radii: center ($r = 0$), mid-radial ($r = 30\text{ mm}, 60\text{ mm}$), and outer boundary ($r = 95\text{ mm}$).
3. Calculate mean thickness ($\bar{x}$) and wafer non-uniformity percentage ($NU\%$):
   $$NU\% = \left(\frac{t_{max} - t_{min}}{2 \cdot \bar{x}}\right) \times 100\% \quad \text{or} \quad \frac{1\sigma}{\bar{x}} \times 100\%$$

#### Step 4: Closed-Loop Thermal Profile Feedback to Quartz Furnace
1. Correlate radial and wafer-to-wafer axial thickness deviations with furnace thermal zones (Load, Center, Source) under Deal-Grove linear-rate oxidation kinetics ($k_l = B/A$).
2. If radial variation or boat-slot drift exceeds control limits, calculate the thermal offset ($\Delta T$) required to correct the growth rate and push the feedback offset table into the horizontal quartz tube controller.

---

### 2. Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Control Limit | Exact Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nominal Gate Oxide Thickness** | $3.50$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (Cauchy/Sellmeier Fit) |
| **Across-Wafer Radial Uniformity ($1\sigma$)** | $< 1.0$ | $\le 1.5$ | $\%$ | 49-point automated polar map ($3\text{ mm}$ edge-exclusion) |
| **Ellipsometric Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\le 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry tool repeatability monitor |
| **Furnace Temperature Correction Step** | $0.0$ | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Thermocouple closed-loop temperature controller offset |

---

### 3. Context Citations

* **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**:
  * Ellipsometric physical parameterization based on fundamental polarization ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$.
  * Dispersion modeled with Cauchy / Sellmeier equations for parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  * Multi-point mapping tracking radial film non-uniformity across 49-point wafer patterns with sub-Angstrom measurement precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) targeting $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide.
* **[Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace]**:
  * Dry thermal oxidation kinetics governed by interface reaction-limited regime ($x_0 \ll A/2$, $k_l = B/A$) for thin $3.5\text{ nm}$ to $4.0\text{ nm}$ gate dielectric growth in quartz tube furnaces, establishing the thermal coefficient sensitivity for zone profile adjustment.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Mercury Probe High-Frequency & Quasistatic C-V Characterization (EOT & Flatband Voltage Extraction)

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Wafer Load on Hg   │
│        Stage         │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Purge & Contact    │
│      Formation       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  HF 1 MHz C-V Sweep  │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Quasistatic C-V    │
│        Sweep         │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│      Parameter       │
│  Extraction: EOT &   │
│         Vfb          │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Tool Initialization & Capillary Area Calibration**:
   - Verify Mercury (Hg) probe pneumatic feed and reservoir purity. 
   - Calibrate the capillary orifice contact area ($A$) using a calibrated standard test wafer. Standard circular contact area nominal diameter: $500\ \mu\text{m}$ (or $200\ \mu\text{m} / 1000\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Ensure inert environment ($\text{N}_2$ purge box) to prevent surface moisture adsorption on the dry thermal oxide.

2. **Wafer Placement & Vacuum Backside Contact**:
   - Place the P-type (100) silicon monitor wafer (with 3.5 nm dry gate oxide grown at 850°C–900°C) face-up onto the vacuum chuck.
   - Engage chuck vacuum to secure the wafer and form the backside substrate ground contact.

3. **Mercury Droplet Contact Formation**:
   - Actuate pneumatic pressure to raise the high-purity mercury column through the glass capillary to contact the frontside 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ surface non-destructively, forming a temporary mercury-gate MOSCAP without shadow-mask sputtering.

4. **High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Sweep**:
   - Set LCR / impedance meter frequency to $f = 1\ \text{MHz}$ with an AC oscillation signal $V_{\text{ac}} = 15\ \text{mV}_{\text{rms}}$ to $25\ \text{mV}_{\text{rms}}$.
   - Sweep gate bias $V_G$ from accumulation ($V_G < V_{\text{fb}}$, typically $-2.5\ \text{V}$) through depletion ($V_{\text{fb}} < V_G < V_T$) to deep inversion ($V_G > V_T$, up to $+2.0\ \text{V}$).
   - Measure high-frequency accumulation capacitance where $C$ saturates at maximum oxide capacitance $C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{ox}} \varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}}{t_{\text{ox}}}$.

5. **Quasistatic (Low-Frequency) C-V Sweep**:
   - Configure the electrometer/picoammeter for quasistatic ramp mode with slow voltage ramp rate (e.g., $10\ \text{mV/s} - 50\ \text{mV/s}$) under light-tight enclosure.
   - Measure displacement current $I(t)$ to calculate $C_{\text{qs}} = \frac{I(t)}{dV/dt}$.
   - Confirm low-frequency inversion capacitance recovers to $C_{\text{ox}}$ due to equilibrium generation-recombination response.

6. **Parameter Extraction**:
   - **EOT / Physical Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)**: Extracted directly from accumulation $C_{\text{ox}}$:
     $$t_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{ox}} \varepsilon_0 \cdot A}{C_{\text{ox}}}$$
     with target thickness $3.5\ \text{nm}$ ($\varepsilon_{\text{ox}} \approx 3.9$, $\varepsilon_0 = 8.854 \times 10^{-14}\ \text{F/cm}$).
   - **Flatband Capacitance ($C_{\text{fb}}$) & Flatband Voltage ($V_{\text{fb}}$)**: Calculate extrinsic Debye length and corresponding flatband capacitance $C_{\text{fb}}$ to extract $V_{\text{fb}}$ along the transition point from accumulation to depletion.
   - **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$)**: Extract $D_{\text{it}}$ across the bandgap using the high-frequency vs. quasistatic discrepancy ($\Delta C = C_{\text{qs}} - C_{\text{hf}}$).

7. **Retraction & Depressurization**:
   - Retract the mercury droplet back into the capillary tube via vacuum pullback.
   - Release wafer chuck vacuum and inspect wafer surface to confirm zero mercury residue.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT / $t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5 \pm 0.1$ | $\text{nm}$ | Extracted from accumulation capacitance $C_{\text{ox}}$ at $1\ \text{MHz}$ |
| **Test Contact Orifice Diameter** | $500 \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Capillary aperture calibration standard |
| **Measurement Test Frequency (HF)** | $1.0$ | $\text{MHz}$ | AC small signal oscillation |
| **Quasistatic Inversion Recovery ($C_{\text{qs,inv}} / C_{\text{ox}}$)** | $\ge 0.95$ | ratio (dimensionless) | Equilibrium thermal generation recovery check |

---

### 3. Sourced Context References

- **Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
  - Test contact geometries ($200\ \mu\text{m}, 500\ \mu\text{m}, 1000\ \mu\text{m}$).
  - Accumulation region ($V_G < V_{\text{fb}}$) saturation formula: $C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{ox}} \varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}}{t_{\text{ox}}}$, physical thickness precision of $\pm 0.1\ \text{nm}$.
  - Depletion dynamics ($V_{\text{fb}} < V_G < V_T$) and inversion recovery under quasistatic vs. minimum capacitance under high-frequency ($1\ \text{MHz}$).
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Dry thermal gate oxidation target of $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ physical thickness grown at 850°C–900°C for the 180nm node.
citations: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction (Nicollian & Brews - MOS Physics and Technology)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Mercury Probe Contact Calibration & Wafer Backside Ohmic Contact Prep

### 1. Process Overview & Workflow
This SOP details the preparation of a low-resistance ohmic substrate contact and the physical/pneumatic area calibration of a mercury (Hg) drop capillary orifice. It enables non-destructive Capacitance-Voltage ($C$-$V$) characterization for 180nm DRAM gate dielectric structures ($3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$).

```text
┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Wafer Backside Native Oxide Strip (BOE)   │
└─────────────────────┬─────────────────────┘
                      │
                      ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Backside Ohmic Interface Prep (GaIn EGaIn)│
└─────────────────────┬─────────────────────┘
                      │
                      ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Mercury Orifice Purge & Capillary Metering│
└─────────────────────┬─────────────────────┘
                      │
                      ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Calibration Wafer Contact Area Extraction │
└─────────────────────┬─────────────────────┘
                      │
                      ▼
┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
│ Readiness Sign-Off for Gate Oxide C-V     │
└───────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Personal Protective Equipment & Mercury Enclosure Safety**:
   - Verify continuous exhaust ventilation on the Mercury Probe station ($face\ velocity \ge 0.5\text{ m/s}$).
   - Wear double nitrile gloves and inspect mercury trap canisters for containment integrity.

2. **Wafer Backside Native Oxide Cleanse & Ohmic Activation**:
   - Mount the wafer frontside against a cleanroom-grade protective elastomeric film or PTFE vacuum wand to protect the frontside $3.5\text{ nm}$ thermal gate oxide.
   - Swab or dip the wafer backside with buffered oxide etch (BOE / dilute HF) to strip native oxide down to bare hydrophobic single-crystal silicon. Rinse immediately with deionized (DI) water ($>18\text{ M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) and blow dry with ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$.
   - Apply a micro-film of Eutectic Gallium-Indium (Ga-In) paste onto the backside bare silicon (or scrub directly onto a gold-plated vacuum stage) to eliminate series resistance and suppress parasitic Schottky barriers.

3. **Substrate Ohmic Vacuum Mounting**:
   - Transfer the wafer onto the mercury probe stage with the gate-oxide-bearing frontside facing the capillary orifice.
   - Engage backside stage vacuum ($<-70\text{ kPa}$) to ensure uniform, rigid planar contact against the gold/GaIn-wetted ground chuck.

4. **Mercury Capillary Purge & Meniscus Calibration**:
   - Actuate pneumatic pressure/vacuum sequencing on the triple-distilled mercury reservoir to draw and expel fresh mercury through the capillary orifice, clearing oxidized Hg surface dross.
   - Load a certified thermal oxide calibration wafer standard (known uniform oxide thickness) to extract the effective electrical contact area ($A_{\text{Hg}}$) under standard vacuum pull down.
   - Verify repeat contact stability by measuring high-frequency accumulation capacitance across 5 successive contact drops.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Backside Contact Series Resistance ($R_s$)** | $< 10.0$ | $\Omega$ | Maximum upper control limit |
| **Mercury Contact Area Repeatability ($\sigma_{A} / A_{\text{Hg}}$)** | $\le 1.0$ | $\%$ | 5-point touch cycle reproducibility |
| **Hg Squeeze Pressure / Capillary Vacuum** | $-50.0$ to $-65.0$ | $\text{kPa}$ | Closed-loop pneumatic regulated pressure |
| **Oxide Cleanliness / Contamination Limit ($D_{it}$ baseline window)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Maximum post-prep background limit |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Target gate dielectric thickness: *"$3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$"* grown via dry oxidation at *"$850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$"* producing minimal interface trap density (*"$D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$"*).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Thermal gate oxide specifications: *"Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness."*
- **Source: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks**:
  - Wet chemistry resistance metrics: BOE etch resistance and stripping kinetics (*"HF and BOE"*).
