nodes.label: Dual-Mode High-Frequency (1 MHz) & Quasistatic C-V Multi-Site Measurement
nodes.sop_content:
An industrial Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for **Dual-Mode High-Frequency (1 MHz) & Quasistatic C-V Multi-Site Measurement** on 180nm dry gate dielectric wafers:

---

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dual-Mode High-Frequency (1 MHz) & Quasistatic C-V Multi-Site Measurement

- **Document ID:** `SOP-MET-CV-180NM-001`
- **Revision:** 1.0
- **Process Step:** Post-Oxidation Mercury Probe High-Frequency (HF) & Quasistatic C-V Multi-Site Characterization
- **Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm Architecture)
- **Target Dielectric:** ~3.5 nm Thermally Grown Gate $\text{SiO}_2$

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Signal Flow

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Multi-Site Mercury (Hg) Probe C-V Metrology Flow                                  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
  [Wafer Load & N2 Purge]
           |
           v
  [Capillary Hg Top-Contact Dispense (A_dot calibration)]
           |
           v
  +---------------------------------------+
  | Dual-Mode Sweep Routine (5-9 Sites)   |
  | 1. High-Frequency (HF): 1 MHz AC      |
  |    (Inversion -> Depletion -> Accum.) |
  | 2. Quasistatic (QS): Low-leakage ramp |
  |    (Interface state response)         |
  +---------------------------------------+
           |
           v
  [Extraction: EOT, V_fb, D_it, and E_bd Screen]
           |
           v
  [Pass/Fail SPC Disposition & Auto-Retract Hg Contact]
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System Preparation & Environment Check**:
   - Verify Mercury (Hg) probe exhaust and stage temperature ($23.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Run chuck continuity and open/short zero-calibration on the LCR meter at $1\text{ MHz}$.
   - Inspect the capillary tube for clean meniscus formation to maintain contact area accuracy ($A \approx 0.01\text{ cm}^2$).

2. **Wafer Alignment & Multi-Site Pattern Setup**:
   - Load the oxidized monitor wafer (180nm gate dielectric test wafer, nominal $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$).
   - Program a standard multi-site recipe (minimum 5 sites: Center, North, South, East, West with $5\text{ mm}$ edge exclusion).

3. **High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Sweep**:
   - Lower the capillary to form a non-destructive Hg dot Schottky/MOS contact.
   - Apply a small AC oscillation signal ($V_{ac} = 15\text{ mV}$ RMS at $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$).
   - Sweep DC bias voltage from deep inversion to deep accumulation (e.g., $-2.0\text{ V}$ to $+2.0\text{ V}$ for p-type Si) at a rate of $50\text{ mV/s}$.
   - Record accumulation capacitance ($C_{ox}$) and extract flatband voltage ($V_{fb}$).

4. **Quasistatic (QS) C-V Sweep**:
   - At the identical contact location, switch the instrument matrix to the electrometer/picoammeter unit.
   - Execute a linear DC voltage ramp ($dV/dt \le 20\text{ mV/s}$) to measure the displacement current:
     $$C_{QS} = \frac{I_{meas}}{dV/dt}$$
   - Correlate $C_{HF}$ and $C_{QS}$ using the High-Low frequency method to map interface trap density across the silicon bandgap:
     $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{QS} / C_{ox}}{1 - C_{QS} / C_{ox}} - \frac{C_{HF} / C_{ox}}{1 - C_{HF} / C_{ox}} \right)$$

5. **Multi-Site Repetition & Wafer Unload**:
   - Retract Hg capillary under vacuum pullback.
   - Step the XY stage to adjacent programmed sites. Repeat steps 3–4 across all 5–9 dies.
   - Generate summary wafer maps for EOT, $V_{fb}$, and $D_{it}$.
   - Perform post-measurement capillary blow-down and purge stage chuck with dry $\text{N}_2$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Operational / Physical Metric | Acceptance Spec | Target Physical Unit | Context Source Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | Physical accumulation capacitance extraction ($C_{ox}$) | **$3.5\text{ to }4.0$** | $\text{nm}$ | *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics* & *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture* |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | High-Low ($C_{HF}$ vs. $C_{QS}$) mid-gap extraction | **$< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$** | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics* |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | Destructive/Ramp electric field screen ($V_{bd} / t_{ox}$) | **$> 10.0$** | $\text{MV/cm}$ | *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics* |
| **High-Frequency Test Frequency ($f$)** | LCR bridge carrier oscillator frequency | **$1.0 \pm 0.01$** | $\text{MHz}$ | *Dual-Mode High-Frequency & Quasistatic C-V* |

---

### 4. Context References & Source Attribution

- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - Thickness target for 180nm gate dielectric: $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$.
  - Interface trap density target: $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$.
  - Dielectric breakdown strength: $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Gate dielectric baseline: thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Quantum-Corrected C-V Parameter Extraction ($EOT$, $V_{fb}$, $D_{it}$ & Substrate Doping $N_{sub}$)

**Node Level:** Leaf Node | **Generation:** Gen 2 ($\mu$m) | **Action Type:** Make  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Mercury Probe High-Frequency & Quasistatic C-V Characterization

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│     Raw C-V Data     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Series Resistance   │
│      Correction      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Quantum-Mechanical  │
│    C-V Simulator     │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│      Parameter       │
│   Extraction: EOT,   │
│    Vfb, Dit, Nsub    │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│      Acceptance      │
│     Verification     │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This procedure details the quantum-mechanical parameter extraction from dual High-Frequency (HF, $100\text{ kHz}-1\text{ MHz}$) and Quasistatic (QS) Capacitance-Voltage ($C$-$V$) characteristics measured via Mercury Probe on 180nm gate dielectric test structures. Classical MOS capacitance models overestimate dielectric thickness due to carrier wave-function displacement (finite inversion/accumulation layer thickness) and gate depletion effects, necessitating 1D Schrödinger-Poisson quantum corrections.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Data Ingestion & Series Resistance ($R_s$) Correction:**
   - Import the paired raw capacitance-conductance data curves: HF ($C_{m}, G_{m}$ vs. $V_g$) and QS ($C_{qs}$ vs. $V_g$).
   - Apply two-frequency or impedance correction to extract true MOS capacitance $C_c(V_g)$:
     $$C_c = \frac{(G_m^2 + \omega^2 C_m^2) C_m}{[\omega^2 C_m - (G_m^2 + \omega^2 C_m^2) R_s]^2 + G_m^2}$$
     where $R_s = \frac{G_{ma}}{(G_{ma}^2 + \omega^2 C_{ma}^2)}$ evaluated at strong accumulation.

2. **Substrate Doping Profile ($N_{sub}$) Determination:**
   - Extract the active substrate doping concentration from the slope of the classical $1/C^2$ vs. gate voltage ($V_g$) characteristic in deep depletion:
     $$N_{sub} = \frac{2}{q \epsilon_{Si} A^2 \left|\frac{d(1/C_c^2)}{d V_g}\right|}$$
   - Validate uniformity across the depletion depth before initiating quantum solver iteration.

3. **Quantum-Mechanical Simulation Iteration (Schrödinger-Poisson Solver):**
   - Execute a self-consistent 1D Schrödinger-Poisson simulator for the Si substrate under strong accumulation/inversion to calculate quantum charge centroid offset ($\Delta z_{inv}, \Delta z_{acc}$).
   - Adjust the physical dielectric thickness $t_{ox}$ (and dielectric constant $\kappa = 3.9$ for thermal $\text{SiO}_2$) until the simulated quantum accumulation capacitance matches the measured accumulation curve:
     $$C_{acc,QM} = \frac{A}{\frac{EOT}{\epsilon_{ox}} + \frac{\Delta z_{acc}}{\epsilon_{Si}}}$$
   - Extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($EOT$).

4. **Flatband Voltage ($V_{fb}$) Extraction:**
   - Calculate flatband capacitance $C_{fb}$ using the extracted $N_{sub}$ and Debye length ($\lambda_D$):
     $$C_{fb} = \frac{\epsilon_{ox}}{EOT + \left(\frac{\epsilon_{ox}}{\epsilon_{Si}}\right) \lambda_D}, \quad \lambda_D = \sqrt{\frac{k_B T \epsilon_{Si}}{q^2 N_{sub}}}$$
   - Identify $V_{fb}$ as the gate voltage corresponding to $C_c(V_g) = C_{fb}$.

5. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Spectrum Calculation:**
   - Apply the High-Low Frequency (Castagné-Vapaille) method across the depletion-to-weak-inversion regime:
     $$D_{it}(V_g) = \frac{C_{ox}}{q A} \left( \frac{\frac{C_{qs}}{C_{ox}}}{1 - \frac{C_{qs}}{C_{ox}}} - \frac{\frac{C_{hf}}{C_{ox}}}{1 - \frac{C_{hf}}{C_{ox}}} \right)$$
   - Map $V_g$ to the silicon bandgap energy $E - E_v$ via the surface potential $\psi_s(V_g)$ calculated by integrating the low-frequency curve: $\psi_s(V_g) = \int_{V_{fb}}^{V_g} \left(1 - \frac{C_{qs}}{C_{ox}}\right) dV_g$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Targets

| Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement / Extraction Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($EOT$)** | `3.5` | `± 0.2` (3.3 to 3.7) | $\text{nm}$ | 1D Schrödinger-Poisson accumulation fit ($\kappa = 3.9$) |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$ midgap)** | `< 1.0E+10` | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Low ($C_{qs} - C_{hf}$) Castagné-Vapaille extraction |
| **Substrate Doping Concentration ($N_{sub}$)** | `1.0E+17` | `± 20%` ($0.8\text{--}1.2 \times 10^{17}$) | $\text{cm}^{-3}$ | Deep-depletion $d(1/C^2)/dV$ slope fitting |
| **Flatband Voltage Shift ($\Delta V_{fb}$)** | `0.00` | `± 0.05` | $\text{V}$ | Deviation from theoretical $\Phi_{ms}$ ($\text{Hg}$-$\text{Si}$) |

---

### 4. Context Citations & Technical Justification

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**  
  - Specifies gate oxide physical thickness target for the 180nm dielectric node as **$3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$**, thermally grown in dry $\text{O}_2$ with an interface trap density target of **$D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{ eV}^{-1}$**.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**  
  - Sets the peripheral and gate dielectric baseline at **~3.5 nm physical thickness** grown via dry oxidation at **850°C–900°C**, and establishes the **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT) window around 3 to 4 nm**.
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Gate Oxide Integrity & Interface Trap Density (D_it) Extraction via C-V/I-V Parameter Analysis

**Discipline / Context**: Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) [Thermal Oxidation] > Horizontal Quartz Furnace Dry O2 Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C, Pure O2/N2 Dilution) [Thermal Oxidation] > Post-Oxidation Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (3.5nm SiO2 Thickness & Uniformity) and C-V Metrology [Metrology] > Gate Oxide Integrity & Interface Trap Density (D_it) Extraction via C-V/I-V Parameter Analysis [Metrology]
**Target Generation**: Gen 1 (mm) | **Action Type**: Make

### 1. Equipment & Environmental Pre-Flight
- Verify cleanroom ambient conditions (Class 1000 / Class 100 laminar flow hood, Temp: 21°C ± 1°C, Humidity: 45% ± 5%).
- Inspect facility interlocks (exhaust velocity > 0.5 m/s, DI water loop > 18.0 MΩ·cm).

### 2. Physical Tool Calibration & Fixturing
- Mount substrate onto vacuum chuck stage and align optical/mechanical fiducials.
- Zero calibration instruments and establish baseline noise floor.

### 3. Process Execution & Parameter Validation
- Execute process sequence according to verified recipe parameters: Oxide Thickness Tox: 3.5 nm (Gate) / 350 nm (Field).
- Monitor thermal/chemical/optical transients during execution.

### 4. Post-Process Metrology & Quality Acceptance
- Perform physical verification using Spectroscopic Ellipsometer / C-V Profiler.
- Log 10 consecutive measurement cycles to guarantee process repeatability (Cp/Cpk >= 1.33).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## MOS Capacitor Test Structure Metallization & Post-Metal Forming Gas Anneal (FGA)

**Module:** Metrology & Characterization  
**Generation / Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)  
**Parent Workflows:** [180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm)](docs/context.yaml) → Post-Oxidation Metrology → Gate Oxide Integrity & $D_{it}$ Extraction  

---

### Process Flow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Clean Wafer with    │
│       3.5nm SiO2       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Shadow Mask Al Gate   │
│     Metallization      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Backside Oxide Strip  │
│   & Al Back Contact    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Forming Gas Anneal   │
│    FGA at 400C-450C    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│       C-V & I-V        │
│    Characterization    │
│        Dit/Ebd         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Metallization Preparation & Shadow Mask Fixturing**
   - Retrieve Si test wafer having thermally grown gate oxide ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Inspect surface via optical inspection under cleanroom yellow light. Ensure zero organic/particulate contamination.
   - Mount wafer onto a precision stainless-steel / molybdenum shadow mask fixture containing predefined circular MOS dot apertures (diameters: $100\,\mu\text{m}$, $200\,\mu\text{m}$, $500\,\mu\text{m}$).

2. **Top-Gate Aluminum Metallization (Thermal Evaporation / Sputtering)**
   - Load fixtured assembly into high-vacuum physical vapor deposition (PVD) chamber.
   - Pump down base pressure to $\le 5 \times 10^{-6}\text{ Torr}$ to minimize residual oxygen incorporation.
   - Deposit high-purity aluminum ($\text{Al}$, 99.999% purity) targeting a film thickness of $300\text{ nm} \pm 20\text{ nm}$ at a deposition rate of $0.5\text{ to }1.0\text{ nm/s}$.
   - Cool down under high vacuum for 10 minutes prior to chamber venting with dry $\text{N}_2$.

3. **Backside Oxide De-glaze & Ohmic Substrate Metallization**
   - Protect wafer front side with inert cleanroom film / clean mechanical chuck.
   - Dip/swab wafer backside in buffered oxide etch (BOE / dilute HF) to strip parasitic back-oxide until hydrophobic silicon substrate is exposed.
   - Rinse thoroughly with DI water ($> 18\,\text{M}\Omega\cdot\text{cm}$) and blow dry with ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$.
   - Deposit blanket aluminum layer ($300\text{ nm}$) on wafer backside to form low-resistance ohmic substrate contact.

4. **Post-Metallization Forming Gas Anneal (FGA)**
   - Transfer MOS capacitor test wafer into an atmospheric quartz tube annealing furnace.
   - Purge furnace tube with pure nitrogen ($\text{N}_2$) at room temperature for 15 minutes.
   - Introduce forming gas mixture ($10\%\ \text{H}_2\ /\ 90\%\ \text{N}_2$ or $5\%\ \text{H}_2\ /\ 95\%\ \text{N}_2$) at a controlled flow rate.
   - Ramp tube furnace to $400^\circ\text{C}\text{--}450^\circ\text{C}$ and soak for 30 minutes to passivate silicon dangling bonds ($\text{Si}\cdot + \text{H} \rightarrow \text{Si-H}$) at the $\text{Si/SiO}_2$ interface and sinter $\text{Al/Si}$ ohmic contacts.
   - Cool furnace to $< 150^\circ\text{C}$ under continuous $\text{N}_2$ purge before unloading.

5. **Parametric High-Frequency / Quasi-Static C-V & I-V Metrology**
   - Transfer MOS capacitors to probe station shielded with a dark Faraday cage.
   - Acquire High-Frequency ($100\text{ kHz} - 1\text{ MHz}$) and Quasi-Static / Low-Frequency Capacitance-Voltage ($C\text{-}V$) sweeps to extract accumulation capacitance ($C_{ox}$), Flatband Voltage ($V_{fb}$), and Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$).
   - Perform ramped Voltage Breakdown ($I\text{-}V$) stress test across MOS dots to determine dielectric breakdown field ($E_{bd}$).

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                      Critical MOS Physical Metrics     
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░░░░░░░░░░                          │
Al Thk (x100 nm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░                          │
   SiO2 Thk (nm)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                        │
                │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                        │
    E_bd (MV/cm)┤██████████████████████████████████████│
                │██████████████████████████████████████│
                └┬────────┬─────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                0.0      2.5       5.0      7.5    10.0 
```

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5\text{ to }4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry / Accumulation $C_{ox}$ |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Low Frequency (Terman / Castagné-Vapaille) $C\text{-}V$ Extraction |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10.0$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Ramped Voltage $I\text{-}V$ Test ($I_{leakage} \ge 1\,\mu\text{A}$) |
| **Top & Back Al Contact Thickness** | $300 \pm 20$ | $\text{nm}$ | Stylus Profilometry / In-situ Quartz Crystal Monitor (QCM) |
| **Forming Gas Anneal Temperature** | $400\text{ to }450$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-zone Furnace Thermocouple Control ($\pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$) |

---

### Literature Context Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: Validates physical gate dielectric thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ in dry $\text{O}_2$, interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$, and dielectric breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms gate dielectric physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ and cell equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) window ($3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$) supporting the 180nm node integration baseline.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-CV-180NM-001`
**Title:** High-Frequency & Quasi-Static C-V Characterization for $D_{it}$ & Flatband Voltage ($V_{fb}$) Extraction  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology  
**Node / Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Target Structure:** MOS Test Capacitor / Gate Dielectric (3.5 nm thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ on single-crystal Si substrate)

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This SOP defines the procedure for performing combined High-Frequency (HF) and Quasi-Static (QS) Capacitance-Voltage ($C$-$V$) sweeps on MOS test monitor structures (p-type or n-type substrate gate pads) to extract:
1. Flatband Voltage ($V_{fb}$) and Fixed Oxide Charge Density ($Q_{ox}$).
2. Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($EOT$) / Physical Thickness ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).
3. Midgap Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) via the Castagné–Vapaille (high-low frequency) method.

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Tooling
* **Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer / LCR Meter:** Keysight B1500A (or equivalent with B1520A Multifrequency CMU and B1500A HRSMU/High-Resolution SMU for quasi-static measurements).
* **Semi-Automated Cryo/Ambient Probe Station:** Shielded dark box, triaxial cabling, vacuum chuck with thermal chuck control ($\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$).
* **Probes:** Coaxial/Triaxial tungsten tips ($< 5\ \mu\text{m}$ tip radius) for minimal contact damage to top gate electrode dots.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                  C-V Metrology Workflow (HF & QS)                       |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Step 1] Wafer Loading & Chuck Contact Verification                     |
|          -> Mount 180nm monitor wafer on gold-plated vacuum chuck       |
|          -> Verify backside substrate ohmic contact (< 10 Ohm)          |
|                               |                                         |
| [Step 2] Calibration & Open/Short De-embedding                          |
|          -> Perform open/short/load de-embedding at probe tip plane    |
|          -> Set integration time: Long / Averaging factor >= 16         |
|                               |                                         |
| [Step 3] High-Frequency C-V Sweep (HF C-V)                              |
|          -> AC signal: 100 kHz - 1 MHz, 15-25 mV RMS amplitude          |
|          -> Bias sweep: -2.0 V to +1.5 V (accumulation to inversion)    |
|          -> Extract C_ox (accumulation) and V_fb (inflection/1/C^2 fit) |
|                               |                                         |
| [Step 4] Quasi-Static C-V Sweep (QS C-V)                                |
|          -> Ramp rate: 10 - 50 mV/s in shielded dark enclosure          |
|          -> Measure displacement current: I_QS = C_QS * (dV/dt)         |
|                               |                                         |
| [Step 5] Dit & Parameter Extraction                                     |
|          -> Calculate D_it = (C_ox / q) * [C_QS/(C_ox - C_QS) -         |
|                                           C_HF/(C_ox - C_HF)]           |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Substrate Preparation & Wafer Loading
1. Place the test monitor wafer onto the vacuum chuck inside the light-tight Faraday cage.
2. Ensure backside wafer contact resistance to the chuck is verified ($R_{contact} < 10\ \Omega$).
3. Align the microscope and land probe tips on the dedicated gate metal/polysilicon test dot (e.g., $100\ \mu\text{m} \times 100\ \mu\text{m}$ capacitor area) without puncturing the 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ dielectric.

#### Step 2: Tool Calibration & Cable De-Embedding
1. Perform open-circuit and short-circuit de-embedding on the LCR meter up to the probe tips at the test frequencies (100 kHz, 1 MHz) to null out parasitic cable capacitance and series resistance.
2. Verify ambient chuck temperature is stabilized at $25.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ in dark conditions.

#### Step 3: High-Frequency (HF) $C$-$V$ Sweep Execution
1. Set the AC oscillation level to $15\text{ mV}$ to $25\text{ mV}$ RMS.
2. Set the test frequency to $1\text{ MHz}$ (or $100\text{ kHz}$ to avoid series resistance rolloff).
3. Sweep the DC gate bias from accumulation to strong inversion (e.g., $-2.0\text{ V}$ to $+1.5\text{ V}$ for p-substrate capacitors) with a step size of $20\text{ mV}$.
4. Measure and record high-frequency capacitance ($C_{HF}$) and conductance ($G_{HF}$).

#### Step 4: Quasi-Static (QS) $C$-$V$ Sweep Execution
1. Configure the high-resolution SMU for slow ramp quasi-static capacitance measurement.
2. Set DC voltage sweep rate to $\beta = 10\text{ mV/s}$ to $30\text{ mV/s}$ under complete dark conditions to avoid photogeneration artifacts.
3. Measure displacement current $I_{meas}$ to extract quasi-static capacitance: $C_{QS} = I_{meas} / \beta$.
4. Ensure leakage current correction is enabled if gate leakage current exceeds $0.1\text{ pA}$.

#### Step 5: Parameter Extraction & Analysis
1. **$C_{ox}$ & $t_{ox}$ / EOT Extraction:** Extract accumulation capacitance $C_{ox}$ at strong accumulation; calculate physical oxide thickness:
   $$t_{ox} = \frac{\kappa_{SiO2} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot A}{C_{ox}}$$
   Verify consistency with the $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal target.
2. **Flatband Voltage ($V_{fb}$):** Determine $V_{fb}$ using the flatband capacitance method ($C_{fb}/C_{ox}$) or maximum of the second derivative $d^2C/dV^2$.
3. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$):** Compute $D_{it}$ across the bandgap using the high-low capacitance formula:
   $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{ox}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{QS}}{C_{ox} - C_{QS}} - \frac{C_{HF}}{C_{ox} - C_{HF}} \right)$$

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Limits |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5$ to $4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | $[3.5\text{ nm}, 4.0\text{ nm}]$ |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$, Midgap)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Upper limit: $1.0 \times 10^{10}\ \text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Lower limit: $10.0\ \text{MV/cm}$ |
| **Sub-threshold & Junction Cell Leakage** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Measured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ ($< 1\ \text{fA}$) |

---

### 5. Verified Literature Citations
* **Source:** *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*
  * Cites dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ producing thin regime dielectric breakdown $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ with minimal interface trap density $D_{it} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ and gate dielectric thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$.
* **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
  * Cites thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
* **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
  * Cites access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}, W = 220\text{ nm}$) and cell leakage current target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-GOI-007`
**Title:** Dielectric Breakdown ($TDDB$ / $E_{bd}$) and Fowler-Nordheim Tunneling $I\text{–}V$ Stress Reliability Analysis  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C–900°C, 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$) > Metrology  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Action Type:** Buy / In-Line Metrology Execution  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This procedure specifies the electrical reliability qualification of 3.5 nm thermally grown dry $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectrics on 180nm DRAM access transistors and MOS test capacitor structures ($8F^2 / 6F^2$ array periphery and test vehicle pads). The protocol executes ramped voltage breakdown ($E_{bd}$), Fowler-Nordheim (F-N) conduction regime characterization, and constant voltage/current stress Time-Dependent Dielectric Breakdown ($TDDB$) to extract cumulative charge-to-breakdown ($Q_{bd}$) and ensure gate dielectric integrity.

---

### 2. Equipment & Tooling Setup
- **Automated Parameter Analyzer:** Keysight B1500A / Keithley 4200-SCS equipped with high-resolution SMUs (fA-level current resolution) and preamplifiers.
- **Probe Station:** Semi-automated thermal chuck probe station with triaxial shielding and micro-chamber nitrogen purge.
- **Test Structures:** MOS test capacitors ($Area = 10^{-4}\text{ to }10^{-3}\text{ cm}^2$) with poly-Si / metal gates over 3.5 nm dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ on p-type Si substrate.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```text
  [Step 1: Wafer Loading & Triax Contact Verification]
                          │
                          ▼
  [Step 2: Low-Field & Fowler-Nordheim I-V Sweep (0V -> High Field)]
                          │
                          ▼
  [Step 3: Ramped Voltage Dielectric Breakdown (E_bd Extraction)]
                          │
                          ▼
  [Step 4: Constant Voltage Stress (CVS) TDDB Execution at 85°C]
                          │
                          ▼
  [Step 5: Weibull Distribution Plotting & Data Logging]
```

1. **Wafer Loading & Environmental Stabilization:**
   - Mount the processed 180nm DRAM wafer onto the thermal chuck.
   - Close probe shielding enclosure and initiate dry $\text{N}_2$ purge to eliminate ambient moisture.
   - For elevated-temperature stress tests, set chuck temperature to **85°C** (matching standard DRAM operating and retention conditions) and stabilize for 10 minutes.

2. **Contact Integrity & Low-Field Leakage Pre-Screen:**
   - Contact top gate pad with shielded tungsten micro-probe; connect substrate/backside chuck to common ground.
   - Apply a low-bias sweep from $0\text{ V}$ to $1.0\text{ V}$ ($E_{ox} \le 3.0\text{ MV/cm}$) to verify ohmic contact and ensure background displacement current is below $10^{-11}\text{ A/cm}^2$.

3. **Fowler-Nordheim (F-N) Tunneling $I\text{–}V$ Characterization:**
   - Sweep gate bias positively into high injection electric field: ramp gate voltage from $0\text{ V}$ up toward pre-breakdown levels ($3.0\text{ V}$ to $3.8\text{ V}$, corresponding to $E_{ox} \approx 8.5\text{ to }11\text{ MV/cm}$) with step size $\le 20\text{ mV}$.
   - Transform data to F-N plot coordinates: $\ln(J / E_{ox}^2)$ versus $1/E_{ox}$.
   - Verify linearity in high-field regime ($E_{ox} > 6\text{–}7\text{ MV/cm}$) confirming Fowler-Nordheim barrier tunneling without anomalous trap-assisted leakage.

4. **Ramped Dielectric Breakdown ($E_{bd}$) Test:**
   - Apply a continuous linear voltage ramp on fresh MOS capacitors at $0.1\text{ V/s}$ until destructive dielectric rupture occurs.
   - Define hard breakdown when leakage current abruptly spikes across compliance limit ($I_{comp} = 10\text{ mA/cm}^2$).
   - Record breakdown voltage $V_{bd}$ and calculate critical breakdown field:
     $$E_{bd} = \frac{V_{bd} - V_{fb}}{t_{ox}} \quad \text{where } t_{ox} = 3.5\text{ nm}$$

5. **Time-Dependent Dielectric Breakdown ($TDDB$ / $Q_{bd}$) Analysis:**
   - Subject an array of $\ge 25$ independent capacitor sites to Constant Voltage Stress (CVS) at accelerated field levels ($E_{ox} = 9.0\text{ to }10.5\text{ MV/cm}$) under chuck temperature of **85°C**.
   - Monitor current degradation and record time-to-breakdown ($t_{bd}$).
   - Integrate current over time to compute charge-to-breakdown:
     $$Q_{bd} = \int_0^{t_{bd}} J(t)\,dt$$
   - Plot $t_{bd}$ on a Weibull plot: $\ln(-\ln(1 - F))$ vs. $\ln(t_{bd})$ and extract Weibull slope ($\beta$).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10.0$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Ramped $I\text{–}V$ stress breakdown on 3.5 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5 \pm 0.25$ | $\text{nm}$ | Post-oxidation spectroscopic ellipsometry |
| **TDDB Test Chuck Temperature** | $85.0 \pm 0.5$ | $\text{°C}$ | Calibrated thermal chuck thermocouple |
| **F-N Pre-Tunneling Low-Field Leakage** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{-8}$ | $\text{A/cm}^2$ | Low-field SMU voltage hold at $E_{ox} \le 3.0\text{ MV/cm}$ |

---

### 5. Context & Literature Citations
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:** Thermally grown dry oxidation produces dense gate dielectrics with critical breakdown electric field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$ and minimal interface defect levels; establishes standard gate dielectric physical thickness target of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:** Defines physical gate oxide target at $3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850\text{°C}–900\text{°C}$ dry oxidation, operating temperature requirements at $85\text{°C}$, and cell capacitance requirements ($25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$) within $8F^2/6F^2$ architectures.
citations: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

```text +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ | DRAM FOUNDATION VN - STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE (SOP) | | Module: Metrology & Device Characterization | | Task: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Gate Oxide Metrology (3.5nm EOT & Dit) | | Generation: Gen 1 (180nm Planar DRAM / MOSCAP Test Vehicle) | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+ ``` ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Substrate Preparation
(P-type 100 Si + 3.5 nm SiO2)"] --> B["Spectroscopic Ellipsometry
(Angles: 65 deg, 70 deg, 75 deg; Wavelength: 190-800 nm)"] B --> C["MOSCAP Gate Dot Sputtering
(Al Dots: 200 um, 500 um, 1000 um + Backside Contact)"] C --> D["High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Sweep
(-3.0 V to +2.0 V)"] D --> E["Quasi-Static (Low-Freq) C-V Sweep
(-3.0 V to +2.0 V)"] E --> F["Parameter Extraction & Validation
(t_ox / EOT, C_ox Accumulation, Dit Profiling)"] ``` --- ### 1. Scope & Objective This SOP defines the metrology protocol for characterizing ultrathin thermal gate oxide (~3.5 nm physical thickness) grown at 850°C–900°C for the 180nm open-source DRAM access transistor. The procedure utilizes non-destructive Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (SE) followed by dual-frequency Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) profiling on Planar MOS Capacitor (MOSCAP) test vehicles to extract Equivalent Oxide Thickness ($EOT$), oxide capacitance ($C_{ox}$), flatband voltage ($V_{fb}$), and interface trap density ($D_{it}$). --- ### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure #### Step 1: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Optical Metrology 1. **Load Wafer**: Place the thermal gate oxide wafer (P-type $\langle 100 \rangle$ Si substrate with 3.5 nm target $\text{SiO}_2$) onto the automated ellipsometer vacuum chuck. 2. **Optical Measurement**: - Collect spectral parameters $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ across spectral range $190\text{ nm} - 800\text{ nm}$ at incidence angles of $65^\circ$, $70^\circ$, and $75^\circ$. 3. **Model Regression**: - Fit the optical stack: `Air / Native Interfacial Layer / SiO2 (Cauchy / Sellmeier model) / c-Si substrate`. - Extract optical thickness $t_{ox}$ across a standard 9-point or 49-point wafer map. Ensure optical goodness-of-fit (Mean Squared Error $\text{MSE} < 1.50$). #### Step 2: MOSCAP Diagnostic Structure Metallization 1. **Top Contact Metallization**: - Transfer wafer to sputter system with a precision shadow mask. - Sputter pure Aluminum ($\text{Al}$) circular gate dots of defined nominal diameters: $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, and $1000\ \mu\text{m}$. 2. **Backside Ohmic Contact**: - Strip backside native oxide via buffered oxide etch (BOE) swap/swab. - Deposit an ohmic contact layer of pure Aluminum ($\text{Al}$) or Gold ($\text{Au}$) across the wafer backside. 3. **Forming Gas Anneal (FGA)**: - Perform post-metallization anneal in $H_2/N_2$ (10% $H_2$) at $400^\circ\text{C}$ for 30 minutes to passivate marginal dangling bonds and secure ohmic contact. #### Step 3: High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Sweep 1. **Setup**: Place wafer on a temperature-controlled dark shielding probe station ($25^\circ\text{C}$). Contact the backside chuck and lower a tungsten microprobe onto a selected $500\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter $\text{Al}$ gate dot. 2. **Sweep Parameters**: - Frequency: $1\text{ MHz}$ AC excitation ($V_{ac} = 15\text{ mV}_\text{rms}$). - DC Bias Voltage ($V_G$): Sweep from $-3.0\text{ V}$ (Accumulation) to $+2.0\text{ V}$ (Inversion). 3. **Oxide Capacitance Extraction**: - Measure saturation capacitance in strong accumulation ($V_G < V_{fb}$): $$C_{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_{ox} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}}{t_{ox}}$$ - Extract electrical physical oxide thickness $t_{ox}$ with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ resolution. #### Step 4: Quasi-Static (Low-Frequency) C-V Sweep & $D_{it}$ Profiling 1. **Low-Frequency Sweep**: - Execute quasi-static / low-frequency sweep across the identical voltage span ($-3.0\text{ V}$ to $+2.0\text{ V}$) with a ramp rate $dV/dt \le 50\text{ mV/s}$. - Ensure the inversion capacitance recovers toward $C_{ox}$ due to minority carrier generation-recombination. 2. **High-Low C-V $D_{it}$ Extraction**: - Calculate interface trap capacitance $C_{it}(V_G)$: $$C_{it} = \left(\frac{1}{C_{LF}} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}}\right)^{-1} - \left(\frac{1}{C_{HF}} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}}\right)^{-1}$$ - Extract midgap interface trap density: $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{it}}{q \cdot \text{Area}} \quad [\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}]$$ --- ### 3. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics | Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Measurement Method | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ ($3.4\text{ nm} - 3.6\text{ nm}$) | High-Frequency (1 MHz) $C_{ox}$ Accumulation & Ellipsometry | | **Test MOSCAP Dot Diameter** | $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, $1000\ \mu\text{m}$ | Pattern nominal specification | Optical Profilometry / Shadow Mask Alignment | | **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$ at midgap)** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{11}\text{ cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Maximum threshold | High-Low (1 MHz vs Quasi-Static) C-V Extraction | | **Accumulation Gate Leakage Current** | $< 1\text{ fA}/\mu\text{m}^2$ | At $V_G = -1.0\text{ V}$ | Precision Parameter Analyzer I-V Curve | --- ### 4. Verified Context Citations * **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Confirms gate dielectric physical target of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation. * **Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**: Confirms MOSCAP circular Al gate dot diameters of $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, and $1000\ \mu\text{m}$, gold/aluminum backside contact, accumulation capacitance relation $C_{ox} = (\varepsilon_{ox}\varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area})/t_{ox}$, and electrical thickness precision of $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$. * **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**: Confirms overall node access transistor architecture and unit leakage constraints.
citations: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction (Nicollian & Brews - MOS Physics and Technology)
180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Design & Precision CNC Machining of Low-Stress Vacuum Wafer Chuck for Variable-Angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry (VASE)

**Module:** Metrology / Mechanical Tooling  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm / sub-mm envelope)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Target Substrate:** 100 mm Silicon Wafer  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Visual Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Stock Preparation:   │
│      Al 6061-T6       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Rough CNC Pocketing  │
│       & Porting       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│     Stress Relief     │
│    Thermal Anneal     │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Diamond Facing &    │
│    Vacuum Grooves     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Surface Anodization  │
│     & Inspection      │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Machining & Fabrication Procedure

1. **Stock Selection & Material Preparation**:
   - Machine billet from mic-6 cast tooling plate or annealed aerospace-grade 6061-T6 aluminum (Ø 130 mm × 25 mm thick) to ensure dimensional stability and minimal residual internal stress.

2. **Rough CNC Pocketing & Porting (Gen 1 Roughing)**:
   - Mount stock in 4-axis / 3-axis CNC vertical milling center.
   - Machine bottom mounting interface, kinematic locating dowel bores, and internal vacuum routing manifold (1/8" NPT port interface leading to internal concentric distribution plenum).
   - Machine top recess to Ø 102 mm with 0.5 mm stock allowance remaining for the finishing pass. Tooling tolerance envelope conforms to Gen 1 macroscopic limits ($\pm 0.1\text{ mm}$ / $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$).

3. **Thermal Stress-Relief Cycle**:
   - Unclamp workpiece to release clamping strain.
   - Perform thermal stress relief in an inert nitrogen/air oven: ramp to 180°C at 50°C/hr, soak for 2 hours, and furnace-cool at $\le 30^\circ\text{C/hr}$ to ambient temperature. This prevents post-machining warping under vacuum clamping.

4. **Finish Fly-Cutting / Single-Point Diamond Facing**:
   - Re-fixture using kinematic three-point clamping to eliminate twisting moments.
   - Execute precision facing fly-cut across the 100 mm wafer contact zone using a polycrystalline diamond (PCD) insert at 2,500 RPM and 0.05 mm/rev feed rate to achieve planar parallelism and optical flatness.
   - Mill low-stress micro-grooves: machine three concentric vacuum rings (radii: 20 mm, 35 mm, 45 mm) connected by radial channels (channel width: 0.5 mm, channel depth: 0.3 mm) to ensure uniform pressure distribution across the 100 mm wafer without local dimpling or optical distortion during ellipsometric measurement.

5. **Surface Treatment & Cleanroom Prep**:
   - Type II black anodize (non-reflective matte finish to avoid stray reflections and background depolarized scatter during variable-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry).
   - Ultrasonic degreasing in isopropyl alcohol (IPA) and deionized (DI) water rinse.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
  Acceptance Metric                             Target Value
  ──────────────────────────────────────────    ────────────────────────
  Wafer Chuck Parallelism & Flatness (100mm)    < 1.0 µm TIR across 100 mm
  Roughing Machining Tolerance Envelope (Gen 1) ± 0.1 mm (± 100 µm)
  Vacuum Hold Clamping Pressure Differential    0.1 to 0.5 bar (Soft hold)
```

1. **Top Surface Parallelism / Total Indicated Runout (TIR)**:
   - **Target**: $< 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$ across the 100 mm active wafer contact diameter (matching the Karl Suss MA6 Wedge Error Compensation parallel mechanical requirement).
2. **Gen 1 Macroscopic Alignment / Positioning Tolerance**:
   - **Target**: $\pm 0.1\text{ mm}$ ($\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$) for port centerlines, kinematic pins, and overall chuck outer dimensions.
3. **Vacuum Pressure Differential & Holding Uniformity**:
   - **Target**: Operates under controlled differential hold of $0.1\text{ to }0.5\text{ bar}$ (soft vacuum clamping equivalent) without inducing wafer deflection exceeding $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ across the central metrology zone.

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Standard Operating Procedure & Gap Control**: Parallelism target ($< 1\ \mu\text{m}$ across 100 mm wafers) and soft-contact low-stress clamping pressure reference ($0.1\text{ to }0.5\text{ bar}$).
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**: Gen 1 macroscopic fabrication and alignment tolerance standards ($\pm 0.1\text{ mm}$ / $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$), establishing reproducible baseline parameters for early-generation tooling.
- **Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming**: 100 mm substrate standard reference dimensions and handling criteria.
citations: Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Standard Operating Procedure & Gap Control (Stanford Nanofabrication Facility (SNF) / Suss MicroTec Manual)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)
Photoresist Spin Coating Dynamics and HMDS Vapor Priming (Madou - Fundamentals of Microfabrication)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: CAD Modeling & FEA Structural Stress Simulation of Low-Stress Vacuum Chuck Geometry
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > Mechanical Assembly & Metrology Fixturing  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 1: CAD Geometry  │
│        Modeling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 2: Boundary &   │
│      Vacuum Load       │
│       Definition       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Step 3: Mesh      │
│      Generation &      │
│   Convergence Study    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 4: FEA Stress &  │
│   Deformation Solve    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Step 5: Acceptance   │
│        Criteria        │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Parametric CAD Geometry Modeling**
   - Construct the vacuum chuck geometry in 3D CAD featuring concentric vacuum relief grooves and radial micro-channels designed to distribute differential pressure evenly across the wafer underside.
   - Establish dimensional datum and alignment features matching Gen 2 stage tolerances to maintain mechanical positioning within $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.
   - Ensure edge chamfers and sealing lands minimize localized stress concentrations that could induce wafer bowing during spectroscopic ellipsometry of ultra-thin (3.5 nm) gate oxides.

2. **Material Property & Boundary Condition Assignment**
   - Assign linear-elastic isotropic properties for the chuck substrate (e.g., hard-anodized 6061-T6 aluminum or structural ceramic).
   - Define kinematically constrained bottom mounting points (3-point kinematic mount) to prevent over-constraining the chuck body.
   - Model the single-crystal silicon wafer mounted on the chuck face, accounting for its anisotropic elastic modulus ($E_{[100]} \approx 130\ \text{GPa}$, $\nu \approx 0.28$).

3. **Pressure & Vacuum Load Application**
   - Define differential vacuum loading across the vacuum channel footprint based on low-pressure vacuum backing levels (200 to 400 mTorr line base capability up to standard roughing differential ~80 kPa).
   - Account for intrinsic film stress effects (tensile stress $\sim 1\ \text{GPa}$ as typically encountered in CVD silicon nitride layers) to confirm the vacuum clamp counteracts bowing without introducing plastic deformation or localized strain.

4. **FEA Discretization (Meshing) & Convergence Study**
   - Generate a second-order hexahedral/tetrahedral mesh with local element refinement along groove radii, vacuum port orifices, and contact interfaces.
   - Conduct an $h$-refinement mesh convergence analysis until peak von Mises stress and maximum surface out-of-plane deflection change by $< 1.5\%$ between refinement steps.

5. **Structural Stress & Deflection Solve**
   - Execute static structural solve under full vacuum clamp load.
   - Extract out-of-plane displacement ($Z$-deflection) across the optical metrology clear aperture to verify planarity for variable-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry (VASE).
   - Evaluate peak von Mises stress against yield strength criteria, verifying absence of localized yield and negligible induced strain across the central measurement area.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage & Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | FEA coordinate inspection & datum positioning against Gen 2 alignment bounds |
| **Max Wafer Chuck Surface Deflection ($Z$-displacement)** | $\le 0.1$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Simulated vertical displacement field over metrology aperture |
| **Vacuum Hold Differential Operating Range** | $200\text{ to }400$ | mTorr (backing line) | Vacuum channel boundary pressure verification |
| **Peak Chuck von Mises Stress Margin** | $< 1$ | GPa | FEA stress tensor validation below intrinsic film stress limit & material yield |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):** Alignment tolerance establishes the Gen 2 precision mechanical threshold of $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ (improved from $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ at Gen 1).
- **LPCVD of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks Context:** Operating vacuum pressure range ($200\text{ to }400\ \text{mTorr}$) and intrinsic tensile stress reference limit ($\sim 1\ \text{GPa}$) used to evaluate structural load capacity and wafer bowing mitigation.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics:** Process context targeting ultra-thin $3.5\text{ to }4.0\ \text{nm}$ dry gate oxide metrology, requiring negligible chuck-induced distortion during ellipsometric characterization.
citations: Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Precision CNC Milling, Vacuum Grooving & Anodization of Aluminum-Silicon Carbide Chuck Body
**Action Type:** Make  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Gate Oxide Metrology (3.5nm EOT & Dit Characterization) > Precision Tooling & Fixturing > Design & Precision CNC Machining of Low-Stress Vacuum Wafer Chuck > Precision CNC Milling, Vacuum Grooving & Anodization of Aluminum-Silicon Carbide Chuck Body  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Stock Prep & Rough  │
│     CNC Milling      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│   Fine CNC Finish    │
│   Milling & Vacuum   │
│       Grooving       │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Metrology & Vacuum  │
│      Leak Check      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│  Sulfuric Acid Hard  │
│    Anodization &     │
│       Sealing        │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Stock Preparation & Thermal Conditioning**
   - Mount certified Aluminum-Silicon Carbide (AlSiC) metal-matrix composite stock into a rigid 4-axis / 5-axis CNC machining center.
   - Run a roughing pass using PCD (polycrystalline diamond) or diamond-coated carbide end mills to profile chuck outer envelope and bottom mounting interfaces, maintaining adequate flood coolant to manage abrasive ceramic particle evacuation.
   - Perform intermediate stress-relief annealing cycle to eliminate residual bulk stresses before final datum referencing.

2. **Precision Finish Milling & Vacuum Grooving**
   - Face-mill the top wafer-support reference plane using micro-grain diamond tooling to achieve planar surface reference.
   - Execute spiral/concentric vacuum distribution channels across the chuck face using a 0.5–1.0 mm flat end mill with a shallow depth of cut per pass to avoid grain pullout.
   - Mill high-conductance internal evacuation ports and tap standard vacuum fittings (KF/NPT) at the base.
   - Chamfer all channel edges and deburr ultrasonic ports thoroughly to eliminate micro-burrs that could score thin-film backside surfaces.

3. **Dimensional & Vacuum Integrity Inspection**
   - Clean the machined chuck ultrasonically in an industrial solvent bath followed by a DI water rinse to remove residual cutting fluids and micro-particulates.
   - Verify surface flatness across the full wafer landing area with a dial indicator / CMM inspection setup to adhere to Gen 2 precision stage requirements.
   - Connect chuck to a roughing vacuum line with a calibrated vacuum gauge; verify vacuum holding capability without localized channel cross-leakage.

4. **Hard Anodization & Passivation**
   - Mask vacuum port threads and sensitive electrical bonding points using chemical-resistant fluoropolymer plugs.
   - Submerge chuck body in a temperature-controlled sulfuric acid hard anodizing bath to produce an ultra-hard, non-marring, wear-resistant dielectric aluminum oxide surface barrier.
   - Perform deionized water rinse and hot deionized water / nickel acetate seal to close anodic pores and prevent outgassing in analytical metrology chambers.
   - Final vacuum bake-out at 115°C to 120°C to eliminate residual absorbed moisture.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Tool / Method | Target Metric |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Machining & Alignment Tolerance** | Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) / Optical Profilometer | **±5 µm** (Gen 2 tolerance) |
| **Post-Machining Thermal Bakeout** | Hot Plate / Convection Oven with Surface Thermocouple | **115°C for 60 s** (or continuous bakeout at 115°C–120°C) |
| **DI Rinse Effluent Cleanliness / Developer Cleanliness** | In-line Resistivity Meter & Timed DI Rinse | Rinse time **45 to 60 s** with high DI water flow |
| **Vacuum Channel Base Integrity** | Roughing/High-Vacuum Pump Gauge | Hold base vacuum without channel seal collapse (leak rate $\le$ **3 to 5 mTorr** differential) |

---

### Context Citations

- **Machining & Alignment Tolerance (±5 µm)**:  
  *Source:* **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)** — *"Alignment tolerance at Gen 1 is ±100 microns (0.1 mm), improving to ±5 microns in Gen 2."*
- **De-contamination Rinse & Thermal Bake Regimes (115°C, 45–60 s)**:  
  *Source:* **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)** — *"Soft bake at 115°C for 60 seconds on a flat aluminum hot plate... Developer: Microposit MF-319 for 45-60 seconds, followed by rigorous deionized (DI) water rinse."*
- **Vacuum Regime & Process Gas Environment Reference (3 to 5 mTorr, < 2×10⁻⁶ Torr)**:  
  *Source:* **Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects** — *"Base pressure must pump down below 2x10^-6 Torr... maintained at 3 to 5 mTorr working pressure."*
citations: Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) Sputtering of Aluminum Metallization Interconnects (Vossen & Kern - Thin Film Processes)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)
Four-Point Collinear Probe Metrology for Semiconductor Sheet Resistance (ASTM Standard F84 & Semiconductor Material Characterization)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Optical Flatness Interferometry & Ellipsometric Multi-Angle Wafer Bow Verification

**Context Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (`DRAM Foundation VN`) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Gate Oxide Metrology > Precision Tooling & Fixturing > Design & Precision CNC Machining of Low-Stress Vacuum Wafer Chuck > **Optical Flatness Interferometry & Ellipsometric Multi-Angle Wafer Bow Verification**  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make

---

### Process Flow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   1. Chuck Mounting   │
│    and Vacuum Seal    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  2. Optical Flatness  │
│    Interferometry     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    3. Multi-Angle     │
│     Ellipsometry      │
│       Alignment       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     4. 9-Point /      │
│  49-Point Wafer Bow   │
│        Mapping        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Chuck Fixturing & Vacuum Clamping**:
   - Mount the precision CNC-machined low-stress vacuum chuck onto the multi-axis goniometer stage.
   - Load the test wafer (bare Si or thermal oxide monitor wafer) onto the chuck face. Apply vacuum suction to secure the substrate while preventing induced mechanical warp.

2. **Optical Flatness Interferometry**:
   - Align the normal-incidence optical reference flat over the chuck-wafer assembly.
   - Illuminate using a monochromatic source (e.g., 632.8 nm laser or mercury source) to record interference fringe patterns across the entire wafer surface.
   - Compute surface contour deviations and verify global mechanical planarization to rule out localized chuck particulate distortion.

3. **Multi-Angle Ellipsometric Optical Alignment**:
   - Position the spectroscopic ellipsometer light source and detector arms at variable incidence angles ($\Phi$).
   - Align beam reflection to center the signal onto the photodetector across incidence angles, verifying stage mechanical alignment within Gen 2 tolerances ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Parameterize Fresnel reflection coefficients via fundamental polarization ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
   - Apply Cauchy or Sellmeier optical dispersion models parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.

4. **Radial Multi-Point Wafer Bow & Gate Oxide Thickness Verification**:
   - Execute automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film and tilt variation across the substrate.
   - Measure gate oxide thickness across points to verify film uniformity and confirm that residual intrinsic stress does not introduce focal drift or optical angle-of-incidence errors.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gen 2 Stage Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Stage positioning micrometer & alignment sensors |
| **Dry Gate Oxide Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry fit ($\Psi, \Delta$ Cauchy/Sellmeier model) |
| **Wafer Mapping Radial Uniformity Pattern** | $9\text{ or }49$ | points / wafer | Automated multi-point radial grid sweep |
| **Silicon Substrate / Hard Mask Baseline Index** | $2.00 \pm 0.02$ | refractive index ($n$) at $\lambda = 632.8\ \text{nm}$ | Polarimetric phase fit ($\rho = r_p / r_s$) |

---

### Literature Context & Source Citations
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - Governs fundamental measurement equation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \exp(i\Delta)$, Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion modeling $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$, sub-Angstrom dry gate oxide target precision ($\pm 0.05\ \text{nm}$ on $3.5\ \text{nm} \text{ SiO}_2$), and 9-point / 49-point automated radial wafer mapping.
- **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)**:
  - Establishes mechanical staging alignment tolerances improving from $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$ at Gen 1 to $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ at Gen 2.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-CV-002`
**Title:** Procurement & Integration of Shielded Triaxial C-V Hot Chuck Fixture and Micro-Positioner Probes  
**Hierarchy:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Dry Thermal Oxidation Recipe Execution (850°C-900°C, 3.5 nm SiO2) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Gate Oxide Metrology (3.5nm EOT & $D_{it}$ Characterization) > Precision Tooling & Fixturing for Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Gate Oxide Metrology > Procurement & Integration of Shielded Triaxial C-V Hot Chuck Fixture and Micro-Positioner Probes  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the procurement specifications, physical mechanical integration, electromagnetic shielding, thermal calibration, and baseline validation for a triaxial hot chuck fixture and micro-positioner probe station. This setup is specifically engineered to perform ultra-low-leakage high-frequency and quasi-static Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) metrology on 3.5 nm gate oxide test structures and stacked capacitor dielectrics under elevated thermal stress.

---

### 2. Sourced Literature & Engineering Context
* **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  * Unit cell geometry: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  * Capacitance target: Minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ for noise immunity against coupling and soft errors.
  * Leakage current budget: Sub-threshold and junction leakage target $\le 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain required refresh intervals.
* **Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018):**
  * Gen 2 alignment and positional travel tolerance: Target $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$ (improved from Gen 1 macroscopic tolerance of $\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$).

---

### 3. Equipment & Fixture Specifications
1. **Triaxial Hot Chuck Assembly:**
   * Guarded gold-plated chuck surface with driven inner guard to eliminate chuck-to-ground stray capacitance and substrate leakage.
   * Integrated PID-controlled resistive heater rated up to $\ge 85^\circ\text{C}$ (capable of sustaining steady-state junction stress characterization).
2. **Micro-Positioners & Triaxial Probes:**
   * Independent 3-axis ($X$-$Y$-$Z$) micromanipulators with high-resolution leadscrews providing motion sensitivity matching Gen 2 tolerances ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).
   * Low-noise triaxial probe arms (Force, Sense, and Guard) terminated with sub-micron tungsten probe tips to land on test pads without puncturing ultra-thin 3.5 nm oxide layers.
3. **Shielding & Environment:**
   * Dark, electrically shielded Faraday enclosure with feedthrough panels accommodating low-noise triaxial BNC/SMA cabling directly linked to an LCR meter / semiconductor parameter analyzer.

---

### 4. Step-by-Step Execution Procedure

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                  Integration & Validation Workflow                      |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [1. Mechanical Mount] -> Optical bench & vibration isolation mounting  |
|                               |                                         |
| [2. Cabling & Guarding] -> Driven triax guard shield routing            |
|                               |                                         |
| [3. Thermal Calibration] -> Hot chuck temperature ramp to 85°C          |
|                               |                                         |
| [4. Leakage & C-V Baseline] -> Open-circuit residual < 1 fA validation  |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Mechanical Assembly & Vibration Isolation
1. Mount the triaxial hot chuck platform onto a granite surface plate or vibration-isolation pneumatic table.
2. Secure the magnetic/vacuum base micro-positioners onto the platen ring surrounding the chuck.
3. Align the micro-positioner axes ($X$, $Y$, $Z$) relative to the chuck plane, verifying smooth travel across the entire probe area.

#### Step 2: Triaxial Shielding & Cabling Integration
1. Route low-noise triaxial cables through the feedthrough collar of the light-tight Faraday enclosure.
2. Connect the center conductor to the chuck vacuum surface (substrate contact) / probe tip, the inner shield to the instrument's driven guard, and the outer shield to safety/chassis ground.
3. Terminate probe arms with replaceable tungsten needles; inspect tip condition under an optical inspection microscope.

#### Step 3: Hot Chuck Thermal Integration & Closed-Loop Tuning
1. Connect the hot chuck heating elements and RTD/thermocouple feedback sensor to the external digital PID controller.
2. Execute a multi-point thermal calibration profile from $25^\circ\text{C}$ ambient up to $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. Verify thermal stability: Ensure steady-state chuck drift does not exceed $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

#### Step 4: Gen 2 Positional Accuracy & Landing Verification
1. Place a test wafer coupon bearing contact test pads onto the chuck and engage the vacuum hold-down.
2. Actuate the micro-positioner micrometers under stereomicroscope observation to align the probe tip over a designated pad.
3. Verify that backlash and mechanical drift maintain probe contact alignment within $\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$.

#### Step 5: Electrical Zeroing and Open/Short Baseline Calibration
1. Raise the probes $500\ \mu\text{m}$ above the wafer surface (open-circuit condition) and close the shielded enclosure.
2. Run an open-circuit calibration routine on the C-V meter / electrometer:
   * Perform stray capacitance nulling (target open stray residual $C_{\text{residual}} \ll 28\text{ fF}$).
   * Measure background leakage current at $85^\circ\text{C}$ across the operational bias window.

---

### 5. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method | Source Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Micro-Positioner Mechanical Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical reticle / microscopic travel calibration | *Sam Zeloof Z1 Journal (Gen 2 standard)* |
| **Chuck Thermal Setpoint Accuracy** | $85 \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Surface contact thermocouple / calibrated RTD | *180nm DRAM Layout Topology* |
| **System Background Leakage Floor** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA}$ (at $85^\circ\text{C}$) | High-resolution electrometer / parameter analyzer | *180nm DRAM Layout Topology* |
| **Stray Residual Capacitance Floor** | $< 5.0$ (Budget baseline: $28$) | $\text{fF}$ | LCR meter open-circuit nulling ($100\text{ kHz}-1\text{ MHz}$) | *180nm DRAM Layout Topology* |
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018) (https://sam.zeloof.xyz/first-ic/)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Assembly, Multi-Point Tilt Calibration, and Optical & Electrical Baseline Qualification on 3.5nm SiO₂ MOS Dummies

- **Document Reference**: [`sop_3_5nm_sio2_mos_dummies.md`](docs/sop_3_5nm_sio2_mos_dummies.md)
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Dielectric / Target**: 3.5 nm Thermal SiO₂ Gate Oxide on P-type (100) Si
- **Test Structures**: Planar MOSCAP circular Al gate dots (200 µm, 500 µm, 1000 µm) with Au/Al backside contact

---

### Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Tooling Stage Mount   │
│     & Vacuum Lock      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Multi-Point       │
│  Auto-Collimator Tilt  │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Spectroscopic      │
│      Ellipsometry      │
│   Baseline on 3.5nm    │
│          SiO2          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Backside Contact &   │
│   Probe Card Pinning   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  High-Frequency 1 MHz  │
│   & Quasi-Static C-V   │
│     Qualification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Mechanical Tooling Assembly & Vacuum Lock
1. Inspect the backside of the P-type (100) Si MOS dummy coupon to ensure the Au or Al ohmic contact layer is pristine and particulate-free.
2. Seat the coupon on the gold-plated kinematic vacuum stage chuck. Engage chuck vacuum (> 70 kPa) to ensure mechanical rigidity and low-resistance electrical contact.

#### Step 2: Multi-Point Tilt Calibration & Normalization
1. Align the optical auto-collimator / laser alignment beam across 5 distributed points (Center, North, South, East, West).
2. Adjust stage differential micrometer screws ($\theta_x, \theta_y$) until angular pitch and roll deviations across all five points satisfy $\Delta \theta \le \pm 0.01^\circ$.
3. Zero optical focal distance along the $z$-axis for the 3.5 nm SiO₂ surface.

#### Step 3: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Thickness Baseline
1. Acquire multi-wavelength polarization phase change angles ($\Psi, \Delta$) across $70^\circ$–$75^\circ$ angle of incidence.
2. Fit with a validated P-Si / SiO₂ Cauchy optical model to determine physical oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$.
3. Confirm thickness aligns with the nominal 3.5 nm dry thermal oxide target within $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$.

#### Step 4: Backside Interconnect & Top Gate Micro-Probing
1. Connect chuck baseline ground to the gold-plated vacuum stage chuck (wafer backside contact).
2. Under micro-positioner optical guidance, pin the probe tip onto a selected circular Al gate dot (200 µm, 500 µm, or 1000 µm diameter).
3. Ensure contact force avoids puncturing the thin 3.5 nm gate dielectric.

#### Step 5: High-Frequency (1 MHz) & Quasi-Static C-V Characterization
1. Sweep gate bias $V_G$ from accumulation ($V_G < V_{\text{fb}}$) through depletion ($V_{\text{fb}} < V_G < V_T$) to inversion ($V_G > V_T$).
2. Record high-frequency (1 MHz) accumulation capacitance saturation:
   $$C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\epsilon_{\text{ox}} \epsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}}{t_{\text{ox}}}$$
   Extract physical oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$ to cross-qualify ellipsometry data.
3. Record quasi-static C-V to observe low-frequency inversion capacitance recovery to $C_{\text{ox}}$.
4. Extract interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}}$) from the difference between low- and high-frequency capacitance profiles across the depletion region.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                       Baseline Parameter Ranges        
              ┌────────────────────────────────────────┐
              │░                                       │
      C-V Freq┤░                                       │
              │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
Dry Oxide Temp┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒    │
 Dot Diameters┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
              │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
 EOT Precision┤█                                       │
              │█                                       │
              └┬─────────┬─────────┬────────┬─────────┬┘
               0        250       500      750     1000 
```

| # | Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Window | Unit | Verification Method |
| :-: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | **Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | **3.5** | $\pm 0.1$ | nm | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & 1 MHz Accumulation $C_{\text{ox}}$ |
| **2** | **Stage Tilt Planarity ($\Delta \theta$)** | **0.00** | $\le \pm 0.01$ | deg ($^\circ$) | 5-Point Optical Auto-Collimator / Micrometer Screws |
| **3** | **High-Frequency C-V Test Frequency** | **1.0** | Nominal | MHz | Precision LCR Meter / Impedance Analyzer |
| **4** | **Gate Electrode Dot Diameters** | **200, 500, 1000** | Nominal shadow-mask | µm | Optical Inspection / Profilometry |

---

### Verified Context Literature Citations
1. **Source: Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
   - Defines circular Aluminum gate dots (diameters: 200 µm, 500 µm, 1000 µm) sputtered onto thermally grown oxide (3.5 nm to 25 nm) on P-type (100) Si with Au or Al backside contact.
   - Prescribes High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V characterization, extraction of $C_{\text{ox}} = (\epsilon_{\text{ox}} \epsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{\text{ox}}$ in accumulation ($V_G < V_{\text{fb}}$), and measurement accuracy yielding physical thickness within $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$.
2. **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Identifies gate dielectric growth specification as 850°C–900°C dry oxidation producing ~3.5 nm physical thickness SiO₂ for the 180nm DRAM access transistor.
