# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-MECH-002`
**Title:** R-Theta Stage Fixture Integration, Vacuum Hold-Down & Total Runout Metrology Calibration  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness and Optical Dispersion Mapping > Precision Tooling & Fixturing > Custom Precision Vacuum Chuck & R-Theta Mapping Stage Fixture Fabrication > R-Theta Stage Fixture Integration, Vacuum Hold-Down & Total Runout Metrology Calibration  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make

---

### Process Workflow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Stage Mechanical    │
│  Mounting & Alignment  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Vacuum Chuck      │
│    Hold-Down & Seal    │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Axial & Radial     │
│    Runout Indicator    │
│      Calibration       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Multi-Point Polar    │
│     Wafer Mapping      │
│       Validation       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Integrate the custom precision vacuum chuck onto the motorized polar ($R\text{-}\theta$) scanning stage for spectroscopic ellipsometry mapping. Establish stable wafer vacuum hold-down, eliminate surface distortion, and calibrate total indicator reading (TIR) axial and radial runout to ensure precise focus and optical angle-of-incidence ($\Psi, \Delta$) measurement stability across the entire wafer surface.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Mechanical Fixture Assembly & Base Alignment:**
   - Mount the $R\text{-}\theta$ polar stage assembly onto the vibration-isolated optical breadboard beneath the spectroscopic ellipsometer beam path.
   - Secure the precision-machined aluminum/ceramic vacuum chuck onto the rotary ($\theta$) bearing hub with torque-calibrated non-magnetic stainless fasteners (tighten diagonally in stages).
   - Co-align the chuck rotation center with the system optical origin ($r = 0, \theta = 0^{\circ}$).

2. **Vacuum Chuck Hold-Down & Seal Verification:**
   - Connect the pneumatic line from the oil-free roughing vacuum pump through an inline sub-micron particulate filter to the rotary vacuum feedthrough.
   - Place a test wafer onto the chuck surface and actuate the vacuum solenoid valve.
   - Confirm differential hold-down vacuum draws down to steady negative pressure without acoustic leaks or localized wafer bending/oil-canning.

3. **Total Runout (Axial & Radial) Metrology Calibration:**
   - Mount a high-precision digital dial gauge / displacement sensor probe normal to the chuck face at the wafer periphery.
   - Rotate the stage continuously through $360^{\circ}$ at nominal mapping velocity to register Axial Total Indicator Reading (wobble/flatness runout).
   - Reposition the indicator probe laterally against the reference rim and measure Radial Runout (eccentricity) over a full $360^{\circ}$ revolution.
   - Adjust tip/tilt kinematic leveling set-screws until total runout is trimmed within Gen 2 mechanical tolerances.

4. **Polar-to-Cartesian Mapping Program Execution:**
   - Home the $R$ linear rail and $\theta$ rotary stage to index switches.
   - Execute an automated polar routine traversing standard 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping coordinates.
   - Verify that ellipsometer optical reflection intensity and focal position remain locked without focal excursion across all sampling radii.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Radial Alignment Tolerance** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | High-precision displacement gauge / optical edge sensor |
| **Axial Total Indicator Reading (Runout / Tilt)** | $\le \pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Dial indicator across $360^{\circ}$ chuck rotation |
| **Film Thickness Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05$ (for 3.5 nm oxide) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry ($\Psi, \Delta$ Cauchy/Sellmeier fit) |
| **Mapping Grid Execution** | Automated 9-point or 49-point | Points / pattern | Polar stage multi-point automated scan cycle |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Alignment Tolerance & Stage Stability:** Sourced from *Sam Zeloof Z1 Garage Semiconductor Journal (2018)*, specifying mechanical positioning and alignment tolerance progression from Gen 1 ($\pm 100\ \mu\text{m}$) down to Gen 2 ($\pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$).
- **Metrology Precision & Mapping Patterns:** Sourced from *Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*, defining sub-Angstrom dry gate oxide measurement precision ($\pm 0.05\ \text{nm}$ on 3.5 nm films), the polar measurement model ($\rho = \tan(\Psi)\exp(i\Delta)$), and standardized 9-point or 49-point wafer non-uniformity mapping routines.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Title:** Optomechanical Alignment, Goniometric Incident Angle Calibration & System Qualification  
**Module:** Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness and Optical Dispersion Mapping  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Target Layer:** 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth ($3.5\text{ nm}$)  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm tooling) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Step 1: Kinematic   │
│     Base Leveling     │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Step 2: Polarizer &  │
│   Analyzer Zeroing    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Step 3: Goniometer   │
│    Incident Angle     │
│      Calibration      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│    Step 4: System     │
│       Metrology       │
│     Qualification     │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Kinematic Fixture & Wafer Chuck Parallelism Leveling
1. Mount the 100mm kinematic vacuum chuck fixture onto the ellipsometer XY stage.
2. Engage spherical air bearings / wedge error leveling mounts (inspired by Suss MA6 WEC leveling principles).
3. Level chuck parallelism against the optical plane across 100mm wafers until total indicator runout across the chuck surface is $< 1.0\ \mu\text{m}$.

#### Step 2: Straight-Through Beam Collimation & Polarizer/Analyzer Zeroing
1. Position the motorized goniometer arms in straight-through transmission mode ($\theta = 90^\circ$ relative to normal, $180^\circ$ line-of-sight).
2. Align the broadband collimated beam through the source polarizer and receiving analyzer directly into the spectrometer detector.
3. Perform polarizer and analyzer azimuth zero calibration to establish the optical plane of incidence where $\Psi = 45^\circ$ and $\Delta = 0^\circ$ in transmission.

#### Step 3: Goniometric Incident Angle Calibration (Silicon Substrate Reference)
1. Mount a clean bare silicon reference wafer onto the leveled vacuum chuck and apply vacuum hold-down.
2. Slew goniometer source and detector arms to the nominal angle of incidence $\theta_0 = 70.00^\circ$ (near the Brewster angle of silicon).
3. Maximize specular reflected optical signal onto the detector four-quadrant pinhole alignment target.
4. Calculate and refine the true incident angle $\theta$ by fitting experimental Fresnel reflection ratio $\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ against bare Si optical constants, locking angular alignment error to $\le \pm 0.01^\circ$.

#### Step 4: System Qualification on Dry Gate Oxide & Thick Film Standards
1. Load a calibration wafer with $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry thermal gate oxide.
2. Execute spectroscopic acquisition across UV-visible wavelengths ($\lambda$). Fit experimental $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ using Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models for $\text{SiO}_2$.
3. Verify gate oxide thickness repeatability across a 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping run.
4. Load a $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ photoresist reference wafer to qualify thick dielectric film modeling accuracy and dispersion parameterization.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Acceptance Criteria & Precision Tolerances
                    ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
                    │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│ Photoresist Metrology (±2.0 nm)
Photoresist (± nm)  ┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                    │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │ Chuck Leveling (<1.0 µm)
Chuck Parallel (µm) ┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                │
                    │██                                │ Gate Oxide Precision (±0.05 nm)
Gate Oxide (± nm)   ┤██                                │
                    │▒                                 │ Goniometer Offset (±0.01°)
Goniometer Offset (°)┤▒                                 │
                    └┬───────┬────────┬───────┬───────┬┘
                   0.00    0.50     1.00    1.50   2.00 
```

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Chuck Surface Parallelism** | $< 1.0$ | $\mu\text{m}$ across $100\text{ mm}$ wafer | Mechanical dial indicator / air-bearing optical leveling |
| **Goniometer Angular Offset** | $\le \pm 0.01$ | degrees ($^\circ$) | Specular alignment on bare Si reference fit |
| **Dry Gate Oxide (3.5 nm) Precision** | $\le \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ (sub-Ångström) | Spectroscopic fit $\rho = \tan(\Psi)\exp(i\Delta)$ / Cauchy model |
| **Thick Film (1.3 µm PR) Precision** | $\le \pm 2.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | 9-point or 49-point automated wafer map |

---

### Literature Context Citations

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - Fundamental ratio equation: $\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
   - Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion modeling for refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
   - Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) measurement precision target of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$.
   - Photoresist ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) measurement precision target of $\pm 2\text{ nm}$.
   - Automated 9-point and 49-point radial wafer mapping for non-uniformity tracking.
2. **Karl Suss MA6 Mask Aligner Standard Operating Procedure & Gap Control**:
   - Wedge Error Compensation (WEC) and spherical air-bearing mechanical chuck leveling achieving parallelism $< 1\ \mu\text{m}$ across $100\text{ mm}$ wafers.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Optomechanical Laser Beam Centering and Auto-Collimator Stage Leveling

**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness and Optical Dispersion Mapping > Optomechanical Laser Beam Centering and Auto-Collimator Stage Leveling  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    Step 1: Iris and    │
│    Source Alignment    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│        Step 2:         │
│    Auto-Collimator     │
│    Normal Leveling     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 3: Goniometric   │
│  Reflection Centering  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Step 4: Calibration   │
│    Verification on     │
│      3.5nm Oxide       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Optical Source & Aperture Mechanical Co-Axial Centering**
   - Power on the alignment laser source along the transmitter arm.
   - Adjust the two-axis kinematic tilt/translation screws on the primary beam launcher until the probe beam passes concentrically through the dual aperture iris stops (entrance pinhole and pre-objective iris) without clipping.

2. **Auto-Collimator Sample Stage Normal Leveling**
   - Mount a clean, bare silicon reference standard or blanket test wafer onto the vacuum chuck and engage the vacuum hold-down.
   - Position the auto-collimator optical head normal ($90^\circ$ relative to the stage reference surface / $0^\circ$ angle of incidence).
   - Adjust the sample stage tip/tilt leveling micrometers (pitch and roll axes) until the retro-reflected crosshair aligns with the auto-collimator reticle origin, ensuring the wafer surface normal matches the goniometer rotation axis.

3. **Goniometric Incident Beam & Receiver Centering**
   - Swing the goniometer source and receiver arms to the target calibration angle of incidence (e.g., $70^\circ$ / $75^\circ$).
   - Verify that the incident beam footprint falls exactly at the rotational center of the goniometric stage.
   - Align the receiver detector arm quadrant photodiode / pinhole alignment target using receiver micrometer stage adjustments until maximum throughput and symmetric detector balance are achieved.

4. **Polarization & Sub-Angstrom Baseline Verification**
   - Acquire reference ellipsometric angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ across the operational spectral range on a calibrated dry thermal gate oxide reference wafer ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal target grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Validate regression fit against the Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion model parameters to confirm instrument alignment integrity prior to production 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Target Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Stage Angular Leveling (Pitch/Roll)** | $\le \pm 0.005$ | $\text{deg}$ (or $\le 18\text{ arcsec}$) | Dual-axis optical auto-collimator retro-reflection reticle |
| **Beam Centering Offset at Stage Pivot** | $\le \pm 50$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Calibrated concentric reticle target / quadrant detector |
| **Dry Gate Oxide Measurement Precision** | $\le \pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ (Sub-Angstrom, $\pm 0.5\text{ \AA}$) | 30-cycle repeatability on $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$ wafer |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Resolution** | $9\text{-point}$ or $49\text{-point}$ | points/wafer | Automated radial film thickness mapping routine |

---

### 3. Literature Context Citations

* **Source 1: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - *Governing Principles:* Non-destructive polarization change quantification through fundamental relation $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - *Model & Precision:* Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models; dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) precision target of sub-Angstrom level ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
  - *Wafer Mapping:* Automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping grids tracking radial film non-uniformity across furnace and deposition runs.
* **Source 2: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Oxide Reference Baseline:* Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  1. Straight-Through   │
│   Zero Offset Homing   │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘

│    2. Theta-2Theta     │
│      Goniometric       │
│       Alignment        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘

┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    3. 3.5nm Thermal    │
│     Oxide Standard     │
│      Measurement       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  4. Multi-Angle Pitch  │
│  Qualification & Lock  │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Straight-Through Optical Alignment and Zero-Offset Calibration**:
   - Lower the sample stage below the optical path or drive the stage to the beam-pass position.
   - Command the source and detector goniometer arms to align co-linearly at the straight-through baseline configuration ($\theta_{\text{source}} = 90^\circ, \theta_{\text{det}} = 90^\circ$ relative to surface normal, or $180^\circ$ through-beam).
   - Maximize beam transmission onto the four-quadrant pinhole detector and register the absolute encoder zero-offset coordinate.

2. **Automated $\theta-2\theta$ Goniometer Calibration & Pitch Sweep**:
   - Load a clean certified calibration standard wafer onto the vacuum chuck.
   - Sweep the incident angle $\Phi_0$ across the goniometric range (e.g., $65^\circ$ to $75^\circ$ at $5^\circ$ steps) utilizing coupled $\theta-2\theta$ synchronized drive motion.
   - Verify detector centering and calibrate angular pitch repeatability at each discrete angular position using optical feedback.

3. **Standard Reference Thin Film Acquisition**:
   - Measure spectroscopic ellipsometric parameters $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ across the UV-visible-NIR spectrum conforming to:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
   - Fit experimental $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ data using a Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion model for $\text{SiO}_2$ on Si to confirm the calibrated physical incident angle.

4. **Metrology Tool Qualification for Dry Gate Oxide Runs**:
   - Execute a 9-point or 49-point repeatability sequence on the reference thermal oxide wafer.
   - Confirm that the extracted oxide thickness matches nominal calibration baselines within required sub-Angstrom limits prior to releasing the goniometer for production 180nm dry gate dielectric runs.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Unit Tolerance | Verification Method / Equipment |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Goniometric Incident Angle Pitch Accuracy** | $\pm 0.01^\circ$ | High-resolution rotary optical encoder / beam centroid quadrant photodiode |
| **Thin Gate Oxide Measurement Precision** | $3.5\text{ nm} \pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (sub-Angstrom precision) | Multi-angle Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi, \Delta$ Cauchy/Sellmeier fit) |
| **Gate Oxide Growth Thermal Reference Run** | $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ | Dry thermal oxidation process furnace thermocouple monitoring |
| **Wafer Non-Uniformity Map Sampling** | 9-point or 49-point radial map pattern | Automated theta-r / X-Y stage coordinated wafer mapping |

---

### Literature Citations & Context Reference

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - Fundamental ellipsometry equation: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
   - Dispersion modeling: Cauchy and Sellmeier formulations for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
   - Precision limits: Sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$) on $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry gate oxide films; automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping for radial non-uniformity tracking.
2. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Gate dielectric target: Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
   - Cell constraints: 1T1C cell capacitor requiring $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ storage capacitance and equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) of $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$.

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Run Environmental & Light Source Stabilization**:
   - Power on the spectroscopic ellipsometer broadband light source and allow a minimum 30-minute warm-up for optical flux and spectral stability.
   - Confirm metrology enclosure ambient conditions ($21.0 \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, relative humidity $<45\%$, laminar clean-air flow).

2. **Reference Standard Inspection & Kinematic Loading**:
   - Transfer certified thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ on $\text{Si}$ reference standards (including ultra-thin $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide equivalent and thick calibration oxide) using cleanroom vacuum wands.
   - Place the standard onto the vacuum chuck; activate vacuum hold-down and verify zero backside particle tilt.

3. **Optomechanical & Goniometric Alignment**:
   - Adjust the motorized sample tilt ($Z, \theta_x, \theta_y$) using the quad-cell auto-collimation sensor until reflected beam deviation is centered within tool null limits.
   - Calibrate the goniometric angle of incidence (AOI) to nominal settings (e.g., $70.0^\circ$ or multi-angle range $65^\circ\text{--}75^\circ$).

4. **Spectroscopic Polarization Data Acquisition**:
   - Execute polarimeter dark-current baseline subtraction.
   - Acquire spectroscopic polarization state measurements across the calibrated spectral band ($\lambda$), extracting the complex reflection ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are Fresnel reflection coefficients, and $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ quantify amplitude ratio and phase shift respectively.

5. **Automated Wafer Mapping**:
   - Execute an automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping scan across the certified wafer surface to assess radial film non-uniformity and detect fixture-induced tilt or mechanical translation drift.

6. **Optical Dispersion Modeling & Fit Analysis**:
   - Fit measured $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra using Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion models parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
   - Extract fitted physical thickness $t_{ox}$, optical constants, and root-mean-square error (RMSE) / regression residuals.

7. **Statistical Drift & Precision Verification**:
   - Perform a 10-cycle repeat measurement loop at wafer center without unchucking to calculate repeatability ($1\sigma$).
   - Compute drift deviation: $\Delta t = |t_{\text{measured}} - t_{\text{certified}}|$. Log results into the Statistical Process Control (SPC) baseline database.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

1. **Dry Gate Oxide Measurement Repeatability / Precision**:
   - Target: $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (sub-Angstrom precision, $1\sigma$) on $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $\text{SiO}_2$ gate oxide standards.
2. **Thick Film / Photoresist Range Measurement Precision**:
   - Target: Within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ on dielectric/photoresist standard layers ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ nominal thickness).
3. **Wafer Mapping Grid Integrity**:
   - Target: Automated 9-point or 49-point mapping completed with $100\%$ valid beam return signals (zero detector saturation or beam occlusion across all test points).
4. **Thermal Baseline Environment**:
   - Target: Thermal oxidation standard process baseline matched to $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation process growth target ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).

---

## 3. Literature Citations (Verified Local Literature Context)

- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - Physical Principle: Polarization state change upon reflection: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - Optical Modeling: Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion models parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Measurement Precision Targets: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) measured with sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$); thick photoresist film ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) measured within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$.
  - Mapping: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping for radial non-uniformity tracking.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Gate Dielectric Target: Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - 180nm unit cell geometry and dielectric layer stack constraints (ONO, access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-180-004
**Title**: Calibration Standard Acquisition and Optical Dispersion Model Parameterization  
**Hierarchy Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness and Optical Dispersion Mapping > Process Parameter Benchmarking > Calibration Standard Acquisition and Optical Dispersion Model Parameterization  
**Technology Node**: 180nm Gen 2 (µm)  
**Process Action Type**: Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP establishes the protocol for acquiring standard calibration data and parameterizing optical dispersion models using spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE). It ensures sub-Angstrom precision when measuring ultra-thin thermal gate oxide ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$) on Si substrates, establishing accurate baseline dispersion equations ($n(\lambda)$, $k(\lambda)$) to support downstream 9-point and 49-point wafer non-uniformity mapping.

---

### 2. Operational Procedure

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["1. Tool Initialization & Optical Calibration"] --> B["2. Standard Reference Wafer Loading & Alignment"]
    B --> C["3. Spectral Data Acquisition (Psi & Delta)"]
    C --> D["4. Optical Dispersion Model Parameterization"]
    D --> E{"5. Goodness-of-Fit (MSE) & Acceptance Verification"}
    E -- Pass --> F["Release SE Model for 9/49-Pt Production Mapping"]
    E -- Fail --> G["Recalibrate Polarizer/Analyzer & Clean Standard"]
```

#### Step 1: Tool Startup & Hardware Calibration
1. Power up the spectroscopic ellipsometer light source (Xe arc lamp or broadband halogen-deuterium source) and stabilize for at least 30 minutes.
2. Perform automated system baseline calibration using the certified calibration reference standard (certified native oxide / bare Si wafer).
3. Verify polarizer and analyzer motor zero-angle offsets. Confirm beam alignment to detector aperture with light intensity maximized.

#### Step 2: Reference Standard Loading and Optical Alignment
1. Mount the calibrated thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ on Si standard reference wafer onto the automated vacuum chuck.
2. Set the goniometer angle of incidence (AOI) to $\Phi = 70.0^\circ$ (near Brewster's angle for the silicon substrate interface to maximize sensitivity).
3. Execute automated tip/tilt stage leveling and z-height optical autofocus to center the reflected signal on the quadrant photodetector.

#### Step 3: Raw Spectroscopic Acquisition ($\Psi, \Delta$)
1. Initiate spectroscopic data acquisition across the ultraviolet-to-visible (UV-Vis) wavelength band ($\lambda = 250\text{ nm}$ to $850\text{ nm}$).
2. Measure the complex reflectance ratio:
   $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
   where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients.
3. Integrate raw signals using dynamic averaging (minimum 30 cycles per spectral point) to ensure low signal-to-noise ratio.

#### Step 4: Optical Dispersion Model Parameterization
1. Build the nominal structural stack in the modeling engine:
   - **Layer 0 (Substrate)**: Single-crystal Silicon ($\text{c-Si}$) with fixed baseline tabulated dielectric functions ($n_{\text{Si}}, k_{\text{Si}}$).
   - **Layer 1 (Dielectric Film)**: Ultra-thin $\text{SiO}_2$ parameterized using the Cauchy dispersion model:
     $$n(\lambda) = A_n + \frac{B_n}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C_n}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0$$
     *(Alternatively, apply the Sellmeier dispersion model across UV-Vis).*
2. Fit the physical film thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$ (target nominal $3.5\text{ nm}$) and dispersion parameters ($A_n \approx 1.457$, $B_n \approx 0.0035\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$).
3. Run the Levenberg-Marquardt regression algorithm to minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE) between experimental and modeled $(\Psi_i, \Delta_i)$ spectra.

#### Step 5: Recipe Sign-Off and Wafer Mapping Export
1. Confirm model fit convergence and parameter parameterization stability.
2. Export the parameterized optical dispersion model into the automated metrology recipe database for multi-point production runs (e.g., standard 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping recipes).

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Limit | Detection Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Goniometer Angle of Incidence (AOI)** | `70.00` | Degrees ($^\circ$) | $\pm 0.02^\circ$ | Optical Autocollimator / Encoder |
| **Oxide Film Measurement Precision** | `3.50` | $\text{nm}$ | $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0.5\text{ \AA}$) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry ($\Psi, \Delta$) |
| **Goodness-of-Fit (MSE)** | $< 2.0$ | Dimensionless | Max $\le 2.5$ | Levenberg-Marquardt Regression |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Density** | `9` or `49` | Inspection Points | Exact discrete count ($9$ or $49\text{ pts}$) | Metrology Stage Pattern Generator |

---

### 4. Verified Literature & Context Sources
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - Applied the fundamental ellipsometric ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ with Fresnel coefficients $r_p, r_s$.
  - Applied Cauchy/Sellmeier dispersion models parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
  - Applied measurement precision benchmark for dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) within $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ ($\pm 0.5\text{ \AA}$).
  - Applied automated 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping protocol for radial non-uniformity tracking.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - Referenced target 180nm dry thermal gate oxide physical thickness specification of $3.5\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-MET-180-SE01: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Angle Spectral Acquisition Recipe Execution

- **Module**: Metrology (Thin Film Dielectric & Optical Dispersion)
- **Hierarchy Level**: Leaf SOP (Action Type: Make)
- **Integration Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness and Optical Dispersion Mapping

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Recipe Config &     │
│        Baseline        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Multi-Angle Spectral  │
│      Acquisition       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Fresnel Amplitude &   │
│    Phase Extraction    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Cauchy / Sellmeier   │
│    Model Regression    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Radial Map &   │
│  Precision Validation  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Handling & Chamber Chucking**:
   - Transfer the 180nm dry thermal gate oxide processed silicon wafer onto the vacuum chuck of the automated spectroscopic ellipsometer.
   - Initiate auto-focus and laser tip-tilt alignment to calibrate normal incidence reflection and establish stage height zero reference.

2. **Optical System Setup & Polarization Baseline**:
   - Engage broad-spectrum source spanning deep ultraviolet through visible wavelengths.
   - Run system baseline intensity calibration through the polarizer-compensator-analyzer (PCA) train to null ambient drift and establish dark counts.

3. **Multi-Angle Spectral Data Acquisition**:
   - Configure recipe for multi-angle of incidence (AOI) goniometer sweeps to decorrelate physical thickness from refractive index.
   - Acquire wavelength-resolved polarization transformation data quantifying amplitude ratio angle $\Psi(\lambda)$ and phase difference angle $\Delta(\lambda)$ across all designated measurement angles.

4. **Complex Reflectance Ratio Calculation**:
   - Compute complex ratio of reflection coefficients:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients for parallel and perpendicular polarization components.

5. **Dispersion Modeling & Layer Regression Fitting**:
   - Construct the optical stack: `Si Substrate / Interfacial Layer / SiO2 Gate Dielectric (3.5 nm nominal)`.
   - Parameterize optical constants $n(\lambda)$ (refractive index) and $k(\lambda)$ (extinction coefficient) using a Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion model.
   - Execute Levenberg-Marquardt regression fitting to minimize mean squared error (MSE) between experimental and modeled $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra, resolving gate oxide physical thickness $t_{ox}$.

6. **Wafer-Level Uniformity Mapping**:
   - Execute automated recipe-driven multi-site grid across the wafer surface:
     - Run high-throughput radial screening via an automated **9-point** wafer map.
     - Run full radial non-uniformity spatial characterization via an automated **49-point** wafer map.
   - Save spatial coordinates, fitted thickness $t_{ox}$, optical dispersion curves $n(\lambda)$, and goodness-of-fit logs to the fab metrology database.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Control Limit | Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dry Gate Oxide Film Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | `3.5` | `±0.05` | nm | Cauchy / Sellmeier dispersion regression fit from multi-angle $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra |
| **Measurement Precision** | `Sub-Angstrom` | `<= ±0.05` | nm | Static repeat repeatability on standard oxide test sites |
| **Wafer Non-Uniformity Map Pattern** | `9-point` or `49-point` | `100% complete coverage` | points | Automated wafer stage multi-site non-uniformity mapping |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References

1. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
   - Principle of measuring polarization change quantified by angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$.
   - Fundamental relation: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
   - Dispersion modeling: Cauchy and Sellmeier formulations for $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
   - Target metrics: Dry gate oxide (3.5 nm) sub-Angstrom precision requirement ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
   - Automated mapping: 9-point and 49-point wafer mapping protocols tracking radial film non-uniformity.
2. **Ellipsometry Basics**:
   - Fundamental measurement of phase change $\Delta$ and amplitude ratio $\Psi$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Spectroscopic Ellipsometer Multi-Angle Goniometer & Baseline Standard Calibration

**Module / Operation:** Metrology / Spectroscopic Ellipsometer Calibration  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Target Structure:** 180nm Dry Gate Oxide ($3.5\,\text{nm}$) & Optical Metrology Baseline  

---

### Calibration & Verification Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│        Step 1:        │
│  Environmental Check  │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│        Step 2:        │
│   Straight-Through    │
│      Calibration      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Step 3: Goniometer   │
│      Multi-Angle      │
│     Verification      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Step 4: Standard    │
│    Oxide Baseline     │
│      Measurement      │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│      Step 5: Lot      │
│    Qualification &    │
│       Sign-off        │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **System & Environmental Stabilization:**
   - Verify class 100 cleanroom ambient temperature and humidity. Allow the broadband light source (Xe/D2 lamp) and detector array to thermalize for at least 30 minutes.
   - Clean the sample stage vacuum chuck using cleanroom-grade IPA and a low-particulate wipe.

2. **Straight-Through (Air) Polarization Baseline Calibration:**
   - Position both goniometer source and receiver arms to $180^\circ$ straight-through orientation (no wafer loaded).
   - Execute air baseline calibration to acquire baseline intensity, phase correction, and zero-point polarization angles where $\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta) = 1$ ($\Psi = 45.00^\circ$, $\Delta = 0.00^\circ$).

3. **Multi-Angle Goniometer Alignment & Angular Repeatability:**
   - Command the automated goniometer arms to standard multi-angle measurement positions around Brewster’s angle (e.g., $65^\circ$, $70^\circ$, $75^\circ$).
   - Verify optical beam alignment on the quadrant photodiode (QPD) detector to confirm beam co-planarity and auto-focus height tracking.

4. **Standard Reference Wafer Baseline Measurement:**
   - Load the certified reference calibration standard ($3.5\,\text{nm}$ thermally grown dry $\text{SiO}_2$ on $\text{Si}$ substrate, grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Run spectroscopic acquisition over the full operational wavelength spectrum $\lambda$.
   - Fit the acquired $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ spectra with the standard Cauchy / Sellmeier dispersion model parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.

5. **Multi-Point Mapping Verification & Process Sign-Off:**
   - Execute an automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping scan to verify across-wafer spatial reproducibility and baseline stability.
   - For thick-film calibration cross-checks, measure the certified photoresist reference standard ($1.3\,\mu\text{m}$).
   - Log calibration parameters, residual errors, and sign off tool status for 180nm production lot metrology.

---

  - **Physical Principle & Equation:** Measures change in light polarization quantified by amplitude ratio $\Psi$ and phase change $\Delta$:
    $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
  - **Optical Modeling:** Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion models parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Multi-Angle Spectral Acquisition ($\Psi$/$\Delta$) Wafer Mapping Execution

### Context & Classification
- **Domain Hierarchy**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology > Automated Multi-Angle Spectral Acquisition ($\Psi$/$\Delta$) Wafer Mapping Execution

---

### Process Workflow

│                        │
│  Multi-Angle Spectral  │
│   Acquisition (65°,    │
│       70°, 75°)        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Ellipsometric (Psi,   │
│      Delta) Data       │
│       Extraction       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Cauchy Dispersion    │
│  Fitting & Thickness   │
│     Map Generation     │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System Startup and Baseline Calibration**:
   - Initialize the spectroscopic ellipsometry tool and stabilize the broadband xenon light source.
   - Run system calibration using a reference certified silicon dioxide substrate to calibrate polarizer/analyzer offset angles and intensity profiles across the target UV-VIS spectrum.

2. **Wafer Loading & Alignment**:
   - Transfer the 180nm dry oxidized wafer onto the automated motorized vacuum chuck.
   - Engage vacuum chucking and run automated laser tilt-and-height auto-alignment to align the surface normal and set the z-focus datum.
   - Align wafer notch/flat to define the 0° coordinate reference for polar/radial mapping.

3. **Recipe Configuration & Multi-Angle Setup**:
   - Load the automated wafer mapping recipe configured for a standard **9-point** or **49-point** pattern to evaluate across-wafer radial non-uniformity.
   - Configure goniometer angles of incidence ($\Phi_0$) across multiple incident angles (e.g., $65^\circ$, $70^\circ$, $75^\circ$) surrounding the Brewster angle of silicon ($\sim 75.6^\circ$).

4. **Multi-Angle Spectral Acquisition**:
   - Execute stage stepping sequentially across the defined 9-point or 49-point grid.
   - At each coordinate, acquire spectral reflection intensity for $s$- and $p$-polarized light across the wavelength spectrum.
   - Measure and record the fundamental ellipsometric parameters $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ according to the complex reflectance ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$

5. **Model Fitting & Dispersion Extraction**:
   - Fit measured $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ spectra against a **Cauchy dispersion model** parameterizing the refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$ for thin $\text{SiO}_2$ on crystalline silicon.
   - Extract fitted physical film thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$), mean squared error (MSE), and non-uniformity contour maps.

---

### Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

```text
                       Metrology & Physical Targets     
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
    Cap Min Budget┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│

Max Non-Uniformity┤▒                                   │

                  │▓                                   │
   Gate Tox Target┤█████                               │
                  │█████                               │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0        7       14      21       28 
```

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5$ | $\text{nm}$ | Cauchy optical model fit from multi-angle spectroscopic $\Psi/\Delta$ |
| **Measurement Precision Tolerance** | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Repeatability across multi-angle spectral acquisition ($\pm 0.5\text{ \AA}$) |
| **Wafer Mapping Grid Resolution** | $9\text{ or }49$ | $\text{points}$ | Automated radial/concentric mapping pattern |
| **Cell Capacitance Integration Budget** | $\ge 28$ | $\text{fF/cell}$ | Target design budget for 180nm cell compatibility |

---

### Verified Literature Citations

- **`Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology`**:
  - *Governing Equation*: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$ where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are complex Fresnel reflection coefficients.
  - *Optical Modeling*: Cauchy dispersion model parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Target & Precision*: Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) metrology requiring sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$).
  - *Wafer Mapping*: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping to track radial film non-uniformity.
- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**:
  - *Capacitance Budget*: Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures noise immunity against alpha-particle soft errors and bitline coupling capacitance.
- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
  - *Thermal Oxidation*: Gate dielectric physical thickness specification of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown via dry oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Title: Dispersion Model Fitting & 3.5nm Oxide Thickness Radial Uniformity Extraction

**Process Layer**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Multi-Angle Spectral Acquisition Recipe Execution [Metrology] > **Dispersion Model Fitting & 3.5nm Oxide Thickness Radial Uniformity Extraction [Metrology]**  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) | **Action Type**: Make  
**Documentation Record**: [sop_ellipsometry_dispersion_fitting.md](docs/sop_ellipsometry_dispersion_fitting.md)

---

### 1. Metrology Process Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Load Recipe & 49-Pt   │
│          Map           │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Acquire Multi-Angle   │
│        Spectra         │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Cauchy / Sellmeier   │
│         Model          │
│    Parameterization    │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Levenberg-Marquardt   │
│   Regression on Psi    │
│       and Delta        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Radial Uniformity &   │
│  Thickness Extraction  │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     Disposition &      │
│  Statistical Process   │
│        Control         │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Recipe Initialization & Stage Alignment**:
   - Load the automated multi-angle spectroscopic ellipsometry recipe for the 180nm gate dielectric baseline.
   - Configure coordinate grid mapping for an automated **49-point wafer map** (or secondary 9-point monitor map) configured to capture radial non-uniformity across center, mid-radius, and edge exclusion zones.
   - Verify auto-focus and tip/tilt optical alignment on the standard calibration reference sample ($100\text{ nm thermal SiO}_2\text{ on Si}$).

2. **Spectral Acquisition Across Multiple Incidence Angles**:
   - Secure the processed production wafer (thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation on Si substrate).
   - Execute spectral acquisition over the standard UV-Visible wavelength range ($\lambda \approx 250\text{ nm to } 800\text{ nm}$) measuring polarized reflection ratios:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
     where $r_p$ and $r_s$ are the complex Fresnel reflection coefficients, and $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ are the measured ellipsometric angles.

3. **Optical Dispersion Model Parameterization**:
   - Construct a two-layer optical model: semi-infinite Single Crystal Silicon ($\text{Si}$) substrate + native interface layer + dielectric top layer ($\text{SiO}_2$).
   - Parameterize the optical constants $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$ using Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion models:
     $$n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0 \quad (\text{transparent in visible spectrum})$$

4. **Regression Fitting & Error Minimization**:
   - Run non-linear Levenberg-Marquardt regression minimizing Mean Squared Error ($\text{MSE}$) between modeled and experimental $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra across all acquisition wavelengths and angles.
   - Extract physical film thickness ($T_{ox}$) ensuring convergence criteria are met ($\text{MSE} < 1.50$, parameter cross-correlation $< 0.90$).

5. **Radial Uniformity Mapping & Lot Disposition**:
   - Compute mean thickness $\bar{T}_{ox}$, standard deviation ($\sigma$), and percent radial non-uniformity ($\%NU$):
     $$\%NU = \frac{T_{max} - T_{min}}{2 \cdot \bar{T}_{ox}} \times 100\%$$
   - Verify film thickness meets the target $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal specification within allowable radial bounds. Record run metrics into the Statistical Process Control (SPC) system.

---

### 3. Radial Thickness Metric Distribution

```text

                           │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│

     Radial Point 3 (Outer)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒│
Radial Point 2 (Mid-Radius)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                           │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
    Radial Point 1 (Center)┤███████████████████████████│
                           │███████████████████████████│
                           └┬──────┬─────┬──────┬─────┬┘
                           0.0    0.9   1.8    2.6  3.5 
```

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Bounds | Physical Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | `3.50` | `3.45 to 3.55` | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Measurement Precision Repeatability ($1\sigma$)** | `< 0.05` | `±0.05` (Sub-Angstrom precision) | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Wafer Radial Non-Uniformity Map Sampling** | `49` (or `9` quick monitor) | `100% sites measured without regression failure` | $\text{points / wafer}$ |
| **Thermal Growth Process Temperature Window** | `850 to 900` | `±2` | $^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 5. Verified Literature Citations

- **`Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology`**:
  - *Governing Equation*: Polarization change upon reflection quantified by $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$ via Fresnel reflection coefficients $r_p$ and $r_s$.
  - *Optical Dispersion*: Cauchy or Sellmeier models parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Precision Benchmark*: Sub-Angstrom precision requirement of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ for dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$).
  - *Spatial Sampling*: Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping tracking radial film non-uniformity across thermal furnace runs.
- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**:
  - *Thermal & Physical Constraints*: Gate dielectric grown by dry thermal oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ to achieve physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$. Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 49-Point Radial Oxide Thickness Mapping and Regression Fitting Analysis

**Module:** Thermal Processing & Spectroscopic Metrology  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Generation 1)  
**Target Layer:** 180nm Dry Gate Oxide ($\text{SiO}_2$, nominal $3.5\text{ nm}$) on Si $\langle100\rangle$ substrate  
**Extracted Knowledge:** [49_point_oxide_mapping.md](docs/knowledge/49_point_oxide_mapping.md)

---

### Process Flow Architecture

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Wafer Load &      │
│       Pre-Align       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Optical Calibration  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    49-Point Polar     │
│     Pattern Scan      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Cauchy Dispersion   │
│       Model Fit       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Radial Polynomial   │
│      Regression       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Acceptance Gate    │
│       Decision        │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **Pre-Alignment & Stage Initialization**:
   - Transfer the dry-oxidized wafer (grown at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation) from the furnace cooling cassette to the spectroscopic ellipsometer vacuum chuck.
   - Run optical edge detection and notch pre-alignment to lock wafer orientation ($\theta = 0^\circ$ aligned with $\langle110\rangle$ notch flat).
   - Set measurement angle of incidence ($\Phi$) to $70.0^\circ \pm 0.01^\circ$ (near Brewster angle for $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$).
2. **Optical System Baseline Calibration**:
   - Measure standard reference sample (native silicon substrate and certified 100 nm $\text{SiO}_2$ standard).
   - Verify spectrometer wavelength sweep range: $\lambda = 250\text{ nm}$ to $850\text{ nm}$.
   - Ensure polarimeter signal-to-noise ratio ($S/N$) $> 1000:1$ across the entire spectral band.
3. **49-Point Radial Polar Pattern Execution**:
   - Execute polar coordinate stage mapping across 49 coordinates with edge exclusion zone of $3\text{ mm}$:
     - **Site 0**: Center ($r = 0\text{ mm}$, 1 point)
     - **Ring 1**: $r = 0.25 R$ (8 equidistant points, $\Delta\theta = 45^\circ$)
     - **Ring 2**: $r = 0.50 R$ (12 equidistant points, $\Delta\theta = 30^\circ$)
     - **Ring 3**: $r = 0.75 R$ (12 equidistant points, $\Delta\theta = 30^\circ$)
     - **Ring 4**: $r = 0.95 R$ (16 equidistant points, $\Delta\theta = 22.5^\circ$)
   - Collect raw ellipsometric angles $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ based on the fundamental reflection equation:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
4. **Spectroscopic Dispersion Fitting**:
   - Apply a Cauchy dispersion model for the thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ dielectric layer:
     $$n(\lambda) = A_n + \frac{B_n}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C_n}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0$$
   - Solve for physical thickness $T_{ox,i}$ using Levenberg-Marquardt non-linear regression minimizing mean squared error ($\text{MSE} \le 1.5$).
5. **Radial Polynomial Regression Analysis**:
   - Compute wafer mean thickness: $\overline{T_{ox}} = \frac{1}{49} \sum_{i=1}^{49} T_{ox,i}$.
   - Fit radial profile to an even-order polynomial function to characterize center-to-edge furnace temperature gradients:
     $$T_{ox}(r) = a_0 + a_2 r^2 + a_4 r^4$$
   - Calculate percentage thickness non-uniformity across the 49 points:
     $$\text{Non-Uniformity (\%)} = \frac{T_{ox,\max} - T_{ox,\min}}{2 \times \overline{T_{ox}}} \times 100\%$$

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                   49-Point Metrology Acceptance Targets
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
      Cap Min (fF)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                  │▒▒▒                                 │
   Radial Unif (%)┤▒▒▒                                 │
Precision (+/- nm)┤▓                                   │
                  │▓                                   │
     Mean Tox (nm)┤█████                               │
                  │█████                               │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                   0        7       14      21       28 
```

1. **Mean Physical Oxide Thickness ($\overline{T_{ox}}$)**:
   - Target: **$3.50\text{ nm} \pm 0.15\text{ nm}$** (validating 850°C–900°C dry oxidation target).
2. **Measurement Precision Repeatability ($\sigma_{Tox}$)**:
   - Target: **$\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$** (sub-Angstrom optical repeatability across 10 repeated center-point scans).
3. **49-Point Full-Wafer Non-Uniformity ($NU_{49}$)**:
   - Target: **$\le 1.5\%$** across the active wafer area (excluding $3\text{ mm}$ edge bevel).
4. **Downstream 1T1C Cell Capacitance Compatibility**:
   - Verification baseline: Cell layout ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$) must support storage capacitor minimum capacitance of **$28\text{ fF}$** (within the nominal **$25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$** range) to ensure retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ with leakage $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$.

---

### 3. Literature Citations & Reference Context

- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - *Governing Equation:* $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$
  - *Optical Modeling:* Cauchy and Sellmeier dispersion models parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Target Precision & Mapping:* Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) measured with sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$); 49-point wafer mapping tracks radial film non-uniformity.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Thermal Process:* Gate dielectric thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at 850°C–900°C dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
  - *Cell Performance Targets:* Storage capacitor minimum capacitance of $25\text{ to }30\text{ fF}$ per cell (data retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Device Dimensions:* Access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - *Capacitance & Leakage Constraints:* Minimum $28\text{ fF}$ per cell ensures alpha-particle soft error immunity; leakage target $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Title: 49-Point Polar Polarimetric Coordinate Grid Recipe Configuration
**Process Level**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness and Optical Dispersion Mapping > 49-Point Polar Polarimetric Coordinate Grid Recipe Configuration  
**Action Type**: Make  
**Generation**: Gen 2 (µm)  

---

### 1. Process Overview & Visual Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Load Recipe & Define  │
│  49-Pt Polar Coords    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Alignment &    │
│    Notch Detection     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Z-Height Auto-Focus   │
│  & Beam Normalization  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Execute 49-Pt Polar   │
│  Ψ & Δ Data Acquisition│
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│ Cauchy Regression Fit  │
│  & Uniformity Mapping  │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Coordinate System & Stage Setup**:
   - Initialize the spectroscopic ellipsometer metrology stage and set origin $(r=0, \theta=0^\circ)$ to wafer center.
   - Program the 49-point polar coordinate measurement grid configured concentrically across 5 annular zones (Center: 1 point at $r=0$; Ring 1: 8 points; Ring 2: 12 points; Ring 3: 12 points; Ring 4: 16 points) with angular indexing referenced to the wafer notch ($0^\circ$).
2. **Optical Model Definition**:
   - Configure film stack: Substrate = `Si`, Overlayer = `SiO2` (Dry Thermal Oxide).
   - Set Cauchy dispersion model parameters for the dielectric oxide: $n(\lambda) = A_n + \frac{B_n}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C_n}{\lambda^4}$, setting initial seed thickness to $3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal. Set extinction coefficient $k(\lambda) = 0$ across the transparent spectral range.
3. **Wafer Load & Robotic Pre-Alignment**:
   - Transfer wafer from FOUP to vacuum chuck; execute notch detection optical centering.
   - Perform automated z-height autofocus and polarimetric signal intensity calibration at $(r=0, \theta=0^\circ)$.
4. **49-Point Automated Polar Traversal**:
   - Drive the $R$-$\theta$ stage to sequentially visit each of the 49 polar coordinate sites.
   - At each site, acquire raw polarimetric angles $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ via the reflection ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$$
5. **Regression Fitting & Wafer Map Generation**:
   - Execute Levenberg-Marquardt regression fitting against Cauchy model parameters at all 49 measured sites.
   - Output mean gate oxide thickness, radial contour map, and wafer non-uniformity metrics.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Target Metric | Specification Target | Physical Units | Tolerance / Requirement |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nominal Gate Oxide Physical Thickness** | `3.5` | `nm` | Target nominal thickness for dry gate oxide |
| **Ellipsometric Measurement Precision** | `±0.05` | `nm` | Sub-Angstrom precision requirement for 3.5 nm gate oxide |
| **Coordinate Grid Density** | `49` | `points` | Polar polarimetric measurement grid count |
| **Dry Oxidation Furnace Reference Range** | `850 to 900` | `°C` | Growth baseline temperature reference for modeled oxide |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **[Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology]**:
  - Measurement principle based on Fresnel reflection ratio: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot e^{i\Delta}$.
  - Optical modeling via Cauchy dispersion parameters $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Dry gate oxide nominal thickness of $3.5\text{ nm}$ measured with sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm0.05\text{ nm}$).
  - Multi-site automated wafer mapping using the 49-point grid configuration to track radial non-uniformity.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - Specification baseline for thermally grown gate dielectric silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Scan Across 180nm Wafers

**Document ID:** SOP-MET-ELLIP-180-001  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Technology Node  
**Process Action Type:** Make / Metrology Execution  
**Context:** DRAM Foundation VN — 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip [Architecture & Integration] > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Metrology  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the automated spectroscopic ellipsometry procedure to measure thin-film thickness and optical dispersion non-destructively across 180nm DRAM device wafers following the 3.5 nm dry gate oxide thermal oxidation process.

---

### 2. Operational Workflow & Visual Flow

```text
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 1: Pre-Alignment & Automatic Robotic Wafer Loading     |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 2: Recipe Selection & Optical Model Parameterization   |
  |         (Cauchy / Sellmeier Dispersion Model)               |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 3: Automated 49-Point Radial Polarimetric Scan         |
  |         (Acquiring Tan(Ψ) and Cos(Δ) across wafer grid)     |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
                                 |
                                 v
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
  | Step 4: Regression Fit, Radial Mapping & Cassette Unload    |
  +-------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step-by-Step Procedure:
1. **Wafer Transfer & Alignment:**
   - Transfer the 180nm processed wafer from the FOUP/cassette to the vacuum chuck using automated robotic end-effectors.
   - Run optical notch/flat pre-alignment to establish precise wafer coordinate center $(X_0, Y_0)$ and coordinate orientation.
2. **Recipe & Optical Model Configuration:**
   - Load the standard recipe for 180nm gate dielectric: `180NM_DRY_GOX_3.5NM_49PT`.
   - Configure optical dispersion parameterization using Cauchy or Sellmeier models to extract the refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
   - Verify incident polarimeter angle and broadband spectral range matching the baseline recipe calibration.
3. **Automated 49-Point Radial Scan Execution:**
   - Execute the automated 49-point wafer mapping scan pattern across the wafer surface.
   - For each coordinate, record polarimetric angles $\Psi$ (amplitude ratio) and $\Delta$ (phase difference), governed by the fundamental ellipsometric ratio:
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
4. **Regression Fitting & Radial Profile Analysis:**
   - Perform automated regression fitting against the parameterized dispersion model.
   - Calculate film thickness distribution and evaluate radial non-uniformity across the wafer.
   - Unload wafer back into the carrier upon successful scan validation.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Nominal Film Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | 3.5 | ±0.05 | nm | Automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Fit |

| **Sub-threshold & Junction Leakage at 85°C** *(Transistor Acceptance Boundary)* | < 1.0 | Upper bound strictly $\le 1.0$ | fA/cell | In-line / Post-patterning C-V Parametric Test |
| **Per-Cell Stacked Storage Capacitance** | $\ge 28$ | Minimum threshold | fF/cell | C-V Capacitance Metrology |

---

### 4. Sources & Literature Context Citations
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - Optical principles: Polarimetric angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$, complex Fresnel reflection ratio $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - Optical modeling: Cauchy and Sellmeier dispersion models parameterizing $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - Metrology precision: Dry gate oxide target thickness $3.5\text{ nm}$ with sub-Angstrom precision of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$.
  - Wafer mapping format: Automated 49-point wafer mapping to capture radial non-uniformity.
- **Source: Ellipsometry Basics**

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - Electrical performance boundaries: Capacitance budget minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$; leakage current target below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to support required retention and refresh intervals.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-SE-007`
**Title:** Sellmeier-Cauchy Dispersion Regression and Radial Non-Uniformity Fitting  
**Process Branch:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Film Thickness and Optical Dispersion Mapping > 49-Point Radial Oxide Thickness Mapping and Regression Fitting Analysis  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm node) | **Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This SOP defines the optical dispersion regression routine and radial non-uniformity fitting procedure for ultra-thin thermally grown gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$ nominal $\text{SiO}_2$) on $200\text{ mm}$ (or $150\text{ mm}$) Si wafers following $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation. It establishes the mathematical parameterization (Cauchy/Sellmeier) of $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ spectra acquired via automated 49-point wafer mapping to track cross-wafer thickness variations.

---

### 2. Physical Principles & Optical Modeling
Ellipsometric measurement assesses the ratio of complex Fresnel reflection coefficients:
$$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$

For the transparent gate dielectric ($\text{SiO}_2$, $k(\lambda) \approx 0$ in the visible–NIR regime), the optical dispersion is parameterized using:
- **Cauchy Dispersion:**
  $$n(\lambda) = A_n + \frac{B_n}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C_n}{\lambda^4}$$
- **Sellmeier Dispersion:**
  $$n^2(\lambda) = 1 + \sum_{i=1}^m \frac{A_i \lambda^2}{\lambda^2 - \lambda_i^2}$$

Non-linear Levenberg-Marquardt regression minimizes the mean squared error (MSE) between experimental and modeled $(\Psi, \Delta)$ spectra across all 49 measurement sites.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

```
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                  SOP FLOW: 49-POINT DISPERSION & MAPPING                |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Step 1] Wafer Loading & Vacuum Chuck Alignment                         |
|   |--> 49-point polar grid (radial tracks: 0, R/3, 2R/3, edge-exclusion)|
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Step 2] Spectral Acquisition (Psi, Delta)                              |
|   |--> Spectroscopic Ellipsometry at fixed AOI (65 deg - 75 deg)        |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Step 3] Model Parameterization & Cauchy/Sellmeier Regression           |
|   |--> Model stack: Air / SiO2 (3.5 nm) / Native Interlayer / Si sub    |
|   |--> Solve for thickness t_ox and dispersion coefficients An, Bn      |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                    |
                                    v
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Step 4] Radial Contour Mapping & Non-Uniformity Quantification         |
|   |--> Calculate % Non-Uniformity = [(t_max - t_min) / (2 * t_mean)]    |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Recipe Setup & Wafer Coordinate Alignment
1. Load the dry oxidized wafer onto the motorized vacuum chuck of the automated Spectroscopic Ellipsometer.
2. Initialize the automated coordinate system using notch/flat optical centering.
3. Configure the 49-point concentric radial sampling pattern distributed symmetrically across the wafer area with a defined edge exclusion ($3\text{ mm}$ to $5\text{ mm}$).

#### Step 2: Spectral Data Acquisition
1. Set the variable angle of incidence (AOI) to the Brewster-angle regime for $\text{Si}/\text{SiO}_2$ (typically $70^\circ$ or $75^\circ$).
2. Acquire the raw polarization parameter spectra $\Psi(\lambda)$ and $\Delta(\lambda)$ across the UV-visible-NIR spectrum ($250\text{ nm}$ to $850\text{ nm}$) at each of the 49 designated radial coordinate points.

#### Step 3: Optical Dispersion Regression & Fitting
1. Apply the structural optical stack: `Ambient (Air) / Gate Dielectric (SiO2, nominal 3.5 nm) / Silicon Substrate`.
2. Fix the substrate optical constants to standard crystalline silicon ($c\text{-Si}$).
3. Parameterize the $\text{SiO}_2$ layer using Cauchy parameters ($A_n \approx 1.45\text{--}1.46$, $B_n \approx 0.0035\text{--}0.0040\text{ }\mu\text{m}^2$, $C_n \approx 0$) with extinction coefficient $k = 0$.
4. Execute non-linear Levenberg-Marquardt regression to simultaneously fit physical oxide thickness $t_{\text{ox}}$ and dispersion coefficients against measured $\rho(\lambda)$. Confirm regression convergence at all 49 sites.

#### Step 4: Radial Profile & Non-Uniformity Calculation
1. Extract fitted physical thicknesses $t_i$ ($i = 1, \dots, 49$).
2. Compute wafer-level descriptive statistics:
   $$\bar{t} = \frac{1}{49}\sum_{i=1}^{49} t_i, \quad \sigma = \sqrt{\frac{1}{48}\sum_{i=1}^{49}(t_i - \bar{t})^2}$$
3. Calculate percentage radial non-uniformity:
   $$\text{Non-Uniformity (\%)} = \frac{t_{\max} - t_{\min}}{2 \times \bar{t}} \times 100\%$$
4. Generate contour and radial cross-section profiles (center-to-edge) to detect thermal gradient non-uniformities from the dry oxidation furnace tube.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Boundary |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Mean Gate Oxide Thickness ($\bar{t}$)** | `3.5` | `nm` | $\pm 0.15\text{ nm}$ (Nominal target from $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry ox) |
| **Ellipsometric Measurement Precision** | `±0.05` | `nm` | Sub-Angstrom precision limit |
| **Wafer Radial Mapping Density** | `49` | `points` | Full 49-point radial inspection grid |
| **Spectroscopic Fit Goodness ($R^2$ or GOF)** | `> 0.990` | `dimensionless` | Fit convergence across all 49 measured sites |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
- **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**:
  - *Polarization principle and Fresnel relation*: $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - *Optical modeling*: Cauchy or Sellmeier dispersion models parameterizing refractive index $n(\lambda)$ and extinction coefficient $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Measurement precision target*: Sub-Angstrom precision of $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ for dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$).
  - *Wafer mapping*: Automated 49-point wafer mapping tracking radial film non-uniformity.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Thermal processing reference*: Gate dielectric thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180NM-042`
**Title:** Procurement & Calibration of Certified Standard Reference Wafers and Cauchy Optical Dispersion Library  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip  
**Module:** Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & Dielectric Metrology  
**Action Type:** Make / Calibration  

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Procure NIST      │
│    Standard Wafers     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Ellipsometer Optical  │
│       Alignment        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Fit Cauchy       │
│    Dispersion Model    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Calibrate Gate Oxide  │
│       & PR Maps        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Statistical Process   │
│       Acceptance       │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Objective & Scope
Establish procurement specifications, optical calibration routines, and Cauchy dispersion model parameterizations ($n(\lambda)$, $k(\lambda)$) on spectroscopic ellipsometry platforms to monitor 180nm DRAM thermal gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) and thick dielectric/photoresist films ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Procurement & Handling of Certified Reference Wafers**
   - Source certified Standard Reference Material (SRM) silicon wafers traceable to NIST/PTB:
     - Ultra-thin thermal $\text{SiO}_2$ standard: nominal $3.5\text{ nm}$ gate oxide.
     - Thick polymer/dielectric standard: nominal $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ photoresist film on bare Si.
   - Inspect incoming standard wafers under cleanroom yellow light (ISO Class 4 / Class 10 area); verify absence of organic residue, haze, or scratch defects.

2. **Optical System Alignment & Baseline Verification**
   - Mount reference wafer on the automated vacuum chuck.
   - Align goniometer to standard angles of incidence ($65^\circ, 70^\circ, 75^\circ$).
   - Execute auto-collimation to zero the optical beam tilt and ensure normal reflection alignment onto the multi-channel spectrometer/CCD array.
   - Acquire baseline calibration on bare silicon to calibrate polarization optics and polarizer/analyzer tracking offsets.

3. **Spectroscopic Ellipsometry Acquisition ($\Psi, \Delta$)**
   - Measure the complex reflectance ratio $\rho$ across the UV-visible-NIR spectrum ($250\text{ nm} - 1000\text{ nm}$):
     $$\rho = \frac{r_p}{r_s} = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$$
   - Acquire polarization angles $\Psi$ and $\Delta$ across multi-angle sweeps to break correlation between film thickness $t$ and refractive index $n$.

4. **Cauchy Dispersion Library Fitting & Parameterization**
   - Open metrology analysis engine and apply the Cauchy transparent dispersion formula for the dielectric layer:
     $$n(\lambda) = A + \frac{B}{\lambda^2} + \frac{C}{\lambda^4}, \quad k(\lambda) \approx 0$$
   - Perform Levenberg-Marquardt regression fitting $A, B, C$ and physical thickness $t$.
   - Confirm Mean Squared Error ($\text{MSE}$) convergence against certified reference wafer nominal values.
   - Store optimized parameter coefficients into the system optical dispersion library for $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry thermal oxide and $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ photoresist films.

5. **Wafer Non-Uniformity Mapping Calibration**
   - Program automated robotic stage recipe for multi-point radial mapping:
     - 9-point radial map for fast furnace run checks.
     - 49-point full-wafer contour map for radial spin-coat/furnace non-uniformity tracking.
   - Record radial distribution and calculate thickness non-uniformity (1-sigma percentage).

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Measurement System / Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dry Gate Oxide Measurement Precision** | $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (sub-Angstrom) | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry at nominal $3.5\text{ nm} \text{ SiO}_2$ |
| **Photoresist Film Thickness Precision** | $\pm 2\text{ nm}$ | Spectroscopic Ellipsometry at nominal $1.3\ \mu\text{m}$ polymer film |
| **Gate Oxide Thickness Target** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | Post-dry oxidation ($850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$) baseline |
| **Automated Mapping Pattern Grid** | $9\text{-point}$ or $49\text{-point}$ | Radial coordinate grid tracking across wafer radius |

---

### 5. Literature Citations & Context
- **Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology**
  - *Governing Equation:* $\rho = r_p / r_s = \tan(\Psi) \cdot \exp(i\Delta)$.
  - *Optical Modeling:* Cauchy dispersion model parameterization of $n(\lambda)$ and $k(\lambda)$.
  - *Precision Metrics:* Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) measured with sub-Angstrom precision ($\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$); photoresist ($1.3\ \mu\text{m}$) measured within $\pm 2\text{ nm}$.
  - *Mapping Protocol:* Automated 9-point or 49-point wafer mapping for radial non-uniformity.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Thermal Gate Baseline:* Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
