# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
**Title:** Parasitic Contact Resistance and Gate Oxide Integrity Inspection  
**Node / Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm) — Metrology & Dielectric Reliability  
**Target Structure:** 180nm Access Transistor & MOSCAP Test Pad Structure ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, $t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm}$)

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Wafer Load &      │
│   Microprobe Contact   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Kelvin 4-Wire Rc    │
│         Check          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    I-V & Tunneling     │
│      Current Ramp      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Voltage-Ramp      │
│     Time-Zero E_bd     │
│       Inspection       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Acceptance Pass/Fail  │
│        Binning         │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Microprobe Positioning & Pad Engagement**:
   - Secure the processed 180nm DRAM wafer onto the semi-automated analytical probe station chuck with vacuum hold-down ($> 80\text{ kPa}$).
   - Align tungsten / beryllium-copper ($\text{W} / \text{BeCu}$) microprobe tips to the MOSCAP gate contact pads and access transistor source/drain terminals under high-magnification optical optics.
   - Execute controlled z-axis overdrive ($5\text{ to }10\ \mu\text{m}$) to scrub native surface oxide on metal/poly pads without fracturing the underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ dielectric stack.

2. **Parasitic Contact Resistance ($R_c$) Verification**:
   - Apply a 4-wire Kelvin microprobe sweep configuration across Kelvin contact test structures and adjacent shared bitline tungsten plug ($\text{W-plug}$) pads.
   - Sweep low-field test current from $-100\ \mu\text{A}$ to $+100\ \mu\text{A}$; extract contact resistance from the linear slope $\Delta V / \Delta I$.
   - Confirm linear, non-rectifying ohmic contact behavior before proceeding to gate dielectric stress testing.

3. **Sub-Breakdown Leakage & Tunneling Current Metrology**:
   - Configure the semiconductor parameter analyzer (SMU) to measure gate leakage ($I_g - V_g$) across the MOSCAP gate terminal with substrate grounded.
   - Perform a voltage sweep across operating range ($V_g = 0\text{ V to } 1.8\text{ V}$) at chuck temperature $T = 85^\circ\text{C}$ to monitor baseline Fowler-Nordheim / direct tunneling leakage and verify access transistor off-state behavior.

4. **Time-Zero Dielectric Breakdown ($\text{TZDB}$) & Field Extraction**:
   - Perform a linear voltage ramp (V-ramp) at a ramp rate of $0.1\text{ V/s}$ across the $3.5\text{ nm}$ thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ gate until hard dielectric breakdown occurs.
   - Define breakdown voltage $V_{\text{bd}}$ at the hard current compliance threshold ($I_{\text{comp}} = 100\ \mu\text{A}$ or current step discontinuity $> 1\text{ mA}$).
   - Calculate breakdown electric field:
     $$E_{\text{bd}} = \frac{V_{\text{bd}}}{t_{\text{ox}}} \quad (t_{\text{ox}} = 3.5\text{ nm})$$

5. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$) Cross-Validation & Defect Screen**:
   - Acquire high-frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) and quasi-static $C-V$ curves on adjacent unstressed MOSCAP structures.
   - Calculate midgap interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}}$) using the high-low frequency method to ensure dry oxidation furnace interface quality.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition | Source Context Reference |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5 \text{ to } 4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Ellipsometry & C-V extraction | *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics* |
| **Gate Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{\text{bd}}$)** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Voltage ramp breakdown on $3.5\text{ nm}$ $\text{SiO}_2$ | *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics* |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$)** | $< 1.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | High-Low $C-V$ interface extraction | *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics* |
| **Transistor & Junction Leakage Current** | $< 1.0$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Gate / sub-threshold leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology* |

---

### Literature Citations
- **[Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace](docs/context.yaml)**: Prescribes dry oxidation at $900^\circ\text{C}-1000^\circ\text{C}$ in pure dry $\text{O}_2$, yielding gate oxide physical thickness of $3.5\text{ to }4.0\text{ nm}$, high breakdown field $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$, and interface trap density $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench](docs/context.yaml)**: Dictates access transistor channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$, tungsten plug contact interconnects, and strict leakage current criteria $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering](docs/context.yaml)**: Confirms thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C}-900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Two-Terminal I-V Leakage Sweep & Series Resistance Contact Verification

**SOP Code:** `SOP-MET-180-IV-001`  
**Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)  
**Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Classification:** Metrology / Parametric Test  

---

### 1. Process Workflow & Structural Flow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Wafer Chuck Load &   │
│      Vacuum Hold       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Backside Ohmic     │
│     Contact Probe      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Al Gate Dot       │
│     Micro-Probing:     │
│    200/500/1000 um     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Low-Field Ohmic     │
│  Verification: -0.2V   │
│     to +0.2V Sweep     │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Two-Terminal DC     │
│  Leakage Sweep: -2.5V  │
│        to +2.5V        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Fowler-Nordheim /    │
│      Tunneling &       │
│  Breakdown Screening   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Pass/Fail        │
│    Qualification vs    │
│   Refresh Retention    │
│        Targets         │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Mounting & Backside Ohmic Grounding**:
   - Place the P-type (100) silicon wafer onto the gold-plated vacuum chuck of the analytical probe station.
   - Establish low-resistance ground contact through the backside Au or Al metallization layer. Verify vacuum hold pressure $\ge 80\text{ kPa}$.

2. **Probe Micro-Positioning & Dot Selection**:
   - Align tungsten micro-probe tips ($r_{tip} \approx 2\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) over circular Aluminum (Al) gate dots of designated diameters ($200\text{ }\mu\text{m}$, $500\text{ }\mu\text{m}$, or $1000\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) patterned on thermally grown dry gate oxide ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Land the probe tip under stereomicroscope with contact force controlled to avoid scrubbing or punching through the thin $3.5\text{ nm}$ dielectric.

3. **Low-Field Series Resistance ($R_s$) Verification**:
   - Perform a symmetric 2-terminal DC sweep across $V_G = -0.2\text{ V to } +0.2\text{ V}$ with a $10\text{ mV}$ step size.
   - Extract the dynamic series resistance $R_s = \frac{dV}{dI}$.
   - Ensure the contact exhibits strict linear ohmic behavior (confirming absence of non-ohmic Schottky barriers at the backside Al/Au or gate interfaces).

4. **Two-Terminal DC Leakage Sweep ($I_G - V_G$)**:
   - Configure the Source Measure Unit (SMU) with a current compliance limit set to $10\text{ mA}$ to protect the oxide from catastrophic early hard breakdown.
   - Apply a dual-staircase voltage sweep from $V_G = -2.5\text{ V to } +2.5\text{ V}$ (sweep rate: $50\text{ mV/s}$, integration time: Medium/1 PLC) at ambient ($25^\circ\text{C}$) and hot chuck condition ($85^\circ\text{C}$).
   - Record gate current $I_G$ down to sub-picoamp resolution (noise floor $\le 10\text{ fA}$).

5. **Dielectric Reliability & Field Extraction**:
   - Convert gate current to current density $J_G = \frac{I_G}{\text{Area}}$, where $\text{Area} = \frac{\pi D^2}{4}$ ($D \in \{200\text{ }\mu\text{m}, 500\text{ }\mu\text{m}, 1000\text{ }\mu\text{m}\}$).
   - Evaluate electric field $E_{ox} = \frac{V_G - V_{fb}}{t_{ox}}$ across the nominal $3.5\text{ nm}$ physical oxide. Check for Fowler-Nordheim (FN) or direct tunneling onset and ensure breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                  Acceptance Limits (Normalized Scale)  
                 ┌─────────────────────────────────────┐
                 │████████████████████                 │
Retention (ms/10)┤████████████████████                 │
                 │▓▓▓                                  │
 Log10(EOT*10/nm)┤▓▓▓                                  │
     Log10(Rs/10)┤▒▒▒                                  │
                 │▒▒▒                                  │
     E_bd (MV/cm)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                 │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                 └┬────────┬────────┬────────┬────────┬┘
                  0        3        6        9       12 
```

| Metric / Parameter | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Unit | Measurement Condition |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Oxide Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.1$ | $\text{nm}$ | Accumulated C-V extraction ($C_{ox}$) / Ellipsometry validation |
| **Contact Series Resistance ($R_s$)** | $\le 50$ | Max $\le 100$ | $\Omega$ | Low-field ohmic sweep ($-0.2\text{ V to } +0.2\text{ V}$) |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 12$ | Min $\ge 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | $V_{bd} \ge 3.5\text{ V to } 4.2\text{ V}$ on $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$ |
| **Normalized Leakage Current ($I_{leak}$)** | $< 1$ | Max $\le 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Tested at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to support DRAM retention $> 64\text{ ms}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Context & Sources

- **Source: Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
  - Test structures: Circular Al gate dots ($200\text{ }\mu\text{m}$, $500\text{ }\mu\text{m}$, $1000\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) sputtered onto thermally grown oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$ to $25\text{ nm}$) on P-type (100) Si.
  - Backside substrate contact: Gold (Au) or Aluminum (Al) ohmic contact layer.
  - Accumulation region physical oxide thickness extraction: $C_{ox} = \frac{\epsilon_{ox} \epsilon_0 \text{Area}}{t_{ox}}$ with precision $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$.
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - DRAM access transistor dimensions: Channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$, width $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Leakage requirement: Sub-threshold and junction/dielectric leakage must be kept $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to preserve storage charge in 1T1C cells ($C_{cell} \ge 28\text{ fF}$).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Dry thermal gate oxidation: Grown at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ with physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ (EOT $3 - 4\text{ nm}$).
  - Cell retention budget: Storage capacitor ($25 - 30\text{ fF}$) requires retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## MOSCAP Backside and Top-Gate Ohmic Contact Verification & $R_s$ Extraction

---

### Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Load Wafer on Vacuum  │
│         Chuck          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Probe Top Poly Gate   │
│    & Backside Chuck    │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Ohmic Linearity     │
│  Check -0.1V to +0.1V  │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Rs Extraction via    │
│  Strong Accumulation   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Acceptance       │
│     Verification &     │
│        Hand-off        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the two-terminal Kelvin/quasi-Kelvin probe contact routine, low-bias ohmic linearity validation, and series resistance ($R_s$) extraction protocol for 180nm node MOSCAP test structures ($t_{ox} = 3.5\,\text{nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$ gate dielectric) to ensure accurate subsequent high-frequency C-V and interface trap density ($D_{it}$) metrology.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate & Vacuum Chuck Preparation:**
   - Verify the backside chuck gold/nickel metallization is free of native oxide and organic contaminants (perform standard solvent wipe or backside scrub if needed).
   - Place the wafer on the thermal vacuum chuck held at $25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (ambient metrology baseline) with vacuum suction $\ge 80\,\text{kPa}$.
2. **Top-Gate Micro-Probe Alignment:**
   - Under $20\times\text{--}50\times$ optical magnification, align a low-force tungsten probe tip onto the top polysilicon gate electrode test pad.
   - Lower the micro-positioner until physical touchdown occurs; apply an overdrive of $5\,\mu\text{m}\text{ to }10\,\mu\text{m}$ to pierce surface native oxide without punching through the $3.5\,\text{nm}$ dry gate oxide.
3. **Low-Field Backside/Gate Contact Linearity Sweep:**
   - Configure the Semiconductor Parameter Analyzer (SMU1 on top gate pad, SMU2 / Chuck ground on backside substrate).
   - Perform a low-bias sweep from $-100\,\text{mV}$ to $+100\,\text{mV}$ with a $5\,\text{mV}$ step and current compliance set to $100\,\mu\text{A}$.
   - Verify linear symmetric behavior ($R^2 \ge 0.998$) confirming pure Ohmic contact without Schottky barrier rectification at both interfaces.
4. **Series Resistance ($R_s$) Impedance Extraction:**
   - Couple the LCR meter / impedance analyzer to the probe station setup at $100\,\text{kHz}$ and $1\,\text{MHz}$ test frequencies.
   - Bias the MOSCAP into strong accumulation ($V_g = -1.5\,\text{V}$ for p-substrate / $+1.5\,\text{V}$ for n-substrate) with an AC oscillation level of $15\,\text{mV}_{\text{rms}}$.
   - Measure equivalent series impedance $Z = R_s + \frac{1}{j\omega C_{ox}}$ or extract $R_s$ using the dual-frequency Nicollian-Goetzberger method:
     $$R_s = \frac{G_{ma}}{G_{ma}^2 + \omega^2 C_{ma}^2}$$
     where $C_{ma}$ and $G_{ma}$ are measured capacitance and conductance in strong accumulation.
5. **Data Logging & Hand-Off:**
   - Record extracted $R_s$, contact resistance symmetry, and chuck temperature.
   - Flag structures exceeding $R_s$ limits for re-probing or backside metallization rework before advancing to $D_{it}$ extraction.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Limit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Probe Overdrive Travel** | `7.5` | $\mu\text{m}$ | $\pm 2.5\,\mu\text{m}$ ($5.0\text{ to }10.0\,\mu\text{m}$) |
| **Chuck Vacuum Retention** | `85.0` | $\text{kPa}$ | $\ge 80.0\,\text{kPa}$ |
| **Contact Linearity Coefficient ($R^2$)** | `0.999` | dimensionless | $\ge 0.998$ ($-0.1\,\text{V}\text{ to }+0.1\,\text{V}$) |
| **Total Series Resistance ($R_s$)** | `< 25.0` | $\Omega$ | Maximum $\le 30.0\,\Omega$ |
| **Metrology Chuck Temperature** | `25.0` | $^\circ\text{C}$ | $\pm 0.5\,^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Validates gate dielectric thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ physical thickness, setting the physical oxide breakdown limit and gate oxide capacitance target ($C_{ox}$).
- **Source: Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Dry oxidation regime produces dense dielectric with minimal interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\,\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$) and breakdown field $E_{bd} > 10\,\text{MV/cm}$ ($\sim 3.5\,\text{V}$ absolute breakdown across $3.5\,\text{nm}$ oxide), requiring $V_{\text{test}} \le 1.5\,\text{V}$ during accumulation testing to prevent stress-induced leakage current (SILC).
- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions ($L = 180\,\text{nm}$, $W = 220\,\text{nm}$) and cell leakage targets ($< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$) define the sensitivity requirement for probe contact parasitics.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## SOP-MET-180-007: Quasi-DC Two-Terminal Gate Dielectric Leakage & Tunneling I-V Sweep Execution

- **Module**: Metrology & Device Characterization
- **Technology Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN)
- **Structure**: MOSCAP / Access Transistor Gate Dielectric ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\,\text{nm}$)
- **Action Type**: Make / Metrology Execution

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│     Load Wafer on     │
│    Triaxial Chuck     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Position Guarded    │
│      Probe Tips       │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Set SMU Sweep 0V to  │
│         3.5V          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Acquire Quasi-DC    │
│        Leakage        │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│         Check         │
│   Fowler-Nordheim &   │
│          Ebd          │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate & Chuck Conditioning**:
   - Mount wafer onto a temperature-stabilized triaxial vacuum chuck configured at $85^\circ\text{C}$ (or $25^\circ\text{C}$ for ambient baseline verification).
   - Ensure triaxial shield and chuck guard lines are connected to prevent parasitic substrate displacement currents.

2. **Probe Landing & Series Contact Integrity**:
   - Micro-position tungsten probe tips on the gate electrode contact pad (shared access transistor polysilicon/metal gate over $W = 220\,\text{nm}$, $L = 180\,\text{nm}$ active region) and the substrate/well tap.
   - Verify low-field ohmic series resistance across contact pads prior to sweeping to ensure no non-ohmic barrier introduces voltage drop distortion.

3. **Source Measure Unit (SMU) Configuration**:
   - **Mode**: Quasi-DC Staircase Sweep (Voltage Source, Current Measure).
   - **Voltage Range**: $0.0\,\text{V}$ to $+3.5\,\text{V}$ (accumulation bias for n-MOSCAP / access gate, ramping towards dielectric stress regime).
   - **Step Size**: $25\,\text{mV}$ to $50\,\text{mV}$ increments.
   - **Integration / Settling Time**: Set aperture to 1 NPLC (Power Line Cycle) with a delay/hold time $\ge 100\,\text{ms}$ per step to suppress transient displacement charging current ($I_{disp} = C \frac{dV}{dt}$).
   - **Current Compliance**: Program current compliance limit strictly to $100\,\mu\text{A}$ to prevent catastrophic thermal arc destruction of the gate dielectric during hard breakdown.

4. **I-V Sweep Acquisition & Tunneling Extraction**:
   - Execute quasi-DC voltage sweep while logging gate leakage current ($I_G$).
   - Monitor direct tunneling regime at nominal operating bias ($V_{DD} \approx 1.8\,\text{V}$) and transition into Fowler-Nordheim (F-N) tunneling at elevated fields ($E_{ox} > 6\,\text{MV/cm}$).
   - Extract dielectric breakdown field:
     $$E_{bd} = \frac{V_{bd}}{t_{ox}}$$
     where $t_{ox} = 3.5\,\text{nm}$.

5. **Post-Test Data Archival & Retraction**:
   - Safely ramp voltage back to $0.0\,\text{V}$.
   - Retract probe tips along the Z-axis by $\ge 500\,\mu\text{m}$.
   - Record current density ($J_G = I_G / A$), dielectric breakdown field ($E_{bd}$), and leakage at $85^\circ\text{C}$.

---

### 3. Physical & Reliability Acceptance Targets

```text
                  180nm Physical & Reliability Targets  
                ┌──────────────────────────────────────┐
                │░░░                                   │
 Breakdown Field┤░░░                                   │
                │▒▒                                    │
  Dielectric Tox┤▒▒                                    │

```

| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{bd}$)** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Quasi-DC ramp to breakdown with $100\,\mu\text{A}$ compliance |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness ($t_{ox}$)** | $3.5 \pm 0.5$ ($3.5 - 4.0$) | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry / C-V inversion extraction |
| **Leakage Current Budget** | $< 1.0$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Low-noise SMU current integration at operating voltage |
| **Access Transistor Channel Geometry** | $L = 180 \pm 10$, $W = 220 \pm 10$ | $\text{nm}$ | In-line CD-SEM / metrology layout overlay |

---

### 5. Context Citations

- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - *Dry oxidation produces dense, high-dielectric breakdown gate oxide ($E_{bd} > 10\,\text{MV/cm}$) with minimal interface trap density ($D_{it} < 10^{10}\,\text{cm}^{-2}\text{eV}^{-1}$); gate dielectric target thickness is $3.5\,\text{nm}$ to $4.0\,\text{nm}$.*
- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
  - *Access transistor dimensions: channel length $L = 180\,\text{nm}$, width $W = 220\,\text{nm}$. Sub-threshold and junction/dielectric leakage current target must remain $< 1\,\text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh retention requirements.*
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - *Gate dielectric is thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ with $\sim 3.5\,\text{nm}$ physical thickness, supporting retention time $> 64\,\text{ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.*

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Contact-Corrected I-V Parameter Extraction & Gate Oxide Leakage Budget Qualification

**Process Module:** Metrology / Parametric Test  
**Node / Technology:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 2 (µm)  
**Parent Context:** MOSCAP Test Structure Probe Setup & Two-Terminal I-V Leakage Sweep $\rightarrow$ Contact-Corrected Parameter Extraction & Qualification

---

### 1. Process Workflow Architecture

```text
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│    Raw I-V & Rs     │
│     Measurement     │
│                     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│  Series Resistance  │
│     Correction      │
│                     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│    E-Field & Jox    │
│     Extraction      │
│                     │
└──────────┬──────────┘
           │
           │
           ▼
┌─────────────────────┐
│                     │
│  Leakage Budget &   │
│   E_bd Validation   │
│                     │
└─────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Test Structure Loading & Thermal Equilibration:**
   - Load the wafer onto the shielded prober thermal chuck.
   - Stabilize chuck temperature at **$85^\circ\text{C}$** ($\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$) in a dry nitrogen/dark enclosure to simulate worst-case DRAM retention thermal conditions.
   - Contact the polysilicon gate electrode and backside/substrate contact of the MOSCAP or scaled access transistor test structure ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).

2. **Raw Voltage Sweep & Series Resistance ($R_s$) De-embedding:**
   - Apply a dual-staircase two-terminal voltage sweep ($V_{\text{applied}}$) across the gate oxide ($t_{\text{ox}} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).
   - Determine series resistance $R_s$ from strong accumulation $I\text{-}V$ or multi-frequency impedance metrology.
   - Calculate true contact-corrected gate oxide potential drop:
     $$V_{\text{ox}}(I) = V_{\text{applied}} - I \cdot R_s$$
   - Remove voltage drop artifacts caused by probe contact resistance and substrate bulk resistance.

3. **Current Density ($J_{\text{ox}}$) and Electric Field ($E_{\text{ox}}$) Extraction:**
   - Normalize measured current by test structure physical area $A_{\text{gate}}$ ($A_{\text{cell}} = 180\text{ nm} \times 220\text{ nm} = 0.0396\ \mu\text{m}^2$ for cell-level structures) to extract leakage current density:
     $$J_{\text{ox}} = \frac{I_{\text{corrected}}}{A_{\text{gate}}}$$
   - Compute physical dielectric electric field:
     $$E_{\text{ox}} = \frac{V_{\text{ox}}}{t_{\text{ox}}} \quad (\text{with } t_{\text{ox}} \approx 3.5\text{ nm})$$

4. **Fowler-Nordheim / Direct Tunneling & Breakdown Characterization:**
   - Evaluate low-field leakage regime to ensure compliance with the DRAM cell retention leakage budget.
   - Ramp field toward high-bias regime until hard/soft dielectric breakdown occurs; register breakdown field $E_{\text{bd}}$.

5. **Pass/Fail Binning & Statistical Qualification:**
   - Compare extracted parameters ($I_{\text{leak}}$, $E_{\text{bd}}$, $t_{\text{ox}}$) against baseline limits across center, middle, and edge test dies.
   - Log qualifying lots to the metrology database.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Targets

```text
                                                        
                       ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                       │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
    Dit Target (<10^10)┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
                       │▒▒▒▒                           │
 Leakage Budget (<1 fA)┤▒▒▒▒                           │
   T_ox Target (3.5 nm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                   │
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓                   │
E_bd Target (>10 MV/cm)┤███████████████████████████████│
                       │███████████████████████████████│
                       └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬──────┬┘
                       0.0     2.5    5.0     7.5  10.0 
```

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Tolerance / Boundary | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Dielectric Breakdown Field ($E_{\text{bd}}$)** | $> 10$ | $\text{MV/cm}$ | Minimum lower limit | Ramp voltage breakdown sweep |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | $3.5$ to $4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ | Target nominal range | Contact-corrected C-V / Ellipsometry cross-check |
| **Cell Transistor Leakage Current** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA/cell}$ | Maximum upper limit at $85^\circ\text{C}$ | Contact-corrected sub-threshold/oxide $I\text{-}V$ sweep |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$)** | $< 10^{10}$ | $\text{cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$ | Maximum upper limit | High-frequency/Quasi-static C-V parameter correlation |

---

### 4. Verified Literature References

- **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench:**
  - Access transistor channel dimensions: $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$.
  - Leakage budget qualification target: $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain refresh interval.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering:**
  - Gate dielectric dry thermal silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) physical thickness: $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Retention requirements: Storage capacitance $> 25\text{--}30\text{ fF/cell}$ with retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Dry thermal oxide quality: Dielectric breakdown field $E_{\text{bd}} > 10\text{ MV/cm}$.
  - Interface trap density requirement: $D_{\text{it}} < 10^{10}\text{ cm}^{-2}\cdot\text{eV}^{-1}$.
  - Thickness target regime: $3.5\text{ to } 4.0\text{ nm}$.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: SOP-MET-180-CV01
**Title:** High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition  
**Node Generation:** Gen 2 (180 nm / µm)  
**Process Step Context:** Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & C-V Metrology $\rightarrow$ High-Frequency & Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction  
**Action Type:** Make  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the dual-sweep Capacitance-Voltage (C-V) metrology protocol for characterizing 3.5 nm thermally grown dry gate oxide test structures (MOSCAPs) on 180 nm DRAM production lots. The dual-sweep data acquisition combines high-frequency (HF, 1 MHz) and quasi-static (QS) capacitance profiling to extract interface trap density ($D_{it}$), flatband voltage ($V_{fb}$), and validate dielectric integrity across access transistor gate stacks.

---

### 2. Workflow & Metrology Architecture

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|  Wafer Loading & Shielded Chuck Thermal Stabilization (25°C / 85°C)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Open/Short Calibration & Parasitic Compensation (LCR Meter / SMU)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|   High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Sweep (-2.5 V to +2.5 V, Accum. -> Inv.)  |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Quasi-Static (QS) Linear Ramp Acquisition (dV/dt <= 50 mV/s)        |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                   |
                                   v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
|   Automated $D_{it}$ Extraction, Gate Leakage Screening (< 1 fA limit)|
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Tool Setup & Environmental Stabilization:**
   - Mount the test wafer on the prober chuck inside a light-tight, electrically shielded Faraday enclosure to prevent photogeneration artifacts.
   - For standard ambient screening, verify chuck temperature is stabilized at $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$. For thermal leakage correlation, ramp chuck to $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$.

2. **Fixture Open/Short De-embedding:**
   - Perform open-circuit and short-circuit calibration on the LCR meter / precision impedance analyzer at the probe tips across the full measurement frequency spectrum (up to 1 MHz) to remove coaxial cable parasitics and chuck stray capacitance.

3. **High-Frequency (1 MHz) C-V Acquisition:**
   - Land Kelvin tungsten/beryllium-copper probe tips onto the designated MOS capacitor test pad (gate contact) and substrate/well tap.
   - Configure AC probe signal: $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$, $V_{osc} = 15\text{ mV}_{\text{RMS}}$.
   - Apply DC bias dual sweep: Sweep gate bias from accumulation ($-2.5\text{ V}$) to strong inversion ($+2.5\text{ V}$) and back to accumulation at a standard step rate ($\Delta V = 20\text{ mV}$, hold time $= 50\text{ ms}$).
   - Record high-frequency capacitance ($C_{HF}$) and conductance ($G_{HF}$) versus DC bias ($V_G$).

4. **Quasi-Static (QS) C-V Acquisition:**
   - Switch instrument configuration to precision electrometer / Source Measure Unit (SMU) mode.
   - Ensure the structure is held in equilibrium hold bias for $10\text{ s}$ prior to ramping.
   - Execute a linear ramp quasi-static acquisition with a slow slew rate ($dV/dt \le 50\text{ mV/s}$) from accumulation to inversion.
   - Measure displacement current $I_{QS}$ and compute quasi-static capacitance:
     $$C_{QS} = \frac{I_{QS}}{dV/dt}$$
   - Verify leakage current limit does not distort $I_{QS}$.

5. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction & Data Export:**
   - Compute interface trap capacitance across the bandgap using the High-Low frequency method:
     $$C_{it}(V_G) = \left(\frac{1}{C_{QS}} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}}\right)^{-1} - \left(\frac{1}{C_{HF}} - \frac{1}{C_{ox}}\right)^{-1}$$
     $$D_{it} = \frac{C_{it}}{q \cdot A}$$
     *(where $q$ is elementary charge and $A$ is MOSCAP pad area).*
   - Automatically log data into the fab manufacturing execution and yield tracking system.

---

### 4. Acceptance Criteria & Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Units | Tolerance / Measurement Limits |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Dielectric Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | `3.5` | nm | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ (extracted via $C_{ox}$ in strong accumulation) |
| **Test Frequency (High-Frequency Mode)** | `1.0` | MHz | $\pm 0.01\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Elevated Temperature Stability Benchmark** | `85` | °C | $\pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ (for thermal retention screening) |
| **MOSCAP Dielectric / Leakage Screening Floor** | `< 1.0` | fA | Upper bound screening threshold at $85^\circ\text{C}$ |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations

- **`Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering`**: Defines the gate dielectric physical target as thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) via $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness; establishes elevated operational retention temperature benchmarking at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
- **`180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench`**: Dictates the ultra-low leakage requirement where sub-threshold and junction leakage must be kept below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ to maintain cell refresh intervals, providing the leakage floor bound during metrology characterization.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## MOSCAP Test Structure Probe Card Alignment and Open/Short Parasitic Calibration

Document stored in: [sop_moscap_probe_alignment_calibration.md](docs/sop_moscap_probe_alignment_calibration.md)

---

### 1. Process Workflow

```text
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│  Probe Card / Chuck  │
│       Loading        │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│       Optical        │
│   Planarization &    │
│      Alignment       │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│    Open Parasitic    │
│     Calibration      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│   Short Parasitic    │
│     Calibration      │
│                      │
└───────────┬──────────┘
            │
            │
            ▼
┌──────────────────────┐
│                      │
│      Acceptance      │
│    Verification &    │
│   Dual-Sweep Ready   │
│                      │
└──────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Substrate Chuck Loading & Backside Ohmic Grounding**:
   - Secure the P-type (100) silicon wafer (with sputtered Au or Al backside metallization) onto the gold-plated vacuum stage.
   - Draw vacuum lock ($> 75\text{ kPa}$) and verify substrate backside contact resistance is $< 1.0\ \Omega$.
2. **Optical Alignment & Planar Touchdown**:
   - Under microscope optics ($10\times$ to $50\times$), locate the circular Al gate dot array (diameters: $200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, and $1000\ \mu\text{m}$).
   - Align probe needles over the dot center. Lower the probe card until initial contact touch is detected, then apply a precise vertical overdrive of **$35 \pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$** (scrubs surface native aluminum oxide without puncturing the underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ dry thermal oxide).
3. **Open Parasitic Calibration (Admittance De-embedding)**:
   - Elevate probe needles exactly **$250\ \mu\text{m}$** above the surface in air; close the dark shield box.
   - Execute open calibration at measurement frequency $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ ($V_{ac} = 15\text{ to }30\text{ mV RMS}$) to measure and null out fixture stray admittance $Y_{open} = G_{open} + j\omega C_{open}$.
4. **Short Parasitic Calibration (Impedance De-embedding)**:
   - Lower probe needles onto the gold/aluminum shorting reference pad with standard $35\ \mu\text{m}$ overdrive.
   - Run short calibration at $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ to extract residual series impedance $Z_{short} = R_{short} + j\omega L_{short}$.
   - Store correction factors in the LCR firmware to enable two-port de-embedding:
     $$Z_{DUT} = \frac{Z_{meas} - Z_{short}}{1 - (Z_{meas} - Z_{short})Y_{open}}$$

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
Calibration Target Windows & Tolerances:
                       ┌───────────────────────────────┐
                       │░                              │
   Oxide Precision (nm)┤░                              │
                       │▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                 │
 Contact Overdrive (um)┤▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒▒                 │
Short Residual R (mOhm)┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                       │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
   Open Residual C (fF)┤███████                        │
                       │███████                        │
                       └┬───────┬──────┬───────┬──────┬┘
                        0      20     40      60     80 
```

| Parameter | Unit | Target Specification | Measurement Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Open Capacitance ($C_{open}$)** | $\text{fF}$ | **$< 20\text{ fF}$** (typical $\le 15\text{ fF}$) | $1.0\text{ MHz}$ open sweep at $250\ \mu\text{m}$ elevation |
| **Residual Short Resistance ($R_{short}$)** | $\text{m}\Omega$ | **$< 100\ \text{m}\Omega$** (typical $\le 80\ \text{m}\Omega$) | $1.0\text{ MHz}$ short test on Au/Al contact pad |
| **Probe Needle Overdrive** | $\mu\text{m}$ | **$35 \pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$** | Z-axis encoder micrometer displacement |
| **Accumulation Oxide Precision ($t_{ox}$)** | $\text{nm}$ | **$3.5 \pm 0.1\text{ nm}$** | Extracted from $C_{ox} = (\varepsilon_{ox}\varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{ox}$ |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Stage 2 Reality Gate: Planar MOS Capacitor C-V Profiling & Dit Extraction**:
  - Test Structure: Aluminum circular gate dots ($200\ \mu\text{m}$, $500\ \mu\text{m}$, $1000\ \mu\text{m}$ diameter) sputtered on thermally grown gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$ to $25\text{ nm}$) on P-type (100) Si; backside substrate Au/Al ohmic contact.
  - High-Frequency ($1\text{ MHz}$) accumulation capacitance saturation $C_{ox} = (\varepsilon_{ox}\varepsilon_0 \cdot \text{Area}) / t_{ox}$ resolves physical oxide thickness $t_{ox}$ with $\pm 0.1\text{ nm}$ precision.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
  - Gate dielectric dry thermal oxidation with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Manual and Optical Probe Tip Planarization and Contact Alignment

**Document ID:** `SOP-MET-180NM-PROBE-001`  
**Classification:** Metrology & Electrical Test (MOSCAP / C-V Characterization)  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Node  
**Process Step:** Probe Card Tip Planarization, Touchdown, & Contact Alignment for MOSCAP Gate Dielectric ($t_{ox} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$) Characterization

---

### 1. Workflow Architecture & Overview

```text
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 1: Load Wafer & Vacuum Verification   │
│  - Secure 180nm wafer on gold-plated chuck   │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 2: Coaxial Optical Focus & Platen Tilt│
│  - Adjust Theta & Roll to align tip plane    │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 3: Micro-Z Contact Touchdown Detect   │
│  - Monitor reflective split-image & contact  │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Stage 4: Controlled Overdrive & Scrub Check │
│  - Verify scrub mark within pad boundaries   │
└──────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

#### Step 1: Substrate Loading & Chuck Conditioning
1. Mount the 180nm wafer (featuring 3.5 nm dry thermal gate oxide MOSCAP test structures) onto the probe station chuck.
2. Engage chuck vacuum (> 65 kPa differential) and ensure back-side substrate electrical continuity for C-V quasi-static/high-frequency dual sweep grounding.
3. Position the microscope turret over the reference contact pads (pitch $\sim 360\text{ nm}$ to $400\text{ nm}$ array periphery or MOSCAP test frame).

#### Step 2: Optical Planarity Co-Focusing
1. Focus high-magnification coaxial optics on the MOSCAP aluminum/tungsten probe pad surface.
2. Lower the probe card or manipulator arms until the probe needle tips are within the field of view ($\sim 50\ \mu\text{m}$ above the surface).
3. Observe the vertical clearance of all probe tips simultaneously using optical split-focus or depth-of-field monitoring:
   - Adjust the probe card holder planarization leveling screws (pitch and roll axes) until all tips come into focus within the same optical focal plane.

#### Step 3: Tip Alignment to MOSCAP Pad Target
1. Align probe tips along the $X$-$Y$ axes to center each tip on its respective test pad target.
2. Inspect tip tips for mechanical contamination or tungsten/beryllium-copper wear; perform ceramic abrasive cleaning pad contact if oxidation or residual particulate is detected.

#### Step 4: Touchdown Detection and Overdrive Application
1. Advance the micrometer Z-axis drive slowly toward the pad surface at $< 5\ \mu\text{m/s}$ while monitoring the tip and reflection image convergence.
2. Identify zero-contact touchdown ($Z_0$) upon first mechanical deflection or optical ground contact.
3. Apply standard mechanical overdrive ($Z_{OD} = 25\ \mu\text{m} \pm 5\ \mu\text{m}$) to displace the surface native oxide and ensure low series contact resistance without puncturing or cracking the underlying $3.5\text{ nm}$ thin gate oxide layer.
4. Verify lateral scrub length under optical inspection to confirm stable contact.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance | Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Probe Tip Planarity Deviation ($\Delta Z_{tip}$)** | $\le 5$ | Max | $\mu\text{m}$ | Optical depth-of-field focal micrometer differential across probe array |
| **Controlled Overdrive Travel ($Z_{OD}$)** | $25$ | $\pm 5$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Z-axis digital linear micrometer encoder / stage readout |
| **Contact Scrub Mark Length** | $8$ | $\pm 2$ | $\mu\text{m}$ | Calibrated optical microscope graticule / automated image metrology |
| **Gate Oxide Structural Integrity** | $3.5$ | $\pm 0.05$ | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry baseline check / zero pre-breakdown leakage |

---

### 4. Verified Context Citations

* **Dielectric Layer & Gate Oxide Thickness:**  
  - Gate dielectric is thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness (*Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
  - Dry gate oxide ($3.5\text{ nm}$) metrology precision capability verified at $\pm 0.05\text{ nm}$ (*Source: Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and Reflectometry for Dielectric Film Metrology*).

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-MET-180-DEEMBED-001`
**Title:** On-Wafer Open-Short Calibration Standard Sweep and Fixture De-embedding  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > 180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth (3.5 nm) [Thermal Processing] > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry and C-V Oxide Thickness & Interface Metrology [Metrology] > High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Extraction [Metrology] > High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition [Metrology] > MOSCAP Test Structure Probe Card Alignment and Open/Short Parasitic Calibration [Metrology] > On-Wafer Open-Short Calibration Standard Sweep and Fixture De-embedding [Metrology]  
**Technology Node:** Gen 2 (180 nm / $\mu\text{m}$)  
**Action Type:** Buy (Turnkey Semi-Automated Wafer Prober / Dual LCR & Quasi-Static Fixture De-embedding Module)

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
This SOP defines the rigorous protocol for executing on-wafer open and short calibration sweeps to isolate and remove residual cable, probe card tip, and pad parasitics (shunt admittance $Y_{open}$ and series impedance $Z_{short}$) from high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V characterization setups targeting dry gate oxide MOSCAP structures (physical thickness $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$).

---

### 2. Equipment, Fixtures & Standards
- **Automated Cryogenic/Thermal Prober Station:** Shielded dark box with low-noise triaxial chuck.
- **Impedance / LCR Meter:** Calibrated at 1 MHz HF test frequency with four-terminal pair (4TP) architecture.
- **Quasi-Static / Sub-pA Electrometer:** Low-leakage dual-sweep source-measure unit (SMU).
- **On-Wafer Calibration Structures (Scribe-Line Test Chip):**
  - *Open Standard:* Layout identical to the MOSCAP device under test (DUT) with top metal and probe pad intact, but gate dielectric active area omitted (unconnected open circuit).
  - *Short Standard:* Layout identical to DUT pad layout with probe landing pad metal directly strapped to bottom substrate/well contact metal via tungsten plugs (zero intentional oxide gap).

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1. Physical Alignment & Prober Zeroing (Dark box, chuck temp, optical alignment)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 2. On-Wafer "Open" Calibration Sweep (G_open, C_open residual admittance sweep)   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 3. On-Wafer "Short" Calibration Sweep (R_short, L_short residual impedance sweep) |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
                                         |
                                         v
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 4. Dual-Network De-embedding & DUT Raw Admittance Correction                      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Probe Card Contact and Environmental Stabilization
1. Place the 180nm process control monitor (PCM) wafer onto the vacuum chuck inside the shielded, light-tight probe station.
2. Set chuck temperature to baseline measurement condition: **$25.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** (or qualification temperature point up to **$85^\circ\text{C}$** for leakage evaluation per specification).
3. Align probe card tips with the dedicated scribe-line open/short calibration pads using pattern recognition. Set probe contact skate/overtravel within specified limits.

#### Step 2: On-Wafer Open Standard Sweep Acquisition
1. Land probe tips onto the **Open Calibration Standard** pads.
2. Initiate frequency sweep at $f = 1\text{ MHz}$ and record measured parallel conductance $G_{open}$ and parallel capacitance $C_{open}$.
3. Calculate residual shunt admittance:
   $$Y_{open} = G_{open} + j\omega C_{open}$$
4. Measure quasi-static baseline current across the voltage operating window to ensure open-structure residual leakage is below instrument noise floor.

#### Step 3: On-Wafer Short Standard Sweep Acquisition
1. Step the chuck to the adjacent **Short Calibration Standard** pads.
2. Land probe tips under identical overtravel pressure and skate length as Step 2.
3. Perform measurement at $f = 1\text{ MHz}$ to record series resistance $R_{short}$ and series reactance $\omega L_{short}$.
4. Calculate residual series impedance:
   $$Z_{short} = R_{short} + j\omega L_{short}$$

#### Step 4: Real-Time Fixture De-embedding Transformation
1. Step probe tips to the active 180nm gate dielectric MOSCAP test structure ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ dry $\text{SiO}_2$ gate oxide).
2. Measure raw device complex admittance:
   $$Y_{raw} = G_{meas} + j\omega C_{meas}$$
3. Execute standard two-port de-embedding formula to strip out pad/probe parallel shunt and series line parasitics:
   $$Y_{int} = Y_{raw} - Y_{open}$$
   $$Z_{int} = \frac{1}{Y_{int}}$$
   $$Z_{DUT} = Z_{int} - Z_{short}$$
   $$Y_{DUT} = \frac{1}{Z_{DUT}} = G_{DUT} + j\omega C_{DUT}$$
4. Stream de-embedded capacitance $C_{DUT}(V)$ and conductance $G_{DUT}(V)$ directly to the $D_{it}$ extraction workflow.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Tolerance / Limit | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **High-Frequency Sweep Frequency** | `1.0` | Exact ($\pm 0.1\%$) | $\text{MHz}$ | LCR internal oscillator counter |
| **Gate Dielectric Physical Thickness Context** | `3.5` | Baseline nominal | $\text{nm}$ | Spectroscopic ellipsometry baseline |
| **Measurement Chuck Temperature** | `25.0` (or `85.0`) | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Embedded PT100 chuck sensor |
| **Open Calibration Residual Conductance ($G_{open}$)** | $< 10$ | Max $\le 50$ | $\text{nS}$ | 1 MHz 4TP LCR Meter measurement |

---

### 5. Verified Source Citations
- **Source:** *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*  
  - Confirms gate dielectric thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) physical thickness target: **$\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness** (grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation).
  - Confirms high-temperature qualification regime at **$85^\circ\text{C}$**.
- **Source:** *180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*  
  - Confirms thermal/leakage qualification baseline at **$85^\circ\text{C}$** and sub-threshold/junction leakage floor targets.
- **Workflow Hierarchy:** *High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition*  
  - Dictates the test frequency baseline of **$1\text{ MHz}$** for high-frequency MOSCAP de-embedding.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Baseline Stray Capacitance and Residual Lead Inductance Verification

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Init Open/Short     │
│      Calibration       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Measure Baseline    │
│       Stray Open       │
│       Admittance       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Verify Stray      │
│  Capacitance C_stray   │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│        Measure         │
│     Short-Circuit      │
│       Impedance        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    Extract Residual    │
│    Lead Inductance     │
│  L_res and Resistance  │
│         R_res          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Pass/Fail Acceptance  │
│      Verification      │
└────────────────────────┘
```

### 1. Scope & Objectives
This SOP defines the verification protocol for baseline stray capacitance ($C_{\text{stray}}$) and residual lead inductance ($L_{\text{res}}$) across the probe card, triaxial/coaxial cabling, and LCR/impedance analyzer front-end. Accurate de-embedding is strictly required prior to dual-sweep high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V acquisition on 180nm MOSCAP and DRAM storage capacitor test structures, where target cell capacitance is on the order of 25 fF to 30 fF ($C_{\text{min}} \ge 28\text{ fF}$) and bitline capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} \approx 250\text{ fF}$.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System & Environmental Stabilization**:
   - Power on the LCR/impedance analyzer, probe station thermal chuck, and shield enclosure.
   - Allow a minimum 45-minute warm-up period to stabilize thermal drift at cleanroom ambient ($21.0^\circ\text{C} \pm 1.0^\circ\text{C}$, $< 45\%\text{ RH}$).
   - Set signal frequency to test grid: $f = 100\text{ kHz}$ to $1.0\text{ MHz}$, AC oscillation level $V_{\text{AC}} = 20\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$ to $30\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$.

2. **Open Calibration & Stray Capacitance Verification**:
   - Retract probe needles/card vertically $100\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $250\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ above the wafer chuck or dedicated calibration substrate (open circuit condition).
   - Execute an open-circuit admittance measurement ($Y_{\text{open}} = G_{\text{open}} + j\omega C_{\text{open}}$).
   - Verify uncompensated stray capacitance ($C_{\text{stray}} = C_{\text{open}}$) across all active signal-to-shield/ground pins.
   - Store open-compensation vectors into the analyzer de-embedding engine.

3. **Short Calibration & Residual Impedance/Inductance Extraction**:
   - Contact probe tips onto a gold calibration standard shorting bar or dedicated test-die short test structure.
   - Apply standard probe overdrive ($25\text{ }\mu\text{m}$ to $40\text{ }\mu\text{m}$) to guarantee stable contact resistance.
   - Perform a short-circuit impedance sweep ($Z_{\text{short}} = R_{\text{short}} + j\omega L_{\text{short}}$) from $100\text{ kHz}$ to $1.0\text{ MHz}$.
   - Extract residual series lead resistance ($R_{\text{res}} = \text{Re}(Z_{\text{short}})$) and residual lead inductance ($L_{\text{res}} = \frac{\text{Im}(Z_{\text{short}})}{2\pi f}$).
   - Store short-compensation vectors into the measurement instrument.

4. **De-Embedding Verification (Baseline Check)**:
   - Re-measure the open fixture with compensation applied; confirm residual compensated capacitance flattens within baseline noise limits.
   - Re-measure the short fixture with compensation applied; confirm residual series impedance is zeroed within measurement tolerance.
   - Lock calibration profile for subsequent high-frequency (1 MHz) and quasi-static C-V acquisition on 3.5 nm gate oxide MOSCAP test structures.

---

### 3. Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Evaluation Condition / Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Compensated Stray Capacitance ($C_{\text{stray, comp}}$)** | $< 1.0$ (or $< 5.0$ uncompensated raw lead margin relative to $25\text{--}28\text{ fF}$ cell budget) | $\text{fF}$ | Open fixture verification after compensation @ $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ |
| **Residual Lead Inductance ($L_{\text{res}}$)** | $< 15.0$ | $\text{nH}$ | Short fixture extraction @ $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ across probe card and cable leads |
| **Residual Series Lead Resistance ($R_{\text{res}}$)** | $< 0.50$ | $\Omega$ | Short fixture extraction across contact pin pair |
| **AC Test Frequency Calibration Benchmark** | $1.0$ | $\text{MHz}$ | Measurement stimulus frequency for high-frequency C-V calibration |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**
  - *Context applied*: Defines the stacked capacitor capacitance budget with a minimum threshold of $28\text{ fF}$ per cell (requiring sub-femtofarad parasitic calibration) and physical transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$).
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Context applied*: Confirms cell storage capacitance targets between $25\text{ fF}$ and $30\text{ fF}$ per cell to sustain retention time $> 64\text{ ms}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$, and establishes the 180nm gate dielectric baseline ($3.5\text{ nm}$ dry oxide physical thickness grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$).
- **Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**
  - *Context applied*: Confirms typical cell capacitance $C_s = 25\text{ fF}$ and bitline parasitic capacitance $C_{\text{BL}} = 250\text{ fF}$, yielding differential signal $\Delta V \approx 100\text{ mV to } 150\text{ mV}$, underscoring the necessity of strict lead parasitic calibration to avoid masking femtofarad-scale capacitive responses.

nodes.primary_metric: Sub-milestone of High-Frequency (1 MHz) and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Acquisition
nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## 1 MHz High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep Measurement Automation

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Probe Card & Chuck   │
│       Alignment        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Open/Short       │
│      Calibration       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  1 MHz High-Frequency  │
│       C-V Sweep        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Quasi-Static Ramp    │
│       C-V Sweep        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Interface Trap     │
│   Density Extraction   │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This SOP defines the automated test execution protocol for dual-sweep Capacitance-Voltage ($C$-$V$) metrology—combining 1 MHz High-Frequency (HF) and Quasi-Static (QS) sweeps on test MOS capacitors (MOSCAP) fabricated alongside 180nm dry thermal gate oxides ($\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness) for the DRAM access transistor ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$). The automated routine extracts interface trap density ($D_{\text{it}}$) and equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) without inducing soft dielectric breakdown.

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Tool Setup & Thermal Stabilization**
   - Power on the automated wafer prober, precision LCR meter (1 MHz capable), and electrometer/picoammeter unit.
   - Set the thermal vacuum chuck to $25^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ (or $85^\circ\text{C} \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ for retention qualification).
   - Ensure triaxial cable shields are grounded to eliminate parasitic noise.

2. **Fixture Compensation (Open/Short Calibration)**
   - Perform probe-tip open-circuit compensation at $1.0\text{ MHz}$ with probe pins lifted $50\ \mu\text{m}$ above contact pads.
   - Perform short-circuit compensation on a gold/aluminum calibration substrate to zero residual series resistance ($R_s$) and cable inductance ($L$).

3. **Wafer Loading & Pad Alignment**
   - Vacuum-clamp the 180nm process wafer onto the chuck.
   - Perform automated pattern recognition to align tungsten probe tips onto test MOSCAP pads (gate dielectric: dry thermal $\text{SiO}_2$, $t_{\text{ox}} \approx 3.5\text{ nm}$).

4. **1 MHz High-Frequency (HF) C-V Sweep Acquisition**
   - Configure the LCR meter in $C_p - G_p$ parallel mode with an AC oscillator amplitude of $v_{\text{ac}} = 15\text{ mV}_{\text{rms}}$ at $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$.
   - Apply a dual-directional DC bias sweep:
     - **Forward:** $-2.0\text{ V} \rightarrow +2.0\text{ V}$ in $20\text{ mV}$ steps with an integration delay of $50\text{ ms}$ per point.
     - **Reverse:** $+2.0\text{ V} \rightarrow -2.0\text{ V}$ to capture mobile ionic charge hysteresis ($\Delta V_{\text{fb}}$).
   - Record accumulation capacitance $C_{\text{ox,HF}}$, flatband capacitance $C_{\text{fb}}$, and inversion minimum $C_{\text{min,HF}}$.

5. **Quasi-Static (QS) Linear Ramp C-V Acquisition**
   - Switch matrix connection to the picoammeter/high-impedance electrometer.
   - Configure a linear voltage ramp: ramp rate $\frac{dV}{dt} = 50\text{ mV/s}$ over the range $-2.0\text{ V} \rightarrow +2.0\text{ V}$.
   - Measure displacement current $I_{\text{disp}}(V)$ via:
     $$C_{\text{QS}}(V) = \frac{I_{\text{disp}}(V)}{dV/dt}$$
   - Confirm leakage current does not saturate the electrometer range.

6. **Automated $D_{\text{it}}$ Extraction & Data Archival**
   - Run the high-low frequency interface trap density extraction algorithm (Castagné-Vapaille method):
     $$D_{\text{it}}(V) = \frac{C_{\text{ox}}}{q} \left( \frac{C_{\text{QS}}}{C_{\text{ox}} - C_{\text{QS}}} - \frac{C_{\text{HF}}}{C_{\text{ox}} - C_{\text{HF}}} \right)$$
   - Calculate physical oxide thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$ / EOT) from strong accumulation capacitance ($C_{\text{ox}} = \frac{\varepsilon_{\text{SiO}_2} \cdot A}{t_{\text{ox}}}$).
   - Export CSV curves and metric summaries to the yield metrology server.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Measurement Condition / Method | Lower Limit | Nominal Target | Upper Limit | Unit |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Physical Gate Oxide Thickness ($t_{\text{ox}}$)** | Strong accumulation capacitance ($V_g = -2.0\text{ V}$) | $3.3$ | $3.5$ | $3.7$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Equivalent Oxide Thickness (EOT)** | HF C-V accumulation model extraction | $3.0$ | $3.5$ | $4.0$ | $\text{nm}$ |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{\text{it}}$ at midgap)** | Dual-sweep High-Low extraction ($f_{\text{HF}} = 1\text{ MHz}$) | — | $< 5.0 \times 10^{10}$ | $1.0 \times 10^{11}$ | $\text{eV}^{-1}\cdot\text{cm}^{-2}$ |
| **High-Frequency C-V Hysteresis ($\Delta V_{\text{fb}}$)** | Forward vs. reverse sweep difference at flatband | — | $< 10$ | $25$ | $\text{mV}$ |

---

### 4. Context & Literature Citations
- **Dielectric & Thickness Specifications**: Thermally grown $\text{SiO}_2$ at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ dry oxidation targeting $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness with EOT around $3\text{ to }4\text{ nm}$ (*Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
- **Access Transistor Constraints**: Target access transistor dimensions of channel length $L = 180\text{ nm}$ and width $W = 220\text{ nm}$ on 180nm process flow (*Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*).
- **Leakage & Retention Requirements**: Refresh interval qualification requires sub-threshold and junction leakage below $1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$ with capacitor retention budget $> 64\text{ ms}$ (*Sources: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*; *Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title**: Kelvin Four-Point Probe Station and LCR/SMU Instrumentation Interconnect Calibration
- **Context**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Metrology > Gate Dielectric & C-V Metrology Pipeline
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Node
- **Action Type**: Make / Calibration SOP

---

## 1. Process Overview & Workflow

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Kelvin Interconnect  │
│         Setup         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Cable Length Delay   │
│     Compensation      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│   Open De-embedding   │
│     Stray G and C     │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Short De-embedding   │
│   Residual R and L    │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Load Reference     │
│      Calibration      │
│     Verification      │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│      Calibration      │
│    Validation Pass    │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Calibration Procedure

### Step 1: Physical Interconnect & Shielding Setup
1. Route triaxial and low-noise coaxial cables from the precision LCR meter / SMU (Force High, Sense High, Sense Low, Force Low) to the shielded analytical probe station.
2. Terminate the outer shields to the common instrument guard ground; ensure probe station dark box/Faraday cage enclosure is secured with continuous grounding.
3. Align micro-positioner probe arms equipped with Kelvin-sensing tungsten probe tips over the calibration substrate (ISS / gold-plated standard).

### Step 2: Cable Length & Phase Delay Compensation
1. Configure instrument cable length setting on the LCR meter (select exact electrical length: `1.0 m` or `2.0 m` based on physical harness).
2. Execute phase offset compensation across the target test spectrum (including 1 kHz to 1 MHz test frequencies).

### Step 3: Open-Circuit De-embedding (Stray Admittance Cancellation)
1. Lift all 4 probe tips to a separation of $100\ \mu\text{m}$ above the substrate surface in air (or over non-conductive open calibration pads).
2. Execute the instrument **Open Calibration** routine over the frequency span ($1\ \text{kHz}$ to $1\ \text{MHz}$).
3. The instrument measures and nulls residual parallel stray conductance ($G_o$) and stray capacitance ($C_o$).

### Step 4: Short-Circuit De-embedding (Residual Impedance Cancellation)
1. Lower Force and Sense probe tips onto a common gold shorting pad on the calibration substrate.
2. Execute the instrument **Short Calibration** routine across the frequency sweep.
3. The instrument measures and zeroes series residual lead resistance ($R_s$) and parasitic inductance ($L_s$).

### Step 5: Load Standard Verification & Leakage Floor Baseline
1. Place probe tips across a certified reference calibration standard ($50.0\ \Omega$ load standard or precision low-loss capacitor).
2. Verify that high-frequency series resistance ($R$) and capacitance ($C$) match certified values within specification limits.
3. Perform quasi-static DC leakage zeroing to establish the triaxial noise and leakage baseline prior to wafer C-V sweeps.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Exact Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Residual Open Stray Capacitance ($C_o$)** | $\le 10$ | $\text{fF}$ (femtofarads) | LCR Open Measurement at $1\ \text{MHz}$ post-compensation |
| **Residual Short Lead Resistance ($R_s$)** | $\le 50$ | $\text{m}\Omega$ (milliohms) | Kelvin 4-point Short Measurement on gold standard |
| **DC Noise & Leakage Current Floor** | $< 1$ | $\text{fA}$ (femtoamperes) | Triaxial SMU zero-bias current acquisition at $25^\circ\text{C}$ / shielded dark box |
| **Impedance Phase Error at High Frequency** | $\pm 0.05$ | ${^\circ}$ (degrees) | Verification against $50.0\ \Omega$ standard at $1\ \text{MHz}$ |

---

## 4. Context & Source Citations

1. **Gate Dielectric Integration & Thickness Context**:
   - *Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering*
   - C-V metrology operates on dry gate oxide with physical thickness of $\sim 3.5\ \text{nm}$ (thermally grown at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$). Precise open/short calibration eliminates cabling parasitics so interface trap density ($D_{it}$) and thin-oxide accumulation capacitance are accurately measured without series resistance attenuation.
2. **Capacitance Resolution Constraints**:
   - *Source: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench*
   - DRAM cell capacitance target budget is $\ge 28\ \text{fF}$ (with subthreshold and junction leakage target $< 1\ \text{fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$). De-embedding stray capacitance below $10\ \text{fF}$ and noise floor below $1\ \text{fA}$ ensures probe interconnects do not swamp cell-scale and micro-dielectric features.
3. **Signal Calibration Scale Context**:
   - *Source: Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout*
   - Sensing dynamics evaluate cell charge across $C_s \approx 25\ \text{fF}$ and bitline capacitance $C_{BL} \approx 250\ \text{fF}$, confirming the critical need for femtofarad-accurate interconnect calibration during metrology extraction.
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title**: 1 MHz High-Frequency and Quasi-Static C-V Dual-Sweep PyVISA Automation Script Development
- **Process Line**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 2 (µm)
- **Hierarchy**: Thermal Processing (180nm Dry Gate Oxide Growth ~3.5 nm) > Spectroscopic Ellipsometry & C-V Metrology > Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) Metrology > Dual-Sweep PyVISA Automation
- **Action Type**: Make

---

## 1. Process Flow Diagram

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Init PyVISA Session  │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│  Configure 1 MHz HF   │
│          C-V          │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│        Execute        │
│  High-Frequency Dual  │
│         Sweep         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│       Configure       │
│     Quasi-Static      │
│   Electrometer Ramp   │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Execute QS Ramp    │
│         Sweep         │
│                       │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│                       │
│    Extract Dit and    │
│  Validate EOT 3.5 nm  │
│                       │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step SOP Procedure

1. **PyVISA Environment & Instrument Initialization**:
   - Establish VISA communications over GPIB/TCPIP via `pyvisa.ResourceManager('@py')` interfacing with the LCR meter (e.g., Keysight E4980A/HP 4284A) and the Quasi-Static Electrometer/SMU (e.g., Keithley 6517B / 4200-SCS).
   - Send `*RST` and `*CLS` SCPI commands to place both instruments into known reset states.

2. **High-Frequency (1 MHz) Dual-Sweep Configuration**:
   - Program the LCR meter to AC frequency $f = 1.0\text{ MHz}$ with an AC oscillator amplitude of $V_{ac} = 15\text{ mV}_\text{RMS}$ (to maintain small-signal linearity across the thin oxide).
   - Define a dual staircase sweep across gate bias $V_G$:
     - Forward Sweep: $-2.5\text{ V} \rightarrow +2.5\text{ V}$ with step size $\Delta V = 50\text{ mV}$, hold time $t_\text{hold} = 1.0\text{ s}$, delay $t_\text{delay} = 100\text{ ms}$.
     - Reverse Sweep: $+2.5\text{ V} \rightarrow -2.5\text{ V}$ with matching step parameters to detect mobile ion or charge trapping hysteresis.
   - Configure instrument measurement mode to parallel capacitance–conductance ($C_p - G_p$).

3. **High-Frequency Dual-Sweep Acquisition & Cabling Correction**:
   - Execute open/short calibration (`CORR:OPEN`, `CORR:SHOR`) at 1 MHz using the automated switching matrix to zero out probe parasitic capacitance ($C_{cable} \ll 1\text{ pF}$).
   - Trigger the dual-sweep sequence via SCPI `:INIT:CONT` and query array buffer (`:FETC?`), buffering $V_G$, $C_{HF}$, and $G_p$.

4. **Quasi-Static (QS) Linear Ramp Acquisition**:
   - Switch matrix connection to electrometer/high-precision picoammeter.
   - Configure linear voltage ramp mode with slew rate $\frac{dV}{dt} = 20\text{ mV/s}$ to maintain thermal equilibrium without deep depletion displacement current artifacts.
   - Measure quasi-static displacement current:
     $$I_{QS}(V) = C_{QS}(V) \cdot \frac{dV}{dt}$$
   - Derive quasi-static capacitance:
     $$C_{QS}(V) = \frac{I_{QS}(V)}{\frac{dV}{dt}} - I_{leak}(V)$$
     where $I_{leak}(V)$ is the steady-state DC leakage current baseline.

5. **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) & Oxide Metric Extraction (Castagné & Vapaille Method)**:
   - Synchronize and interpolate $C_{HF}(V_G)$ and $C_{QS}(V_G)$ curves on an identical bias grid.
   - Extract maximum accumulation capacitance $C_{ox}$ to verify equivalent oxide thickness:
     $$T_{ox} = \frac{\varepsilon_{SiO2} \cdot \varepsilon_0 \cdot A_{gate}}{C_{ox}}$$
   - Calculate interface trap density across the depletion/weak inversion regime using:
     $$D_{it}(V) = \frac{C_{ox}}{q \cdot A_{gate}} \left( \frac{C_{QS}/C_{ox}}{1 - C_{QS}/C_{ox}} - \frac{C_{HF}/C_{ox}}{1 - C_{HF}/C_{ox}} \right) = \frac{C_{ox}}{q \cdot A_{gate}} \left( \frac{1}{\frac{C_{ox}}{C_{QS}} - 1} - \frac{1}{\frac{C_{ox}}{C_{HF}} - 1} \right)$$
   - Export CSV report and plot curves inside the automated run folder.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Tolerance / Bounds | Measurement Technique |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **High-Frequency AC Signal** | $1.0\text{ MHz}$ | $\pm 0.01\text{ MHz}$ ($10\text{ kHz}$ limit) | LCR internal oscillator frequency counter |
| **Quasi-Static Ramp Slew Rate ($\frac{dV}{dt}$)** | $20\text{ mV/s}$ | $\pm 1.0\text{ mV/s}$ | SMU/Electrometer linear ramp monitor |
| **Gate Oxide Physical Thickness ($T_{ox}$)** | $3.5\text{ nm}$ | $\pm 0.2\text{ nm}$ ($3.3\text{ nm}$ to $3.7\text{ nm}$) | Extracted from $C_{ox}$ accumulation capacitance |
| **Interface Trap Density ($D_{it}$) at Midgap** | $\le 1.0 \times 10^{10}\text{ eV}^{-1}\text{cm}^{-2}$ | Upper ceiling $< 2.0 \times 10^{10}\text{ eV}^{-1}\text{cm}^{-2}$ | High-Frequency / Quasi-Static combined extraction |
| **Dual-Sweep Hysteresis Flatband Shift ($\Delta V_{FB}$)** | $0\text{ mV}$ | $|\Delta V_{FB}| \le 15\text{ mV}$ | Forward vs. reverse sweep $V_{FB}$ delta |

---

## 4. Cited Literature Sources

1. **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**:
   - Thermally grown silicon dioxide ($\text{SiO}_2$) dry gate dielectric at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ with $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ physical thickness.
   - Storage capacitor equivalent oxide thickness (EOT) around $3\text{ nm}$ to $4\text{ nm}$.
2. **180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench**:
   - Access transistor dimensions ($L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$), cell capacitance budget $\ge 28\text{ fF/cell}$, leakage constraints $< 1\text{ fA/cell}$ at $85^\circ\text{C}$.
3. **Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout**:
   - Readout charge development $Q_s = C_s \cdot (V_{cell} - V_{BL})$ and signal margins ($C_s = 25\text{ fF}$, $C_{BL} = 250\text{ fF}$).
citations: 180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench (Kang & Leblebici - CMOS Digital Integrated Circuits)
Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering (IEEE / Legacy Foundry Technical Reports)
Folded Bitline Sense Amplifier Circuit Design for DRAM Cell Readout (Keeth & Baker - DRAM Circuit Design: A Tutorial)
