# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Fused Quartz Process Tube and Ultra-High Purity Gas Flange Integration

- **Generation:** Gen 1 (mm)
- **Hierarchy:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) `>` Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly `>` Fused Quartz Process Tube and Ultra-High Purity Gas Flange Integration
- **Action Type:** Make
- **Domain:** Thermal Processing / LPCVD & Oxidation Furnace Subsystems

---

### 1. Integration Workflow Overview

```text
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Inspect Tube and    │
│    Flange Surfaces    │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  Position Elastomer   │
│  Seal on Ground End   │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Star Pattern Bolt   │
│       Torquing        │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│  UHP Line Hookup to   │
│         MFCs          │
└───────────┬───────────┘
            │
            ▼
┌───────────────────────┐
│   Laminar Flow and    │
│  Vacuum Verification  │
└───────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Pre-Assembly Inspection & Cleanliness Protocol:**
   - Inspect the fused silica (high-purity quartz) process tube exterior, ground flat-face / flanged end, and internal walls under grazing high-intensity light for scratches, fractures, or particulate contamination.
   - Wipe mating 316L stainless steel flange sealing surfaces and O-ring grooves with cleanroom-grade isopropyl alcohol (IPA) and particle-free wipes.
2. **O-Ring Gasket Alignment & Seating:**
   - Seat high-purity fluoroelastomer/perfluoroelastomer O-rings into the precision-machined flange retaining grooves without twisting.
   - Gently guide the ground end of the fused quartz tube into concentric alignment with the gas distribution flange.
3. **Flange Clamp Fastening (Mechanical Stress Prevention):**
   - Install flange split-collars and hardware.
   - Hand-tighten all bolts evenly, followed by progressive star-pattern torquing in incremental steps to prevent localized point-loading or micro-cracking of the quartz lip.
4. **UHP Gas Manifold & MFC Hookup:**
   - Connect VCR/face-seal process lines from the Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs) supplying carrier and process gases (high-purity $\text{N}_2$ purge, ultra-pure $\text{O}_2$, or forming gas).
   - Ensure thermocouple quartz thermowells (Type R / Type S Platinum-Rhodium) are securely seated through flange feedthrough ports without mechanical strain.
5. **Vacuum & Dynamic Flow Integrity Test:**
   - Evacuate or seal the tube assembly; verify pressure regulation capability across the operating pressure regime (200 to 400 mTorr for chemical-duty booster roots pump LPCVD setups, or positive pressure for atmospheric oxidation).
   - Flow $\text{N}_2$ carrier gas through the MFCs across the 1 to 5 SLPM range to verify leak-tight laminar flow dynamics.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Metric | Engineering Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Carrier Gas Flow Regulation** | **1 to 5** | $\text{SLPM}$ | Mass Flow Controller (MFC) feedback logging |
| **Operating Vacuum Integrity (LPCVD mode)** | **200 to 400** | $\text{mTorr}$ | Chemical-duty mechanical booster roots pump gauge reading |
| **Zone Temperature Uniformity across Boat Region** | **$\pm 0.5$** across **300** (or **30**) | **°C** across **mm** (or **cm**) flat zone | 3-Zone PID multi-point profiling (800°C – 1150°C) |
| **Boat Mechanical Insertion Speed Limit** | **$< 50$** | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Automated boat push/pull linear actuator controller |

---

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source:** *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation*
  - Triple-loop PID control and Type R / Type S thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells.
  - Temperature uniformity requirement: maintains **$\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** across the central **$300\text{ mm}$** wafer boat region between **$800^\circ\text{C}$** and **$1150^\circ\text{C}$**.
  - Laminar flow of carrier gases ($\text{N}_2$ purge, ultra-pure $\text{O}_2$, forming gas) regulated by Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) at **$1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$**.
  - Wafer boat mechanical feed rate: **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and crystallographic slip.
- **Source:** *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*
  - Fused silica process tube with 3-zone PID temperature regulation maintaining **$\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** over **$30\text{ cm}$** flat zone for field oxide / LOCOS isolation.
- **Source:** *Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks*
  - Hot-wall tube furnace sealed and maintained at operating pressure of **$200\text{ to }400\text{ mTorr}$** evacuated via chemical-duty mechanical booster roots pump.
citations: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation (Levinson - Principles of Lithography & Thermal Processing)
Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace (Deal & Grove - Journal of Applied Physics)
Low-Pressure Chemical Vapor Deposition (LPCVD) of Silicon Nitride Hard Masks (Kern & Rosler - Chemically Vapor Deposited Synthetic Materials)

## 2. Step-by-Step Commissioning Procedure

### Step 1: Physical Assembly & Cold Sensor Verification
1. **Tube Specification Verification**: Confirm the horizontal process tube is fused quartz (outer diameter: **150 mm to 200 mm**, purity **99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$**).
2. **Heating Coil Integrity**: Inspect the 3-zone resistive heating coil array (**Kanthal A1 / APM alloy** or **Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$**) partitioned into:
   - **Source Zone** (gas inlet end)
   - **Center Zone** (process flat zone)
   - **Load Zone** (loading door end)
3. **Thermocouple Encapsulation**: Verify installation of **dual Type-R / Type-S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples** per zone housed inside dedicated quartz thermowells (one primary control thermocouple, one over-temperature safety monitor per zone).

### Step 2: Atmospheric Sweep & Gas Line Preparation
1. **Laminar Carrier Gas Purge**: Connect calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) supplying ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ (or ultra-pure $\text{Ar} / \text{O}_2$).
2. **Sweep Flow Rate**: Establish a laminar gas sweep velocity between **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** (operating minimum within the verified range of **1 to 5 SLPM**) to suppress ambient back-diffusion during thermal cycling.

### Step 3: Decoupled Multi-Zone PID Calibration
1. **Cross-Zone Feedforward Decoupling**: Configure the triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling matrices to compensate for thermal cross-coupling:
   - Offset convective and conductive heat transfer from Center zone into Source and Load ends.
   - Adjust power bias dynamically on Load and Source elements to counteract door/flange heat sinking.
2. **Ramping & Target Thermal Soak**:
   - Ramp the furnace controller systematically across calibration milestones: **800°C**, **1000°C**, and **1150°C to 1200°C**.
   - Mechanical wafer boat positioning (if present) must remain stationary or move at $< 50\text{ mm/min}$ during thermal transitions to avoid crystallographic slip.

### Step 4: Multi-Point Isothermal Flat Zone Profiling
1. Insert a calibrated profiling thermocouple array into the quartz process tube under a steady gas sweep of **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM**.
2. Measure steady-state thermal gradients across the central **300 mm to 350 mm** wafer zone at target soak temperatures between **800°C and 1200°C**.
3. Fine-tune zone-specific PID gains ($P, I, D$) and setpoint offsets until the flat zone meets the required semiconductor uniformity.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Tolerance | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Flat Zone Thermal Uniformity** | `0.0` (Center setpoint reference) | `°C` | `≤ ±0.5 °C` | Multi-point Pt-Pt/Rh profile across central 300 mm to 350 mm |
| **Operating Temperature Span** | `800 to 1200` | `°C` | Full range stable | Triple-loop Type R/S dual thermocouple readout |
| **Carrier Gas Sweep Flow Rate** | `2.0 to 5.0` (range: `1 to 5`) | `SLPM` | `±0.05 SLPM` | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) feedback |
| **Wafer Boat Insertion/Exit Speed** | `< 50.0` | `mm/min` | `≤ 50 mm/min` | Automated mechanical push/pull drive encoder |

---

## 4. Contextual Literature Citations

- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery**:
  - Horizontal fused quartz process tube dimensions (OD: 150 mm – 200 mm, purity 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$).
  - 3-zone division: Source, Center, and Load zones with Kanthal A1 or APM alloy coils.
  - Dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples per zone and digital PID controller.
  - Center flat zone: middle 350 mm maintaining uniformity $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ at 1000°C to 1200°C.
  - MFC gas delivery rate: 2.0 to 5.0 SLPM laminar gas sweep velocity.
- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**:
  - Heating elements: Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal molybdenum disilicide ($\text{MoSi}_2$) coils across Load, Center, and Source zones.
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling and quartz thermowell encasements.
  - Uniformity of $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across central 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C.
  - Laminar carrier gas flow of 1 to 5 SLPM via MFC.
  - Mechanical boat travel rate $< 50\text{ mm/min}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**:
  - 3-zone PID temperature controller maintaining $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ over 30 cm flat zone in high-purity quartz process tube.

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Pre-Installation Inspection & Cleaning
1. Clean the furnace chassis and outer surface of the high-purity fused silica quartz tube with cleanroom-grade wipes and isopropyl alcohol (IPA).
2. Inspect the Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal heating element coils and high-purity quartz thermowells for micro-cracks, surface contamination, or mechanical warping.

### Step 2: Kanthal Heating Element Harness Installation
1. Mount the heating element coils onto the furnace chassis, physically partitioning the assembly into three dedicated heating zones: **Load Zone**, **Center Zone**, and **Source Zone**.
2. Fasten high-temperature ceramic insulators and secure the power harness terminals with torque-specified ceramic barrel connectors to avoid localized contact resistance and hotspots.

### Step 3: Quartz Thermowell & Type-S Thermocouple Insertion
1. Insert the fused quartz thermowells along the longitudinal profile adjacent to the process tube.
2. Thread three calibrated Type-S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples into the three dedicated thermowell bores corresponding to the Load, Center, and Source heating zones.
3. Position the center thermocouple probe tip precisely aligned with the central 300 mm (30 cm) wafer flat zone.

### Step 4: PID Harness Wiring & Signal Loop Connection
1. Terminate the Type-S thermocouple leads with matched Platinum-Rhodium compensation cables to the triple-loop digital PID controller input channels.
2. Interlock the heating element power relays with the decoupled feedforward PID loop and emergency over-temperature cutoff breakers.
3. Set the MFC carrier gas (ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$, $\text{O}_2$) laminar flow purge to 1 to 5 SLPM and verify temperature sensor continuity prior to bake-out.

---

| **Operating Temperature Range** | $800 \text{ to } 1150$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Digital PID loop sensor readout across Load, Center, and Source zones |
| **Isothermal Flat Zone Length** | $300$ (or $30$) | $\text{mm}$ (or $\text{cm}$) | Center zone thermocouple array mapping under steady-state PID lock |
| **Carrier Gas Laminar Flow Range** | $1 \text{ to } 5$ | $\text{SLPM}$ | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) flow telemetry ($\text{N}_2 / \text{O}_2$) |
| **Wafer Boat Insertion / Withdrawal Speed** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Automated mechanical boat-loader drive encoder telemetry |

  - Temperature uniformity requirement of $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region between $800^\circ\text{C}$ and $1150^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Carrier gas flow regulated by MFC at $1 \text{ to } 5\text{ SLPM}$.
  - Boat travel speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid thermal shock and crystallographic slip.

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Details
- **Title**: Multi-Zone Thermal Profile Dynamic Decoupling & Feedforward Matrix Characterization
- **Generation**: Gen 2 (µm) / 180nm Open-Source DRAM Architecture
- **Process System**: Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly (Load, Center, Source Zones)
- **Action Type**: Make / Commissioning

---

## 1. Process Overview & Architecture

Multi-zone diffusion furnaces equipped with Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ elements experience significant convective end-losses and thermal cross-talk across adjacent heating elements. Dynamic decoupling characterizes the $3 \times 3$ interaction transfer function matrix $[G(s)]$ across Load, Center, and Source zones, permitting implementation of an inverted feedforward matrix $[D(s)] = [G(s)]^{-1}$ to achieve strict isothermal conditions without zone overshoot.

### Workflow Architecture
```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│    1. Baseline Gas     │
│         Purge          │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│     2. Wafer Boat      │
│       Insertion        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      3. Zone Step      │
│      Perturbation      │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  4. Decoupling Matrix  │
│      Calculation       │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   5. Multi-Zone Ramp   │
│      Verification      │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Characterization Procedure

### Step 1: Furnace Gas Flow & Atmosphere Stabilization
1. Verify mass flow controllers (MFC) regulate carrier gas flow (ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ purge, $\text{O}_2$, or forming gas) between **1 to 5 SLPM** in the laminar regime inside the fused quartz tube.
2. Confirm Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples are securely seated in their sealed quartz thermowells at Load, Center, and Source zones.

### Step 2: Wafer Boat Insertion
1. Load dummy/monitor wafer boats into the furnace track.
2. Actuate the mechanical push/pull drive at a speed strictly **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** into the central 300 mm isothermal region to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations from thermal shock.

### Step 3: Baseline Setpoint Thermal Equilibrium
1. Ramp all three zones concurrently to the primary calibration setpoint between **800°C and 1150°C** (e.g., 850°C–900°C dry oxidation baseline for gate oxide growth).
2. Allow furnace temperature readings across all zones to stabilize to steady-state ($dT/dt < 0.1\text{°C/min}$).

### Step 4: Open-Loop / SISO Dynamic Step Perturbation
1. Apply an individual step input of $+10\text{°C}$ to the **Load Zone** heating coil while holding Center and Source power inputs constant. Record transient temperature curves $T_{\text{Load}}(t)$, $T_{\text{Center}}(t)$, and $T_{\text{Source}}(t)$.
2. Return to baseline and repeat the $+10\text{°C}$ step on the **Center Zone**, logging cross-coupling impacts on Load and Source zones.
3. Return to baseline and execute the $+10\text{°C}$ step on the **Source Zone**.
4. Extract the direct gains $K_{ii}$ and coupling gains $K_{ij}$, along with time constants $\tau_{ij}$ and transport delays $\theta_{ij}$, for the system matrix:
   $$G_{ij}(s) = \frac{K_{ij} e^{-\theta_{ij} s}}{\tau_{ij} s + 1}$$

### Step 5: Feedforward Decoupling Matrix Calculation & Upload
1. Compute the steady-state and dynamic decoupling compensator matrix $[D(s)]$:
   $$D(s) = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & -G_{12}/G_{11} & -G_{13}/G_{11} \\ -G_{21}/G_{22} & 1 & -G_{23}/G_{22} \\ -G_{31}/G_{33} & -G_{32}/G_{33} & 1 \end{bmatrix}$$
2. Parameterize the triple-loop digital PID controller registers with the feedforward gain matrix values.

### Step 6: Closed-Loop Ramp & Flat-Zone Profiling
1. Execute a synchronized multi-zone thermal ramp across the target processing range (**800°C to 1150°C**).
2. Verify with multi-junction profile profiling thermocouples across the central 300 mm boat region that thermal decoupling mitigates boundary temperature sag.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

```text
                         ┌─────────────────────────────┐
                         │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░            │
         Capacitor Budget┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░            │
                         │▒▒▒▒                         │
             Gas Flow MFC┤▒▒▒▒                         │
        Boat Travel Speed┤▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
                         │▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓│
Zone Uniformity (Delta T)┤█                            │
                         │█                            │
                         └┬──────┬──────┬──────┬──────┬┘
                         0.0   12.5   25.0   37.5  50.0 
```

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Evaluation Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\pm 0.5$** | **°C** | Multi-point thermocouple profile across the central 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C |
| **Wafer Boat Mechanical Travel Speed** | **$< 50$** | **mm/min** | Optical encoder readout during furnace insertion and withdrawal cycles |
| **Carrier Gas Flow Rate (Laminar Purge)** | **1 to 5** | **SLPM** | In-line Mass Flow Controller (MFC) calibrated for $\text{N}_2$ / $\text{O}_2$ |
| **Subsequent DRAM Gate Oxide Thermal Target** | **850 to 900** | **°C** | Furnace steady-state oxidation temperature for ~3.5 nm physical thickness $\text{SiO}_2$ |

---

## 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **[Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation]**:
  - Validated Kanthal-A1/Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ three-zone partitioning (Load, Center, Source).
  - Encased Type R / Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples in quartz thermowells.
  - Temperature uniformity requirement of **$\pm 0.5\text{°C}$** across the **central 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C**.
  - MFC carrier gas laminar flow dynamic range of **1 to 5 SLPM** ($\text{N}_2$ purge, ultra-pure $\text{O}_2$, or forming gas).
  - Boat mechanical ramp rate restriction of **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]**:
  - Gate dielectric dry thermal oxidation window of **850°C–900°C** for 3.5 nm physical gate $\text{SiO}_2$.
- **[180nm DRAM Cell Layout Topology: Stacked Capacitor vs Deep Trench]**:
  - Integration downstream boundary requirements for 180nm 1T1C stacked cells (transistor channel $L = 180\text{ nm}$, $W = 220\text{ nm}$, minimum $28\text{ fF/cell}$ budget).

nodes.sop_content:
# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## **Isothermal Flat-Zone Ramp-Rate & Thermal Shock Boundary Recipe Calibration**
**Node / Level:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (Gen 2 µm)  
**Assembly Unit:** Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly  
**Module:** Decoupled 3-Zone PID Feedforward Loop Tuning & Ramp-Rate Calibration  
**Action Type:** Buy / Commissioning  

---

### **1. Scope & Objective**
Calibrate ramp-rate profiles and thermal shock boundaries within a fused quartz process tube heated by 3-zone Kanthal elements (Load, Center, Source). The objective is to achieve an isothermal flat zone across the wafer boat while preventing crystallographic slip dislocations during boat transfer and temperature transitions.

---

### **2. Step-by-Step Procedure**

#### **Step 1: Atmosphere Stabilization & Gas Purge**
1. Ensure the fused quartz process tube is sealed and connected to Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs).
2. Establish a continuous laminar carrier gas flow of high-purity $\text{N}_2$ purge gas regulated between **$1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$**.
3. Verify that laminar flow is stable to prevent convective thermal turbulence across zones.

#### **Step 2: Triple-Loop PID Baseline Configuration & Profile Setpoint**
1. Configure the triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling across all three heating zones:
   - **Load Zone** (inlet / door end to counteract end-loss)
   - **Center Zone** (process flat zone)
   - **Source Zone** (exhaust end to counteract end-loss)
2. Verify feedback signals from Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples (**Type R or Type S**) encased in protective quartz thermowells.
3. Set the target calibration thermal plateau within the operating range of **$800^\circ\text{C to }1150^\circ\text{C}$**.

#### **Step 3: Thermal Shock Boundary & Mechanical Transfer Calibration**
1. Program the automated wafer boat push/pull transfer mechanism.
2. Calibrate and constrain the wafer boat mechanical push/pull insertion and withdrawal speed to strictly **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** across the thermal gradient to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
3. Test mechanical boat transfer across the load zone threshold at baseline operating temperature.

#### **Step 4: Isothermal Flat-Zone Decoupled Tuning & Profile Verification**
1. Ramp the furnace through the decoupled PID feedforward loop to the test plateau ($800^\circ\text{C} - 1150^\circ\text{C}$).
2. Allow temperatures to equilibrate across the three zones.
3. Record temperature across the central **$300\text{ mm}$ ($30\text{ cm}$)** wafer boat region using multi-point profiling thermocouples.
4. Fine-tune Load and Source zone feedforward offsets until temperature variation across the central flat zone stays strictly within target limits.

---

### **3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria**

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Unit | Measurement Method / Tool |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wafer Boat Insertion / Withdrawal Velocity** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/min}$ | Automated boat puller optical encoder / motion controller |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | $\pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-point Type R/S Pt-Rh profiling thermocouples |
| **Isothermal Flat-Zone Length** | $\ge 300$ (or $30$) | $\text{mm}$ (or $\text{cm}$) | Profiling thermocouple array across central wafer boat zone |

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Info
- **Title**: 9-Point Profiling Thermocouple Array Metrology & $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ Steady-State Validation
- **Tracking ID**: `SOP-FAB-DIFF-018`
- **Node**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM (DRAM Foundation VN) — Gen 2 ($\mu\text{m}$)
- **Process Classification**: Thermal Processing / Diffusion & Oxidation Metrology
- **Equipment**: Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace (Load, Center, Source Zones)

---

## 1. Process Flow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│      Pre-Check &       │
│       Alignment        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Array Insertion < 50  │
│         mm/min         │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Laminar Purge 1-5    │
│          SLPM          │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│    PID Ramp & 9-Pt     │
│      Thermal Soak      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Isothermal       │
│   Validation ±0.5°C    │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

### Step 1: Tool Pre-Flight Inspection & Sensor Rigging
1. Verify integrity of the 9-point Platinum-Rhodium (Type R or Type S) profiling thermocouple array encased in quartz thermowells.
2. Confirm the 9 measuring junctions span symmetrically along the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region across Load, Center, and Source zones.
3. Inspect Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal molybdenum disilicide ($\text{MoSi}_2$) heating coil circuits and verify triple-loop digital PID controller communication.

### Step 2: Mechanical Insertion Under Thermal Shock Mitigation
1. Mount the quartz profiling tree onto the automated cantilever paddle/push-rod assembly.
2. Set cantilever mechanical traverse velocity to $< 50\text{ mm/min}$ to prevent thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.
3. Insert the 9-point array into the fused quartz furnace tube until the target central measuring junction aligns with the furnace isothermal centerline.

### Step 3: Atmosphere Conditioning & Gas Dynamic Stabilization
1. Seal tube flange assembly and initialize mass flow controller (MFC) delivery.
2. Establish laminar carrier gas flow ($\text{N}_2$ purge, ultra-pure $\text{O}_2$, or forming gas) between $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
3. Verify backpressure stability and maintain laminar flow dynamics across the tube diameter.

### Step 4: Multi-Zone Ramp & Decoupled PID Thermal Soak
1. Execute feedforward decoupled multi-zone ramp profile to the target calibration setpoint:
   - Dry gate oxide calibration baseline: $850^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }900^\circ\text{C}$ (or high-temperature diffusion plateau up to $1150^\circ\text{C}$).
2. Engage decoupled 3-zone feedforward control to compensate for convective end-losses at Load and Source zones relative to the Center zone.
3. Allow the system to settle into steady-state soak for a minimum of 30 minutes once process setpoint is reached.

### Step 5: 9-Point Metrology Logging & Uniformity Calculation
1. Continuously log real-time temperature data across all 9 channels at $1\text{ Hz}$ for 15 minutes.
2. Compute thermal delta across all 9 profiling points within the active $300\text{ mm}$ flat zone:
   $$\Delta T = T_{\max} - T_{\min}$$
3. Confirm $\Delta T \le 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ (i.e., within $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ from nominal setpoint).
4. Retract the thermocouple array at $< 50\text{ mm/min}$ upon validation completion.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Inspection Target / Tolerance | Unit | Verification Tool / Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\le \pm 0.5$** across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat zone ($800^\circ\text{C} - 1150^\circ\text{C}$) | $^\circ\text{C}$ | 9-Point Type R/S Quartz-Encased Thermocouple Array |
| **Carrier Gas Flow Rate** | **$1.0\text{ to }5.0$** (regulated laminar flow) | $\text{SLPM}$ | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) |
| **Cantilever Insertion/Ramp Speed** | **$< 50.0$** | $\text{mm/min}$ | Programmable Boat Loader Controller |
| **Operating Thermal Window** | **$800.0\text{ to }1150.0$** (gate oxide baseline $850.0\text{ to }900.0$) | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Decoupled Triple-Loop Digital PID Controller |

---

## 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**: Multi-zone heating (Load, Center, Source zones) using Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ coils; Platinum-Rhodium (Type R / Type S) thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells; $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ uniformity across central $300\text{ mm}$ boat region between $800^\circ\text{C}$ and $1150^\circ\text{C}$; laminar carrier gas flow ($\text{N}_2$, ultra-pure $\text{O}_2$, forming gas) via MFC at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$; mechanical boat travel speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**: Gate dielectric dry oxidation temperature setpoint at $850^\circ\text{C} - 900^\circ\text{C}$ with physical thickness target $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Multi-Point Isothermal Flat-Zone Profiling & ±0.5°C Uniformity Thermal Metrology

**Document ID:** `SOP-DIFF-MET-001`  
**Process Step:** Context: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly > 3-Zone Kanthal Heating Element & Decoupled PID Controller Commissioning > Multi-Point Isothermal Flat-Zone Profiling & ±0.5°C Uniformity Thermal Metrology  
**Equipment Architecture:** 3-Zone Resistive Horizontal Furnace (Source / Center / Load) with 150–200 mm OD High-Purity Fused Quartz Process Tube (99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$).

---

### Thermal Profiling Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Phase 1: Multi-Point Thermocouple Rig Insertion       │
│  (Type-R / Type-S Quartz Thermowell Assembly)          │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Phase 2: Inert Purge & Dynamic Gas Sweep Regulation   │
│  (2.0 to 5.0 SLPM Laminar N2 Sweep via Calibrated MFC) │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Phase 3: Thermal Equilibration & PID Decoupling Run   │
│  (Ramp to 800°C - 1200°C Setpoints; End-Loss Tuning)   │
│                                                        │
└───────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────┘
                            │
                            │
                            ▼
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  Phase 4: Multi-Point Axial Flat-Zone Data Logging     │
│  (Validate Isothermal Stability <= +/- 0.5°C)          │
│                                                        │
└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

---

### Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

#### 1. Pre-Run Inspection & Metrology Rig Installation
1. Verify process tube integrity: Inspect the horizontal fused quartz process tube (150 mm to 200 mm outer diameter, 99.999% purity $\text{SiO}_2$) for devitrification or micro-cracks.
2. Insert the profiled multi-junction thermocouple rake: Introduce calibrated dual Type-R / Type-S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples encased in high-purity quartz thermowells along the furnace axis covering the Source, Center, and Load zones.
3. Position the measurement sensors such that they span the entire central 300 mm to 350 mm wafer processing region.
4. Mount the rig onto the cantilever loader and transfer it into the tube at a controlled insertion rate of $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid thermal shock and mechanical damage.

#### 2. Gas Delivery & Laminar Flow Stabilization
1. Connect and initialize mass flow controllers (MFC) calibrated for high-purity process and inert sweep gases (ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ or $\text{Ar}$, $99.999\%$ purity).
2. Set the laminar carrier gas sweep rate between **$2.0\text{ SLPM}$ and $5.0\text{ SLPM}$** (1.0 to 5.0 SLPM allowable operating window).
3. Verify that the continuous positive-pressure sweep prevents ambient air back-diffusion through the load zone/door opening prior to ramp.

#### 3. Closed-Loop Thermal Ramp & Decoupled PID Tuning
1. Configure the triple-loop digital PID temperature controller with feedforward zone decoupling active across:
   - **Source Zone** (gas inlet end)
   - **Center Zone** (wafer boat process flat zone)
   - **Load Zone** (furnace door end)
2. Initiate thermal ramp to target profiling setpoints across the thermal processing range ($800^\circ\text{C}$ to $1200^\circ\text{C}$, e.g., baseline test at $1000^\circ\text{C}$ to $1150^\circ\text{C}$).
3. Adjust power offsets and feedforward gain on the Source and Load zones to counteract convective and radiative end losses.
4. Allow the furnace to soak for a minimum of 45 minutes until all internal dual Type-R/S control thermocouples reach steady state.

#### 4. Multi-Point Isothermal Metrology & Gradient Mapping
1. Log temperature channels continuously across the axial flat zone at a sample rate $\ge 1\text{ Hz}$.
2. Measure steady-state deviation across the entire central **$300\text{ mm}$ to $350\text{ mm}$** flat zone length.
3. Calculate maximum peak-to-peak gradient:
   $$\Delta T_{\text{max}} = T_{\text{max}} - T_{\text{min}}$$
4. Verify that the spatial variation remains strictly within the $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ process window.
5. Withdraw the profiling rig at $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ upon completion of thermal data capture.

---

### Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Specification | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | $\le \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-point Type-R/S thermocouple axial profiling across $300\text{ mm}$ to $350\text{ mm}$ center zone |
| **Isothermal Flat-Zone Length** | $\ge 300\text{ to } 350$ (or $30\text{ to } 35$) | $\text{mm}$ (or $\text{cm}$) | Profiling array position indexing over target wafer boat span |
| **Carrier Gas Sweep Flow Rate** | $2.0 \text{ to } 5.0$ (operating range $1.0 \text{ to } 5.0$) | $\text{SLPM}$ | Calibrated digital Mass Flow Controller (MFC) logging |
| **Wafer Boat / Rig Insertion & Withdrawal Speed** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Cantilever boat loader encoder velocity |
| **Process Tube SiO₂ Purity** | $\ge 99.999$ | $\%$ | Certificate of Analysis (CoA) spectroscopy |

---

### Literature Context Citations

1. **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery**
   - Fused quartz process tube: $150\text{ mm}$ to $200\text{ mm}$ OD, $99.999\%$ purity $\text{SiO}_2$.
   - Zone division: Source zone (gas inlet), Center zone (wafer process flat zone), and Load zone (door end).
   - Sensor standard: Dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples per zone connected to a digital PID controller.
   - Uniformity specification: Central $350\text{ mm}$ flat zone maintaining $\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ at $1000^\circ\text{C}$ to $1200^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Gas sweep: Mass flow controller (MFC) delivery at $2.0\text{ to } 5.0\text{ SLPM}$ laminar sweep velocity.
2. **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**
   - Multi-zone heating with Kanthal-A1 or MoSi$_2$ coils.
   - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling.
   - Uniformity: $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region between $800^\circ\text{C}$ and $1150^\circ\text{C}$.
   - Mechanical handling limit: Wafer boat ramp in/out speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid crystallographic slip dislocations.
   - Carrier gas regulation: $1\text{ to } 5\text{ SLPM}$ via MFC.
3. **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**
   - High-purity fused silica tube with 3-zone PID controller maintaining $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ over a $30\text{ cm}$ flat zone.

## Isothermal Flat-Zone Multi-Point Profiling & Triple-Loop Decoupled PID Feedforward Tuning

### 1. Process Flow Overview

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│   Thermocouple Array   │
│       Insertion        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

│      Temperature       │
│       Profiling        │

             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Uniformity Metrology  │
│     & Verification     │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **Safety & Tool Pre-Check**:
   - Inspect the fused quartz process tube and Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal heating coil assemblies across the three zones (**Load**, **Center**, **Source**).
   - Verify that Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples (**Type R** or **Type S**) are installed inside high-purity quartz thermowells positioned within each heating zone.

2. **Carrier Gas Flow Stabilization**:
   - Initiate continuous laminar purge flow using calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) supplying carrier gas ($N_2$ purge, ultra-pure $O_2$, or forming gas) set within **1 to 5 SLPM** to establish dynamic convective equilibrium within the quartz tube.

3. **Multi-Point Profiling Thermocouple Fixture Insertion**:
   - Mount a calibrated multi-point profile thermocouple tree across the designated **300 mm (30 cm)** central wafer boat zone.
   - Insert the wafer boat / profiling fixture at a controlled mechanical translation rate of **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and avoid crystallographic slip dislocations.

4. **Triple-Loop Decoupled PID & Dynamic Feedforward Tuning**:
   - Set base operating setpoints across the thermal processing range (**800°C to 1150°C**).
   - Configure dynamic cross-coupling gain matrices between Load, Center, and Source loops to compensate for inter-zone thermal conduction.
   - Activate convective end-loss feedforward compensation on the Load and Source loops calibrated against MFC gas flow transitions (1 to 5 SLPM) and furnace ambient gradients.

5. **Isothermal Flat-Zone Profiling & Final Metrology**:
   - Allow thermal soak until steady state is reached across all three zones.
   - Acquire multi-point profile measurements across the entire 300 mm wafer boat span at 25 mm intervals.
   - Ensure the delta between maximum and minimum recorded temperatures satisfies the required flat-zone thermal budget.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\le \pm 0.5$** | **°C** | Multi-point profiling across 300 mm central zone (800°C to 1150°C) |
| **Isothermal Flat-Zone Span** | **$\ge 300$ (30)** | **mm (cm)** | Linear travel metrology across central wafer boat region |
| **Boat Mechanical Insertion/Ramp Speed** | **$< 50$** | **mm/min** | Automated furnace paddle push/pull drive tachometer |
| **Carrier Gas Purge Flow Rate** | **$1\text{ to }5$** | **SLPM** | In-line calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) logging |

---

### 4. Literature & Context Citations

- **[Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation]**:
  - Multi-zone heating architecture with Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal ($MoSi_2$) coils divided into Load, Center, and Source zones.
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling; Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells.
  - Temperature uniformity requirement of **$\pm 0.5\text{°C}$** across the central **300 mm** wafer boat region between **800°C and 1150°C**.
  - Laminar flow of carrier gases ($N_2$, $O_2$, forming gas) via MFC at **1 to 5 SLPM**.
  - Mechanical boat ramp in/out speed **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **[Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace]**:
  - High-purity quartz process tube (fused silica) with 3-zone PID controller maintaining **$\pm 0.5\text{°C}$** over a **30 cm** flat zone.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document ID: `SOP-DIFF-MET-004`
**Title:** Dynamic Gas-Flow & Wafer Boat Translation Steady-State ±0.5°C Uniformity Metrology Verification  
**Hierarchy Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly > 3-Zone Kanthal Heating Element & Decoupled PID Controller Commissioning > Multi-Point Isothermal Flat-Zone Profiling & ±0.5°C Uniformity Thermal Metrology > Dynamic Gas-Flow & Wafer Boat Translation Steady-State ±0.5°C Uniformity Metrology Verification  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm / 180nm) | **Action Type:** Buy / Commissioning & Metrology Verification  

---

### 1. Purpose & Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure defines the metrology protocol to verify steady-state temperature uniformity across the process flat zone of a 3-zone quartz tube furnace during dynamic carrier gas injection and mechanical wafer boat push/pull translation, preventing crystallographic slip dislocations and ensuring isothermal stability prior to 180nm gate and field oxidation.

---

### 2. Required Equipment & Tooling
* **Furnace Tube:** High-purity fused silica (quartz) process tube with 3 heating zones: Load, Center, and Source (Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal MoSi₂ elements).
* **Thermal Sensors:** Multi-point Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium profiling thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells positioned across the 300 mm (30 cm) wafer boat region.
* **Control Unit:** Triple-loop digital PID controller equipped with feedforward cross-zone decoupling.
* **Gas Flow Delivery:** Calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) supplying dry carrier gases (ultra-pure $N_2$ purge, $O_2$, or forming gas).
* **Cantilever / Translation System:** Motorized lead-screw or linear drive boat-loader with precise velocity feedback.

---

### 3. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Step 1: Baseline Stabilization] -> [Step 2: Dynamic Gas Introduction]            |
|                                                     |                             |
|                                                     v                             |
| [Step 4: Thermal Steady-State Verification] <- [Step 3: Wafer Boat Translation]   |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

#### Step 1: Baseline Isothermal Flat-Zone Stabilization
1. Evacuate or purge the quartz tube with high-purity $N_2$ at baseline flow.
2. Power on the decoupled triple-loop PID controller and ramp heating elements (Load, Center, Source) to the target baseline setpoint between **800°C and 1150°C**.
3. Allow the central 300 mm (30 cm) flat zone to settle until all profile thermocouples indicate thermal equilibrium.

#### Step 2: Dynamic Carrier Gas Injection
1. Actuate the Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs) to inject process carrier gases (laminar flow $N_2$ purge, ultra-pure $O_2$, or forming gas).
2. Establish gas flow dynamically stepped within **1 to 5 SLPM**.
3. Monitor the feedforward PID compensation on the Source and Load zones as convective cooling initiates from incoming gas flow.

#### Step 3: Wafer Boat Push/Pull Translation Verification
1. Load the multi-junction profiling thermocouple instrumented wafer boat onto the quartz cantilever paddle.
2. Initialize automated push translation into the 3-zone furnace at a controlled mechanical translation rate strictly **< 50 mm/minute** to suppress thermal shock and avoid crystallographic slip dislocations.
3. Advance the boat until centered within the calibrated 300 mm isothermal flat zone.

#### Step 4: Steady-State Dynamic Metrology Data Acquisition
1. Maintain process gas flow at setpoint between **1 and 5 SLPM**.
2. Log multi-point temperature profiles continuously at 1 Hz across the Load, Center, and Source profile thermocouples.
3. Confirm that transient thermal depressions recover and that the steady-state thermal gradient across the entire 300 mm boat span stabilizes within tolerance.
4. Execute retract/pull translation at **< 50 mm/minute** to verify symmetry and thermal stability during post-process extraction.

---

### 4. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Flat-Zone Temperature Uniformity** | **$\le \pm 0.5$** | **°C** | Multi-point Type R/S thermocouple logging across the 300 mm (30 cm) boat span |
| **Operating Temperature Range** | **800 to 1150** | **°C** | Digital PID zone process value (PV) acquisition |
| **Carrier Gas Laminar Flow Rate** | **1 to 5** | **SLPM** | Calibrated digital Mass Flow Controller (MFC) readback |
| **Wafer Boat Translation Velocity** | **$< 50$** | **mm/minute** | Linear encoder / drive motor tachometer feedback |
| **Uniform Isothermal Flat-Zone Length** | **$\ge 300$ (30)** | **mm (cm)** | Multi-junction profiling probe array mapping |

---

### 5. Context Literature Citations
* **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation:**
  - Multi-zone heating elements: Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ divided into Load, Center, and Source zones.
  - Temperature uniformity requirement: $\pm 0.5\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$ across the central 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C.
  - Gas flow dynamics: Laminar flow of carrier gases ($N_2$ purge, ultra-pure $O_2$, or forming gas) regulated by MFCs at 1 to 5 SLPM.
  - Mechanical translation speed: $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.
* **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace:**
  - Equipment requirement: High-purity quartz process tube (fused silica) with a 3-zone PID temperature controller maintaining $\pm 0.5\text{ }^\circ\text{C}$ over a 30 cm flat zone.

### 2. Concise Step-by-Step Procedure

1. **System Inerting & Pre-Flow Stabilization**:
   - Establish laminar sweep gas flow through the fused quartz tube (outer diameter 150 mm to 200 mm, purity 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$).
   - Regulate ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ carrier purge gas via calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) to a flow rate between **2.0 SLPM and 5.0 SLPM** to suppress ambient air back-diffusion through the load door.

2. **Furnace Thermal Ramp**:
   - Engage the triple-loop digital PID controller regulating the 3-zone resistive heating element (Kanthal A1 / APM / $\text{MoSi}_2$).
   - Ramp the Source, Center, and Load zones to the baseline calibration target operating window (**1000°C to 1200°C**; secondary validation between **800°C and 1150°C**). Allow soaking for 45 minutes to reach thermal equilibrium.

3. **Profiling Tool Insertion**:
   - Mount a multi-junction profiling thermocouple assembly (encased in a high-purity quartz thermowell, Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium / $\text{Pt}\text{-}\text{Pt/Rh}$) onto the cantilever drive.
   - Insert the profiling lance dynamically into the process tube at a mechanical drive speed of **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and mechanical vibration.

4. **Dynamic Flat Zone Thermal Profiling**:
   - Traverse the profiling thermocouple incrementally across the central **300 mm to 350 mm** furnace segment (wafer boat region).
   - Log localized steady-state temperatures and cross-check against internal control thermocouples (dual Type-R/S per zone).

5. **Triple-Loop PID Trim & Offset Calibration**:
   - Adjust feedforward decoupling and digital PID temperature offset values on Source and Load zones to compensate for convective and radiative end-losses.
   - Re-profile until center flat zone dynamic thermal gradients conform to tolerance limits.

### 4. Verified Literature Citations

- **Source 1: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery**
  - Fused quartz process tube: OD 150 mm to 200 mm, purity 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$.
  - 3-zone resistive heating element (Kanthal A1 / APM alloy coils) with dual Type-R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples per zone and digital PID controller.
  - Middle 350 mm flat zone temperature uniformity $\le \pm 0.5\text{°C}$ at 1000°C to 1200°C.
  - MFC gas delivery rate: 2.0 to 5.0 SLPM laminar gas sweep velocity.
- **Source 2: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling to mitigate convective end-losses.
  - Type R / Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells.
  - Uniformity of $\pm 0.5\text{°C}$ across central 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C.
  - Mechanical boat/probe speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.

  - 3-zone PID temperature controller maintaining $\pm 0.5\text{°C}$ across a 30 cm flat zone.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Document Identification
- **Title**: Type-S Multi-Point Profile Thermocouple Array & Spike Calibration Jig Procurement and Metrology Setup
- **Scope**: 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly > Isothermal Flat Zone Dynamic Profiling & Thermocouple Metrology Calibration
- **Action Type**: Make / Procurement & Metrological Calibration
- **Target Technology Generation**: Gen 2 (180nm Class)

---

### Process Workflow Diagram

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│     Procure Type-S     │
│   Profile TC Array &   │
│       Spike Jig        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Inspect High-Purity   │
│     Quartz Sheath      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│  Spike TC Alignment &  │
│      Jig Assembly      │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│      PID Dynamic       │
│       Isothermal       │
│      Calibration       │
│       800-1150°C       │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│       Acceptance       │
│   Validation ±0.5°C    │
│       Flat Zone        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

## 1. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Procurement & Incoming Metrological Inspection
1. Procure certified Platinum-Rhodium (Pt-10%Rh / Pt, Type-S) multi-junction profiling thermocouple arrays equipped with dedicated quartz thermowell sheaths to eliminate metallic contamination.
2. Procure the mechanical Spike Calibration Jig designed for the 3-zone furnace geometry (Load, Center, Source zones).
3. Visually and dimensionally inspect the quartz thermowell sheath under cleanroom conditions (Class 100/ISO 5) to ensure zero micro-cracks, surface devitrification, or dimensional distortion.

### Step 2: Mechanical Assembly & Spike TC Positioning
1. Insert the Spike Thermocouple calibration jig into the quartz furnace tube.
2. Align the multi-point profile thermocouple probe along the axial centerline spanning across the 300 mm wafer boat region.
3. Secure the reference spike thermocouples into their fixed outer-tube thermowells adjacent to the Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal MoSi2 heating elements in Load, Center, and Source heating zones.
4. Establish reference wire connections to the triple-loop digital PID controller with cold-junction compensation.

### Step 3: Atmosphere Stabilization & Mechanical Transfer Profiling
1. Seal the quartz tube and initiate laminar purge flow of ultra-pure N2 or carrier gases via calibrated mass flow controllers (MFC) at **1 to 5 SLPM**.
2. Mount the profile thermocouple test assembly to the cantilever push-pull loading mechanism.
3. Verify that boat travel insertion and extraction speeds do not exceed **50 mm/minute** to prevent thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.

### Step 4: Multi-Zone Dynamic Temperature Profiling & Loop Tuning
1. Ramp the triple-loop digital PID furnace through the gate oxidation and high-temperature thermal budget range: **800°C to 1150°C** (specifically encompassing the 850°C–900°C dry oxidation window).
2. Measure simultaneous temperature readings across all profile TC nodes across Load, Center, and Source zones.
3. Tune feedforward decoupling and digital PID coefficients until thermal drift between spike thermocouples and profile thermocouples is nullified and steady-state equilibrium is achieved across the 300 mm flat zone.

---

## 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Tolerance | Physical Unit | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isothermal Flat Zone Uniformity** | **±0.5** | **°C** | Continuous multi-point Type-S TC profile across central 300 mm wafer boat span at 800°C–1150°C |
| **Wafer Boat Transfer Speed** | **< 50** | **mm/min** | Automated lead-screw / linear encoder velocity logging during insertion/retraction |
| **Carrier Gas Purge Flow Rate** | **1 to 5** | **SLPM** | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) digital telemetry |
| **Operational Calibration Range** | **800 to 1150** | **°C** | Multi-zone triple-loop PID logging across high-temperature regime |

---

## 3. Literature Sources & Citations
- **Source: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**
  - *Thermocouple & Sheath Specification*: Type-S / Type-R Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells.
  - *Temperature Uniformity Target*: $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across central 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C.
  - *Gas Dynamics*: Laminar carrier gas flow regulated by MFC at 1 to 5 SLPM.
  - *Thermal Shock Prevention*: Wafer boat push/pull speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$.
- **Source: Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering**
  - *Thermal Oxidation Baseline*: 850°C–900°C dry oxidation thermal budget for critical $\sim 3.5\text{ nm}$ gate dielectric growth requiring precise isothermal regulation.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

**Document ID:** `SOP-DIFF-180NM-3Z-PID-001`  
**Title:** 3-Zone Thermal PID Decoupling Loop Tuning & Dynamic Ramp In-Situ Profiling  
**Level:** Gen 1 (mm) | Action Type: Make  
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly > Isothermal Flat Zone Dynamic Profiling & Thermocouple Metrology Calibration

---

### Process Architecture Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  Stabilize Gas Purge   │
│    2.0-5.0 SLPM N2     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │

             │
             │
             ▼

             │
             │

             ▼

│                        │
│       Acceptance       │
│    Verification <=     │
│      +/-0.5 degC       │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Purge & Ambient Back-Diffusion Prevention Setup**
   - Confirm quartz process tube (outer diameter 150 mm to 200 mm, 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$ purity) is sealed.
   - Using Mass Flow Controllers (MFC), establish a continuous laminar gas sweep of ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ at **2.0 to 5.0 SLPM** to prevent ambient atmospheric back-diffusion through the tube exhaust/door end.
   - Verify dual Type-R / Type-S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples in each zone (Source, Center, Load) are securely encased inside quartz thermowells and reporting valid baseline ambient readings.

2. **Decoupling Feedforward Matrix Configuration**
   - Initialize the triple-loop digital PID temperature controller.
   - Configure dynamic cross-zone feedforward decoupling compensation coefficients between the Load zone (door end convective heat sink), Center flat zone, and Source zone (gas inlet cooling boundary) to eliminate thermal crosstalk caused by longitudinal radiative and conductive transfer along the tube.

3. **Step-Response Loop Tuning (Dynamic Ramp & Soak)**
   - Maintain wafer boat load/unload transfer mechanism at a controlled linear velocity of **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock risks and mechanical crystallographic slip dislocations.
   - Execute controlled step ramps between **800°C and 1150°C** (up to 1200°C for high-temperature oxidation/diffusion).
   - Tune proportional ($P$), integral ($I$), and derivative ($D$) parameters on the individual Kanthal A1 / APM / MoSi2 coil drivers to achieve critical damping without overshooting $\pm 1.0\text{°C}$ during thermal transitions.

4. **In-Situ Multi-Point Flat Zone Profiling**
   - Traverse calibrated in-situ profiling thermocouples across the longitudinal axis of the process tube at steady-state soak temperatures (800°C, 1000°C, 1150°C, and 1200°C).
   - Log continuous temperature variations across the central **300 mm to 350 mm** wafer boat process region.
   - Adjust zone temperature offsets on Source and Load trim controllers until thermal end-loss droop is fully compensated.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria Target Metrics

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value | Physical Units | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Center Flat Zone Temperature Uniformity** | $\le \pm 0.5$ | $\text{°C}$ | Multi-point in-situ Type-R/S profiling across central 300 mm to 350 mm boat region at 800°C to 1200°C soak |
| **Wafer Boat Insertion / Withdrawal Velocity** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Automated quartz puller position encoder telemetry |
| **Gas Sweep Flow Rate (Laminar Sweep)** | $2.0 \text{ to } 5.0$ | $\text{SLPM}$ | Digital Mass Flow Controller (MFC) calibrated output flow |
| **Quartz Tube Structural Purity** | $\ge 99.999$ | $\%$ $\text{SiO}_2$ | Certified quartz manufacturer assay metrology |

---

### 3. Source Context Citations

- **[Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery]**: Quartz tube OD 150 mm to 200 mm, purity 99.999% $\text{SiO}_2$; 3-zone Kanthal A1/APM coils; dual Type-R/S thermocouples; center 350 mm flat zone uniformity $\le \pm 0.5\text{°C}$ at 1000°C to 1200°C; MFC gas flow 2.0 to 5.0 SLPM laminar sweep.
- **[Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation]**: Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling; Type R/S thermocouples in quartz thermowells; $\pm 0.5\text{°C}$ uniformity across central 300 mm wafer boat region between 800°C and 1150°C; wafer boat speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **[Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace]**: Fused silica quartz tube, 3-zone PID temperature controller maintaining $\pm 0.5\text{°C}$ over 30 cm flat zone.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)

## Title: Multi-Zone Quartz Thermocouple Rake Instrument & Rig Calibration
**Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly > Isothermal Flat Zone Dynamic Profiling & Thermocouple Metrology Calibration  
**Generation:** Gen 2 (µm)  
**Action Type:** Make  
**Equipment:** Multi-junction quartz thermocouple rake rig (Type R/S Platinum-Rhodium in fused silica thermowells), 3-Zone Furnace (Load, Center, Source).

---

### 1. Objective & Scope
Calibrate, inspect, and mechanically align the multi-zone quartz thermocouple rake instrument to ensure accurate dynamic profiling and thermal uniformity verification across the 3-zone furnace flat zone for 180nm DRAM thermal processing (such as thick field oxide isolation LOCOS/STI trench fill).

---

### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Inspection & Decontamination of Quartz Rake Rig**
   - Visually inspect the fused quartz profiling rake body and sheath assemblies for micro-fractures, devitrification, or particulate contamination.
   - Verify junction integrity for all Type R / Type S Platinum-Rhodium (Pt-Rh) thermocouple channels across Load, Center, and Source sensor nodes.
   - Clean the quartz rake with high-purity isopropyl alcohol (IPA) and ultra-pure DI water rinse; dry under filtered N2.

2. **Cold Reference & Data Acquisition Interface Calibration**
   - Connect the Pt-Rh lead wires to the precision multi-channel temperature metrology scanner / data acquisition (DAQ) interface.
   - Perform ice-point (0.0°C) or precision electronic cold-junction compensation calibration for all rake channels.
   - Verify continuous loop resistance and millivolt-to-temperature conversion tables for each zone channel.

3. **Furnace Environment Preparation**
   - Verify the fused quartz process tube is sealed and purged under laminar carrier gas flow ($N_2$ purge regulated via Mass Flow Controller at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$).
   - Set the furnace digital PID triple-loop temperature controller across Load, Center, and Source zones to a stable thermal holding plateau between $800^\circ\text{C}\text{ and }1150^\circ\text{C}$.

4. **Rake Rig Insertion & Positional Alignment**
   - Mount the quartz thermocouple rake onto the automated cantilever paddle / push-pull mechanism.
   - Insert the rake into the quartz tube at a controlled mechanical transfer speed strictly $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent thermal shock and structural stress.
   - Align sensor nodes to span the central $300\text{ mm}$ ($30\text{ cm}$) wafer boat flat-zone region across the Load, Center, and Source zones.

5. **In-Situ Multi-Zone Calibration & Dynamic Flat-Zone Profiling**
   - Allow thermal stabilization at setpoint ($800^\circ\text{C} - 1150^\circ\text{C}$) for $\ge 30\text{ minutes}$.
   - Log multi-point spatial temperature distributions across the entire $300\text{ mm}$ flat zone.
   - Calculate cross-zone temperature offsets between rake probe readings and internal furnace quartz thermowell thermocouples.
   - Tune the feedforward decoupling and PID trim values on the furnace temperature controller until flat-zone variance meets specification.

6. **Post-Profiling Retraction**
   - Retract the quartz thermocouple rake assembly at a mechanical translation speed $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$.
   - Cool down under continuous laminar $N_2$ flow ($1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$) in the staging load station.

---

### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Target Value & Exact Physical Units | Context / Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isothermal Flat-Zone Uniformity** | $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ | Across the central $300\text{ mm}$ ($30\text{ cm}$) wafer boat flat zone between $800^\circ\text{C}\text{ and }1150^\circ\text{C}$ |
| **Mechanical Rake Insertion / Extraction Velocity** | $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ | Controlled cantilever drive encoder to prevent thermal shock |
| **Carrier Purge Gas Flow Rate** | $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ | Laminar $N_2$ purge regulated via calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) |

---

### 4. Sources & Literature Citations

- **Source: Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling; Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP): Cross-Coupling Thermal Matrix Identification & Decoupled PID Loop Parameter Synthesis

**Document ID:** `SOP-FAB-THM-180-004`  
**Module:** Thermal Processing & Furnace Metrology  
**Technology Node:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM (Gen 2 µm)  
**Process Tube Equipment:** Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone Furnace (Load, Center, Source)

---

## 1. Process Overview & Cross-Coupling Architecture

In multi-zone fused quartz furnaces, conductive and radiative thermal transfer between adjacent zones causes strong cross-zone interactions. Uncoupled independent PID loops result in overshoot and temperature oscillation during ramp-up and stabilization. This procedure identifies the thermal transfer matrix $G(s)$ via step-response testing and synthesizes a static feedforward decoupling compensator $D = G(0)^{-1}$ combined with individual digital PID loops to achieve strict isothermal conditions across the central wafer flat zone.

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A["Initialize Furnace & Establish Laminar Baseline Flow (1 to 5 SLPM N2)"] --> B["Step Response Perturbation Test on Individual Heating Coils"]
    B --> C["Construct 3x3 Static Thermal Gain Matrix G(0)"]
    C --> D["Invert Gain Matrix to Synthesize Decoupling Matrix D = G(0)^-1"]
    D --> E["Synthesize Decoupled Digital PID Gains (Load, Center, Source)"]
    E --> F["Execute Multi-Zone Dynamic Ramp & Isothermal Verification"]
```

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Procedure

### Step 1: Furnace Environmental Baseline Stabilization
1. Verify Type R/S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells are fully calibrated and securely seated in the Load, Center, and Source zone ports.
2. Ensure no mechanical motion occurs during stabilization. Wafer boats must remain parked or undergo load/unload sequences strictly at mechanical speeds $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to avoid thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.
3. Establish a steady laminar purge flow of ultra-pure $\text{N}_2$ carrier gas regulated by Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) between $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
4. Stabilize the furnace at a baseline operating temperature between $800^\circ\text{C}\text{ and }1150^\circ\text{C}$ across all three zones.

### Step 2: Open-Loop Cross-Coupling Step Response Identification
1. Set the controller to manual open-loop power mode with fixed base power $(P_L, P_C, P_S)$.
2. Apply a discrete $+5\%$ power step change to the **Load zone** coil (Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$) while holding Center and Source zone powers strictly constant.
3. Log the transient temperature responses $\Delta T_L(t), \Delta T_C(t), \Delta T_S(t)$ until steady state is reached.
4. Repeat the discrete $+5\%$ power step perturbation sequentially for the **Center zone** and the **Source zone**, logging the respective settling profiles across all three thermocouples.

### Step 3: Gain Matrix Extraction & Decoupling Synthesis
1. Formulate the steady-state thermal gain matrix:
   $$G(0) = \begin{bmatrix} 
   K_{LL} & K_{LC} & K_{LS} \\ 
   K_{CL} & K_{CC} & K_{CS} \\ 
   K_{SL} & K_{SC} & K_{SS} 
   \end{bmatrix}, \quad \text{where } K_{ij} = \frac{\Delta T_i(\infty)}{\Delta P_j}$$
2. Compute the static decoupling matrix:
   $$D = G(0)^{-1}$$
3. Implement the decoupling feedforward compensator into the triple-loop digital PID controller so that virtual control inputs $U^*(s)$ decouple into independent single-input single-output (SISO) control channels:
   $$U(s) = D \cdot U^*(s)$$

### Step 4: Individual Decoupled PID Parameter Synthesis & Verification
1. Tune proportional ($K_p$), integral ($T_i$), and derivative ($T_d$) parameters for each decoupled zone loop.
2. Execute a closed-loop temperature ramp test up to process setpoint ($800^\circ\text{C} - 1150^\circ\text{C}$).
3. Measure temperature distribution using a multi-point profiling thermocouple along the central $300\text{ mm}$ ($30\text{ cm}$) wafer boat flat zone.

---

## 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Parameter / Metric | Acceptance Target Metric | Tolerance / Target Range | Verification Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isothermal Flat Zone Uniformity** | Central $300\text{ mm}$ ($30\text{ cm}$) flat zone temperature | $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ between $800^\circ\text{C}\text{ and }1150^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-point Type R/S quartz profiling thermocouple |
| **Carrier Gas Laminar Flow Rate** | $\text{N}_2$ purge / ultra-pure $\text{O}_2$ flow rate | $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) datalogger |
| **Wafer Boat Translation Speed** | Maximum mechanical push/pull velocity | $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ | Furnace boat loader optical encoder feedback |

```text
                     Furnace Control Parameter Limits   
                  ┌────────────────────────────────────┐
                  │░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
   Boat Push Speed┤░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░│
Gas Flow Stability┤▒▒▒▒▒                               │
                  │▒▒▒▒▒                               │
   Zone Uniformity┤█                                   │
                  │█                                   │
                  └┬────────┬────────┬───────┬────────┬┘
                  0.0     12.5     25.0    37.5    50.0 
```

---

## 4. Context References & Source Citations

- **Source:** *Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation*
  - Heating coil elements (Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$) in Load, Center, and Source configurations.
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling and Type R / Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples in quartz thermowells.
  - Temperature uniformity constraint: $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region between $800^\circ\text{C}\text{ and }1150^\circ\text{C}$.
  - Mass flow carrier gas control at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$.
  - Boat ramp mechanical speed limit: $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **Source:** *Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace*
  - High-purity fused silica quartz process tube with 3-zone PID temperature controller maintaining $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ over $30\text{ cm}$ flat zone.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
## Dynamic Ramp In-Situ Profiling & 300mm Flat Zone Thermal Uniformity Qualification

**Document ID:** `SOP-DIFF-180NM-042`  
**Classification:** Generation 2 (180nm Node) — DRAM Foundation VN Council  
**Assembly:** Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly  

---

### Process Workflow

```text
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│   Furnace Prep & N2    │
│    Purge: 1-5 SLPM     │
│                        │

             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│  3-Zone Dynamic Ramp:  │
│    800°C to 1150°C     │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │
             ▼
┌────────────────────────┐
│                        │
│      Multi-Point       │
│      Thermocouple      │
│       Profiling        │
│                        │
└────────────┬───────────┘
             │
             │

│     Qualification:     │
│  ±0.5°C across 300mm   │
│          Zone          │
│                        │
└────────────────────────┘
```

---

### 1. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure

1. **Pre-Purge & Atmosphere Conditioning:**
   - Verify gas delivery lines and initialize laminar carrier gas flow ($N_2$ purge) using calibrated Mass Flow Controllers (MFC) set between **$1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$**.
   - Confirm quartz tube pressure equilibrium and seal integrity prior to paddle motion.

2. **Instrumented Profiling Boat Loading:**
   - Mount the quartz profiling boat equipped with multi-point Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples protected in quartz thermowells across the Load, Center, and Source zones.
   - Insert the wafer boat mechanically into the furnace tube at a controlled travel velocity **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and suppress crystallographic slip dislocations.

3. **Dynamic Ramp Execution & Feedforward Tuning:**
   - Engage the triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward cross-zone decoupling across the Kanthal-A1 / Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ heating elements.
   - Execute dynamic ramp profiling across the qualification thermal range from **$800^\circ\text{C to }1150^\circ\text{C}$** (covering dry gate oxidation at $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ through high-temperature activation steps).

4. **Isothermal Flat Zone Uniformity Measurement:**
   - Log real-time in-situ temperature profiles across the central **$300\text{ mm}$** flat zone under stabilized laminar gas flow.
   - Calculate zone-to-zone cross-coupling offsets between the Load, Center, and Source zones.

5. **Post-Profile Controlled Retraction:**
   - Following dynamic profiling, ramp down the furnace assembly and retract the thermocouple profiling boat at a mechanical velocity strictly **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$**.

---

### 2. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria

| Metric Parameter | Target Specification | Physical Units | Inspection Tool / Metrology |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Isothermal Flat Zone Uniformity** | $\le \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Multi-point Type R/S Pt-Rh Thermocouple array across central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat region |
| **Furnace Qualification Thermal Band** | $800\text{ to }1150$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Triple-loop digital PID controller data logger |
| **Boat Insertion / Retraction Velocity** | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/minute}$ | Automated cantilever drive encoder |
| **Carrier Gas Purge Flow Rate** | $1\text{ to }5$ | $\text{SLPM}$ | Calibrated Mass Flow Controller (MFC) |

---

### 3. Literature Context & Source Citations

- **[Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation]:**
  - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling regulating Kanthal-A1 or Super Kanthal $\text{MoSi}_2$ coils (Load, Center, Source).
  - Temperature uniformity requirement of $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$ across the central $300\text{ mm}$ wafer boat flat zone within the $800^\circ\text{C}\text{ to }1150^\circ\text{C}$ range.
  - Quartz thermowell-encased Type R or Type S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples.
  - Laminar gas flow regulation via MFC at $1\text{ to }5\text{ SLPM}$ ($N_2$, $O_2$, forming gas).
  - Mechanical boat travel velocity $< 50\text{ mm/minute}$ to prevent crystallographic slip dislocations.
- **[Legacy 180nm DRAM Architecture & Cell Capacitor Engineering]:**
  - Gate dielectric dry thermal oxidation window of $850^\circ\text{C}\text{--}900^\circ\text{C}$ requiring strict flat-zone thermal budget control to ensure uniform $~3.5\text{ nm}$ physical $SiO_2$ growth.

# Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) ## Document ID: SOP-FURN-CAL-004 **Title:** 300mm Boat Isothermal Flat Zone ±0.5°C Steady-State Mapping & Drift Verification **Context:** 180nm Open-Source DRAM Chip (DRAM Foundation VN) > Fused Quartz Tube 3-Zone PID Furnace Assembly > Isothermal Flat Zone Dynamic Profiling & Metrology Calibration **Equipment Architecture:** Horizontal fused quartz process tube (99.999% purity $SiO_2$, OD 150–200 mm), 3-Zone resistive heating element (Source, Center, Load zones; Kanthal A1 / APM / MoSi₂), triple-loop digital PID controller, dual Type R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells, multi-point profiling thermocouple cart. --- ### 1. Workflow Architecture & Signal Flow ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Pre-Calibration Gas Purge
N₂ at 2.0–5.0 SLPM"] --> B["Boat Insertion
Speed < 50 mm/min"] B --> C["Thermal Soak & PID Ramp
800°C to 1150°C (Center Zone)"] C --> D["Multi-Point Profiling Scan
300 mm Boat Region (50 mm steps)"] D --> E["Feedforward PID Tuning
Source & Load Convective Trim"] E --> F["Steady-State Drift Logging
ΔT ≤ ±0.5°C Over 60 min"] ``` --- ### 2. Step-by-Step Operating Procedure #### Step 1: Pre-Calibration Purge & Ambient Back-Diffusion Prevention 1. Verify fused quartz process tube seal integrity ($150\text{ mm}$ to $200\text{ mm}$ OD). 2. Configure Mass Flow Controllers (MFCs) to establish a continuous, laminar purge sweep using high-purity carrier gas ($N_2$ purge, $99.999\%$ purity) at **$2.0\text{ to }5.0\text{ SLPM}$** to prevent ambient back-diffusion. #### Step 2: Safe Profiling Boat Insertion (Dislocation Guard) 1. Load the multi-point Type R/S calibration profiling thermocouple array into the dedicated fused quartz wafer boat ($300\text{ mm}$ wafer payload envelope). 2. Engage the mechanical cantilever drive mechanism. 3. Advance the boat into the process tube at a controlled velocity strictly **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** until centered within the primary flat zone. > **Critical Control:** Insertion speeds exceeding $50\text{ mm/minute}$ generate severe steep thermal gradients inducing crystallographic slip dislocations across the silicon substrate. #### Step 3: Closed-Loop PID Setpoint Stabilization 1. Command the triple-loop digital PID controller to ramp the three heating zones (Load, Center, Source) to the target calibration setpoint (**$800^\circ\text{C}$ to $1150^\circ\text{C}$**, qualification target at $1000^\circ\text{C}$). 2. Allow a thermal stabilization soak time of not less than 45 minutes until zone temperature derivatives reach steady state ($|dT/dt| < 0.05^\circ\text{C/min}$). #### Step 4: Multi-Point Spatial Mapping Across the 300 mm Boat Region 1. Execute profiling scan across the central flat zone encompassing the **$300\text{ mm}$ boat region** (within the nominal $350\text{ mm}$ furnace center flat zone). 2. Record temperature readings at $50\text{ mm}$ axial increments using calibrated Type R/S Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouples. 3. Calculate spatial thermal uniformity: $$\Delta T_{\text{spatial}} = T_{\text{max}} - T_{\text{min}}$$ #### Step 5: Feedforward Decoupling Trim & 60-Minute Drift Verification 1. If $\Delta T_{\text{spatial}} > 1.0^\circ\text{C}$ peak-to-peak (or deviation from setpoint exceeds $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$), apply independent trim offsets to the Source zone (compensating gas inlet cooling) and Load zone (compensating furnace door radiative/convective losses). 2. Once within $\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$, initiate continuous steady-state logging for **60 minutes** at 1 Hz sample rate to record temporal drift ($\sigma_{\text{drift}}$). --- ### 3. Machine-Measurable Acceptance Criteria | Target Parameter | Operational Metric | Target Threshold | Physical Units | Pass/Fail Logic | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Center Flat Zone Uniformity** | Spatial profile delta over 300 mm boat ($T_{\text{max}} - T_{\text{min}}$) | $\le 1.0$ (within $\pm 0.5$) | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Mandatory Stop Gate | | **Temporal Temperature Drift** | Maximum temperature drift over 60 min steady-state soak | $\le \pm 0.5$ | $^\circ\text{C}$ | Pass / Retune PID | | **Mechanical Transfer Speed** | Profiling boat insertion / extraction drive velocity | $< 50$ | $\text{mm/min}$ | Hard Interlock ($> 50 \implies \text{Abort}$) | | **Laminar Sweep Carrier Gas Flow** | Carrier gas delivery via calibrated MFC ($N_2 / O_2$) | $2.0 \text{ to } 5.0$ | $\text{SLPM}$ | MFC Out-of-Spec Alarm | --- ### 4. Source Literature Citations 1. **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Thermal Dynamics and PID Temperature Regulation**: - Triple-loop digital PID controller with feedforward decoupling and Type R/S Platinum-Rhodium thermocouples encased in quartz thermowells. - Temperature uniformity requirement of **$\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** across the central **$300\text{ mm}$** wafer boat region between **$800^\circ\text{C}\text{ and }1150^\circ\text{C}$**. - Mechanical push/pull speed limit of **$< 50\text{ mm/minute}$** to eliminate thermal shock and crystallographic slip dislocations. 2. **Three-Zone Quartz Tube Diffusion Furnace Thermal Profiling & Gas Delivery**: - Fused quartz process tube ($150\text{ mm to }200\text{ mm}$ outer diameter, $99.999\%$ high purity $SiO_2$). - Three-zone split (Source gas inlet, Center wafer flat zone, Load door zone). - Center flat zone length: **$350\text{ mm}$** with temperature uniformity **$\le \pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** between $1000^\circ\text{C}\text{ and }1200^\circ\text{C}$. - Laminar sweep velocity gas delivery: **$2.0\text{ to }5.0\text{ SLPM}$** via calibrated MFC to eliminate back-diffusion. 3. **Deal-Grove Silicon Thermal Oxidation Kinetics in Quartz Tube Furnace**: - High-purity quartz process tube with 3-zone PID temperature regulation maintaining **$\pm 0.5^\circ\text{C}$** over the **$30\text{ cm}$ ($300\text{ mm}$)** flat zone.
